## Source: internal/plugins/kit/kit.go#Report.Text

``````
// Text renders the report in plain human-readable text.
func (r Report) Text() string {
	var b strings.Builder
	title := r.PluginID
	if title == "" {
		title = "(unidentified plugin)"
	}
	if r.Version != "" {
		title += " " + r.Version
	}
	if r.Kind != "" {
		title += " (" + r.Kind + ")"
	}
	status := "PASS"
	if !r.OK {
		status = "FAIL"
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%s: %s (%.1fms)\n", status, title, r.DurationMS)
	for _, e := range r.Errors {
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  error: %s\n", e.String())
	}
	for _, w := range r.Warnings {
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  warn:  %s\n", w.String())
	}
	if len(r.Routes) > 0 {
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  routes:\n")
		for _, rt := range r.Routes {
			mark := "ok"
			if !rt.OK {
				mark = "fail"
			}
			if rt.Skipped {
				mark = "live test needed"
			}
			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "    %s %s %s -> %d (%.2fms / %dms)\n", mark, rt.Method, rt.Route, rt.Status, rt.DurationMS, rt.DeadlineMS)
		}
	}
	if r.HotPath != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  hot path: %d candidates in %d batches (%.1fms total, max batch %.2fms, slow %d, deterministic=%t)\n",
			r.HotPath.Candidates, r.HotPath.Batches, r.HotPath.TotalMS, r.HotPath.MaxBatchMS, r.HotPath.SlowCount, r.HotPath.Deterministic)
	}
	return b.String()
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/kit/kit.go#Load

``````
// Load reads a plugin from a directory path or an .etherpkg file path.
func Load(target string) (*Package, error) {
	info, err := os.Stat(target)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if info.IsDir() {
		return LoadDir(target)
	}
	b, err := os.ReadFile(target)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return LoadPkgBytes(b)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/kit/kit.go#LoadDir

``````
// LoadDir loads a plugin package from a filesystem directory.
func LoadDir(dir string) (*Package, error) {
	files := map[string][]byte{}
	err := filepath.WalkDir(dir, func(p string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		rel, err := filepath.Rel(dir, p)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		rel = filepath.ToSlash(rel)
		if rel == "." {
			return nil
		}
		if d.IsDir() {
			if d.Name() == ".git" || d.Name() == "node_modules" {
				return filepath.SkipDir
			}
			return nil
		}
		if strings.HasSuffix(rel, ".etherpkg") {
			return nil
		}
		b, err := os.ReadFile(p)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		files[rel] = b
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	manRaw, ok := files["manifest.json"]
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("kit: directory %s has no manifest.json", dir)
	}
	man, err := plugins.ParseManifest(manRaw)
	if err != nil {
		return &Package{ManifestRaw: manRaw, Files: files, Dir: dir}, err
	}
	pkg := &Package{ManifestRaw: manRaw, Manifest: man, Files: files, Dir: dir}
	if man.Ether != nil && man.Ether.Runtime.Kind == "hosted" && isTSPath(man.Ether.Runtime.Entry) {
		entry := man.Ether.Runtime.Entry
		if isUnsafePath(entry) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("kit: unsafe entry %q", entry)
		}
		result := api.Build(api.BuildOptions{AbsWorkingDir: mustAbs(dir), EntryPoints: []string{entry}, Bundle: true, Write: false, Format: api.FormatIIFE, GlobalName: "__plugin", Platform: api.PlatformNeutral, Target: api.ES2020, LogLevel: api.LogLevelSilent})
		if len(result.Errors) != 0 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("kit: bundle: %s", result.Errors[0].Text)
		}
		manRaw, err = withEntry(manRaw, bundleEntry)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		man, err = plugins.ParseManifest(manRaw)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		files[bundleEntry] = result.OutputFiles[0].Contents
		files["manifest.json"] = manRaw
		pkg.ManifestRaw, pkg.Manifest = manRaw, man
	}
	return pkg, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/kit/kit.go#LoadPkgBytes

``````
// LoadPkgBytes loads a plugin package from .etherpkg zip bytes, verifying
// the digest entry when present.
func LoadPkgBytes(raw []byte) (*Package, error) {
	zr, err := zip.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(raw), int64(len(raw)))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("kit: open package: %w", err)
	}
	files := map[string][]byte{}
	var total int64
	for _, f := range zr.File {
		name := strings.TrimPrefix(filepath.ToSlash(f.Name), "./")
		if f.FileInfo().IsDir() || isUnsafePath(name) || strings.HasPrefix(name, "__MACOSX") {
			continue
		}
		rc, err := f.Open()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		b, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(rc, 64<<20))
		_ = rc.Close()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		total += int64(len(b))
		if total > 128<<20 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("kit: package exceeds 128 MiB limit")
		}
		files[name] = b
	}
	manRaw, ok := files["manifest.json"]
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("kit: package has no manifest.json")
	}
	if d, ok := files["digest"]; ok {
		want := plugins.PkgDigest(files)
		if strings.TrimSpace(string(d)) != want {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("kit: package digest mismatch")
		}
	}
	man, err := plugins.ParseManifest(manRaw)
	if err != nil {
		return &Package{ManifestRaw: manRaw, Files: files}, err
	}
	return &Package{ManifestRaw: manRaw, Manifest: man, Files: files}, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/kit/kit.go#Pack

``````
// Pack compiles any TypeScript entry via wasm.Compile, bundles manifest,
// compiled JS/WASM, assets, schema, strings, and writes the verified
// `digest` entry into an installable .etherpkg archive.
func Pack(pkg *Package) ([]byte, error) {
	if pkg == nil || len(pkg.ManifestRaw) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("kit: pack: empty package")
	}
	man, err := plugins.ParseManifest(pkg.ManifestRaw)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := man.Validate(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	outFiles := map[string][]byte{}
	for k, v := range pkg.Files {
		if k == "digest" || strings.HasPrefix(k, "tests/") || strings.HasSuffix(k, ".test.js") || strings.HasSuffix(k, ".test.ts") {
			continue
		}
		outFiles[k] = v
	}
	outFiles["manifest.json"] = pkg.ManifestRaw

	if man.Ether != nil && man.Ether.Runtime.Kind == "hosted" && man.Ether.Runtime.Entry != "" {
		entry := man.Ether.Runtime.Entry
		if _, hasEntry := outFiles[entry]; !hasEntry {
			// Look for a TypeScript source that compiles to entry (e.g. src/index.ts -> dist/plugin.js).
			tsEntry := findTSEntry(pkg.Files, entry)
			if tsEntry == "" {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("kit: pack: entry %q not found and no TypeScript source found", entry)
			}
			srcMap := collectSources(pkg.Files)
			js, smap, diags := wasm.Compile(srcMap, tsEntry)
			if err := compileDiagsError(diags); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			outFiles[entry] = js
			if len(smap) > 0 {
				outFiles[entry+".map"] = smap
			}
		} else if isTSPath(entry) {
			// The bundle goes to a .js entry and the manifest follows it,
			// keeping the source beside it. Left at the .ts path, the host
			// would compile the bundle again and its exports would vanish
			// inside the second wrapper.
			srcMap := collectSources(pkg.Files)
			js, smap, diags := wasm.Compile(srcMap, entry)
			if err := compileDiagsError(diags); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			manRaw, err := withEntry(pkg.ManifestRaw, bundleEntry)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			outFiles["manifest.json"] = manRaw
			outFiles[bundleEntry] = js
			delete(outFiles, bundleEntry+".map")
			if len(smap) > 0 {
				outFiles[bundleEntry+".map"] = smap
			}
		}
	}

	// Compute deterministic digest over sorted package files.
	outFiles["digest"] = []byte(plugins.PkgDigest(outFiles))

	names := make([]string, 0, len(outFiles))
	for name := range outFiles {
		names = append(names, name)
	}
	sort.Strings(names)

	var buf bytes.Buffer
	zw := zip.NewWriter(&buf)
	for _, name := range names {
		w, err := zw.Create(name)
		if err != nil {
			_ = zw.Close()
			return nil, err
		}
		if _, err := w.Write(outFiles[name]); err != nil {
			_ = zw.Close()
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	if err := zw.Close(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return buf.Bytes(), nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/kit/kit.go#withEntry

``````
// withEntry returns manifest JSON whose hosted runtime entry is entry.
func withEntry(manRaw []byte, entry string) ([]byte, error) {
	var doc map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(manRaw, &doc); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	ether, _ := doc["ether"].(map[string]any)
	runtime, _ := ether["runtime"].(map[string]any)
	if runtime == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("kit: manifest runtime is missing")
	}
	runtime["entry"] = entry
	return json.Marshal(doc)
}
``````

func isTSPath(p string) bool {
	ext := strings.ToLower(path.Ext(p))
	return ext == ".ts" || ext == ".tsx" || ext == ".mts"
}

## Source: internal/plugins/kit/kit.go#findTSEntry

``````
func findTSEntry(files map[string][]byte, entry string) string {
	candidates := []string{
		strings.TrimSuffix(entry, path.Ext(entry)) + ".ts",
		"src/index.ts",
		"src/plugin.ts",
		"index.ts",
		"plugin.ts",
	}
	for _, c := range candidates {
		if _, ok := files[c]; ok {
			return c
		}
	}
	return ""
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/kit/kit.go#collectSources

``````
func collectSources(files map[string][]byte) map[string]string {
	out := map[string]string{}
	for k, v := range files {
		ext := strings.ToLower(path.Ext(k))
		if ext == ".ts" || ext == ".tsx" || ext == ".mts" || ext == ".js" || ext == ".json" {
			out[k] = string(v)
		}
	}
	return out
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/kit/kit.go#compileDiagsError

``````
func compileDiagsError(diags []wasm.Diagnostic) error {
	var errs []string
	for _, d := range diags {
		if d.Severity == "error" {
			if d.File != "" && d.Line > 0 {
				errs = append(errs, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d:%d: %s", d.File, d.Line, d.Column, d.Text))
			} else {
				errs = append(errs, d.Text)
			}
		}
	}
	if len(errs) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("compile: %s", strings.Join(errs, "; "))
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/kit/kit.go#CheckInstall

``````
// CheckInstall adapts the conformance report to the plugin host's validation error.
func CheckInstall(ctx context.Context, manifest []byte, files map[string][]byte) error {
	report := Check(ctx, &Package{ManifestRaw: manifest, Files: files})
	if report.OK {
		return nil
	}
	fields := make([]plugins.FieldError, 0, len(report.Errors))
	for _, issue := range report.Errors {
		fields = append(fields, plugins.FieldError{Field: issue.Field, Message: issue.Message})
	}
	return &plugins.ValidationError{Fields: fields}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/kit/templates.go#Scaffold

``````
// Scaffold generates a minimal working plugin for the requested kind and
// language in opts.Dir. Every generated template passes kit.Check out of
// the box.
func Scaffold(opts TemplateOptions) error {
	if opts.Kind == "" {
		opts.Kind = string(plugins.KindLiveTVSource)
	}
	switch plugins.Kind(opts.Kind) {
	case plugins.KindSource, plugins.KindIntegration, plugins.KindNotificationChannel, plugins.KindLiveTVSource, plugins.KindExtension:
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("unknown plugin kind %q (must be source, integration, notification_channel, livetv_source or extension)", opts.Kind)
	}
	if opts.Lang == "" {
		opts.Lang = "ts"
	}
	switch opts.Lang {
	case "ts", "js", "python":
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("unknown language %q (must be ts, js or python)", opts.Lang)
	}
	if opts.Dir == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("target directory is required")
	}
	if entries, err := os.ReadDir(opts.Dir); err == nil {
		if len(entries) != 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("target directory %q is not empty", opts.Dir)
		}
	} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return err
	}
	base := strings.ToLower(filepath.Base(opts.Dir))
	slug := strings.Trim(slugCleanRe.ReplaceAllString(base, "-"), "-")
	if slug == "" || !(slug[0] >= 'a' && slug[0] <= 'z') {
		slug = "sample-" + slug
		slug = strings.Trim(slug, "-")
	}
	if opts.ID == "" {
		opts.ID = "community.example." + strings.ReplaceAll(slug, "-", "")
	}
	if opts.Name == "" {
		opts.Name = humanName(slug)
	}

	files, err := GenerateTemplateFiles(opts)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for rel, content := range files {
		full := filepath.Join(opts.Dir, filepath.FromSlash(rel))
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(full), 0o755); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(full, content, 0o644); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/kit/templates.go#humanName

``````
func humanName(slug string) string {
	parts := strings.Split(slug, "-")
	for i, p := range parts {
		if len(p) > 0 {
			if i == 0 {
				parts[i] = strings.ToUpper(p[:1]) + p[1:]
			} else {
				parts[i] = p
			}
		}
	}
	name := strings.Join(parts, " ")
	if name == "" {
		return "Sample plugin"
	}
	return name
}
``````

func generatePluginCode(lang string) string {
	if lang == "python" {
		return `#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Minimal Ether remote sidecar plugin."""

import json
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer


def handle_request(method: str, path: str, headers: dict, body: bytes) -> tuple[int, dict]:
    if path == "/ether/health":
        return 200, {"status": "ok"}
    if path == "/ether/configure":
        return 200, {"errors": {}}
    if path == "/ether/test":
        return 200, {"ok": True, "message": "Connection verified"}
    if path == "/ether/channels.json":
        return 200, {
            "channels": [
                {
                    "id": "ch-1",
                    "number": "101",
                    "name": "Sample Channel",
                    "group": "General",
                    "streams": [{"url": "https://example.org/live/stream.m3u8"}],
                }
            ]
        }
    if path.startswith("/ether/guide/"):
        return 200, {"programmes": []}
    if path.startswith("/stream/"):
        return 200, {"streams": []}
    if path.startswith("/catalog/"):
        return 200, {"metas": []}
    if path == "/ether/subtitles/download":
        if not headers.get("X-Ether-Pick") and not headers.get("x-ether-pick"):
            return 403, {"error": {"code": "pick_required", "message": "Subtitle download requires a viewer pick token"}}
        return 200, {"format": "srt", "encoding": "utf8", "data": ""}
    if path.startswith("/subtitles/"):
        return 200, {"subtitles": []}
    if path == "/ether/event":
        payload = json.loads(body.decode("utf-8") or "{}")
        events = payload.get("events", [])
        return 200, {"ack": [e.get("id", "") for e in events if e.get("id")]}
    if path.startswith("/ether/view/"):
        return 200, {
            "spec": {
                "specVersion": 1,
                "layout": "detail",
                "header": [{"kind": "page-header", "title": "$t:pageTitle", "description": "$t:pageDesc"}],
                "body": [{"kind": "stat-tile", "iconKey": "globe", "accent": "teal", "label": "$t:statLabel", "value": {"$": "activeLanguage"}}],
            },
            "data": {"activeLanguage": "en"},
        }
    if path.startswith("/ether/tool/"):
        return 200, {"status": "ok"}
    return 404, {"error": {"code": "not_found", "message": "Route not found"}}


class PluginHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        status, payload = handle_request("GET", self.path.split("?")[0], dict(self.headers), b"")
        self._respond(status, payload)

    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
        body = self.rfile.read(length) if length > 0 else b""
        status, payload = handle_request("POST", self.path.split("?")[0], dict(self.headers), body)
        self._respond(status, payload)

    def _respond(self, status: int, payload: dict):
        raw = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(raw)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(raw)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 8787), PluginHandler).serve_forever()
`
	}

function handle(req) {

  if (p.indexOf("/ether/tool/") === 0) {
    return jsonResponse(200, { status: "ok" });
  }
  if (p.indexOf("/ether/job/") === 0) {
    return jsonResponse(200, { status: "ok" });
  }
  return jsonResponse(404, {
    error: { code: "not_found", message: "Route not found" },
  });
}

function rank_key(candidate, config) {
  const target = (config && config.preferred) ? String(config.preferred) : "en";
  const langs = Array.isArray(candidate.languages) ? candidate.languages : [];
  return langs.indexOf(target) >= 0 ? 10 : 0;
}

function cond_match(candidate, operator, value) {
  const langs = Array.isArray(candidate.languages) ? candidate.languages : [];
  const has = langs.indexOf(String(value)) >= 0;
  return operator === "is_not" ? !has : has;
}

globalThis.handle = handle;
globalThis.rank_key = rank_key;
globalThis.cond_match = cond_match;

function jsonResponse(status: number, data: unknown): PluginResponse {

}

export function handle(req: PluginRequest): PluginResponse {
  const p = req.path || "/";
  if (p === "/ether/health") {

  if (p === "/ether/configure") {
    return jsonResponse(200, { errors: {} });

  if (p.startsWith("/stream/")) {

        layout: "detail",
        header: [

            kind: "page-header",

func generateReadme(opts TemplateOptions) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(`# %s

An Ether plugin (%s, %s).

## Commands

Validate the manifest, copy rules, ViewSpec pages, routes, and hot path:

    ether plugin check .

Run the recorded fixture suite:

    ether plugin test .

Build an installable package:

    ether plugin pack .

Develop against a running Ether server:

    ether plugin dev . --server http://localhost:32400

## Limits

- Only declared network hosts in `+"`manifest.json`"+` are reachable.
- User-visible copy follows Ether sentence-case and length rules.
`, opts.Name, opts.Kind, opts.Lang)
}

## Source: internal/plugins/local_hosts.go#NormalizeLocalHost

``````
// NormalizeLocalHost validates a single local-network host grant ("host" or
// "host:port", or a single IP literal with optional port, without wildcards
// or CIDRs) and returns its canonical lowercase form.
func NormalizeLocalHost(raw string) (string, error) {
	norm, ok := safefetch.NormalizeTrustedHost(raw)
	if !ok {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("must be a host name or single IP address (with optional :port), without wildcards or CIDRs")
	}
	return norm, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/local_hosts.go#normalizeLocalHosts

``````
func normalizeLocalHosts(in []string) ([]string, error) {
	if in == nil {
		return nil, nil
	}
	out := make([]string, 0, len(in))
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, raw := range in {
		if strings.TrimSpace(raw) == "" {
			continue
		}
		norm, err := NormalizeLocalHost(raw)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if !seen[norm] {
			seen[norm] = true
			out = append(out, norm)
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/local_hosts.go#localListCoversHost

``````
func localListCoversHost(entries []string, hostName string) bool {
	normHost, ok := safefetch.NormalizeTrustedHost(hostName)
	if !ok {
		return false
	}
	for _, raw := range entries {
		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(raw), OperatorNetworkEntry) {
			continue
		}
		norm, ok := safefetch.NormalizeTrustedHost(raw)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		if norm == normHost {
			return true
		}
		if h, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(norm); err == nil && h == normHost {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/local_hosts.go#localGrantCoversBlockedEntry

``````
func localGrantCoversBlockedEntry(granted []string, blocked string) bool {
	u, err := url.Parse("http://" + blocked)
	if err != nil || u.Hostname() == "" {
		return false
	}
	if u.Port() != "" {
		return safefetch.TrustedHostMatchesURL(granted, u)
	}
	for _, g := range granted {
		norm, ok := safefetch.NormalizeTrustedHost(g)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		if norm == blocked {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/local_hosts.go#IsLocalNetworkHost

``````
// IsLocalNetworkHost reports whether raw is an exact non-public LAN host
// (dotless hostname, .local, .lan, .home.arpa, or a private/CGNAT IP literal).
// Loopback (localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1), "operator", and wildcards are excluded
// so a manifest never pre-grants loopback or operator-placeholder access.
func IsLocalNetworkHost(raw string) bool {
	if strings.Contains(raw, "*") || strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(raw), OperatorNetworkEntry) {
		return false
	}
	norm, ok := safefetch.NormalizeTrustedHost(raw)
	if !ok {
		return false
	}
	host := norm
	if h, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(norm); err == nil {
		host = h
	}
	host = strings.Trim(host, "[]")
	if host == "localhost" || strings.HasSuffix(host, ".localhost") {
		return false
	}
	if ip, err := netip.ParseAddr(host); err == nil {
		return safefetch.IsPrivateLANIP(ip)
	}
	return !strings.Contains(host, ".") ||
		strings.HasSuffix(host, ".local") ||
		strings.HasSuffix(host, ".lan") ||
		strings.HasSuffix(host, ".home.arpa")
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/local_hosts.go#DeclaredLocalHosts

``````
// DeclaredLocalHosts returns any local-network hosts declared in a manifest's
// permissions.network list, normalized and deduplicated.
func DeclaredLocalHosts(man Manifest) []string {
	if man.Ether == nil {
		return nil
	}
	var out []string
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, h := range man.Ether.Permissions.Network {
		if !IsLocalNetworkHost(h) {
			continue
		}
		norm, ok := safefetch.NormalizeTrustedHost(h)
		if !ok || seen[norm] {
			continue
		}
		seen[norm] = true
		out = append(out, norm)
	}
	return out
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/local_hosts.go#isValidManifestNetworkEntry

``````
func isValidManifestNetworkEntry(raw string) bool {
	if raw == OperatorNetworkEntry {
		return true
	}
	if strings.EqualFold(raw, OperatorNetworkEntry) || strings.Contains(raw, "://") {
		return false
	}
	lower := strings.ToLower(raw)
	if hostRe.MatchString(lower) {
		return true
	}
	if strings.Contains(raw, "*") {
		return false
	}
	_, ok := safefetch.NormalizeTrustedHost(raw)
	return ok
}
``````

func networkHostDeclaredOrGranted(man Manifest, g Grants, host string) bool {

		}

## Source: internal/plugins/local_hosts.go#urlHostPortDisplay

``````
func urlHostPortDisplay(u *url.URL) string {
	if u == nil || u.Hostname() == "" {
		return ""
	}
	if port := u.Port(); port != "" {
		if norm, ok := safefetch.NormalizeTrustedHost(net.JoinHostPort(u.Hostname(), port)); ok {
			return norm
		}
	}
	if norm, ok := safefetch.NormalizeTrustedHost(u.Hostname()); ok {
		return norm
	}
	return strings.ToLower(u.Hostname())
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/local_hosts.go#*host.allowNetworkURL

``````
func (h *host) allowNetworkURL(ctx context.Context, u *url.URL) error {
	if err := h.m.CheckIndexerNetwork(u.Hostname()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	r, g, err := h.record(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if r.Manifest.Ether == nil {
		return ErrPermissionDenied
	}
	if g.revoked("network") {
		h.noteDenied("network")
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: network", ErrPermissionDenied)
	}
	if networkAllowedURL(r.Manifest.Ether.Permissions.Network, u) ||
		g.allowsLocalURL(u) ||
		(DeclaresOperatorHosts(r.Manifest) && g.allowsOperatorURL(u)) {
		return nil
	}
	if DeclaresOperatorHosts(r.Manifest) {
		blocked := urlHostPortDisplay(u)
		h.m.noteBlockedOperatorHost(ctx, h.plugin, blocked)
		return &BlockedOperatorHostError{Host: blocked}
	}
	if IsLocalNetworkHost(u.Hostname()) {
		blocked := urlHostPortDisplay(u)
		h.m.noteBlockedLocalHost(ctx, h.plugin, blocked)
		return &BlockedLocalHostError{Host: blocked}
	}
	h.noteDenied("network")
	return fmt.Errorf("%w: network", ErrPermissionDenied)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/local_hosts.go#*Manager.noteBlockedLocalHost

``````
func (m *Manager) noteBlockedLocalHost(ctx context.Context, pluginID, blocked string) {
	norm, ok := safefetch.NormalizeTrustedHost(blocked)
	if !ok || pluginID == "" {
		return
	}
	if g, err := m.store.grants(ctx, pluginID); err == nil {
		if localGrantCoversBlockedEntry(g.LocalHosts, norm) {
			return
		}
	}
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	if m.blockedLocal == nil {
		m.blockedLocal = map[string][]string{}
	}
	cur := m.blockedLocal[pluginID]
	next := make([]string, 0, min(len(cur)+1, maxBlockedLocalHosts))
	for _, existing := range cur {
		if existing != norm {
			next = append(next, existing)
		}
	}
	next = append(next, norm)
	if len(next) > maxBlockedLocalHosts {
		next = next[len(next)-maxBlockedLocalHosts:]
	}
	m.blockedLocal[pluginID] = next
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/local_hosts.go#*Manager.BlockedLocalHosts

// BlockedLocalHosts returns recently blocked private-network hosts (up to 10
// distinct entries) for one plugin, oldest to newest.
func (m *Manager) BlockedLocalHosts(pluginID string) []string {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	src := m.blockedLocal[pluginID]
	if len(src) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]string, len(src))
	copy(out, src)
	return out
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/local_hosts.go#*Manager.pruneBlockedLocalHosts

``````
func (m *Manager) pruneBlockedLocalHosts(pluginID string, granted []string) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	cur := m.blockedLocal[pluginID]
	if len(cur) == 0 {
		return
	}
	kept := cur[:0]
	for _, b := range cur {
		if !localGrantCoversBlockedEntry(granted, b) {
			kept = append(kept, b)
		}
	}
	if len(kept) == 0 {
		delete(m.blockedLocal, pluginID)
		return
	}
	m.blockedLocal[pluginID] = kept
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#ParseManifest

``````
// ParseManifest decodes manifest JSON. Unknown fields are ignored (SPEC
// §5.1.1). Call Validate before trusting the result.
func ParseManifest(raw []byte) (Manifest, error) {
	var m Manifest
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	if err := dec.Decode(&m); err != nil {
		return Manifest{}, fmt.Errorf("plugins: manifest: %w", err)
	}
	return m, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#*Manifest.UnmarshalJSON

``````
// UnmarshalJSON completes a Stremio-backed plugin's roles from its
// catalogs and resources wherever a manifest is read: packages, stored
// records and drafts alike.
func (m *Manifest) UnmarshalJSON(b []byte) error {
	type plain Manifest
	var p plain
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &p); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	*m = Manifest(p)
	if m.Ether != nil && m.Ether.Stremio {
		m.Ether = m.withStremioRoles()
	}
	return nil
}

var (
	idRe             = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9]+(\.[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*)+$`)
	keyRe            = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$`)
	posterBadgeKeyRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$`)
	liveFeedIDRe     = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$`)
	pluginEventKeyRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*){0,2}$`)
	flowActionKeyRe  = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$`)
	eventFieldNameRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*(\.[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)*$`)
	flowParamKeyRe   = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$`)
	toolNameRe       = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,63}$`)
	hostRe           = regexp.MustCompile(`^(\*\.)?([a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?\.)*[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$`)
	bannedRe         = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)\b(simply|easily|just)\b`)
	// dockerImageRe accepts registry/name:tag or name@sha256:digest, with no
	// spaces or shell metacharacters.
	dockerImageRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._/:@-]*$`)

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#LintCopy

``````
// LintCopy checks one user-visible string against the copy rules: at most
// max characters (0 means no limit), no em or en dashes, no exclamation
// marks, no "simply", "just" or "easily", and sentence case. It returns a
// plain reason, or "" when the copy passes. Shared with the kit (WS11).
func LintCopy(s string, max int) string {
	s = strings.TrimSpace(s)
	switch {
	case max > 0 && utf8.RuneCountInString(s) > max:
		return fmt.Sprintf("is longer than %d characters", max)
	case strings.ContainsAny(s, "—–"):
		return "must not contain em or en dashes"
	case strings.Contains(s, "!"):
		return "must not contain exclamation marks"
	case bannedRe.MatchString(s):
		return "must not use the words simply, just or easily"
	}
	for _, r := range s {
		if unicode.IsLetter(r) {
			if unicode.IsLower(r) {
				return "must use sentence case"
			}
			break
		}
	}
	// Reject Title Case: more than two thirds of words capitalised, so one
	// proper noun ("Screenings this Friday") still passes.
	words := strings.Fields(s)
	if len(words) >= 3 {
		caps := 0
		for _, w := range words {
			r, _ := utf8.DecodeRuneInString(w)
			if unicode.IsUpper(r) {
				caps++
			}
		}
		if caps*3 > len(words)*2 {
			return "must use sentence case"
		}
	}
	return ""
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#Manifest.Validate

``````
// Validate checks every field rule in SPEC §5.1.1 and §5.1.3 and the copy
// rules for summary and contribution labels. It returns a
// *ValidationError listing all problems, or nil.
func (m Manifest) Validate() error {
	var f []FieldError
	add := func(field, msg string) { f = append(f, FieldError{field, msg}) }

	switch {
	case !(idRe.MatchString(m.ID) || (m.Ether == nil && regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+(\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)+$`).MatchString(m.ID))):
		add("id", "must be a reverse-DNS id in lower case, such as community.example.plugin")
	case len(m.ID) > 120:
		add("id", "is longer than 120 characters")
	}
	if _, ok := ParseSemVer(m.Version); !ok {
		add("version", "must be a version such as 1.2.0")
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(m.Name) == "" {
		add("name", "is required")
	} else if m.Ether != nil && utf8.RuneCountInString(m.Name) > 60 {
		add("name", "is longer than 60 characters")
	}
	if m.Ether != nil && strings.TrimSpace(m.Description) != "" {
		if msg := LintCopy(m.Description, 300); msg != "" {
			add("description", msg)
		}
	}
	if m.Ether == nil {
		if len(f) > 0 {
			return &ValidationError{f}
		}
		return nil
	}
	e := m.Ether
	if e.Protocol != Protocol {
		add("ether.protocol", fmt.Sprintf("this version of Ether speaks plugin protocol %d", Protocol))
	}
	if !knownKinds[e.Kind] {
		add("ether.kind", "must be source, integration, notification_channel, livetv_source, extension or content")
	}
	if e.Kind == "sign_in" {
		add("ether.kind", "sign_in is reserved for a later release")
	}
	seenCap := map[Capability]bool{}
	for i, c := range e.Capabilities {
		field := fmt.Sprintf("ether.capabilities[%d]", i)
		switch {
		case ReservedCapabilities[c]:
			add(field, string(c)+" is reserved for a later release")
		case capabilityKinds[c] == nil && !isAnyKindCap(c):
			add(field, "unknown capability "+strconv.Quote(string(c)))
		case seenCap[c]:
			add(field, "is listed twice")
		default:
			// An add-on-backed plugin's roles come from its Stremio
			// resources, which may combine (a catalogue that also streams).
			if allowed := capabilityKinds[c]; allowed != nil && !allowed[e.Kind] && !e.Stremio {
				add(field, string(c)+" is not allowed for kind "+string(e.Kind))
			}
		}
		seenCap[c] = true
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(e.Summary, "$t:") {
		if strings.TrimSpace(e.Summary) == "" {
			add("ether.summary", "is required")
		} else if msg := LintCopy(e.Summary, 80); msg != "" {
			add("ether.summary", msg)
		}
	}
	if e.Icon != "" && !strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(e.Icon), ".svg") && !strings.HasPrefix(e.Icon, "http") {
		add("ether.icon", "must be an SVG file")
	}
	if len(e.Contributes.Looks) > 0 && !m.HasCapability(CapLiveTVPack) {
		add("ether.capabilities", "livetv_pack is required for style contributions")
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapLiveTVPack) && e.Runtime.Kind != "data" {
		add("ether.runtime.kind", "style packs require the data runtime")
	}
	switch e.Runtime.Kind {
	case "data":
		if e.Kind != KindExtension || len(e.Capabilities) != 1 || !m.HasCapability(CapLiveTVPack) || len(e.Contributes.Looks) != 1 {
			add("ether.contributes.looks", "a data package must contribute exactly one style")
		}
		if e.Runtime.Entry != "" || e.Runtime.Module != "" {
			add("ether.runtime", "data packages run no code")
		}
		c := e.Contributes
		c.Looks = nil
		raw, _ := json.Marshal(c)
		if string(raw) != "{}" {
			add("ether.contributes", "data packages may contribute only styles")
		}
		permissions, _ := json.Marshal(e.Permissions)
		empty, _ := json.Marshal(Permissions{})
		if string(permissions) != string(empty) || len(e.Schedule) > 0 {
			add("ether.permissions", "data packages require no permissions or schedules")
		}
		for _, look := range e.Contributes.Looks {
			if look.ID == "" || look.File == "" || unsafePath(look.File) {
				add("ether.contributes.looks", "style files must stay inside the package")
			}
		}

	case "hosted":
		if e.Runtime.Entry == "" && e.Runtime.Module == "" {
			add("ether.runtime", "a hosted plugin needs an entry or module file")
		}
		if e.Runtime.Entry != "" && e.Runtime.Module != "" {
			add("ether.runtime", "give either entry or module, not both")
		}
		for _, p := range []string{e.Runtime.Entry, e.Runtime.Module} {
			if unsafePath(p) {
				add("ether.runtime", "file paths must stay inside the package")
			}
		}
	case "remote":
		if e.Runtime.Entry != "" || e.Runtime.Module != "" {
			add("ether.runtime", "a remote plugin has no entry or module file")
		}
	default:
		add("ether.runtime.kind", "must be hosted, remote or data")
	}
	if l := e.Runtime.Limits; l != nil {
		switch e.Runtime.Kind {
		case "hosted":
		case "remote":
			if l.MemoryBytes > 0 || l.Deadline != "" || l.UnitBudget > 0 || l.PoolSize > 0 {
				add("ether.runtime.limits", "remote plugins cannot request hosted memory, deadline, unitBudget or poolSize")
			}
		default:
			add("ether.runtime.limits", "data packages cannot request runtime limits")
		}
		if l.Deadline != "" {
			if d, err := time.ParseDuration(l.Deadline); err != nil || d <= 0 {
				add("ether.runtime.limits.deadline", "must be a positive duration such as 120s")
			}
		}
		if l.FetchBytes < 0 || l.ArchiveMemberBytes < 0 || l.ArchiveExpandedBytes < 0 || l.ArchiveMembers < 0 || l.MaxItems < 0 {
			add("ether.runtime.limits", "data ceilings must not be negative")
		}
		if l.UnitBudget < 0 {
			add("ether.runtime.limits.unitBudget", "must not be negative")
		}
		if l.PoolSize < 0 {
			add("ether.runtime.limits.poolSize", "must not be negative")
		}
	}
	validateSidecar(e, add)
	if e.Cluster != "" && e.Cluster != "leader" && e.Cluster != "every_node" {
		add("ether.cluster", "must be leader or every_node")
	}
	if e.Health.Interval != "" {
		d, err := time.ParseDuration(e.Health.Interval)
		if err != nil || d < 15*time.Second {
			add("ether.health.interval", "must be a duration of at least 15s")
		}
	}
	for i, s := range e.Schedule {
		field := fmt.Sprintf("ether.schedule[%d]", i)
		d, err := time.ParseDuration(s.Every)
		if err != nil || d < 15*time.Minute {
			add(field+".every", "must be a duration of at least 15m")
		}
		if !strings.HasPrefix(s.Call, "/") {
			add(field+".call", "must be a plugin route starting with /")
		}
	}
	validatePermissions(e.Permissions, add)
	if normLevel(e.Permissions.Sources) != "none" && !m.HasCapability(CapKindResolver) {
		add("ether.permissions.sources", "needs the kind_resolver capability")
	}
	validateSettings(e.Settings, add)
	usesT := strings.HasPrefix(e.Summary, "$t:") || contributesUseT(e.Contributes)
	if usesT {
		if _, ok := e.Strings["en"]; !ok {
			add("ether.strings", "an en strings file is required when $t: keys are used")
		}
	}
	validateContributes(m, add)
	validateOnAir(m, add)
	if len(f) > 0 {
		return &ValidationError{f}
	}
	return nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#unsafePath

``````
func unsafePath(p string) bool {
	if p == "" {
		return false
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(p, "/") || strings.ContainsAny(p, "\\\x00") {
		return true
	}
	for _, seg := range strings.Split(p, "/") {
		if seg == ".." {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#validateSidecar

``````
// validateSidecar checks the ether.sidecar block. It is additive and only
// meaningful for a remote runtime: a hosted plugin cannot ship one.
func validateSidecar(e *EtherBlock, add func(string, string)) {
	if e.Sidecar == nil {
		return
	}
	if e.Runtime.Kind != "remote" {
		add("ether.sidecar", "only a remote plugin has a sidecar block")
	}
	s := e.Sidecar
	if s.Docker != "" {
		if len(s.Docker) > 255 || !dockerImageRe.MatchString(s.Docker) || strings.Contains(s.Docker, "..") {
			add("ether.sidecar.docker", "must be an image reference such as registry/name:tag")
		}
	}
	if s.Download != "" && !isHTTPSURL(s.Download) {
		add("ether.sidecar.download", "must be an https URL")
	}
	if s.Docs != "" && !isHTTPSURL(s.Docs) {
		add("ether.sidecar.docs", "must be an https URL")
	}
	if s.Command != "" {
		if strings.ContainsAny(s.Command, "\r\n") || len(s.Command) > 200 {
			add("ether.sidecar.command", "must be a single line of at most 200 characters")
		}
	}
	// A download with no way to start it is not usable.
	if s.Download != "" && s.Command == "" {
		add("ether.sidecar.command", "is required when a download is given")
	}
}
``````

func isHTTPSURL(s string) bool {
	return strings.HasPrefix(s, "https://") && len(s) > len("https://")
}

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#validatePermissions

``````
func validatePermissions(p Permissions, add func(string, string)) {
	for i, h := range p.Network {
		if !isValidManifestNetworkEntry(h) {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("ether.permissions.network[%d]", i), "must be a host name, \"operator\", or a wildcard only as *.example.com")
		}
	}
	level := func(field, v string, allowed ...string) {
		for _, a := range allowed {
			if v == a {
				return
			}
		}
		add(field, "must be one of "+strings.Join(allowed, ", "))
	}
	level("ether.permissions.catalog", normLevel(p.Catalog), "none", "read")
	level("ether.permissions.collections", normLevel(p.Collections), "none", "write")
	level("ether.permissions.folders", normLevel(p.Folders), "none", "read")
	level("ether.permissions.sources", normLevel(p.Sources), "none", "search", "search+check", "acquire", "acquire+check")
	level("ether.permissions.ai", normLevel(p.AI), "none", "complete", "complete+search")
	level("ether.permissions.storage", normLevel(string(p.Storage)), "none", "durable")
	level("ether.permissions.media", normLevel(p.Media), "none", "probe")
	level("ether.permissions.viewers.identity", normLevel(p.Viewers.Identity), "none", "granted_viewers", "all")
	level("ether.permissions.viewers.watch_history", normLevel(p.Viewers.WatchHistory), "none", "granted_viewers", "all")
	level("ether.permissions.viewers.write_watch_state", normLevel(p.Viewers.WriteWatchState), "none", "granted_viewers")
	for i, s := range p.Secrets {
		if !keyRe.MatchString(s) {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("ether.permissions.secrets[%d]", i), "must be a simple name")
		}
	}
}

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#validateSettings

``````
// validateSettings checks the settings schema shape (SPEC §5.5). A $ref is
// validated again after resolution at install.
func validateSettings(raw json.RawMessage, add func(string, string)) {
	if len(raw) == 0 {
		return
	}
	var doc map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &doc); err != nil {
		add("ether.settings", "must be a JSON object")
		return
	}
	if ref, ok := doc["$ref"].(string); ok {
		if unsafePath(ref) || ref == "" {
			add("ether.settings.$ref", "must name a file inside the package")
		}
		return
	}
	lintSettingsNode(doc, "ether.settings", add)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#LintSettingsSchema

``````
// LintSettingsSchema validates a resolved settings schema document
// (SPEC §5.5 copy rules). Shared with the kit.
func LintSettingsSchema(raw json.RawMessage) error {
	var f []FieldError
	validateSettings(raw, func(field, msg string) { f = append(f, FieldError{field, msg}) })
	if len(f) > 0 {
		return &ValidationError{f}
	}
	return nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#lintSettingsNode

``````
func lintSettingsNode(node any, path string, add func(string, string)) {
	switch n := node.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		if k, ok := n["kind"].(string); ok {
			if k == "json" {
				add(path+".kind", "the json field kind is not allowed in plugin settings")
			} else if !settingKinds[k] {
				add(path+".kind", "unknown field kind "+strconv.Quote(k))
			}
		}
		if label, ok := n["label"].(string); ok && !strings.HasPrefix(label, "$t:") {
			if msg := LintCopy(label, 40); msg != "" {
				add(path+".label", msg)
			}
		}
		if hint, ok := n["hint"].(string); ok && !strings.HasPrefix(hint, "$t:") {
			if msg := LintCopy(hint, 120); msg != "" {
				add(path+".hint", msg)
			}
			if strings.Count(strings.TrimRight(hint, "."), ".") > 0 {
				add(path+".hint", "must be one sentence")
			}
		}
		for key, v := range n {
			lintSettingsNode(v, path+"."+key, add)
		}
	case []any:
		for i, v := range n {
			lintSettingsNode(v, fmt.Sprintf("%s[%d]", path, i), add)
		}
	}
}
``````

func contributesUseT(c Contributes) bool {
	any := false
	check := func(s string) {
		if strings.HasPrefix(s, "$t:") {
			any = true
		}
	}
	for _, x := range c.ListSources {
		check(x.Label)
	}
	for _, x := range c.RankingSteps {
		check(x.Label)
	}
	for _, x := range c.RuleConditions {
		check(x.Label)
	}
	for _, x := range c.PosterBadges {
		check(x.Label)
		check(x.Description)
	}
	if c.Events != nil {
		for _, pe := range c.Events.Publish {
			check(pe.Label)
			check(pe.Description)
			for _, fld := range pe.Fields {
				check(fld.Label)
				check(fld.Description)
				for _, opt := range fld.Enum {
					check(opt.Label)
				}
			}
		}
	}
	for _, fa := range c.FlowActions {
		check(fa.Label)
		check(fa.Description)
		for _, p := range fa.Params {
			check(p.Label)
			check(p.Description)
			for _, opt := range p.Enum {
				check(opt.Label)
			}
		}
		for _, out := range fa.Outputs {
			check(out.Label)
			check(out.Description)
			for _, opt := range out.Enum {
				check(opt.Label)
			}
		}
	}
	for _, x := range c.Tools {
		check(x.Title)
	}
	for _, x := range c.Pages {
		check(x.Label)
	}
	for _, x := range c.Slots {
		check(x.Label)
	}
	for _, x := range c.Commands {
		check(x.Label)
	}
	if c.Integration != nil {
		for _, s := range c.Integration.Adds {
			check(s)
		}
	}
	for _, k := range c.MediaKinds {
		check(k.Label)
		check(k.Library.Name)
		for _, t := range k.Library.Tabs {
			check(t.Label)
			check(t.SearchPlaceholder)
		}
		for _, sh := range k.Library.Shelves {
			check(sh.Label)
		}
		for _, lv := range k.Levels {
			check(lv.Label)
		}
		for _, f := range k.Fields {
			check(f.Label)
		}
		for _, a := range k.Art {
			check(a.Label)
		}
	}
	for _, a := range c.FrontendAdapters {
		check(a.Label)
	}
	for _, lf := range c.LiveFeeds {
		check(lf.Title)
	}
	if c.Setup != nil {
		for _, s := range c.Setup.Steps {
			check(s.Label)
			check(s.Hint)
		}
	}
	for _, sc := range c.Screens {
		check(sc.Title)
	}
	return any
}

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#validateContributes

``````
func validateContributes(m Manifest, add func(string, string)) {
	e := m.Ether
	c := e.Contributes
	hosted := e.Runtime.Kind == "hosted"
	label := func(field, s string, max int) {
		if strings.HasPrefix(s, "$t:") {
			if !keyRe.MatchString(strings.TrimPrefix(s, "$t:")) {
				add(field, "must name a string key after $t:")
			}
			return
		}
		if strings.TrimSpace(s) == "" {
			add(field, "is required")
		} else if msg := LintCopy(s, max); msg != "" && !e.Stremio {
			// Labels an add-on brings (its catalogue names) are its own
			// words; Ether shows them as the add-on wrote them.
			add(field, msg)
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapStreamSource) {
		if c.Source == nil {
			add("ether.contributes.source", "is required for stream_source")
		} else if !map[string]bool{"debrid": true, "usenet": true, "indexer": true, "direct": true}[c.Source.Class] {
			add("ether.contributes.source.class", "must be debrid, usenet, indexer or direct")
		}
	}
	if c.Source != nil && c.Source.Search != nil {
		validateSourceSearch(c.Source.Search, m.HasCapability(CapStreamSource), e.Stremio, add)
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapDebridProvider) && (c.Source == nil || c.Source.Class != "debrid") {
		add("ether.contributes.source.class", "must be debrid for debrid_provider")
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapLiveTV) {
		if c.Channels == nil || !c.Channels.Test {
			add("ether.contributes.channels", "is required for livetv_channels, with test set")
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapPluginDirectory) && len(c.Directories) == 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.directories", "is required for plugin_directory")
	}
	seenDirectories := map[string]bool{}
	for i, d := range c.Directories {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.directories[%d]", i)
		if !keyRe.MatchString(d.Key) || seenDirectories[d.Key] {
			add(base+".key", "must be a unique simple key")
		}
		seenDirectories[d.Key] = true
		label(base+".label", d.Label, 80)
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapMetadata) {
		if c.Metadata == nil || len(c.Metadata.Types) == 0 {
			add("ether.contributes.metadata.types", "is required for metadata")
		} else {
			for _, typ := range c.Metadata.Types {
				if typ != "movie" && typ != "show" {
					add("ether.contributes.metadata.types", "must contain movie or show")
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapSubtitles) && c.Subtitles == nil {
		add("ether.contributes.subtitles", "is required for subtitles")
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapMarkers) {
		if c.Markers == nil || len(c.Markers.Kinds) == 0 {
			add("ether.contributes.markers.kinds", "is required for markers")
		} else {
			for _, k := range c.Markers.Kinds {
				if !map[string]bool{"intro": true, "credits": true, "recap": true, "preview": true}[k] {
					add("ether.contributes.markers.kinds", "unknown marker kind "+strconv.Quote(k))
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapNotify) {
		if c.Notification == nil || !c.Notification.SendTest {
			add("ether.contributes.notification", "is required for notify, with sendTest set")
		}
	}
	optDesc := func(field, s string, max int) {
		if s == "" {
			return
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(s, "$t:") {
			if !keyRe.MatchString(strings.TrimPrefix(s, "$t:")) {
				add(field, "must name a string key after $t:")
			}
			return
		}
		if msg := LintCopy(s, max); msg != "" && !e.Stremio {
			add(field, msg)
		}
	}
	validateEventFields := func(prefix string, fields []EventFieldMeta) {
		if len(fields) > MaxEventFields {
			add(prefix, fmt.Sprintf("must declare at most %d fields", MaxEventFields))
		}
		seenFields := map[string]bool{}
		for j, fld := range fields {
			fbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s[%d]", prefix, j)
			if !eventFieldNameRe.MatchString(fld.Name) || seenFields[fld.Name] {
				add(fbase+".name", "must be a unique field name")
			}
			seenFields[fld.Name] = true
			ft := events.FieldType(fld.Type)
			if !ft.Valid() {
				add(fbase+".type", "unknown field type "+strconv.Quote(fld.Type))
			}
			label(fbase+".label", fld.Label, 60)
			optDesc(fbase+".description", fld.Description, 200)
			if ft == events.FieldEnum {
				if len(fld.Enum) == 0 {
					add(fbase+".enum", "is required for enum fields")
				}
			}
			seenEnum := map[string]bool{}
			for k, opt := range fld.Enum {
				ebase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.enum[%d]", fbase, k)
				if strings.TrimSpace(opt.Value) == "" || seenEnum[opt.Value] {
					add(ebase+".value", "must be a unique non-empty enum value")
				}
				seenEnum[opt.Value] = true
				optDesc(ebase+".label", opt.Label, 60)
			}
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapEvents) {
		if c.Events == nil || (len(c.Events.Subscribe) == 0 && len(c.Events.Publish) == 0) {
			add("ether.contributes.events", "must declare subscribe or publish for events")
		}
	}
	if c.Events != nil {
		if !m.HasCapability(CapEvents) && (len(c.Events.Subscribe) > 0 || len(c.Events.Publish) > 0) {
			add("ether.capabilities", "events is required for contributes.events")
		}
		for _, n := range c.Events.Subscribe {
			if !IsSubscribableEvent(n) {
				add("ether.contributes.events.subscribe", "unknown event "+strconv.Quote(n))
			}
		}
		if len(c.Events.Publish) > MaxPluginPublishedEvents {
			add("ether.contributes.events.publish", fmt.Sprintf("must declare at most %d published events", MaxPluginPublishedEvents))
		}
		seenPublished := map[string]bool{}
		for i, pe := range c.Events.Publish {
			base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.events.publish[%d]", i)
			if !pluginEventKeyRe.MatchString(pe.Key) || seenPublished[pe.Key] {
				add(base+".key", "must be a unique key matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*){0,2}$")
			} else if len(events.PluginEventType(m.ID, pe.Key)) > 128 {
				add(base+".key", "event type exceeds 128 characters")
			}
			seenPublished[pe.Key] = true
			label(base+".label", pe.Label, 60)
			optDesc(base+".description", pe.Description, 200)
			if pe.Version < 0 {
				add(base+".version", "must be >= 1")
			}
			validateEventFields(base+".fields", pe.Fields)
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapFlowActions) && len(c.FlowActions) == 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.flowActions", "is required for flow_actions")
	}
	if len(c.FlowActions) > 0 && !m.HasCapability(CapFlowActions) {
		add("ether.capabilities", "flow_actions is required for flowActions")
	}
	if len(c.FlowActions) > MaxPluginFlowActions {
		add("ether.contributes.flowActions", fmt.Sprintf("must declare at most %d flow actions", MaxPluginFlowActions))
	}
	seenActions := map[string]bool{}
	for i, fa := range c.FlowActions {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.flowActions[%d]", i)
		if !flowActionKeyRe.MatchString(fa.Key) || seenActions[fa.Key] {
			add(base+".key", "must be a unique key matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$")
		} else if len(flows.PluginActionType(m.ID, fa.Key)) > 128 {
			add(base+".key", "action type exceeds 128 characters")
		}
		seenActions[fa.Key] = true
		label(base+".label", fa.Label, 60)
		optDesc(base+".description", fa.Description, 200)
		if !strings.HasPrefix(fa.Route, "/ether/") || !isSafePluginRoute(fa.Route) {
			add(base+".route", "must be a safe plugin route under /ether/")
		}
		if fa.Timeout != "" {
			d, err := time.ParseDuration(fa.Timeout)
			if err != nil || d <= 0 || d > MaxPluginFlowActionTimeout {
				add(base+".timeout", fmt.Sprintf("must be a positive duration of at most %s", MaxPluginFlowActionTimeout))
			}
		}
		if len(fa.Params) > MaxFlowActionParams {
			add(base+".params", fmt.Sprintf("must declare at most %d params", MaxFlowActionParams))
		}
		seenParams := map[string]bool{}
		for j, p := range fa.Params {
			pbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.params[%d]", base, j)
			if !flowParamKeyRe.MatchString(p.Key) || seenParams[p.Key] {
				add(pbase+".key", "must be a unique param key")
			}
			seenParams[p.Key] = true
			pt := events.FieldType(p.Type)
			if !pt.Valid() {
				add(pbase+".type", "unknown param type "+strconv.Quote(p.Type))
			}
			label(pbase+".label", p.Label, 60)
			optDesc(pbase+".description", p.Description, 200)
			if pt == events.FieldEnum && len(p.Enum) == 0 {
				add(pbase+".enum", "is required for enum params")
			}
			seenEnum := map[string]bool{}
			for k, opt := range p.Enum {
				ebase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.enum[%d]", pbase, k)
				if strings.TrimSpace(opt.Value) == "" || seenEnum[opt.Value] {
					add(ebase+".value", "must be a unique non-empty enum value")
				}
				seenEnum[opt.Value] = true
				optDesc(ebase+".label", opt.Label, 60)
			}
			if !flows.ValidPicker(p.Picker) {
				add(pbase+".picker", "unknown picker "+strconv.Quote(p.Picker))
			}
		}
		validateEventFields(base+".outputs", fa.Outputs)
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapListSource) && len(c.ListSources) == 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.listSources", "is required for list_source")
	}
	for i, ls := range c.ListSources {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.listSources[%d]", i)
		if !keyRe.MatchString(ls.Key) {
			add(base+".key", "must be a simple key")
		}
		label(base+".label", ls.Label, 40)
		if ls.Catalog == "" {
			add(base+".catalog", "is required")
		}
		if ls.MaxItems < 0 || ls.MaxItems > MaxListItems {
			add(base+".maxItems", fmt.Sprintf("must be at most %d", MaxListItems))
		}
		if ls.Refresh != "" {
			if d, err := time.ParseDuration(ls.Refresh); err != nil || d < time.Hour {
				add(base+".refresh", "must be a duration of at least 1h")
			}
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapRankingStep) {
		if !hosted {
			add("ether.capabilities", "ranking_step needs the hosted runtime")
		}
		if len(c.RankingSteps) == 0 {
			add("ether.contributes.rankingSteps", "is required for ranking_step")
		}
	}
	for i, rs := range c.RankingSteps {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.rankingSteps[%d]", i)
		if !keyRe.MatchString(rs.Key) {
			add(base+".key", "must be a simple key")
		}
		label(base+".label", rs.Label, 40)
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapRuleCondition) {
		if !hosted {
			add("ether.capabilities", "rule_condition needs the hosted runtime")
		}
		if len(c.RuleConditions) == 0 {
			add("ether.contributes.ruleConditions", "is required for rule_condition")
		}
	}
	for i, rc := range c.RuleConditions {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.ruleConditions[%d]", i)
		if !keyRe.MatchString(rc.Key) {
			add(base+".key", "must be a simple key")
		}
		label(base+".label", rc.Label, 40)
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapPosterBadges) && len(c.PosterBadges) == 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.posterBadges", "is required for poster_badges")
	}
	if len(c.PosterBadges) > 0 && !m.HasCapability(CapPosterBadges) {
		add("ether.capabilities", "poster_badges is required for posterBadges")
	}
	if len(c.PosterBadges) > MaxPosterBadgeSets {
		add("ether.contributes.posterBadges", fmt.Sprintf("must declare at most %d badge sets", MaxPosterBadgeSets))
	}
	seenBadgeSets := map[string]bool{}
	for i, pb := range c.PosterBadges {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.posterBadges[%d]", i)
		if !posterBadgeKeyRe.MatchString(pb.Key) || seenBadgeSets[pb.Key] {
			add(base+".key", "must be a unique key matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$")
		}
		seenBadgeSets[pb.Key] = true
		label(base+".label", pb.Label, 40)
		if pb.Description != "" {
			if strings.HasPrefix(pb.Description, "$t:") {
				if !keyRe.MatchString(strings.TrimPrefix(pb.Description, "$t:")) {
					add(base+".description", "must name a string key after $t:")
				}
			} else if msg := LintCopy(pb.Description, 120); msg != "" && !e.Stremio {
				add(base+".description", msg)
			}
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapTools) && len(c.Tools) == 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.tools", "is required for tools")
	}
	for i, tl := range c.Tools {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.tools[%d]", i)
		if !toolNameRe.MatchString(tl.Name) {
			add(base+".name", "must be snake_case")
		}
		label(base+".title", tl.Title, 60)
		if strings.TrimSpace(tl.Description) == "" {
			add(base+".description", "is required")
		}
		var schema map[string]any
		if len(tl.InputSchema) == 0 || json.Unmarshal(tl.InputSchema, &schema) != nil || schema["type"] != "object" {
			add(base+".inputSchema", "must be a JSON object schema")
		}
		if tl.ReadOnly && tl.Destructive {
			add(base, "a tool cannot be both read-only and destructive")
		}
	}
	for i, pg := range c.Pages {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.pages[%d]", i)
		if !keyRe.MatchString(pg.Key) {
			add(base+".key", "must be a simple key")
		}
		label(base+".label", pg.Label, 40)
		if !strings.HasPrefix(pg.Route, "/") {
			add(base+".route", "must be a plugin route starting with /")
		}
	}
	for i, sl := range c.Slots {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.slots[%d]", i)
		if !knownSlots[sl.Slot] {
			add(base+".slot", "unknown slot "+strconv.Quote(sl.Slot))
		}
		label(base+".label", sl.Label, 40)
		if !keyRe.MatchString(sl.Key) {
			add(base+".key", "must be a simple key")
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(sl.Slot, "actionMenu.") {
			if !keyRe.MatchString(sl.Action) {
				add(base+".action", "must be a simple action name")
			}
			if sl.Route != "" {
				add(base+".route", "action slots use an action instead of a route")
			}
		} else {
			if !strings.HasPrefix(sl.Route, "/") {
				add(base+".route", "must be a plugin route starting with /")
			}
			if sl.Action != "" {
				add(base+".action", "view slots use a route instead of an action")
			}
		}
	}
	for i, cm := range c.Commands {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.commands[%d]", i)
		if !keyRe.MatchString(cm.Key) {
			add(base+".key", "must be a simple key")
		}
		label(base+".label", cm.Label, 40)
		if cm.Action == "" {
			add(base+".action", "is required")
		}
	}
	validateMediaKinds(m, add, label)
	validateFrontendAdapters(m, add, label)
	validateLiveFeeds(m, add, label)
	validateSetup(e, add, label)
	validateScreens(m, add, label)
	validateSurfaces(m, add, label)
	if e.Kind == KindIntegration {
		if c.Integration == nil {
			add("ether.contributes.integration", "is required for the integration kind")
		} else {
			if c.Integration.Category == "" {
				add("ether.contributes.integration.category", "is required")
			}
			if len(c.Integration.Adds) < 1 || len(c.Integration.Adds) > 4 {
				add("ether.contributes.integration.adds", "must list one to four things the plugin adds")
			}
			for i, s := range c.Integration.Adds {
				label(fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.integration.adds[%d]", i), s, 80)
			}
			if !map[string]bool{"fields": true, "device_code": true, "none": true}[c.Integration.Connect] {
				add("ether.contributes.integration.connect", "must be fields, device_code or none")
			}
		}
	}
}
``````

func validateLiveFeeds(m Manifest, add func(string, string), label func(string, string, int)) {
	feeds := m.Ether.Contributes.LiveFeeds
	if m.HasCapability(CapLiveEvents) && len(feeds) == 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.liveFeeds", "is required for live_events")
	}
	if !m.HasCapability(CapLiveEvents) && len(feeds) > 0 {
		add("ether.capabilities", "live_events is required for liveFeeds")
	}
	seenID := map[string]bool{}
	for i, lf := range feeds {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.liveFeeds[%d]", i)
		if !liveFeedIDRe.MatchString(lf.ID) || seenID[lf.ID] {
			add(base+".id", "must be a unique lower case key matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$")
		}
		seenID[lf.ID] = true
		label(base+".title", lf.Title, 60)
		if lf.MinIntervalSec < MinLiveFeedIntervalSec {
			add(base+".minIntervalSec", fmt.Sprintf("must be at least %d", MinLiveFeedIntervalSec))
		}
		seenKind := map[string]bool{}
		for j, ek := range lf.EntityKinds {
			if !liveFeedIDRe.MatchString(ek) || seenKind[ek] {
				add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.entityKinds[%d]", base, j), "must be a unique lower case key matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$")
			}
			seenKind[ek] = true
		}
	}
}

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#ParseSemVer

``````
// ParseSemVer parses a plain major.minor.patch version.
func ParseSemVer(v string) ([3]int, bool) {
	var out [3]int
	v = strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(v), "v")
	if i := strings.IndexAny(v, "-+"); i >= 0 {
		v = v[:i]
	}
	parts := strings.Split(v, ".")
	if len(parts) != 3 {
		return out, false
	}
	for i, p := range parts {
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(p)
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return out, false
		}
		out[i] = n
	}
	return out, true
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#CompareSemVer

``````
// CompareSemVer returns -1, 0 or 1. Unparseable versions compare equal to 0.
func CompareSemVer(a, b string) int {
	va, _ := ParseSemVer(a)
	vb, _ := ParseSemVer(b)
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		if va[i] != vb[i] {
			if va[i] < vb[i] {
				return -1
			}
			return 1
		}
	}
	// A release sorts after any prerelease of the same core version.
	pre := func(v string) string {
		v, _, _ = strings.Cut(v, "+")
		_, p, _ := strings.Cut(v, "-")
		return p
	}
	pa, pb := pre(a), pre(b)
	if pa == pb {
		return 0
	}
	if pa == "" {
		return 1
	}
	if pb == "" {
		return -1
	}
	as, bs := strings.Split(pa, "."), strings.Split(pb, ".")
	for i := 0; i < len(as) && i < len(bs); i++ {
		x, y := as[i], bs[i]
		if x == y {
			continue
		}
		isNumeric := func(s string) bool {
			if s == "" {
				return false
			}
			for _, c := range s {
				if c < '0' || c > '9' {
					return false
				}
			}
			return true
		}
		xn, yn := isNumeric(x), isNumeric(y)
		if xn != yn {
			if xn {
				return -1
			}
			return 1
		}
		if xn {
			x, y = strings.TrimLeft(x, "0"), strings.TrimLeft(y, "0")
			if len(x) < len(y) {
				return -1
			}
			if len(x) > len(y) {
				return 1
			}
		}
		if x < y {
			return -1
		}
		if x > y {
			return 1
		}
	}
	if len(as) < len(bs) {
		return -1
	}
	if len(as) > len(bs) {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#validateSourceSearch

``````
// validateSourceSearch checks ether.contributes.source.search: the Newznab
// categories (1000-8999, no duplicates) and typed lookups a stream_source
// plugin answers on GET /ether/search.
func validateSourceSearch(ss *SourceSearchMeta, streamSource, stremioMode bool, add func(field, msg string)) {
	const base = "ether.contributes.source.search"
	if !streamSource {
		add(base, "needs the stream_source capability")
	}
	if stremioMode {
		add(base, "is not available to plugins that answer Stremio add-on routes")
	}
	if len(ss.Categories) == 0 {
		add(base+".categories", "must list at least one Newznab category (for example 3000 for audio, 7000 for books)")
	}
	if len(ss.Categories) > MaxSourceSearchCategories {
		add(base+".categories", fmt.Sprintf("must list at most %d categories", MaxSourceSearchCategories))
	}
	seen := map[int]bool{}
	for i, c := range ss.Categories {
		if c < 1000 || c > 8999 {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.categories[%d]", base, i), "must be a Newznab category between 1000 and 8999")
		} else if seen[c] {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.categories[%d]", base, i), "is listed twice")
		}
		seen[c] = true
	}
	if len(ss.Lookups) > MaxSourceSearchLookups {
		add(base+".lookups", fmt.Sprintf("must list at most %d lookups", MaxSourceSearchLookups))
	}
	seenLookup := map[string]bool{}
	for i, l := range ss.Lookups {
		if !keyRe.MatchString(l) || seenLookup[l] {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.lookups[%d]", base, i), "must be a unique simple key such as album or book")
		}
		seenLookup[l] = true
	}
}

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#KindRuleFields

``````
// KindRuleFields maps built-in rule facts (genre, studio, runtime, ...) onto
// declared, indexed plugin field keys. Shared by manifest validation and
// pluginitems SQL compilation so both agree on which built-in facts exist.
func KindRuleFields(fields []KindField) map[string]string {
	out := map[string]string{}
	aliases := map[string][]string{
		"genre":      {"genre", "genres", "tags", "tag"},
		"studio":     {"studio", "studios"},
		"country":    {"country", "countries"},
		"keyword":    {"keyword", "keywords"},
		"language":   {"language"},
		"runtime":    {"runtime", "duration", "length"},
		"votes":      {"votes"},
		"popularity": {"popularity"},
	}
	for field, keys := range aliases {
		wantNumeric := field == "runtime" || field == "votes" || field == "popularity"
		for _, key := range keys {
			for _, f := range fields {
				text := f.Type == "string" || f.Type == "strings" || f.Type == "enum" || f.Type == "people"
				numeric := f.Type == "int" || f.Type == "float" || f.Type == "duration"
				if f.Key == key && f.Indexed && ((wantNumeric && numeric) || (!wantNumeric && text)) {
					out[field] = key
					break
				}
			}
			if out[field] != "" {
				break
			}
		}
	}
	return out
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#validateMediaKinds

``````
func validateMediaKinds(m Manifest, add func(string, string), label func(string, string, int)) {
	e := m.Ether
	kinds := e.Contributes.MediaKinds
	hasProvider := m.HasCapability(CapCatalogProvider)
	hasResolver := m.HasCapability(CapKindResolver)
	if e.Kind == KindContent && !hasProvider && !hasResolver {
		add("ether.capabilities", "a content plugin needs catalog_provider or kind_resolver")
	}
	if (hasProvider || hasResolver) && len(kinds) == 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.mediaKinds", "is required for catalog_provider and kind_resolver")
	}
	if !hasProvider && !hasResolver && len(kinds) > 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.mediaKinds", "needs the catalog_provider or kind_resolver capability")
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for i, k := range kinds {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.mediaKinds[%d]", i)
		validateMediaKind(m, k, base, hasProvider, add, label)
		if seen[k.Key] {
			add(base+".key", "is listed twice")
		}
		seen[k.Key] = true
	}
}

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#validateMediaKind

``````
func validateMediaKind(m Manifest, k MediaKindMeta, base string, hasProvider bool, add func(string, string), label func(string, string, int)) {
	if !kindKeyRe.MatchString(k.Key) {
		add(base+".key", "must be lower case letters, digits and dashes, at most 32 characters")
	}
	label(base+".label", k.Label, 60)
	if k.Media != "" && !core.ValidMediaClass(k.Media) {
		add(base+".media", "must be video, music, audiobook, book, podcast or photo")
	}
	if !k.Library.IsZero() {
		label(base+".library.name", k.Library.Name, 60)
		if k.Library.Icon != "" && !ValidAdapterIconPath(k.Library.Icon) {
			add(base+".library.icon", "must be a package-relative SVG or PNG path")
		}
		if k.Library.Card != "" && !kindLibraryCards[k.Library.Card] {
			add(base+".library.card", "must be poster, landscape or square")
		}
		if k.Library.DateDisplay != "" && !kindLibraryDateDisplays[k.Library.DateDisplay] {
			add(base+".library.dateDisplay", "must be year or date")
		}
		if k.Import != nil {
			if len(k.Import.Links) > 8 {
				add(base+".import.links", "at most 8 sites may be named")
			}
			for i, site := range k.Import.Links {
				if !importSiteName.MatchString(site) {
					add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.import.links[%d]", base, i), "must be a short lowercase site name such as deezer")
				}
			}
			if len(k.Import.Links) > 0 && !k.Import.Identify {
				add(base+".import.identify", "link imports need identify")
			}
		}
		if k.Library.Experience != "" && !core.ValidLibraryExperience(k.Library.Experience) {
			add(base+".library.experience", "must be an experience id such as watch, listen, read, gallery or live")
		}
		if len(k.Library.Tabs) > MaxKindLibraryTabs {
			add(base+".library.tabs", fmt.Sprintf("at most %d tabs may be declared", MaxKindLibraryTabs))
		}
		seenTab := map[string]bool{}
		for j, tab := range k.Library.Tabs {
			tbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.library.tabs[%d]", base, j)
			switch {
			case !kindKeyRe.MatchString(tab.Key):
				add(tbase+".key", "must be lower case letters, digits and dashes, at most 32 characters")
			case seenTab[tab.Key]:
				add(tbase+".key", "is listed twice")
			}
			seenTab[tab.Key] = true
			label(tbase+".label", tab.Label, 40)
			if !kindLibraryTabKinds[tab.Kind] {
				add(tbase+".kind", "must be recommended, library, collections, people, view or live")
			}
		}
	}

	if len(k.Levels) < 1 || len(k.Levels) > 5 {
		add(base+".levels", "must declare one to five levels")
	}
	levelKeys := map[string]bool{}
	playable := false
	for j, lv := range k.Levels {
		lbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.levels[%d]", base, j)
		if !kindKeyRe.MatchString(lv.Key) {
			add(lbase+".key", "must be lower case letters, digits and dashes, at most 32 characters")
		}
		if levelKeys[lv.Key] {
			add(lbase+".key", "is listed twice")
		}
		if lv.Members {
			switch {
			case j == 0:
				add(lbase+".members", "the root level cannot be a list level")
			case lv.Parent != "":
				add(lbase+".members", "a list level has no parent")
			case lv.Playable:
				add(lbase+".members", "a list level cannot be playable")
			}
		}
		if lv.Parent != "" && !lv.Members {
			switch {
			case j == 0:
				add(lbase+".parent", "the root level cannot set parent")
			case lv.Parent == lv.Key:
				add(lbase+".parent", "cannot reference itself (cycle)")
			case !levelKeys[lv.Parent]:
				add(lbase+".parent", "must name an earlier level")
			}
		}
		levelKeys[lv.Key] = true
		label(lbase+".label", lv.Label, 40)
		if lv.Media != "" && !core.ValidMediaClass(lv.Media) {
			add(lbase+".media", "must be video, music, audiobook, book, podcast or photo")
		}
		if lv.Role != "" && !validKindLevelRole(lv.Role) {
			add(lbase+".role", "must be trimmed printable text of at most 40 characters")
		}
		if lv.Playable {
			playable = true
		}
	}
	if len(k.Levels) > 0 && !playable {
		add(base+".levels", "at least one level must be playable")
	}
	for j, lv := range k.Levels {
		if lv.Parent != "" {
			if parent, _, ok := k.Level(lv.Parent); ok && parent.Members {
				add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.levels[%d].parent", base, j), "a list level cannot be a parent (its children are its members)")
			}
		}
	}

	fields := map[string]KindField{}
	for j, f := range k.Fields {
		fbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.fields[%d]", base, j)
		switch {
		case !kindFieldRe.MatchString(f.Key):
			add(fbase+".key", "must start with a lower case letter and use letters, digits and underscores, at most 40 characters")
		case kindEnvelopeKeys[f.Key]:
			add(fbase+".key", "collides with an item envelope key")
		case fields[f.Key].Key != "":
			add(fbase+".key", "is listed twice")
		}
		fields[f.Key] = f
		if !kindFieldTypes[f.Type] {
			add(fbase+".type", "must be string, int, float, bool, date, duration, enum, strings or people")
		}
		label(fbase+".label", f.Label, 40)
		if f.Type == "enum" {
			if len(f.Enum) == 0 {
				add(fbase+".enum", "an enum field needs at least one value")
			}
			seenEnum := map[string]bool{}
			for _, v := range f.Enum {
				if strings.TrimSpace(v) == "" || seenEnum[v] {
					add(fbase+".enum", "values must be non-empty and listed once")
					break
				}
				seenEnum[v] = true
			}
		} else if len(f.Enum) > 0 {
			add(fbase+".enum", "only enum fields list values")
		}
		if len(f.Values) > 0 {
			if f.Type != "strings" {
				add(fbase+".values", "only strings fields may declare values")
			} else {
				seenValues := map[string]bool{}
				for _, v := range f.Values {
					if strings.TrimSpace(v) == "" || seenValues[v] {
						add(fbase+".values", "values must be non-empty and listed once")
						break
					}
					seenValues[v] = true
				}
			}
		}
	}

	seenArt := map[string]bool{}
	for j, a := range k.Art {
		abase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.art[%d]", base, j)
		switch {
		case !kindArtRe.MatchString(a.Role):
			add(abase+".role", "must be lower case letters, digits and dashes, at most 32 characters")
		case BuiltinKindArtRoles[a.Role]:
			add(abase+".role", "is a built-in role and needs no declaration")
		case seenArt[a.Role]:
			add(abase+".role", "is listed twice")
		}
		seenArt[a.Role] = true
		label(abase+".label", a.Label, 40)
	}

	validatePresentations(m, k, base+".present", levelKeys, add)

	seenSort := map[string]bool{}
	for j, s := range k.Browse.Sorts {
		if !kindSorts[s] || seenSort[s] {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.browse.sorts[%d]", base, j), "must be title, added, released, year, rating, index or lastViewed, listed once")
		}
		seenSort[s] = true
	}
	seenFacet := map[string]bool{}
	for j, f := range k.Browse.Facets {
		if seenFacet[f] {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.browse.facets[%d]", base, j), "is listed twice")
		}
		seenFacet[f] = true
		if f == "year" || f == "released" || f == "rating" {
			continue
		}
		field, ok := fields[f]
		if !ok {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.browse.facets[%d]", base, j), "must name a declared field")
		} else if !field.Indexed && field.Type != "people" {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.browse.facets[%d]", base, j), "a facet field must be indexed")
		}
	}
	if k.Browse.Expand != nil {
		ebase := base + ".browse.expand"
		if !hasProvider {
			add(ebase, "expand needs the catalog_provider capability")
		}
		if len(k.Browse.Expand.Facets) == 0 && len(k.Browse.Expand.Levels) == 0 {
			add(ebase, "must list at least one browse facet or container level")
		}
		seenExpand := map[string]bool{}
		for j, f := range k.Browse.Expand.Facets {
			fbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.facets[%d]", ebase, j)
			if seenExpand[f] {
				add(fbase, "is listed twice")
			}
			seenExpand[f] = true
			if !seenFacet[f] {
				add(fbase, "must name a declared browse facet")
			}
		}
		seenExpandLevel := map[string]bool{}
		for j, lvKey := range k.Browse.Expand.Levels {
			lbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.levels[%d]", ebase, j)
			if seenExpandLevel[lvKey] {
				add(lbase, "is listed twice")
			}
			seenExpandLevel[lvKey] = true
			lv, _, ok := k.Level(lvKey)
			if !ok {
				add(lbase, "must name a declared level")
			} else if !lv.Container {
				add(lbase, "must name a level with container: true")
			}
		}
		if k.Browse.Expand.TTLHours < 0 {
			add(ebase+".ttlHours", "must be positive")
		}
	}
	if !k.Library.IsZero() {
		declaredIndexed := make(map[string]string, len(k.Fields))
		for _, f := range k.Fields {
			if f.Indexed || f.Type == "people" {
				declaredIndexed[f.Key] = f.Type
			}
		}
		ruleFields := KindRuleFields(k.Fields)
		for j, tab := range k.Library.Tabs {
			tbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.library.tabs[%d]", base, j)
			if tab.Level != "" {
				switch tab.Kind {
				case "library", "view", "collections", "people":
					if !levelKeys[tab.Level] {
						add(tbase+".level", "must name a declared level")
					}
				default:
					add(tbase+".level", "only library, view, collections or people tabs may set level")
				}
			}
			switch tab.Kind {
			case "collections":
				if tab.Facet != "" && !seenFacet[tab.Facet] {
					add(tbase+".facet", "must name a declared browse facet")
				}
				if tab.Sort != "" {
					if tab.Facet == "" {
						add(tbase+".sort", "requires facet to be set")
					} else if !seenSort[tab.Sort] && !core.IsLastViewedSort(tab.Sort) {
						add(tbase+".sort", "must name a declared browse sort")
					}
				}
				if tab.Direction != "" {
					if tab.Facet == "" {
						add(tbase+".direction", "requires facet to be set")
					} else if tab.Direction != "asc" && tab.Direction != "desc" {
						add(tbase+".direction", "must be asc or desc")
					}
				}
				if tab.Order != "" {
					if tab.Facet == "" {
						add(tbase+".order", "requires facet to be set")
					} else if tab.Order != "count" && tab.Order != "name" {
						add(tbase+".order", "must be count or name")
					}
				}
				if tab.SearchPlaceholder != "" {
					label(tbase+".searchPlaceholder", tab.SearchPlaceholder, 60)
					if tab.Search != nil && !*tab.Search {
						add(tbase+".searchPlaceholder", "requires search to be enabled")
					}
				}
				if tab.Card != "" {
					add(tbase+".card", "only live or recommended tabs may set card")
				}
				if tab.Layout != "" {
					add(tbase+".layout", "only view tabs may set layout")
				}
				if tab.Filters != nil && !tab.Filters.IsEmpty() {
					add(tbase+".filters", "only view tabs may set filters")
				}
				if len(tab.Shelves) > 0 {
					add(tbase+".shelves", "only recommended tabs may set shelves")
				}
			case "people":
				if tab.Facet == "" || !seenFacet[tab.Facet] {
					add(tbase+".facet", "must name a declared browse facet")
				} else if fields[tab.Facet].Type != "people" {
					add(tbase+".facet", "must name a people field")
				}
				if tab.Sort != "" {
					add(tbase+".sort", "only collections or view tabs may set sort")
				}
				if tab.Direction != "" {
					add(tbase+".direction", "only collections or view tabs may set direction")
				}
				if tab.Order != "" && tab.Order != "count" && tab.Order != "name" {
					add(tbase+".order", "must be count or name")
				}
				if tab.SearchPlaceholder != "" {
					label(tbase+".searchPlaceholder", tab.SearchPlaceholder, 60)
					if tab.Search != nil && !*tab.Search {
						add(tbase+".searchPlaceholder", "requires search to be enabled")
					}
				}
				if tab.Card != "" {
					add(tbase+".card", "only live or recommended tabs may set card")
				}
				if tab.Layout != "" {
					add(tbase+".layout", "only view tabs may set layout")
				}
				if tab.Filters != nil && !tab.Filters.IsEmpty() {
					add(tbase+".filters", "only view tabs may set filters")
				}
				if len(tab.Shelves) > 0 {
					add(tbase+".shelves", "only recommended tabs may set shelves")
				}
			case "view":
				if tab.Facet != "" {
					add(tbase+".facet", "only collections or people tabs may set facet")
				}
				if tab.Order != "" {
					add(tbase+".order", "only collections or people tabs may set order")
				}
				if tab.Card != "" {
					add(tbase+".card", "only live or recommended tabs may set card")
				}
				if tab.Layout != "" && !kindLibraryTabLayouts[tab.Layout] {
					add(tbase+".layout", "must be grid, list or timeline")
				}
				if tab.Sort != "" && !seenSort[tab.Sort] && !core.IsLastViewedSort(tab.Sort) {
					add(tbase+".sort", "must name a declared browse sort or lastViewed")
				}
				if tab.Direction != "" && tab.Direction != "asc" && tab.Direction != "desc" {
					add(tbase+".direction", "must be asc or desc")
				}
				if tab.SearchPlaceholder != "" {
					label(tbase+".searchPlaceholder", tab.SearchPlaceholder, 60)
					if tab.Search != nil && !*tab.Search {
						add(tbase+".searchPlaceholder", "requires search to be enabled")
					}
				}
				if tab.Filters != nil {
					if tab.Filters.Match != "" && tab.Filters.Match != "all" && tab.Filters.Match != "any" {
						add(tbase+".filters.match", "must be all or any")
					}
					if tab.Filters.VisibilityDefault != "" && tab.Filters.VisibilityDefault != "show" && tab.Filters.VisibilityDefault != "hide" {
						add(tbase+".filters.visibilityDefault", "must be show or hide")
					}

						specs, fallback := tab.Filters.ToPolicy("")
						if err := libraryfilter.ValidatePluginManifestPolicy(specs, fallback, declaredIndexed, ruleFields); err != nil {
							add(tbase+".filters", err.Error())
						}
					}
				}

					add(tbase+".shelves", "only recommended tabs may set shelves")

				if tab.Direction != "" {
					add(tbase+".direction", "only collections or view tabs may set direction")

				if tab.Order != "" {
					add(tbase+".order", "only collections or people tabs may set order")
				}
				if tab.Card != "" && !kindLibraryCards[tab.Card] {
					add(tbase+".card", "must be poster, landscape or square")
				}
				if tab.Layout != "" {
					add(tbase+".layout", "only view tabs may set layout")
				}
				if tab.Filters != nil && !tab.Filters.IsEmpty() {
					add(tbase+".filters", "only view tabs may set filters")
				}
				if tab.SearchPlaceholder != "" {
					label(tbase+".searchPlaceholder", tab.SearchPlaceholder, 60)
					if tab.Search != nil && !*tab.Search {
						add(tbase+".searchPlaceholder", "requires search to be enabled")
					}
				}
				if len(tab.Shelves) > 0 {
					add(tbase+".shelves", "only recommended tabs may set shelves")
				}
			case "recommended":
				if tab.Facet != "" {
					add(tbase+".facet", "only collections or people tabs may set facet")

			default:
				if tab.Facet != "" {
					add(tbase+".facet", "only collections or people tabs may set facet")
				}
				if tab.Sort != "" {
					add(tbase+".sort", "only collections or view tabs may set sort")
				}
				if tab.Direction != "" {
					add(tbase+".direction", "only collections or view tabs may set direction")
				}
				if tab.Order != "" {
					add(tbase+".order", "only collections or people tabs may set order")
				}
				if tab.Card != "" {
					add(tbase+".card", "only live or recommended tabs may set card")
				}
				if tab.Layout != "" {
					add(tbase+".layout", "only view tabs may set layout")
				}
				if tab.Filters != nil && !tab.Filters.IsEmpty() {
					add(tbase+".filters", "only view tabs may set filters")
				}
				if tab.Search != nil {
					add(tbase+".search", "only collections, people, view or live tabs may set search")
				}
				if tab.SearchPlaceholder != "" {
					add(tbase+".searchPlaceholder", "only collections, people, view or live tabs may set searchPlaceholder")
				}
				if len(tab.Shelves) > 0 {
					add(tbase+".shelves", "only recommended tabs may set shelves")
				}
			}
