	for j, f := range k.Browse.SearchFields {
		field, ok := fields[f]
		if !ok {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.browse.searchFields[%d]", base, j), "must name a declared field")
		} else if field.Type != "string" && field.Type != "strings" && field.Type != "people" {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.browse.searchFields[%d]", base, j), "a search field must hold text")
		}
	}
	if len(k.Browse.SearchFields) > 0 && !k.Browse.Search {
		add(base+".browse.search", "searchFields need search to be set")
	}
	if k.Browse.LiveSearch && !hasProvider {
		add(base+".browse.liveSearch", "live search needs the catalog_provider capability")
	}

	switch k.Sync.Mode {
	case "":
		if hasProvider && k.HasLibrary() {
			add(base+".sync.mode", "a catalog provider kind must be pull or push")
		}
	case KindSyncPull, KindSyncPush:
		if !hasProvider {
			add(base+".sync.mode", "sync needs the catalog_provider capability")
		}
	case "ondemand":
		add(base+".sync.mode", "ondemand is not supported; kinds sync with pull or push")
	default:
		add(base+".sync.mode", "must be pull or push")
	}
	if k.Sync.Refresh != "" {
		if k.Sync.Mode != KindSyncPull {
			add(base+".sync.refresh", "only pull kinds refresh on a schedule")
		} else if d, err := time.ParseDuration(k.Sync.Refresh); err != nil || d < 15*time.Minute {
			add(base+".sync.refresh", "must be a duration of at least 15m")
		}
	}
	if k.Sync.Undo != "" {
		if k.Sync.Mode != KindSyncPush {
			add(base+".sync.undo", "only push kinds configure sync.undo")
		} else if k.Sync.Undo != KindSyncUndoSnapshots && k.Sync.Undo != KindSyncUndoIDs {
			add(base+".sync.undo", "must be snapshots or ids")
		}
	}
	if k.Cache.MaxBytes < 0 {
		add(base+".cache.maxBytes", "must not be negative")
	}
	if k.Cache.TTL != "" {
		if d, err := time.ParseDuration(k.Cache.TTL); err != nil || d <= 0 {
			add(base+".cache.ttl", "must be a positive duration")
		}
	}
	if k.Match.ThresholdDefault < 0 || k.Match.ThresholdDefault > 1 {
		add(base+".match.thresholdDefault", "must be between 0 and 1")
	}
}

``````
func validatePresentations(m Manifest, k MediaKindMeta, base string, levelKeys map[string]bool, add func(string, string)) {
	p := k.Present
	protocols := 0
	if p.Vela != nil {
		protocols++
	}
	if p.Plex != nil {
		protocols++
	}
	if p.MediaBrowser != nil {
		protocols++
	}
	if p.Stremio != nil {
		protocols++
	}
	if p.Xtream != nil {
		protocols++
	}
	if p.Silo != nil {
		protocols++
	}
	if p.AdapterOnly {
		if protocols > 0 {
			add(base, "adapterOnly cannot be combined with a protocol presentation")
		}
		if !m.HasCapability(CapFrontendAdapter) {
			add(base+".adapterOnly", "needs a frontend adapter")
		}
		return
	}
	if protocols == 0 {
		// Present is optional: Ether infers per-app presentations from the
		// kind's media class, level roles, and hierarchy shape.
		return
	}
	levels := len(k.Levels)
	if p.Vela != nil {
		switch p.Vela.Type {
		case "":
			if p.Vela.Default == nil {
				add(base+".vela.type", "must be movies or shows")
			}
		case "movies":
		case "shows":
			if levels < 2 {
				add(base+".vela.type", "shows needs at least two levels")
			}
		default:
			add(base+".vela.type", "must be movies or shows")
		}
	}
	if p.Plex != nil {
		switch p.Plex.Base {
		case "":
			if p.Plex.Default == nil {
				add(base+".plex.base", "must be movie, show, artist or photo")
			}
		case "movie", "photo", "artist":
			// A single-level artist kind is a flat album list: its items
			// present as albums (a level named artist/track presents as
			// that instead), never as artists.
		case "show":
			if levels < 2 {
				add(base+".plex.base", p.Plex.Base+" needs at least two levels")
			}
		default:
			add(base+".plex.base", "must be movie, show, artist or photo")
		}
	}
	if p.MediaBrowser != nil {
		if p.MediaBrowser.CollectionType == "" {
			if p.MediaBrowser.Default == nil && len(p.MediaBrowser.ItemTypes) == 0 {
				add(base+".mediaBrowser.collectionType", "must be movies, tvshows, music, audiobooks, books, photos or homevideos")
			}
		} else if !mediaBrowserCollectionTypes[p.MediaBrowser.CollectionType] {
			add(base+".mediaBrowser.collectionType", "must be movies, tvshows, music, audiobooks, books, photos or homevideos")
		}
		for level, itemType := range p.MediaBrowser.ItemTypes {
			if !levelKeys[level] {
				add(base+".mediaBrowser.itemTypes", "unknown level "+level)
			}
			if !mediaBrowserItemTypes[itemType] {
				add(base+".mediaBrowser.itemTypes", "unknown item type "+itemType+" for level "+level+" (must be "+mediaBrowserItemTypeList+")")
			}
		}
	}
	if p.Stremio != nil {
		switch p.Stremio.Type {
		case "":
			if p.Stremio.Default == nil {
				add(base+".stremio.type", "must be movie, series, channel or tv")
			}
		case "movie", "channel", "tv":
		case "series":
			if levels < 2 {
				add(base+".stremio.type", "series needs at least two levels")
			}
		default:
			add(base+".stremio.type", "must be movie, series, channel or tv")
		}
	}
	if p.Xtream != nil {
		switch p.Xtream.Category {
		case "":
			if p.Xtream.Default == nil {
				add(base+".xtream.category", "must be movie, series or live")
			}
		case "movie", "live":
		case "series":
			if levels < 2 {
				add(base+".xtream.category", "series needs at least two levels")
			}
		default:
			add(base+".xtream.category", "must be movie, series or live")
		}
	}
	if p.Silo != nil {
		if p.Silo.Type == "" {
			if p.Silo.Default == nil {
				add(base+".silo.type", "must be movies, tvshows, or a MediaBrowser item type such as Movie or Series")
			}
		} else if !mediaBrowserItemTypes[p.Silo.Type] && !mediaBrowserCollectionTypes[p.Silo.Type] {
			add(base+".silo.type", "must be movies, tvshows, or a MediaBrowser item type such as Movie or Series")
		}
	}
}

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#validateFrontendAdapters

``````
func validateFrontendAdapters(m Manifest, add func(string, string), label func(string, string, int)) {
	adapters := m.Ether.Contributes.FrontendAdapters
	if m.HasCapability(CapFrontendAdapter) && len(adapters) == 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.frontendAdapters", "is required for frontend_adapter")
	}
	if !m.HasCapability(CapFrontendAdapter) && len(adapters) > 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.frontendAdapters", "needs the frontend_adapter capability")
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for i, a := range adapters {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.frontendAdapters[%d]", i)
		if !kindKeyRe.MatchString(a.Key) || seen[a.Key] {
			add(base+".key", "must be a unique lower case key, at most 32 characters")
		}
		seen[a.Key] = true
		label(base+".label", a.Label, 60)
		if !map[string]bool{"opds": true, "subsonic": true, "custom": true}[a.ProtocolHint] {
			add(base+".protocolHint", "must be opds, subsonic or custom")
		}
		if !strings.HasPrefix(a.PathPrefix, "/") || a.PathPrefix == "/" {
			add(base+".pathPrefix", "must be a path below the shared listener root, such as /opds")
		}
		if a.DefaultPort < 0 || a.DefaultPort > 65535 {
			add(base+".defaultPort", "must be a port number")
		}
		if a.Auth != "" && !map[string]bool{"ether_token": true, "basic": true, "none_lan": true, "query_credentials": true}[a.Auth] {
			add(base+".auth", "must be ether_token, basic, none_lan or query_credentials")
		}
		seenLib := map[string]bool{}
		for j, key := range a.Libraries {
			if !kindKeyRe.MatchString(key) || seenLib[key] {
				add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.libraries[%d]", base, j), "must name a declared media kind key")
			}
			seenLib[key] = true
			if _, ok := m.MediaKindByKey(key); !ok {
				add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.libraries[%d]", base, j), "must name a media kind declared by this plugin")
			}
		}
		if len(a.SearchPaths) > MaxAdapterSearchPaths {
			add(base+".searchPaths", fmt.Sprintf("must declare at most %d search paths", MaxAdapterSearchPaths))
		}
		seenSearch := map[string]bool{}
		for j, sp := range a.SearchPaths {
			norm, ok := normalizeAdapterSearchPath(sp)
			if !ok {
				add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.searchPaths[%d]", base, j), "must be a clean subpath starting with /, without ?, #, whitespace, or ..")
				continue
			}
			if seenSearch[norm] {
				add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.searchPaths[%d]", base, j), "must not repeat a search path")
				continue
			}
			seenSearch[norm] = true
		}
		if len(a.UploadPaths) > maxAdapterUploadPaths {
			add(base+".uploadPaths", fmt.Sprintf("must declare at most %d upload paths", maxAdapterUploadPaths))
		}
		seenUploads := map[string]bool{}
		for j, upload := range a.UploadPaths {
			field := fmt.Sprintf("%s.uploadPaths[%d]", base, j)
			norm, ok := normalizeAdapterSearchPath(upload.Path)
			if _, err := path.Match(norm, ""); !ok || err != nil || len(norm) > 256 {
				add(field+".path", "must be a clean subpath glob starting with /, at most 256 characters")
			} else if seenUploads[norm] {
				add(field+".path", "must not repeat an upload path")
			}
			seenUploads[norm] = true
			if upload.MaxBytes < 1 || upload.MaxBytes > MaxAdapterUploadBytes {
				add(field+".maxBytes", fmt.Sprintf("must be between 1 and %d bytes", MaxAdapterUploadBytes))
			}
		}
		if a.Icon != "" && !ValidAdapterIconPath(a.Icon) {
			add(base+".icon", "must be an SVG or PNG file inside the package")
		}
	}
}

	MaxAdapterUploadBytes     int64 = 512 << 20
	maxAdapterUploadPaths           = 16

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#FrontendAdapterMeta.UploadLimit

``````
// UploadLimit returns the smallest limit of the declared globs matching a
// normalized adapter subpath, or zero for ordinary inline requests.
func (a FrontendAdapterMeta) UploadLimit(subpath string) int64 {
	if len(a.UploadPaths) == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	subpath, ok := normalizeAdapterSearchPath(subpath)
	if !ok {
		return 0
	}
	var limit int64
	for _, upload := range a.UploadPaths {
		pattern, ok := normalizeAdapterSearchPath(upload.Path)
		if !ok || upload.MaxBytes < 1 || upload.MaxBytes > MaxAdapterUploadBytes {
			continue
		}
		if match, _ := path.Match(pattern, subpath); match && (limit == 0 || upload.MaxBytes < limit) {
			limit = upload.MaxBytes
		}
	}
	return limit
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#ValidAdapterIconPath

``````
// ValidAdapterIconPath reports whether p names an SVG or PNG icon inside
// the package; the conformance kit checks the file itself.
func ValidAdapterIconPath(p string) bool {
	lower := strings.ToLower(p)
	return !unsafePath(p) && !strings.ContainsAny(p, "\\:%?#\r\n\t") && (strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".svg") || strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".png"))
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#Manifest.MediaKindByKey

``````
// MediaKindByKey returns the declared kind with this key, if any.
func (m Manifest) MediaKindByKey(key string) (MediaKindMeta, bool) {
	if e := m.EffectiveEther(); e != nil {
		for _, k := range e.Contributes.MediaKinds {
			if k.Key == key {
				return k, true
			}
		}
	}
	return MediaKindMeta{}, false
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#MediaKindMeta.HasLibrary

``````
// HasLibrary reports whether this media kind declares a library block.
// Creating a library is optional per kind: a kind without a library block
// (for example, a resolver-only kind) creates no library.
func (k MediaKindMeta) HasLibrary() bool {
	return strings.TrimSpace(k.Library.Name) != ""
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#MediaKindMeta.Level

``````
// Level returns the declared level with this key and its position.
func (k MediaKindMeta) Level(key string) (KindLevel, int, bool) {
	for i, lv := range k.Levels {
		if lv.Key == key {
			return lv, i, true
		}
	}
	return KindLevel{}, -1, false
}

// LevelParent returns the effective parent level key for key: the declared
// KindLevel.Parent when set, or the preceding level's key by default. The root
// level (index 0) and unknown keys return "".
func (k MediaKindMeta) LevelParent(key string) string {
	lv, idx, ok := k.Level(key)
	if !ok || idx == 0 || lv.Members {
		return ""
	}
	if lv.Parent != "" {
		return lv.Parent
	}
	return k.Levels[idx-1].Key
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#MediaKindMeta.ChildLevels

``````
// ChildLevels returns all declared levels whose effective parent is parentKey,
// in manifest declaration order.
func (k MediaKindMeta) ChildLevels(parentKey string) []KindLevel {
	if parentKey == "" {
		return nil
	}
	var out []KindLevel
	for _, lv := range k.Levels {
		if k.LevelParent(lv.Key) == parentKey {
			out = append(out, lv)
		}
	}
	return out
}

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#MediaKindMeta.PrimaryChildLevel

``````
// PrimaryChildLevel returns the primary direct child level of parentKey.
// For a branching container (more than one direct child level), it prefers
// the first child level whose effective media class matches parentKey's own
// effective media class, falling back to the first declared child level.
func (k MediaKindMeta) PrimaryChildLevel(parentKey string, kindMedia core.MediaClass) (KindLevel, bool) {
	children := k.ChildLevels(parentKey)
	if len(children) == 0 {
		return KindLevel{}, false
	}
	if len(children) == 1 {
		return children[0], true
	}
	parentMedia := k.EffectiveLevelMedia(parentKey, kindMedia)
	for _, lv := range children {
		if k.EffectiveLevelMedia(lv.Key, kindMedia) == parentMedia {
			return lv, true
		}
	}
	return children[0], true
}
``````

// LeafLevels returns the set of all declared level keys that have no child levels.
func (k MediaKindMeta) LeafLevels() map[string]bool {
	out := make(map[string]bool, len(k.Levels))
	for _, lv := range k.Levels {

			out[lv.Key] = true

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#MediaKindMeta.LevelDepth

``````
// LevelDepth returns the zero-based tree depth of key (0 for the root level,
// 1 for direct children of root, etc.), or -1 if key is not declared.
func (k MediaKindMeta) LevelDepth(key string) int {
	if _, _, ok := k.Level(key); !ok {
		return -1
	}
	depth := 0
	cur := key
	for step := 0; step < len(k.Levels); step++ {
		p := k.LevelParent(cur)
		if p == "" {
			return depth
		}
		depth++
		cur = p
	}
	return depth
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#MediaKindMeta.EffectiveLevelMedia

``````
// EffectiveLevelMedia returns the effective media class for level key: the
// level's explicit Media override when declared, else the kind's Media, else
// fallback (or core.MediaClassVideo when fallback is empty).
func (k MediaKindMeta) EffectiveLevelMedia(key string, fallback core.MediaClass) core.MediaClass {
	if lv, _, ok := k.Level(key); ok && lv.Media != "" && core.ValidMediaClass(lv.Media) {
		return core.MediaClass(lv.Media)
	}
	if k.Media != "" && core.ValidMediaClass(k.Media) {
		return core.MediaClass(k.Media)
	}
	if fallback != "" {
		return fallback
	}
	return core.MediaClassVideo
}
``````

func validKindLevelRole(role string) bool {
	if role == "" || strings.TrimSpace(role) != role {
		return false
	}
	if utf8.RuneCountInString(role) > 40 {
		return false
	}
	for _, r := range role {
		if unicode.IsControl(r) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#MediaKindMeta.DeclHash

``````
// DeclHash is the upgrade gate for an installed kind (spec §2.3/§2.5):
// the SHA-256 of the declaration's canonical JSON. Go marshals struct
// fields in declaration order and map keys sorted, so equal
// declarations always hash equal.
func (k MediaKindMeta) DeclHash() string {
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(k)
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#ValidateMediaKindsUpgrade

``````
// ValidateMediaKindsUpgrade applies the additive-only upgrade rule
// (spec §2.5): a new manifest may add kinds, fields, trailing levels
// and art roles, and may change labels, presentations, browse, cache
// and match defaults, but it may not drop or rename a kind, drop or
// retype a field, shrink an enum, drop a field's index, or remove,
// reorder or re-flag a level. A caller that gets an error refuses the
// upgrade unless the owner chose to replace the library contents.
func ValidateMediaKindsUpgrade(prev, next []MediaKindMeta) error {
	var f []FieldError
	add := func(field, msg string) { f = append(f, FieldError{field, msg}) }
	nextByKey := map[string]MediaKindMeta{}
	for _, k := range next {
		nextByKey[k.Key] = k
	}
	for _, old := range prev {
		base := "ether.contributes.mediaKinds." + old.Key
		nk, ok := nextByKey[old.Key]
		if !ok {
			add(base, "kind was removed; removing a kind needs the owner to replace its library")
			continue
		}
		for i, lv := range old.Levels {
			lbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.levels[%d]", base, i)
			if i >= len(nk.Levels) {
				add(lbase, "level "+lv.Key+" was removed")
				continue
			}
			nl := nk.Levels[i]
			if nl.Key != lv.Key {
				add(lbase+".key", "levels cannot be removed or reordered; add new levels at the end")
			}
			if nl.Playable != lv.Playable || nl.Container != lv.Container {
				add(lbase, "level "+lv.Key+" changed its playable or container flag")
			}
			if old.LevelParent(lv.Key) != nk.LevelParent(nl.Key) {
				add(lbase+".parent", "level "+lv.Key+" changed its parent")
			}
		}
		nextFields := map[string]KindField{}
		for _, nf := range nk.Fields {
			nextFields[nf.Key] = nf
		}
		for _, of := range old.Fields {
			fbase := base + ".fields." + of.Key
			nf, ok := nextFields[of.Key]
			if !ok {
				add(fbase, "field was removed")
				continue
			}
			if nf.Type != of.Type {
				add(fbase+".type", "field changed type from "+of.Type+" to "+nf.Type)
			}
			if of.Indexed && !nf.Indexed {
				add(fbase+".indexed", "field lost its index")
			}
			if of.Type == "enum" && nf.Type == "enum" {
				have := map[string]bool{}
				for _, v := range nf.Enum {
					have[v] = true
				}
				for _, v := range of.Enum {
					if !have[v] {
						add(fbase+".enum", "enum value "+v+" was removed")
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if len(f) > 0 {
		return &ValidationError{f}
	}
	return nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#validateKindLibraryShelves

``````
func validateKindLibraryShelves(shelvesPath string, shelves []KindLibraryShelf, levelKeys map[string]bool, fields map[string]KindField, add func(string, string), label func(string, string, int)) {
	if len(shelves) == 0 {
		return
	}
	if len(shelves) > MaxKindLibraryShelves {
		add(shelvesPath, fmt.Sprintf("at most %d shelves are allowed", MaxKindLibraryShelves))
	}
	declaredIndexed := make(map[string]string, len(fields))
	fieldList := make([]KindField, 0, len(fields))
	for _, f := range fields {
		fieldList = append(fieldList, f)
		if f.Indexed || f.Type == "people" {
			declaredIndexed[f.Key] = f.Type
		}
	}
	ruleFields := KindRuleFields(fieldList)
	checkFacet := func(fieldPath, fk string) {
		if fk == "year" || fk == "released" || fk == "rating" {
			return
		}
		field, ok := fields[fk]
		if !ok {
			add(fieldPath, "must name a declared field")
		} else if !field.Indexed && field.Type != "people" {
			add(fieldPath, "a shelf facet field must be indexed")
		}
	}
	seenKey := map[string]bool{}
	for j, sh := range shelves {
		sbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s[%d]", shelvesPath, j)
		if !kindShelfKeyRe.MatchString(sh.Key) {
			add(sbase+".key", "must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$")
		} else if seenKey[sh.Key] {
			add(sbase+".key", "is listed twice")
		}
		seenKey[sh.Key] = true
		label(sbase+".label", sh.Label, 60)
		if sh.Level != "" && !levelKeys[sh.Level] {
			add(sbase+".level", "must name a declared level")
		}
		if sh.Sort != "" && !kindSorts[sh.Sort] {
			add(sbase+".sort", "must be title, added, released, year, rating, index or lastViewed")
		}
		if sh.Direction != "" && sh.Direction != "asc" && sh.Direction != "desc" {
			add(sbase+".direction", "must be asc or desc")
		}
		if sh.Purpose != "" && sh.Purpose != string(core.PurposeRecentContexts) && sh.Purpose != string(core.PurposeLiked) {
			add(sbase+".purpose", "must be recentContexts or liked")
		}
		if sh.Layout != "" && !core.ValidRowStyle(sh.Layout) {
			add(sbase+".layout", "must be standard, hero, wide, tiles or tracks")
		}
		if sh.Facet != "" && !sh.Filters.IsEmpty() {
			add(sbase+".filters", "cannot be combined with facet")
		}
		if sh.Facet != "" {
			checkFacet(sbase+".facet", sh.Facet)
			switch {
			case sh.Value != "" && len(sh.Values) > 0:
				add(sbase+".values", "cannot be combined with value")
			case sh.Value != "":
				if strings.TrimSpace(sh.Value) == "" {
					add(sbase+".value", "must not be empty")
				}
			case len(sh.Values) > 0:
				for vi, v := range sh.Values {
					if strings.TrimSpace(v) == "" {
						add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.values[%d]", sbase, vi), "must not be empty")
					}
				}
			default:
				add(sbase+".value", "facet requires value or values")
			}
		} else {
			if sh.Value != "" {
				add(sbase+".value", "requires facet to be set")
			}
			if len(sh.Values) > 0 {
				add(sbase+".values", "requires facet to be set")
			}
		}
		if sh.Filters != nil {
			if sh.Filters.Tab != nil {
				tf := sh.Filters.Tab
				if tf.Match != "" && tf.Match != "all" && tf.Match != "any" {
					add(sbase+".filters.match", "must be all or any")
				}
				if tf.VisibilityDefault != "" && tf.VisibilityDefault != "show" && tf.VisibilityDefault != "hide" {
					add(sbase+".filters.visibilityDefault", "must be show or hide")
				}
				if !tf.IsEmpty() {
					specs, fallback := tf.ToPolicy("")
					if err := libraryfilter.ValidatePluginManifestPolicy(specs, fallback, declaredIndexed, ruleFields); err != nil {
						add(sbase+".filters", err.Error())
					}
				}
			}
			if len(sh.Filters.Facets) > 0 {
				fkeys := make([]string, 0, len(sh.Filters.Facets))
				for fk := range sh.Filters.Facets {
					fkeys = append(fkeys, fk)
				}
				sort.Strings(fkeys)
				for _, fk := range fkeys {
					if strings.TrimSpace(fk) == "" {
						add(sbase+".filters", "filter facet key must not be empty")
						continue
					}
					fbase := sbase + ".filters." + fk
					checkFacet(fbase, fk)
					vals := sh.Filters.Facets[fk]
					if len(vals) == 0 {
						add(fbase, "must list at least one value")
						continue
					}
					for vi, v := range vals {
						if strings.TrimSpace(v) == "" {
							add(fmt.Sprintf("%s[%d]", fbase, vi), "must not be empty")
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#DeclaresOperatorHosts

``````
// DeclaresOperatorHosts reports whether man declares "operator" in
// ether.permissions.network for an executable plugin.
func DeclaresOperatorHosts(man Manifest) bool {
	if man.Ether == nil || man.Ether.Runtime.Kind == "data" {
		return false
	}
	for _, entry := range man.Ether.Permissions.Network {
		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(entry), OperatorNetworkEntry) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#NormalizeOperatorHost

``````
// NormalizeOperatorHost validates a single owner-approved host grant ("host"
// or "host:port", or a single IP literal with optional port, without schemes,
// wildcards, or CIDRs) and returns its canonical lowercase form. Wildcards
// (including bare "*") and the manifest token "operator" are rejected.
func NormalizeOperatorHost(raw string) (string, error) {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
	if strings.Contains(trimmed, "*") {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("wildcards are not allowed; enter a specific host name or IP address")
	}
	if strings.EqualFold(trimmed, OperatorNetworkEntry) {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("must be a specific host name or IP address")
	}
	norm, ok := safefetch.NormalizeTrustedHost(trimmed)
	if !ok {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("must be a host name or single IP address (with optional :port), without wildcards or CIDRs")
	}
	return norm, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#normalizeOperatorHosts

``````
func normalizeOperatorHosts(in []string) ([]string, error) {
	if in == nil {
		return nil, nil
	}
	out := make([]string, 0, len(in))
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, raw := range in {
		if strings.TrimSpace(raw) == "" {
			continue
		}
		norm, err := NormalizeOperatorHost(raw)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if !seen[norm] {
			seen[norm] = true
			out = append(out, norm)
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#isExplicitLoopbackEntry

``````
func isExplicitLoopbackEntry(raw string) bool {
	norm, ok := safefetch.NormalizeTrustedHost(raw)
	if !ok {
		return false
	}
	host := norm
	if h, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(norm); err == nil {
		host = h
	}
	host = strings.Trim(host, "[]")
	if host == "localhost" || strings.HasSuffix(host, ".localhost") {
		return true
	}
	ip, err := netip.ParseAddr(host)
	return err == nil && ip.Unmap().IsLoopback()
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#trustedFetchHosts

``````
// trustedFetchHosts returns the exact destinations allowed to resolve to
// non-public addresses during safefetch: Grants.LocalHosts plus, for plugins
// declaring "operator", any explicitly approved LAN or loopback literal in
// Grants.OperatorHosts. Public DNS names in OperatorHosts stay on the public
// pool so DNS-rebinding SSRF protection remains enforced.
func trustedFetchHosts(man Manifest, g Grants) []string {
	if !DeclaresOperatorHosts(man) || len(g.OperatorHosts) == 0 {
		return g.LocalHosts
	}
	var extra []string
	for _, entry := range g.OperatorHosts {
		if IsLocalNetworkHost(entry) || isExplicitLoopbackEntry(entry) {
			extra = append(extra, entry)
		}
	}
	if len(extra) == 0 {
		return g.LocalHosts
	}
	out := make([]string, 0, len(g.LocalHosts)+len(extra))
	out = append(out, g.LocalHosts...)
	out = append(out, extra...)
	return out
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#isOperatorHostField

``````
func isOperatorHostField(key string, field map[string]any) bool {
	if field != nil {
		for _, prop := range []string{"kind", "type", "format"} {
			if s, _ := field[prop].(string); s == "url" || s == "uri" {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	lower := strings.ToLower(key)
	for _, token := range []string{"url", "host", "endpoint", "server", "origin", "address"} {
		if strings.Contains(lower, token) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#extractSettingHost

``````
func extractSettingHost(raw string, hostField bool) (string, bool) {
	s := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
	if s == "" {
		return "", false
	}
	if strings.Contains(s, "://") {
		u, err := url.Parse(s)
		if err != nil || u.Hostname() == "" {
			return "", false
		}
		switch strings.ToLower(u.Scheme) {
		case "http", "https", "stremio", "ws", "wss":
		default:
			return "", false
		}
		norm, err := NormalizeOperatorHost(urlHostPortDisplay(u))
		if err != nil {
			return "", false
		}
		return norm, true
	}
	if !hostField || strings.ContainsAny(s, " /\\?#@%") {
		return "", false
	}
	norm, err := NormalizeOperatorHost(s)
	if err != nil {
		return "", false
	}
	return norm, true
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#SettingsCandidateHosts

``````
// SettingsCandidateHosts extracts normalized host or host:port candidates from
// a plugin's non-secret settings (including schema defaults when settings omit
// a field). Secret fields are never inspected.
func SettingsCandidateHosts(settings map[string]any, schema json.RawMessage, declaredSecrets []string, excludeLoopback bool) []string {
	public := NonSecretSettings(settings, schema, declaredSecrets)
	if len(public) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	hostFields := map[string]bool{}
	var doc map[string]any
	if len(schema) > 0 && json.Unmarshal(schema, &doc) == nil {
		visitSettingsFields(doc, func(key string, field map[string]any) {
			if isOperatorHostField(key, field) {
				hostFields[key] = true
			}
		})
	}
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(public))
	for key := range public {
		keys = append(keys, key)
	}
	slices.Sort(keys)

	var out []string
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	add := func(raw string, hostField bool) {
		norm, ok := extractSettingHost(raw, hostField)
		if !ok || seen[norm] {
			return
		}
		if excludeLoopback && isExplicitLoopbackEntry(norm) {
			return
		}
		seen[norm] = true
		out = append(out, norm)
	}
	for _, key := range keys {
		val := public[key]
		hf := hostFields[key] || isOperatorHostField(key, nil)
		switch v := val.(type) {
		case string:
			add(v, hf)
		case []string:
			for _, item := range v {
				add(item, hf)
			}
		case []any:
			for _, item := range v {
				if s, ok := item.(string); ok {
					add(s, hf)
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return out
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#operatorCandidateCovered

``````
func operatorCandidateCovered(man Manifest, g Grants, cand string) bool {
	norm, err := NormalizeOperatorHost(cand)
	if err != nil {
		return true
	}
	hostSpec := norm
	if ip, ipErr := netip.ParseAddr(norm); ipErr == nil && ip.Is6() {
		hostSpec = "[" + ip.String() + "]"
	}
	u, parseErr := url.Parse("https://" + hostSpec)
	if parseErr != nil || u.Hostname() == "" {
		return true
	}
	var declared []string
	if man.Ether != nil {
		for _, entry := range man.Ether.Permissions.Network {
			if !strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(entry), OperatorNetworkEntry) {
				declared = append(declared, entry)
			}
		}
	}
	if u.Port() != "" {
		return networkAllowedURL(declared, u) || g.allowsLocalURL(u) || g.allowsOperatorURL(u)
	}
	return hostAllowed(declared, u.Hostname()) ||
		localGrantCoversBlockedEntry(declared, norm) ||
		localGrantCoversBlockedEntry(g.LocalHosts, norm) ||
		localGrantCoversBlockedEntry(g.OperatorHosts, norm)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#PendingOperatorHosts

``````
// PendingOperatorHosts returns distinct unapproved host or host:port entries
// referenced by a plugin's non-secret settings or recently blocked at runtime
// for a plugin declaring "operator" in permissions.network.
func PendingOperatorHosts(man Manifest, g Grants, settings map[string]any, schema json.RawMessage, blocked []string, excludeLoopback bool) []string {
	if !DeclaresOperatorHosts(man) {
		return nil
	}
	var secrets []string
	if man.Ether != nil {
		secrets = man.Ether.Permissions.Secrets
	}
	candidates := SettingsCandidateHosts(settings, schema, secrets, excludeLoopback)
	out := make([]string, 0, len(candidates)+len(blocked))
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, cand := range append(candidates, blocked...) {
		norm, err := NormalizeOperatorHost(cand)
		if err != nil || seen[norm] {
			continue
		}
		if excludeLoopback && isExplicitLoopbackEntry(norm) {
			continue
		}
		if operatorCandidateCovered(man, g, norm) {
			continue
		}
		seen[norm] = true
		out = append(out, norm)
	}
	if len(out) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return out
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#operatorGrantCoversBlockedEntry

``````
func operatorGrantCoversBlockedEntry(granted []string, blocked string) bool {
	hostSpec := blocked
	if ip, err := netip.ParseAddr(blocked); err == nil && ip.Is6() {
		hostSpec = "[" + ip.String() + "]"
	}
	u, err := url.Parse("https://" + hostSpec)
	if err != nil || u.Hostname() == "" {
		return false
	}
	if u.Port() != "" {
		return safefetch.TrustedHostMatchesURL(granted, u)
	}
	for _, g := range granted {
		norm, err := NormalizeOperatorHost(g)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if norm == blocked {
			return true
		}
		if h, _, splitErr := net.SplitHostPort(norm); splitErr == nil && strings.Trim(h, "[]") == blocked {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#*Manager.noteBlockedOperatorHost

``````
func (m *Manager) noteBlockedOperatorHost(ctx context.Context, pluginID, blocked string) {
	norm, err := NormalizeOperatorHost(blocked)
	if err != nil || pluginID == "" {
		return
	}
	if g, gErr := m.store.grants(ctx, pluginID); gErr == nil {
		if operatorGrantCoversBlockedEntry(g.OperatorHosts, norm) || localGrantCoversBlockedEntry(g.LocalHosts, norm) {
			return
		}
	}
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	if m.blockedOperator == nil {
		m.blockedOperator = map[string][]string{}
	}
	cur := m.blockedOperator[pluginID]
	next := make([]string, 0, min(len(cur)+1, maxBlockedOperatorHosts))
	for _, existing := range cur {
		if existing != norm {
			next = append(next, existing)
		}
	}
	next = append(next, norm)
	if len(next) > maxBlockedOperatorHosts {
		next = next[len(next)-maxBlockedOperatorHosts:]
	}
	m.blockedOperator[pluginID] = next
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#*Manager.BlockedOperatorHosts

``````
// BlockedOperatorHosts returns recently blocked operator-configurable hosts
// (up to 10 distinct entries) for one plugin, oldest to newest.
func (m *Manager) BlockedOperatorHosts(pluginID string) []string {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	src := m.blockedOperator[pluginID]
	if len(src) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]string, len(src))
	copy(out, src)
	return out
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#*Manager.pruneBlockedOperatorHosts

``````
func (m *Manager) pruneBlockedOperatorHosts(pluginID string, granted []string) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	cur := m.blockedOperator[pluginID]
	if len(cur) == 0 {
		return
	}
	kept := cur[:0]
	for _, b := range cur {
		if !operatorGrantCoversBlockedEntry(granted, b) {
			kept = append(kept, b)
		}
	}
	if len(kept) == 0 {
		delete(m.blockedOperator, pluginID)
		return
	}
	m.blockedOperator[pluginID] = kept
}
``````

	m.mu.Unlock()
}

## Source: internal/plugins/pending.go#PendingReply

``````
// PendingReply defers a kind resolve or match without recording a failure.
// RetryInMS is clamped to 250..5000. Job is an optional /ether/job/ route;
// the host passes the original request body and drives job continuations.
type PendingReply struct {
	Pending   bool   `json:"pending"`
	RetryInMS int64  `json:"retryInMs,omitempty"`
	Job       string `json:"job,omitempty"`
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/pending.go#pendingBudgetBody

``````
func pendingBudgetBody(retryInMS int64) json.RawMessage {
	if retryInMS > 0 {
		if b, err := json.Marshal(PendingReply{Pending: true, RetryInMS: retryInMS}); err == nil {
			return b
		}
	}
	return json.RawMessage(`{"pending":true}`)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/pending.go#*Manager.Call

``````
// Call applies the total pending budget to kind resolvers and matchers.
func (m *Manager) Call(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, req Request) (Response, error) {
	if !strings.HasPrefix(req.Path, "/ether/v1/kinds/") || strings.HasSuffix(req.Path, "/live/resolve") || (!strings.HasSuffix(req.Path, "/resolve") && !strings.HasSuffix(req.Path, "/match")) {
		return m.callOnce(ctx, pluginID, req)
	}
	parent := ctx
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, ResolverTotal)
	defer cancel()
	// One job per plugin/kind/item (and part index / source when set), even across
	// simultaneous Plays. Include the request body when older callers do not
	// supply an item reference.
	var identity struct {
		PartIndex *int   `json:"partIndex"`
		Source    string `json:"source"`
		Item      struct {
			Ref        string `json:"ref"`
			ExternalID string `json:"id"`
		} `json:"item"`
	}
	_ = json.Unmarshal(req.Body, &identity)
	item := identity.Item.Ref
	if item == "" {
		item = identity.Item.ExternalID
	}
	if item == "" {
		item = string(req.Body)
	} else {
		if identity.PartIndex != nil {
			item = fmt.Sprintf("%s#part:%d", item, *identity.PartIndex)
		}
		if identity.Source != "" {
			item = fmt.Sprintf("%s#source:%s", item, identity.Source)
		}
	}
	suffix := fmt.Sprintf("|%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSuffix(req.Path, "/resolve"), "/match")+"|"+item)))
	started := false
	var lastRetryMS int64
	var job *actionJob
	for {
		if onSlice, _ := ctx.Value(resolveSliceHookKey{}).(func()); onSlice != nil {
			onSlice()
		}
		resp, err := m.callOnce(ctx, pluginID, req)
		if err != nil {
			if parent.Err() != nil {
				return Response{}, parent.Err()
			}
			if ctx.Err() != nil {
				return Response{Status: 202, Body: pendingBudgetBody(lastRetryMS)}, nil
			}
			return resp, err
		}
		var pending PendingReply
		if resp.Status >= 400 || json.Unmarshal(resp.Body, &pending) != nil || !pending.Pending {
			return resp, nil
		}
		if pending.RetryInMS > 0 {
			lastRetryMS = pending.RetryInMS
		}
		if strings.HasSuffix(req.Path, "/resolve") {
			var resolved struct {
				Sources []json.RawMessage `json:"sources"`
			}
			if json.Unmarshal(resp.Body, &resolved) == nil && len(resolved.Sources) > 0 {
				body := resp.Body
				resp.pendingFallback = sync.OnceValue(func() error {
					if !started {
						if _, err := m.startPendingResolverJob(pluginID, pending.Job, body, req.Body, suffix, lastRetryMS); err != nil {
							return err
						}
					}
					return core.PreparingFromPending(lastRetryMS)
				})
				return resp, nil
			}
		}
		if !started && strings.HasPrefix(pending.Job, "/ether/job/") {
			job, err = m.startPendingResolverJob(pluginID, pending.Job, resp.Body, req.Body, suffix, lastRetryMS)
			if err != nil {
				sec := core.JobsBusyRetrySeconds(err, 5)
				return Response{
					Status: http.StatusServiceUnavailable,
					Headers: map[string]string{
						"Retry-After":         strconv.Itoa(sec),
						"X-Ether-Media-Error": "jobs_busy",
					},
					Body: core.JobsBusyErrorBody(err),
				}, err
			}
			started = true
		}
		var done <-chan struct{}
		if job != nil {
			done = job.done
		}
		timer := time.NewTimer(time.Duration(max(int64(250), min(int64(5000), pending.RetryInMS))) * time.Millisecond)
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			timer.Stop()
			if parent.Err() != nil {
				return Response{}, parent.Err()
			}
			return Response{Status: 202, Body: pendingBudgetBody(lastRetryMS)}, nil
		case <-done:
			timer.Stop()
			job = nil
		case <-timer.C:
		}
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/pending.go#*Manager.startPendingResolverJob

``````
func (m *Manager) startPendingResolverJob(pluginID, path string, body, initial json.RawMessage, suffix string, retryMS int64) (*actionJob, error) {
	if !strings.HasPrefix(path, "/ether/job/") {
		return nil, nil
	}
	job, err := m.startResolverJob(pluginID, body, initial, suffix)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, core.JobsBusyFromPending(err.Error(), retryMS)
	}
	return job, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#Host

``````
// Host is the set of Ether services a remote plugin may call back
// into (SPEC §5.1.5). It mirrors plugins.Host method for method for
// the services remote plugins may use; secret.get is hosted-only and
// deliberately absent (remote plugins receive owner secrets in
// /ether/configure, and may write derived secrets via SecretSet /
// SecretDelete for {secret:<name>} expansion without reading them back).
// Every method is expected to re-check the plugin's live grants and return
// ErrPermissionDenied when a grant is missing or revoked.
type Host interface {
	KVGet(ctx context.Context, pluginID, key string) ([]byte, bool, error)
	KVPut(ctx context.Context, pluginID, key string, value []byte) error
	KVDelete(ctx context.Context, pluginID, key string) error
	KVList(ctx context.Context, pluginID, prefix string) ([]string, error)
	KVUsage(ctx context.Context, pluginID string) (plugins.KVUsage, error)

	SecretSet(ctx context.Context, pluginID, name, value string, ttlSec int64) error
	SecretDelete(ctx context.Context, pluginID, name string) error

	BadgesSet(ctx context.Context, pluginID, setKey string, entries []plugins.BadgeEntry) error
	BadgesClear(ctx context.Context, pluginID, setKey string) error
	BadgesUsage(ctx context.Context, pluginID string) (plugins.BadgeUsage, error)

	CatalogSearch(ctx context.Context, pluginID, query string, limit, offset int) (json.RawMessage, error)
	CatalogGet(ctx context.Context, pluginID, id string) (json.RawMessage, error)

	ViewerGranted(ctx context.Context, pluginID string) (json.RawMessage, error)
	ViewerHistory(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, viewerID int64, limit, offset int) (json.RawMessage, error)
	SetWatchState(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, viewerID int64, titleID string, watched bool) error

	CollectionsUpsert(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, collection json.RawMessage) error

	KindUpsert(ctx context.Context, pluginID, kindKey string, items []core.KindItem) (int, error)
	KindDelete(ctx context.Context, pluginID, kindKey string, externalIDs []string) error
	KindItems(ctx context.Context, pluginID, kindKey, cursor string, limit int) (core.KindPage, error)
	// KindVisible and KindBrowse evaluate a plugin library's Rules and viewer
	// access policy for the requesting frontend-adapter viewer (#615). The
	// viewer is resolved solely from the host-minted X-Ether-Viewer-Token.
	KindVisible(ctx context.Context, pluginID, viewerToken, kindKey string, ids []string) ([]string, error)
	KindBrowse(ctx context.Context, pluginID, viewerToken, kindKey string, q core.KindBrowseRequest) (core.KindPage, error)
	ResolveSources(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, q core.SourceQuery) ([]core.SourceCandidate, error)
	CachePut(ctx context.Context, pluginID, libraryKey, name string, r io.Reader) (string, error)
	CacheOpen(ctx context.Context, pluginID, blobRef string) (io.ReadSeekCloser, error)
	CacheDelete(ctx context.Context, pluginID, blobRef string) error

	// StreamURL mints a scoped stream ticket for one of the plugin's own
	// kind items for viewerID and returns the Ether stream URL (spec §6.5).
	StreamURL(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, viewerID int64, itemRef string) (string, error)

	Settings(ctx context.Context, pluginID string) (map[string]any, error)

	PublishEvent(ctx context.Context, pluginID, key string, payload json.RawMessage, corr events.Correlation) error

	// ScreensInvalidate and ScreensPutRecords are the screens pushes
	// (docs/plugin-screens.md); both need the screens capability.
	ScreensInvalidate(ctx context.Context, pluginID string) (int, error)
	ScreensPutRecords(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, records json.RawMessage) (int, error)

	// AIComplete runs a bounded completion against the owner's configured
	// language model (requires permissions.ai: "complete", or "complete+search"
	// when viewerToken identifies an active frontend-adapter search call; #702).
	AIComplete(ctx context.Context, pluginID, viewerToken string, req plugins.AICompleteRequest) (plugins.AICompleteResponse, error)

	// MediaProbe reads container metadata ({durationSec, container, width,
	// height, sizeBytes}) for a PlayableSource in the same shape /resolve
	// returns, reusing release_probes (requires permissions.media: "probe";
	// refused when viewerToken is set; #712).
	MediaProbe(ctx context.Context, pluginID, viewerToken string, src core.PlayableSource) (core.MediaProbeResult, error)

	NotifyOwner(ctx context.Context, pluginID, text string) error
	Log(ctx context.Context, pluginID, level, msg string, attrs map[string]any) error
}
``````

// HostHandler serves /ether/plugin-host/* for remote plugins. Every

// NewHostHandler builds the plugin-host API. Mount the result at
// HostPath (or use Mount to register it on a mux).
func NewHostHandler(opts HostOptions) *HostHandler {
	h := &HostHandler{host: opts.Host, auth: opts.Auth, log: opts.Logger}
	if h.log == nil {
		h.log = slog.Default()

	mux := &route.Mux{}

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.ServeHTTP

``````
func (h *HostHandler) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.auth == nil || h.host == nil {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "unavailable", "Plugin host API is not configured")
		return
	}
	pluginID, err := h.auth.ResolvePluginCredential(r.Context(), credentialFromRequest(r))
	if err != nil || pluginID == "" {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized", "Plugin credential rejected")
		return
	}
	r = r.WithContext(context.WithValue(r.Context(), pluginIDContextKey{}, pluginID))
	h.mux.ServeHTTP(w, r)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.kvGet

``````
func (h *HostHandler) kvGet(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	key := r.PathValue("key")
	value, ok, err := h.host.KVGet(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), key)
	if !h.finishErr(w, err) {
		return
	}
	if !ok {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "No value for this key")
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"key": key, "value": string(value)})
}

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.kvPut

``````
func (h *HostHandler) kvPut(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	key := r.PathValue("key")
	var body struct {
		Value *string `json:"value"`
	}
	// Accept either {"value": "..."} or a raw text body: the SDKs send
	// JSON, hand-rolled sidecars often send the bare value.
	raw, err := readBody(w, r, maxKVValueBytes)
	if err != nil {
		h.finishErr(w, err)
		return
	}
	value := raw
	if strings.HasPrefix(r.Header.Get("Content-Type"), "application/json") {
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &body); err != nil || body.Value == nil {
			writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid", `Body must be {"value": "..."}`)
			return
		}
		value = []byte(*body.Value)
	}
	if !h.finishErr(w, h.host.KVPut(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), key, value)) {
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": true})
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#decodeBadgeEntries

``````
func decodeBadgeEntries(raw []byte) ([]plugins.BadgeEntry, string, bool) {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(string(raw))
	if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "[") {
		var entries []plugins.BadgeEntry
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &entries); err != nil {
			return nil, "", false
		}
		return entries, "", true
	}
	var body struct {
		SetKey  string               `json:"setKey"`
		Entries []plugins.BadgeEntry `json:"entries"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &body); err != nil {
		return nil, "", false
	}
	return body.Entries, body.SetKey, true
}
``````

func (h *HostHandler) badgesPost(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	raw, err := readBody(w, r, maxHostBodyBytes)
	if err != nil {
		h.finishErr(w, err)
		return
	}
	pathKey := r.PathValue("setKey")
	entries, bodySetKey, ok := decodeBadgeEntries(raw)
	if !ok {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid", `Body must be {"entries": [...]}`)
		return
	}
	if pathKey == "clear" && bodySetKey != "" {
		if !h.finishErr(w, h.host.BadgesClear(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), bodySetKey)) {
			return
		}
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": true})
		return
	}
	if pathKey == "set" && bodySetKey != "" {
		pathKey = bodySetKey
	}
	if !h.finishErr(w, h.host.BadgesSet(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), pathKey, entries)) {
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": true})
}

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.kindUpsert

``````
func (h *HostHandler) kindUpsert(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	raw, err := readBody(w, r, maxKindUpsertBytes)
	if err != nil {
		h.finishErr(w, err)
		return
	}
	var items []core.KindItem
	var envelope struct {
		Items []core.KindItem `json:"items"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &envelope); err == nil && envelope.Items != nil {
		items = envelope.Items
	} else if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &items); err != nil {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid", `Body must be {"items": [...]} or a JSON array of KindItem`)
		return
	}
	result := plugins.KindUpsertResult{}
	if wh, ok := h.host.(interface {
		KindUpsertWithResult(context.Context, string, string, []core.KindItem) (plugins.KindUpsertResult, error)
	}); ok {
		result, err = wh.KindUpsertWithResult(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), r.PathValue("kind"), items)
	} else {
		var accepted int
		accepted, err = h.host.KindUpsert(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), r.PathValue("kind"), items)
		result.Accepted = accepted
	}
	if !h.finishErr(w, err) {
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"ok": true, "accepted": result.Accepted, "added": result.Added,
		"updated": result.Updated, "unchanged": result.Unchanged,
	})
}
``````

func (h *HostHandler) kindDelete(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {

	}

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.kindVisible

``````
// kindVisible returns the subset of external IDs in {kind} allowed by the
// library's Rules and viewer access policy (#615). The viewer identity comes
// exclusively from the host-minted X-Ether-Viewer-Token header on active
// frontend adapter requests, never from guest-supplied viewer IDs.
func (h *HostHandler) kindVisible(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	raw, err := readBody(w, r, maxHostBodyBytes)
	if err != nil {
		h.finishErr(w, err)
		return
	}
	var ids []string
	var envelope struct {
		IDs []string `json:"ids"`
	}
	if len(strings.TrimSpace(string(raw))) == 0 {
		ids = nil
	} else if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &envelope); err == nil && envelope.IDs != nil {
		ids = envelope.IDs
	} else if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &ids); err != nil {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid", `Body must be {"ids": [...]} or a JSON array of item ids`)
		return
	}
	viewerToken := strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get(HeaderViewerToken))
	visible, err := h.host.KindVisible(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), viewerToken, r.PathValue("kind"), ids)
	if !h.finishErr(w, err) {
		return
	}
	if visible == nil {
		visible = []string{}
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ids": visible})
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.cachePut

``````
func (h *HostHandler) cachePut(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	libraryKey := r.PathValue("libraryKey")
	name := r.PathValue("name")
	if name == "" {
		name = r.URL.Query().Get("name")
	}
	pluginID := pluginIDOf(r)
	limit := int64(plugins.MaxDataFetchBytes)
	if h, ok := h.host.(interface {
		CacheUploadLimit(context.Context, string) int64
	}); ok {
		limit = h.CacheUploadLimit(r.Context(), pluginID)
	}
	if r.ContentLength > limit {
		h.finishErr(w, ErrTooLarge)
		return
	}
	body := cacheUploadBody{http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, limit), r.ContentLength}
	ref, err := h.host.CachePut(r.Context(), pluginID, libraryKey, name, body)
	var overflow *http.MaxBytesError
	if errors.As(err, &overflow) {
		err = ErrTooLarge
	}
	if !h.finishErr(w, err) {
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": true, "blob": ref})
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.frontendStreamURL

``````
// frontendStreamURL mints a scoped stream ticket for one of the plugin's
// own kind items and returns the Ether stream URL (spec §6.5). The viewer
// id is the one the adapter proxied the request for; when X-Ether-Viewer-Token
// is forwarded, Ether also binds the active adapter route and request origin
// for absolute stream URLs (#772).
func (h *HostHandler) frontendStreamURL(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var body struct {
		ViewerID  int64                     `json:"viewerId"`
		ItemRef   string                    `json:"itemRef"`
		PartIndex *int                      `json:"partIndex,omitempty"`
		Source    string                    `json:"source,omitempty"`
		Fallback  bool                      `json:"fallback,omitempty"`
		Absolute  bool                      `json:"absolute,omitempty"`
		Wait      *plugins.StreamWaitPolicy `json:"wait,omitempty"`
	}
	if !h.decode(w, r, maxHostBodyBytes, &body) {
		return
	}
	if body.PartIndex != nil && *body.PartIndex < 0 {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_arguments", "partIndex must be non-negative")
		return
	}
	if body.Fallback && body.Source == "" {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_arguments", "fallback requires a source")
		return
	}
	if body.Source != "" && strings.TrimSpace(body.Source) == "" {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_arguments", "source must not be blank")
		return
	}
	if body.Wait != nil && body.Wait.MaxSeconds <= 0 {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_arguments", "wait.maxSeconds must be a positive integer")
		return
	}
	ctx := withStreamViewerToken(r.Context(), r.Header.Get(HeaderViewerToken))
	var (
		u   string
		err error
	)
	if body.Source != "" || body.Absolute || body.Wait != nil {
		oh, ok := h.host.(interface {
			StreamURLWithOptions(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, viewerID int64, itemRef string, opts plugins.StreamURLOptions) (string, error)
		})
		if !ok {
			writeHostError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "unavailable", "This host service does not support stream URL options")
			return
		}
		u, err = oh.StreamURLWithOptions(ctx, pluginIDOf(r), body.ViewerID, body.ItemRef, plugins.StreamURLOptions{
			PartIndex: body.PartIndex,
			Source:    body.Source,
			Fallback:  body.Fallback,
			Absolute:  body.Absolute,
			Wait:      body.Wait,
		})
	} else if body.PartIndex != nil {
		if oh, ok := h.host.(interface {
			StreamURLWithOptions(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, viewerID int64, itemRef string, opts plugins.StreamURLOptions) (string, error)
		}); ok {
			u, err = oh.StreamURLWithOptions(ctx, pluginIDOf(r), body.ViewerID, body.ItemRef, plugins.StreamURLOptions{PartIndex: body.PartIndex})
		} else if ph, ok := h.host.(interface {
			StreamPartURL(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, viewerID int64, itemRef string, partIndex *int) (string, error)
		}); ok {
			u, err = ph.StreamPartURL(ctx, pluginIDOf(r), body.ViewerID, body.ItemRef, body.PartIndex)
		} else {
			u, err = h.host.StreamURL(ctx, pluginIDOf(r), body.ViewerID, body.ItemRef)
			if err == nil {
				sep := "?"
				if strings.Contains(u, "?") {
					sep = "&"
				}
				u = u + sep + "part=" + strconv.Itoa(*body.PartIndex)
			}
		}
	} else {
		u, err = h.host.StreamURL(ctx, pluginIDOf(r), body.ViewerID, body.ItemRef)
	}
	if !h.finishErr(w, err) {
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"url": u})
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.eventsPublish

``````
func (h *HostHandler) eventsPublish(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var body struct {
		Key         string             `json:"key"`
		Payload     json.RawMessage    `json:"payload"`
		Correlation events.Correlation `json:"correlation"`
	}
	if !h.decode(w, r, maxHostBodyBytes, &body) {
		return
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(body.Key) == "" {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid", "key is required")
		return
	}
	if len(body.Payload) == 0 || string(body.Payload) == "null" {
		body.Payload = json.RawMessage(`{}`)
	}
	if !h.finishErr(w, h.host.PublishEvent(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), body.Key, body.Payload, body.Correlation)) {
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": true})
}
``````

func (h *HostHandler) writeRaw(w http.ResponseWriter, out json.RawMessage, err error) {
	if !h.finishErr(w, err) {
		return
	}
	if len(out) == 0 {
		out = json.RawMessage("null")
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	_, _ = w.Write(out)
}

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.decode

``````
func (h *HostHandler) decode(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, max int64, into any) bool {
	raw, err := readBody(w, r, max)
	if err != nil {
		h.finishErr(w, err)
		return false
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, into); err != nil {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid", "Body is not valid JSON")
		return false
	}
	return true
}

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.finishErr

``````
// finishErr maps a host error onto the EPP error shape and reports
// whether the handler may continue. Host errors are mapped, never
// echoed raw: a storage error must not leak SQL or paths to a
// plugin.
func (h *HostHandler) finishErr(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) bool {
	if err == nil {
		return true
	}
	var blockedLocal *plugins.BlockedLocalHostError
	if errors.As(err, &blockedLocal) {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "permission_denied", blockedLocal.PluginMessage())
		return false
	}
	var blockedOp *plugins.BlockedOperatorHostError
	if errors.As(err, &blockedOp) {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "permission_denied", blockedOp.PluginMessage())
		return false
	}
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, ErrPermissionDenied):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "permission_denied", "This plugin does not have the grant this call needs")
	case errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "Not found")
	case errors.Is(err, plugins.ErrQuotaExceeded):
		msg := strings.TrimPrefix(err.Error(), "remote: response body too large: ")
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge, "quota_exceeded", msg)
	case errors.Is(err, ErrTooLarge):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge, "too_large", "Request body is too large")
	case errors.Is(err, ErrInvalid):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid", cleanMessage(err))
	case errors.Is(err, ErrRateLimited):
		var rl *plugins.RateLimitError
		if errors.As(err, &rl) {
			sec := rl.RetryAfterSeconds(time.Now())
			if sec > 0 {
				w.Header().Set("Retry-After", strconv.FormatInt(sec, 10))
			}
			errObj := map[string]any{
				"code":    "rate_limited",
				"message": rl.Error(),
			}
			if sec > 0 {
				errObj["retryAfterSec"] = sec
			}
			if !rl.RetryAt.IsZero() {
				errObj["retryAt"] = rl.RetryAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
			}
			writeJSON(w, http.StatusTooManyRequests, map[string]any{"error": errObj})
			return false
		}
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusTooManyRequests, "rate_limited", strings.TrimPrefix(err.Error(), "remote: rate limit exceeded: "))
	case errors.Is(err, ErrNotConfigured):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusNotImplemented, "not_configured", "Language model is not configured")
	case errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidOutput):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, "invalid_output", "Language model returned invalid or oversized output")
	case errors.Is(err, ErrUnavailable):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "unavailable", "This host service is not available")
	case errors.Is(err, ErrUnauthorized):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized", "Plugin credential rejected")
	case errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusGatewayTimeout, "deadline", "The call ran past its deadline")
	default:
		h.log.Warn("plugin host call failed", "err", err)
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "error", "The host call failed")
	}
	return false
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#cleanMessage

``````
// cleanMessage strips the sentinel prefix from an ErrInvalid so the
// plugin sees the specific reason ("path escapes...") only.
func cleanMessage(err error) string {
	msg := err.Error()
	msg = strings.TrimPrefix(msg, "remote: invalid request: ")
	msg = strings.TrimPrefix(msg, "remote: invalid request")
	if msg == "" {
		return "The request is not valid"
	}
	return msg
}

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#pageParams

``````
// pageParams reads limit/offset, or page/pageSize, clamped.
func pageParams(r *http.Request) (limit, offset int) {
	q := r.URL.Query()
	limit = defaultPageLimit
	if v, err := strconv.Atoi(q.Get("limit")); err == nil && v > 0 {
		limit = v
	}
	if v, err := paging.ParseOffset(q.Get("offset"), limit); err == nil && v >= 0 {
		offset = v
	}
	if q.Get("page") != "" {
		pageSize := limit
		if v, err := strconv.Atoi(q.Get("pageSize")); err == nil && v > 0 {
			pageSize = v
		}
		if v, err := strconv.Atoi(q.Get("page")); err == nil && v >= 1 {
			limit = pageSize
			offset = paging.PageOffset(v, pageSize)
		}
	}
	if limit > maxPageLimit {
		limit = maxPageLimit
	}
	return limit, offset
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#readBody

``````
func readBody(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, max int64) ([]byte, error) {
	if r.Body == nil {
		return nil, nil
	}
	raw, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, max+1))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if int64(len(raw)) > max {
		return nil, ErrTooLarge
	}
	return raw, nil
}

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.dataCall

``````
// dataCall exposes only bounded blob/archive services, authenticated like all
// other plugin-host calls. HostAdapter performs the live grant checks.
func (h *HostHandler) dataCall(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var args json.RawMessage
	if !h.decode(w, r, maxHostBodyBytes, &args) {
		return
	}
	service, ok := h.host.(interface {
		CallDataHost(context.Context, string, string, json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error)
	})
	if !ok {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "unavailable", "Data services unavailable")
		return
	}
	name := r.PathValue("service")
	ctx := r.Context()
	if name == "cache.stat" && strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get(HeaderViewerToken)) != "" {
		ctx = plugins.WithCallContext(ctx, "/ether/v1/frontend/", "")
	}
	out, err := service.CallDataHost(ctx, pluginIDOf(r), name, args)
	if !h.finishErr(w, err) {
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out)
}

``````
type HashRequest struct {
	URL        string `json:"url"`
	Algo       string `json:"algo"`
	ExpectSize *int64 `json:"expectSize,omitempty"`
	// Headers sends optional request headers with the hash fetch. Values may
	// use {secret:<name>} placeholders expanded via permissions.secrets;
	// hop-by-hop and framing headers are rejected, headers follow redirects
	// only under Ether's redirect credential policy (same origin, strict
	// same-site subdomain, or KeepHeadersOnRedirect within granted hosts), and
	// values are never logged or persisted in the hash cache.
	Headers map[string]string `json:"headers,omitempty"`
	// KeepHeadersOnRedirect lists optional host or wildcard (*.example.org)
	// patterns (within permissions.network / granted hosts) that may keep
	// credentials and caller headers across redirects. Never applies across
	// HTTPS -> HTTP downgrades.
	KeepHeadersOnRedirect []string `json:"keepHeadersOnRedirect,omitempty"`
}

## Source: internal/plugins/remote_hash.go#validateHashHeaders

``````
func validateHashHeaders(headers map[string]string, expanded bool) error {
	if len(headers) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	if len(headers) > maxHashHeaders {
		return &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{
			Field:   "headers",
			Message: fmt.Sprintf("at most %d headers are allowed", maxHashHeaders),
		}}}
	}
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(headers))
	totalBytes := 0
	for name, val := range headers {
		if name == "" || !httpguts.ValidHeaderFieldName(name) {
			return &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{
				Field:   "headers",
				Message: fmt.Sprintf("invalid header name %q", name),
			}}}
		}
		canonical := http.CanonicalHeaderKey(name)
		if forbiddenHashHeaders[canonical] {
			return &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{
				Field:   "headers",
				Message: fmt.Sprintf("header %q is not allowed", canonical),
			}}}
		}
		if _, dup := seen[canonical]; dup {
			return &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{
				Field:   "headers",
				Message: fmt.Sprintf("duplicate header %q", canonical),
			}}}
		}
		seen[canonical] = struct{}{}
		totalBytes += len(name) + len(val)
		if totalBytes > maxHashHeaderBytes {
			return &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{
				Field:   "headers",
				Message: fmt.Sprintf("headers exceed %d bytes", maxHashHeaderBytes),
			}}}
		}
		if strings.ContainsAny(val, "\r\n\x00") || !httpguts.ValidHeaderFieldValue(val) {
			msg := fmt.Sprintf("header %q has an invalid HTTP header value", canonical)
			if expanded {
				msg = fmt.Sprintf("header %q expanded to an invalid HTTP header value", canonical)
			}
			return &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{Field: "headers", Message: msg}}}
		}
	}
	return nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote_hash.go#*host.expandHashHeaders

``````
func (h *host) expandHashHeaders(ctx context.Context, headers map[string]string) (map[string]string, error) {
	if len(headers) == 0 {
		return nil, nil
	}
	if err := validateHashHeaders(headers, false); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	expanded, err := kindstream.ExpandHeaders(ctx, headers, h.SecretGet)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, kindstream.ErrInvalidTemplate) {
			return nil, &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{Field: "headers", Message: err.Error()}}}
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := validateHashHeaders(expanded, true); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return expanded, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote_hash.go#*host.hashPermission

``````
func (h *host) hashPermission(ctx context.Context, req HashRequest) error {
	if req.Algo != "sha256" && req.Algo != "sha1" && req.Algo != "md5" {
		return fmt.Errorf("plugins: hash algo must be sha256, sha1 or md5")
	}
	if req.ExpectSize != nil && (*req.ExpectSize < 0 || *req.ExpectSize > RemoteHashMaxBytes) {
		return fmt.Errorf("plugins: hash size outside limit")
	}
	u, err := url.Parse(req.URL)
	if err != nil || (u.Scheme != "http" && u.Scheme != "https") || u.Hostname() == "" {
		return ErrPermissionDenied
	}
	if err := h.allowNetworkURL(ctx, u); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(req.KeepHeadersOnRedirect) > 0 {
		r, g, err := h.record(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, err := validateKeepHeadersOnRedirect(r.Manifest, g, req.KeepHeadersOnRedirect); err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, ErrPermissionDenied) {
				h.noteDenied("network")
			}
			return err
		}
	}
	if _, err := h.expandHashHeaders(ctx, req.Headers); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote_hash.go#*host.cachedRemoteHash

``````
func (h *host) cachedRemoteHash(ctx context.Context, key string) (remoteHashEntry, error) {
	var e remoteHashEntry
	var data []byte
	err := h.m.store.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT etag,modified,value,checked FROM plugins_remote_hashes WHERE plugin=? AND urlkey=?`, h.plugin, key).Scan(&e.etag, &e.modified, &data, &e.checked)
	if err == nil {
		err = json.Unmarshal(data, &e.HashResult)
	}
	return e, err
}

## Source: internal/plugins/remote_hash.go#*host.HTTPHash

``````
func (h *host) HTTPHash(ctx context.Context, req HashRequest) (HashResult, error) {
	if err := h.hashPermission(ctx, req); err != nil {
		return HashResult{}, err
	}
	key := fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte(req.URL)))
	e, err := h.cachedRemoteHash(ctx, key)
	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
		return HashResult{}, err
	}
	if err == nil && h.m.now().Sub(time.Unix(e.checked, 0)) < remoteHashFresh {
		if req.ExpectSize != nil && *req.ExpectSize != e.Size {
			return HashResult{}, fmt.Errorf("plugins: hash size did not match expectSize")
		}
		return e.HashResult, nil
	}
	m := h.m
	m.remoteHashMu.Lock()
	defer m.remoteHashMu.Unlock()
	if m.remoteHashes == nil {
		m.remoteHashes = map[string]*remoteHashWork{}
	}
	if work := m.remoteHashes[h.plugin]; work != nil {
		select {
		case <-work.done:
			// The worker may have committed after our first cache read.
			if work.key == key && work.err == nil {
				if fresh, err := h.cachedRemoteHash(ctx, key); err == nil && m.now().Sub(time.Unix(fresh.checked, 0)) < remoteHashFresh {
					if req.ExpectSize != nil && *req.ExpectSize != fresh.Size {
						return HashResult{}, fmt.Errorf("plugins: hash size did not match expectSize")
					}
					return fresh.HashResult, nil
				}
			}
			if work.key == key && work.err != nil && m.now().Sub(work.ended) < 30*time.Second {
				return HashResult{}, work.err
			}
		default:
			return HashResult{Pending: true, RetryInMS: 1000}, nil
		}
	}
	// Recheck enabled state under the cancellation lock so a disable cannot
	// race between authorization and registering this worker.
	if _, _, err := h.record(ctx); err != nil {
		return HashResult{}, err
	}
	workerReq := req
	if len(req.Headers) > 0 {
		workerReq.Headers = maps.Clone(req.Headers)
	}
	workCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 12*time.Hour)
	w := &remoteHashWork{key: key, cancel: cancel, done: make(chan struct{})}
	m.remoteHashes[h.plugin] = w
	go func() {
		defer cancel()
		select {
		case folderHashSlots <- struct{}{}:
			defer func() { <-folderHashSlots }()
		case <-workCtx.Done():
			w.err = workCtx.Err()
			close(w.done)
			return
		}
		// Waiting plugins consume a goroutine, never a dedicated OS thread.
		runtime.LockOSThread()
		lowerJobPriority()
		w.err = h.computeRemoteHash(workCtx, workerReq, key, e)
		w.ended = m.now()
		close(w.done)
	}()
	return HashResult{Pending: true, RetryInMS: 1000}, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote_hash.go#*Manager.cancelRemoteHashes

``````
func (m *Manager) cancelRemoteHashes(id string) {
	m.remoteHashMu.Lock()
	defer m.remoteHashMu.Unlock()
	for plugin, w := range m.remoteHashes {
		if id == "" || plugin == id {
			w.cancel()
		}
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote_hash.go#*host.computeRemoteHash

``````
func (h *host) computeRemoteHash(ctx context.Context, req HashRequest, key string, old remoteHashEntry) error {
	if err := wasm.WaitBackground(ctx, h.m.deps.Busy); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	expanded, err := h.expandHashHeaders(ctx, req.Headers)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	headers := make(map[string]string, len(expanded)+3)
	stripCrossOrigin := make([]string, 0, len(expanded))
	for k, v := range expanded {
		ck := http.CanonicalHeaderKey(k)
		if ck == "Accept-Encoding" || ck == "If-None-Match" || ck == "If-Modified-Since" {
			continue
		}
		headers[ck] = v
		stripCrossOrigin = append(stripCrossOrigin, ck)
	}
	headers["Accept-Encoding"] = "identity"
	if old.etag != "" {
		headers["If-None-Match"] = old.etag
	} else if old.modified != "" {
		headers["If-Modified-Since"] = old.modified
	}
	fetchCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 10*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	resp, err := h.openFetchWithOptions(fetchCtx, FetchRequest{
		URL:                   req.URL,
		Headers:               headers,
		KeepHeadersOnRedirect: req.KeepHeadersOnRedirect,
	}, fetchOptions{
		stripCrossOriginHeaders: stripCrossOrigin,
		stripAllCallerHeaders:   true,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	if resp.StatusCode == 304 && old.SHA256 != "" {
		_, err = h.m.store.db.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE plugins_remote_hashes SET checked=? WHERE plugin=? AND urlkey=?`, h.m.now().Unix(), h.plugin, key)
		return err
	}
	if resp.StatusCode != 200 {
		return fmt.Errorf("plugins: hash HTTP %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}
	if resp.ContentLength > RemoteHashMaxBytes {
		return fmt.Errorf("plugins: hash size outside limit")
	}
	if req.ExpectSize != nil && resp.ContentLength >= 0 && resp.ContentLength != *req.ExpectSize {
		return fmt.Errorf("plugins: hash size did not match expectSize")
	}
	// Reserve the remaining allowance durably before reading. An interrupted
	// process conservatively keeps its reservation; normal completion refunds it.
	day := h.m.now().UTC().Format("2006-01-02")
	_, err = h.m.store.db.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO plugins_remote_hash_budget(plugin,day,bytes) VALUES(?,?,0) ON CONFLICT(plugin) DO UPDATE SET day=excluded.day,bytes=0 WHERE plugins_remote_hash_budget.day<>excluded.day`, h.plugin, day)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var used int64
	if err = h.m.store.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT bytes FROM plugins_remote_hash_budget WHERE plugin=?`, h.plugin).Scan(&used); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	allowance := RemoteHashDailyBytes - used
	if allowance <= 0 {
		h.m.log.Info("plugins: daily hash byte budget reached", "plugin", h.plugin)
		return fmt.Errorf("plugins: daily hash byte budget reached")
	}
	if resp.ContentLength > allowance {
		h.m.log.Info("plugins: daily hash byte budget reached", "plugin", h.plugin)
		return fmt.Errorf("plugins: daily hash byte budget reached")
	}
	reserve := allowance
	if resp.ContentLength >= 0 {
		reserve = resp.ContentLength
	}
	reservation, err := h.m.store.db.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE plugins_remote_hash_budget SET bytes=bytes+? WHERE plugin=? AND day=? AND bytes+?<=?`, reserve, h.plugin, day, reserve, RemoteHashDailyBytes)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if n, err := reservation.RowsAffected(); err != nil {
		return err
	} else if n != 1 {
		h.m.log.Info("plugins: daily hash byte budget reached", "plugin", h.plugin)
		return fmt.Errorf("plugins: daily hash byte budget reached")
	}
	var size int64
	defer func() {
		refundCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		_, _ = h.m.store.db.ExecContext(refundCtx, `UPDATE plugins_remote_hash_budget SET bytes=bytes-? WHERE plugin=? AND day=?`, max(int64(0), reserve-size), h.plugin, day)
	}()
	a, b, c := sha256.New(), sha1.New(), md5.New()
	buf := make([]byte, 256<<10)
	var checkedGrants time.Time
	limit := min(RemoteHashMaxBytes, reserve)
	for {
		if err = wasm.WaitBackground(ctx, h.m.deps.Busy); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		// Recheck grants at most once a second rather than querying the store
		// for every chunk. Disable/uninstall also cancels the read context.
		if time.Since(checkedGrants) >= time.Second {
			if err = h.hashPermission(ctx, req); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			checkedGrants = time.Now()
		}
		n, readErr := resp.Body.Read(buf[:min(int64(len(buf)), limit-size+1)])
		size += int64(n)
		if size > limit {
			return fmt.Errorf("plugins: hash exceeded byte limit")
		}
		if n > 0 {
			_, _ = a.Write(buf[:n])
			_, _ = b.Write(buf[:n])
			_, _ = c.Write(buf[:n])
		}
		if readErr == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if readErr != nil {
			return fetchError(resp.Request.URL.Hostname(), readErr)
		}
	}
	if req.ExpectSize != nil && size != *req.ExpectSize {
		return fmt.Errorf("plugins: hash size did not match expectSize")
	}
	result := HashResult{Size: size, SHA256: fmt.Sprintf("%x", a.Sum(nil)), SHA1: fmt.Sprintf("%x", b.Sum(nil)), MD5: fmt.Sprintf("%x", c.Sum(nil))}
	data, _ := json.Marshal(result)
	_, err = h.m.store.db.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO plugins_remote_hashes(plugin,urlkey,etag,modified,size,value,checked) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(plugin,urlkey) DO UPDATE SET etag=excluded.etag,modified=excluded.modified,size=excluded.size,value=excluded.value,checked=excluded.checked`, h.plugin, key, resp.Header.Get("ETag"), resp.Header.Get("Last-Modified"), size, data, h.m.now().Unix())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = h.m.store.db.ExecContext(ctx, `DELETE FROM plugins_remote_hashes WHERE plugin=? AND urlkey IN (SELECT urlkey FROM plugins_remote_hashes WHERE plugin=? ORDER BY checked DESC LIMIT 2147483647 OFFSET 2048)`, h.plugin, h.plugin)
	return err
}
``````

func defaultRuntimeCeilings() runtimeCeilings {
	return runtimeCeilings{
		memory:    2 << 30,
		deadline:  12 * time.Hour,
		units:     1 << 60,
		poolSize:  wasm.DefaultPoolCeiling,
		fetch:     8 << 30,
		member:    8 << 30,
		expanded:  32 << 30,
		members:   65535,
		maxItems:  DefaultMaxPluginItems,
		listItems: MaxListItems,
	}
}

## Source: internal/plugins/runtime_limits.go#applyRuntimeCeilings

``````
func applyRuntimeCeilings(c runtimeCeilings, l config.PluginRuntimeLimits) runtimeCeilings {
	if l.MemoryBytes > 0 {
		c.memory = min(l.MemoryBytes, uint64(wasm.MaxMemoryBytes))
	}
	if d, err := time.ParseDuration(l.Deadline); err == nil && d > 0 {
		c.deadline = min(d, 365*24*time.Hour)
	}
	if l.UnitBudget > 0 {
		c.units = l.UnitBudget
	}
	if l.PoolSize > 0 {
		c.poolSize = min(l.PoolSize, wasm.MaxPoolSize)
	}
	if l.FetchBytes > 0 {
		c.fetch = min(l.FetchBytes, int64(1<<60))
	}
	if l.ArchiveMemberBytes > 0 {
		c.member = min(l.ArchiveMemberBytes, int64(1<<60))
	}
	if l.ArchiveExpandedBytes > 0 {
		c.expanded = min(l.ArchiveExpandedBytes, int64(1<<60))
	}
	if l.ArchiveMembers > 0 {
		c.members = min(l.ArchiveMembers, 1000000)
	}
	if l.MaxItems > 0 {
		c.maxItems = l.MaxItems
	}
	if l.ListItems > 0 {
		c.listItems = min(l.ListItems, MaxListItems)
	}
	return c
}
``````

func (m *Manager) runtimeCeilings(id string) runtimeCeilings {

## Source: internal/plugins/runtime_limits.go#*Manager.grantedMaxItems

func (m *Manager) grantedMaxItems(man Manifest, c runtimeCeilings) int {
	n := c.maxItems
	if m != nil && m.runtimeConfig().RuntimeOverrides[man.ID].MaxItems > 0 {
		return n
	}
	if man.Ether != nil && man.Ether.Runtime.Limits != nil && man.Ether.Runtime.Limits.MaxItems > 0 {
		n = min(n, man.Ether.Runtime.Limits.MaxItems)
	}
	return n
}

## Source: internal/plugins/runtime_limits.go#*Manager.MaxPluginItems

``````
// MaxPluginItems returns the effective stored-item ceiling across all content
// libraries owned by id (default 2,000,000; owner-configurable globally and per
// plugin with no upper bound).
func (m *Manager) MaxPluginItems(id string) int {
	if m == nil {
		return DefaultMaxPluginItems
	}
	c := m.runtimeCeilings(id)
	if m.store != nil && id != "" {
		if rec, err := m.store.record(context.Background(), id); err == nil {
			return m.grantedMaxItems(rec.Manifest, c)
		}
	}
	return c.maxItems
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/runtime_limits.go#runtimeLimitsWithCeilings

``````
func runtimeLimitsWithCeilings(m Manifest, c runtimeCeilings) wasm.Limits {
	l := wasm.Limits{
		MemoryBytes: min(uint64(32<<20), c.memory),
		Deadline:    c.deadline,
		UnitBudget:  c.units,
		PoolSize:    min(wasm.DefaultPoolSize, c.poolSize),
		Stremio:     m.SpeaksStremio(),
	}
	if m.Ether != nil && m.Ether.Runtime.Limits != nil {
		r := m.Ether.Runtime.Limits
		if r.MemoryBytes > 0 {
			l.MemoryBytes = min(r.MemoryBytes, c.memory)
		}
		if d, err := time.ParseDuration(r.Deadline); err == nil && d > 0 {
			l.Deadline = min(d, c.deadline)
		}
		if r.UnitBudget > 0 {
			l.UnitBudget = min(r.UnitBudget, c.units)
		}
		if r.PoolSize > 0 {
			l.PoolSize = min(r.PoolSize, c.poolSize)
		}
	}
	return l
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/runtime_limits.go#*Manager.grantedRuntimeLimits

``````
func (m *Manager) grantedRuntimeLimits(man Manifest) *RuntimeLimits {
	if man.RuntimeKind() != "hosted" {
		return nil
	}
	c := m.runtimeCeilings(man.ID)
	l := runtimeLimitsWithCeilings(man, c)
	r := &RuntimeLimits{
		MemoryBytes: l.MemoryBytes,
		ReadBytes:   wasm.DataReadBytes(l.MemoryBytes),
		Deadline:    l.Deadline.String(),
		UnitBudget:  l.UnitBudget,
		PoolSize:    m.grantedPoolSize(man, c),
	}
	r.FetchBytes = c.fetch
	r.ArchiveMemberBytes = c.member
	r.ArchiveExpandedBytes = c.expanded
	r.ArchiveMembers = c.members
	r.MaxItems = m.grantedMaxItems(man, c)
	if req := man.Ether.Runtime.Limits; req != nil {
		if req.FetchBytes > 0 {
			r.FetchBytes = min(r.FetchBytes, req.FetchBytes)
		}
		if req.ArchiveMemberBytes > 0 {
			r.ArchiveMemberBytes = min(r.ArchiveMemberBytes, req.ArchiveMemberBytes)
		}
		if req.ArchiveExpandedBytes > 0 {
			r.ArchiveExpandedBytes = min(r.ArchiveExpandedBytes, req.ArchiveExpandedBytes)
		}
		if req.ArchiveMembers > 0 {
			r.ArchiveMembers = min(r.ArchiveMembers, req.ArchiveMembers)
		}
	}
	return r
}
