## Source: internal/plugins/runtime_limits.go#*Manager.handleRuntimeLimits

``````
func (m *Manager) handleRuntimeLimits(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	plugin := r.URL.Query().Get("plugin")
	if r.Method == http.MethodPut {
		var req struct {
			Plugin string                     `json:"plugin"`
			Limits config.PluginRuntimeLimits `json:"limits"`
		}
		if err := decode(r, &req); err != nil {
			m.fail(w, err)
			return
		}
		if req.Limits.MemoryBytes > wasm.MaxMemoryBytes || req.Limits.UnitBudget < 0 || req.Limits.PoolSize < 0 || req.Limits.PoolSize > wasm.MaxPoolSize || req.Limits.FetchBytes < 0 || req.Limits.ArchiveMemberBytes < 0 || req.Limits.ArchiveExpandedBytes < 0 || req.Limits.ArchiveMembers < 0 || req.Limits.ArchiveMembers > 1000000 || req.Limits.MaxItems < 0 || req.Limits.ListItems < 0 || req.Limits.ListItems > MaxListItems {
			writeErr(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "validation", fmt.Sprintf("Memory must be at most 4 GiB, instances at most %d, titles per list at most %d, and resource limits must not be negative.", wasm.MaxPoolSize, MaxListItems), nil)
			return
		}
		if req.Limits.UploadBytes < 0 || req.Limits.UploadBytes > MaxAdapterUploadBytes || (req.Plugin == "" && req.Limits.UploadBytes != 0) {
			m.fail(w, &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{Field: "uploadBytes", Message: "expected a per-plugin upload limit from 0 to 512 MiB"}}})
			return
		}
		plugin = req.Plugin
		if req.Limits.DurableBytes < 0 || req.Limits.DurableFiles < 0 ||
			(plugin == "" && (req.Limits.DurableBytes != 0 || req.Limits.DurableFiles != 0)) ||
			req.Limits.DurableFreePercent < 0 || req.Limits.DurableFreePercent > 100 ||
			(plugin != "" && req.Limits.DurableFreePercent != 0) {
			writeErr(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "durable_quota_invalid", "Invalid durable storage settings.", nil)
			return
		}
		if req.Limits.Deadline != "" {
			if d, err := time.ParseDuration(req.Limits.Deadline); err != nil || d <= 0 || d > 365*24*time.Hour {
				writeErr(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "validation", "Time limit must be positive and at most one year.", nil)
				return
			}
		}
		if req.Plugin != "" {
			if _, err := m.Get(r.Context(), req.Plugin); err != nil {
				m.fail(w, err)
				return
			}
		}
		if m.deps.SaveRuntimeConfig == nil {
			m.fail(w, fmt.Errorf("runtime settings are unavailable"))
			return
		}
		m.storageMu.Lock()
		cfg := m.runtimeConfig()
		before := cfg.RuntimeLimits
		if plugin != "" {
			before = cfg.RuntimeOverrides[plugin]
		}
		after := req.Limits
		if after.DurableBytes > before.DurableBytes || after.DurableFiles > before.DurableFiles {
			capacity, _ := m.deps.DurableStorage.Capacity(cfg.RuntimeLimits.DurableFreePercent)
			if (after.DurableBytes > before.DurableBytes && after.DurableBytes > capacity.Bytes) ||
				(after.DurableFiles > before.DurableFiles && after.DurableFiles > capacity.Files) {
				m.storageMu.Unlock()
				writeErr(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "durable_quota_ceiling", "Durable quota exceeds the current volume ceiling.", nil)
				return
			}
		}
		err := m.deps.SaveRuntimeConfig(plugin, after)
		m.storageMu.Unlock()
		if err != nil {
			m.fail(w, err)
			return
		}
		// Durable quotas are consulted live and do not require stopping plugin jobs.
		if runtimeLimitsWithoutDurable(before) != runtimeLimitsWithoutDurable(after) {
			recs, err := m.List(r.Context())
			if err != nil {
				m.fail(w, err)
				return
			}
			for _, rec := range recs {
				if plugin == "" || plugin == rec.ID {
					m.closeRuntime(rec.ID)
				}
			}
		}
		m.broadcast(r.Context())
	}
	cfg := m.runtimeConfig()
	out := struct {
		config.Plugins
		DurableStorage *durableLimitsStatus `json:"durableStorage,omitempty"`
	}{Plugins: cfg}
	if plugin != "" && m.deps.DurableStorage != nil {
		rec, err := m.Get(r.Context(), plugin)
		if err != nil {
			m.fail(w, err)
			return
		}
		if allowsDurableStorage(storagePermission(rec.Manifest)) {
			store := m.deps.DurableStorage
			capacity, diskErr := store.Capacity(cfg.RuntimeLimits.DurableFreePercent)
			usage, usageErr := store.Usage(plugin)
			out.DurableStorage = &durableLimitsStatus{
				Capacity: capacity, DiskAvailable: diskErr == nil,
			}
			if usageErr == nil {
				out.DurableStorage.Usage = &usage
			}
		}
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out)
}
``````

func withCallRecord(ctx context.Context, h Host) context.Context {
	ph, ok := h.(*host)
	if !ok {
		return ctx
	}
	rec, err := ph.m.store.record(ctx, ph.plugin)
	if err != nil {
		return ctx
	}
	return context.WithValue(ctx, callRecordKey{}, cachedCallRecord{m: ph.m, plugin: ph.plugin, rec: rec})
}

func (h *host) callRecord(ctx context.Context) (Record, error) {
	if cached, ok := ctx.Value(callRecordKey{}).(cachedCallRecord); ok && cached.m == h.m && cached.plugin == h.plugin {
		return cached.rec, nil
	}
	return h.m.store.record(ctx, h.plugin)
}

## Source: internal/plugins/runtime_limits.go#*host.DataLimits

``````
// DataLimits exposes owner grants to shared hosted/remote data services.
func (h *host) DataLimits(ctx context.Context) RuntimeLimits {
	rec, err := h.callRecord(ctx)
	if err == nil {
		if l := h.m.grantedRuntimeLimits(rec.Manifest); l != nil {
			return *l
		}
	}
	c := h.m.runtimeCeilings(h.plugin)
	maxItems := c.maxItems
	if err == nil {
		maxItems = h.m.grantedMaxItems(rec.Manifest, c)
	}
	return RuntimeLimits{
		FetchBytes:           c.fetch,
		ArchiveMemberBytes:   c.member,
		ArchiveExpandedBytes: c.expanded,
		ArchiveMembers:       c.members,
		MaxItems:             maxItems,
		MemoryBytes:          c.memory,
		ReadBytes:            wasm.DataReadBytes(c.memory),
		Deadline:             c.deadline.String(),
	}
}

## Source: internal/plugins/settings_public.go#NonSecretSettings

``````
// NonSecretSettings applies declared defaults, then stored public settings.
// Explicit zero, false, empty and null values take precedence over defaults.
// Studio uses the same secret field classifier as installed settings storage.
func NonSecretSettings(settings map[string]any, schema json.RawMessage, declaredSecrets []string) map[string]any {
	secretNames := secretFieldNames(schema)
	for _, key := range declaredSecrets {
		secretNames[key] = true
	}
	out := make(map[string]any, len(settings))
	var doc map[string]any
	if json.Unmarshal(schema, &doc) == nil {
		visitSettingsFields(doc, func(key string, field map[string]any) {
			if field["kind"] == "secret" || field["type"] == "secret" {
				secretNames[key] = true
			}
		})
		visitSettingsFields(doc, func(key string, field map[string]any) {
			if value, exists := field["default"]; exists && !secretNames[key] {
				out[key] = value
			}
		})
	}
	for key, value := range settings {
		if !secretNames[key] {
			out[key] = value
		}
	}
	return out
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/settings_public.go#visitSettingsFields

``````
// Only traverse the schema's supported field containers, never default values or
// arbitrary nested objects that happen to contain a key/default pair.
func visitSettingsFields(doc map[string]any, visit func(string, map[string]any)) {
	for _, container := range []string{"fields", "groups"} {
		entries, _ := doc[container].([]any)
		for _, entry := range entries {
			field, ok := entry.(map[string]any)
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			if container == "fields" && field["kind"] != "group" {
				if key, ok := firstString(field, "key", "name", "id", "field"); ok {
					visit(key, field)
				}
			}
			visitSettingsFields(field, visit)
		}
	}
	properties, _ := doc["properties"].(map[string]any)
	for key, raw := range properties {
		if field, ok := raw.(map[string]any); ok {
			visit(key, field)
		}
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/setup.go#init

func init() {

## Source: internal/plugins/setup.go#validateSetup

``````
func validateSetup(e *EtherBlock, add func(string, string), label func(string, string, int)) {
	if e.Contributes.Setup == nil {
		return
	}
	steps := e.Contributes.Setup.Steps
	if len(steps) == 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.setup.steps", "must list at least one step")
	}
	schemaFields := settingsFieldKeys(e.Settings)
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for i, s := range steps {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.setup.steps[%d]", i)
		if !keyRe.MatchString(s.Key) || seen[s.Key] {
			add(base+".key", "must be a unique simple key")
		}
		seen[s.Key] = true
		label(base+".label", s.Label, 60)
		if s.Hint != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(s.Hint, "$t:") {
			if msg := LintCopy(s.Hint, 120); msg != "" {
				add(base+".hint", msg)
			}
			if strings.Count(strings.TrimRight(s.Hint, "."), ".") > 0 {
				add(base+".hint", "must be one sentence")
			}
		}
		for j, f := range s.Fields {
			if !keyRe.MatchString(f) {
				add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.fields[%d]", base, j), "must be a settings field key")
			} else if schemaFields != nil && !schemaFields[f] {
				add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.fields[%d]", base, j), "is not a field in the settings schema")
			}
		}
		if s.Test != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(s.Test, "/") {
			add(base+".test", "must be a plugin route starting with /")
		}
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/setup.go#settingsFieldKeys

``````
// settingsFieldKeys extracts every "key" string from an inline settings
// schema. A "$ref" schema is resolved at install, so it returns nil
// and field membership is not checked here.
func settingsFieldKeys(raw json.RawMessage) map[string]bool {
	if len(raw) == 0 {
		return map[string]bool{}
	}
	var doc any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &doc); err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	if obj, ok := doc.(map[string]any); ok {
		if _, isRef := obj["$ref"]; isRef {
			return nil
		}
	}
	out := map[string]bool{}
	var walk func(v any)
	walk = func(v any) {
		switch n := v.(type) {
		case map[string]any:
			if k, ok := n["key"].(string); ok {
				out[k] = true
			}
			for _, child := range n {
				walk(child)
			}
		case []any:
			for _, child := range n {
				walk(child)
			}
		}
	}
	walk(doc)
	return out
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/setup.go#*storage.setupState

``````
func (s *storage) setupState(ctx context.Context, plugin string) ([]SetupStepState, error) {
	rows, err := s.db.QueryContext(ctx, `SELECT step,status,detail,at FROM plugins_setup WHERE plugin=? ORDER BY step`, plugin)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var out []SetupStepState
	for rows.Next() {
		var st SetupStepState
		var at int64
		if err := rows.Scan(&st.Step, &st.Status, &st.Detail, &at); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		st.At = time.Unix(at, 0).UTC()
		out = append(out, st)
	}
	return out, rows.Err()
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/setup.go#*storage.putSetupState

``````
func (s *storage) putSetupState(ctx context.Context, plugin, step, status, detail string) error {
	_, err := s.db.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO plugins_setup(plugin,step,status,detail,at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)
ON CONFLICT(plugin,step) DO UPDATE SET status=excluded.status,detail=excluded.detail,at=excluded.at`,
		plugin, step, status, detail, s.now().Unix())
	return err
}

## Source: internal/plugins/setup.go#*Manager.SetupState

``````
// SetupState returns every recorded setup step result for a plugin,
// with unrecorded steps reported as pending, in manifest order.
func (m *Manager) SetupState(ctx context.Context, pluginID string) ([]SetupStepState, error) {
	r, err := m.Get(ctx, pluginID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	stored, err := m.store.setupState(ctx, pluginID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	byStep := map[string]SetupStepState{}
	for _, st := range stored {
		byStep[st.Step] = st
	}
	var out []SetupStepState
	if e := r.Manifest.EffectiveEther(); e != nil && e.Contributes.Setup != nil {
		for _, step := range e.Contributes.Setup.Steps {
			if st, ok := byStep[step.Key]; ok {
				out = append(out, st)
			} else {
				out = append(out, SetupStepState{Step: step.Key, Status: SetupPending})
			}
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/setup.go#*Manager.SetupBlockers

``````
// SetupBlockers lists the required setup steps still holding a plugin
// back: steps that have neither passed nor been skipped by the owner
// (spec §8). Content adapters keep libraries hidden and sync stopped
// while this is non-empty.
func (m *Manager) SetupBlockers(ctx context.Context, pluginID string) ([]string, error) {
	r, err := m.Get(ctx, pluginID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	e := r.Manifest.EffectiveEther()
	if e == nil || e.Contributes.Setup == nil {
		return nil, nil
	}
	state, err := m.SetupState(ctx, pluginID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	byStep := map[string]SetupStepState{}
	for _, st := range state {
		byStep[st.Step] = st
	}
	var blocked []string
	for _, step := range e.Contributes.Setup.Steps {
		if !step.Required {
			continue
		}
		if st := byStep[step.Key]; st.Status != SetupOK && st.Status != SetupSkipped {
			blocked = append(blocked, step.Key)
		}
	}
	return blocked, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/setup.go#setupStepOf

``````
func setupStepOf(r Record, key string) (SetupStep, bool) {
	if e := r.Manifest.EffectiveEther(); e != nil && e.Contributes.Setup != nil {
		for _, s := range e.Contributes.Setup.Steps {
			if s.Key == key {
				return s, true
			}
		}
	}
	return SetupStep{}, false
}

## Source: internal/plugins/setup.go#*Manager.TestSetupStep

``````
// TestSetupStep runs one setup step's test against the saved settings
// and records the result. Only the step's non-secret field values are
// sent; secrets reach the plugin through SecretGet, never in the test
// body (spec §8). A step with no test route passes once it is run.
func (m *Manager) TestSetupStep(ctx context.Context, pluginID, stepKey string) (SetupTestResult, error) {
	r, err := m.Get(ctx, pluginID)
	if err != nil {
		return SetupTestResult{}, err
	}
	step, ok := setupStepOf(r, stepKey)
	if !ok {
		return SetupTestResult{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: plugin has no setup step %q", ErrUnavailable, stepKey)
	}
	if step.Test == "" {
		res := SetupTestResult{OK: true}
		if err := m.store.putSetupState(ctx, pluginID, stepKey, SetupOK, ""); err != nil {
			return res, err
		}
		m.syncDescriptors(ctx, r)
		m.broadcast(ctx)
		return res, nil
	}
	settings, err := m.HostFor(pluginID).Settings(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return SetupTestResult{}, err
	}
	values := map[string]any{}
	for _, f := range step.Fields {
		if v, present := settings[f]; present {
			values[f] = v
		}
	}
	body, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"step": stepKey, "fields": values})
	if err != nil {
		return SetupTestResult{}, err
	}
	callCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	resp, err := m.Call(callCtx, pluginID, Request{Method: "POST", Path: step.Test, Body: body})
	if err != nil {
		_ = m.store.putSetupState(ctx, pluginID, stepKey, SetupFailed, "The plugin did not answer")
		m.syncDescriptors(ctx, r)
		m.broadcast(ctx)
		return SetupTestResult{OK: false, Detail: "The plugin did not answer"}, nil
	}
	var res SetupTestResult
	if len(resp.Body) > 0 {
		_ = json.Unmarshal(resp.Body, &res)
	}
	if resp.Status >= 300 {
		res.OK = false
		if res.Detail == "" {
			res.Detail = fmt.Sprintf("The plugin answered with status %d", resp.Status)
		}
	}
	res.Detail = textclip.Bytes(res.Detail, 500)
	status := SetupFailed
	if res.OK {
		status = SetupOK
	}
	if err := m.store.putSetupState(ctx, pluginID, stepKey, status, res.Detail); err != nil {
		return SetupTestResult{}, err
	}
	m.syncDescriptors(ctx, r)
	m.broadcast(ctx)
	return res, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/setup.go#*Manager.SkipSetupStep

``````
// SkipSetupStep records the owner's "skip for now" on one step, which
// unblocks the plugin while leaving the step visibly unfinished.
func (m *Manager) SkipSetupStep(ctx context.Context, pluginID, stepKey string) error {
	r, err := m.Get(ctx, pluginID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, ok := setupStepOf(r, stepKey); !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: plugin has no setup step %q", ErrUnavailable, stepKey)
	}
	if err := m.store.putSetupState(ctx, pluginID, stepKey, SetupSkipped, ""); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	m.syncDescriptors(ctx, r)
	m.broadcast(ctx)
	return nil
}

// Tools returns the 8 Studio and extensibility tools (WS11h):
// registry_describe, viewspec_validate, viewspec_render, plugin_scaffold,

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#registryDescribeTool

``````
func registryDescribeTool(deps ToolDeps) tools.Tool {
	schema := json.RawMessage(`{
		"type": "object",
		"properties": {
			"kind": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Optional descriptor kind to filter by (for example rankingStep, ruleField, collectionSource, page, widget, tool)."
			},
			"id": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Optional descriptor ID to inspect."
			},
			"owner": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Optional owner filter (builtin or a plugin ID)."
			},
			"locale": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Locale code for resolving copy, defaulting to en."
			},
			"limit": {
				"type": "integer",
				"minimum": 1,
				"maximum": 200,
				"description": "Maximum number of descriptors to return (1 to 200)."
			}
		},
		"additionalProperties": false
	}`)

	return tools.Tool{
		Name:        "registry_describe",
		Title:       "Describe extension registry",
		Description: "List registered extension descriptors by kind or owner, or inspect one descriptor in detail.",
		InputSchema: schema,
		ReadOnly:    true,
		Audience:    tools.AudienceOwner,
		Owner:       extend.Builtin,
		Execute: func(_ context.Context, _ tools.Principal, input map[string]any) (tools.Result, error) {
			if deps.Registry == nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("The extension registry is not available.")
			}
			kindStr, err := optString(input, "kind", 64)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			idStr, err := optString(input, "id", 128)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			ownerStr, err := optString(input, "owner", 128)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			locale, err := optString(input, "locale", 16)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			if locale == "" {
				locale = "en"
			}
			limit, err := optInt(input, "limit", 100, 1, 200)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}

			if kindStr != "" && !extend.Known(extend.Kind(kindStr)) {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Unknown descriptor kind %q.", kindStr)
			}

			resolver := deps.TextResolver
			if resolver == nil && deps.Manager != nil {
				resolver = deps.Manager.TextResolver()
			}
			resolveDescriptor := func(d extend.Descriptor) extend.Descriptor {
				if resolver != nil {
					if d.Label.Plugin != "" && d.Label.Key != "" {
						if s, ok := resolver(d.Label.Plugin, d.Label.Key, locale); ok {
							d.Label.Resolved = s
						}
					}
					if d.Hint.Plugin != "" && d.Hint.Key != "" {
						if s, ok := resolver(d.Hint.Plugin, d.Hint.Key, locale); ok {
							d.Hint.Resolved = s
						}
					}
				}
				return d
			}

			if kindStr != "" && idStr != "" {
				d, ok := deps.Registry.Get(extend.Kind(kindStr), idStr)
				if !ok {
					return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Descriptor %q of kind %q was not found.", idStr, kindStr)
				}
				return tools.Result{
					Data: map[string]any{
						"descriptor": resolveDescriptor(d),
					},
				}, nil
			}

			var list []extend.Descriptor
			if kindStr != "" {
				list = deps.Registry.List(extend.Kind(kindStr))
			} else {
				list = deps.Registry.List()
			}
			filtered := make([]extend.Descriptor, 0, len(list))
			for _, d := range list {
				if idStr != "" && d.ID != idStr {
					continue
				}
				if ownerStr != "" && d.Owner != ownerStr {
					continue
				}
				filtered = append(filtered, resolveDescriptor(d))
				if len(filtered) >= limit {
					break
				}
			}

			return tools.Result{
				Data: map[string]any{
					"count":       len(filtered),
					"descriptors": filtered,
				},
				Links: []tools.Link{
					{Label: "Open plugins", Route: "/settings/plugins"},
				},
			}, nil
		},
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#viewspecValidateTool

``````
func viewspecValidateTool() tools.Tool {
	schema := json.RawMessage(`{
		"type": "object",
		"required": ["spec"],
		"properties": {
			"spec": {
				"description": "The ViewSpec JSON object or JSON string to validate."
			}
		},
		"additionalProperties": false
	}`)

	return tools.Tool{
		Name:        "viewspec_validate",
		Title:       "Validate ViewSpec document",
		Description: "Validate a ViewSpec JSON document against Ether's plugin UI rules and report any field errors.",
		InputSchema: schema,
		ReadOnly:    true,
		Audience:    tools.AudienceOwner,
		Owner:       extend.Builtin,
		Execute: func(_ context.Context, _ tools.Principal, input map[string]any) (tools.Result, error) {
			rawSpec, ok := input["spec"]
			if !ok || rawSpec == nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Provide a spec object to validate.")
			}
			specBytes, err := encodeBoundedJSON(rawSpec, maxManifestBytes, "spec")
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			res := viewspec.ValidatePlugin(specBytes)
			errs := res.Errors
			if errs == nil {
				errs = []string{}
			}
			return tools.Result{
				Data: map[string]any{
					"ok":     res.OK,
					"errors": errs,
				},
			}, nil
		},
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#viewspecRenderTool

``````
func viewspecRenderTool(deps ToolDeps) tools.Tool {
	schema := json.RawMessage(`{
		"type": "object",
		"properties": {
			"spec": {
				"description": "The ViewSpec JSON object or JSON string to validate and prepare for console rendering."
			},
			"data": {
				"description": "Optional data object bound to the ViewSpec document."
			},
			"plugin": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Optional installed plugin ID to load a contributed page from."
			},
			"page": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Optional contributed page key on the installed plugin."
			}
		},
		"additionalProperties": false
	}`)

	return tools.Tool{
		Name:        "viewspec_render",
		Title:       "Render ViewSpec preview",
		Description: "Validate a ViewSpec document and data payload, and return the validated spec, data, and console preview URL.",
		InputSchema: schema,
		ReadOnly:    true,
		Audience:    tools.AudienceOwner,
		Owner:       extend.Builtin,
		Execute: func(ctx context.Context, _ tools.Principal, input map[string]any) (tools.Result, error) {
			pluginID, err := optString(input, "plugin", 128)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			pageKey, err := optString(input, "page", 64)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}

			var specBytes []byte
			var dataObj map[string]any

			if rawSpec, ok := input["spec"]; ok && rawSpec != nil {
				specBytes, err = encodeBoundedJSON(rawSpec, maxManifestBytes, "spec")
				if err != nil {
					return tools.Result{}, err
				}
			}
			if rawData, ok := input["data"]; ok && rawData != nil {
				dataBytes, err := encodeBoundedJSON(rawData, maxManifestBytes, "data")
				if err != nil {
					return tools.Result{}, err
				}
				if err := json.Unmarshal(dataBytes, &dataObj); err != nil {
					return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("The data field must be a JSON object.")
				}
			}

			if len(specBytes) == 0 {
				if pluginID == "" || pageKey == "" {
					return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Provide either spec or both plugin and page.")
				}
				if deps.Manager == nil {
					return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("The plugin manager is not available.")
				}
				rec, err := deps.Manager.Get(ctx, pluginID)
				if err != nil {
					return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Plugin %q is not installed.", pluginID)
				}
				route := ""
				if rec.Manifest.Ether != nil {
					for _, p := range rec.Manifest.Ether.Contributes.Pages {
						if p.Key == pageKey {
							route = p.Route
							break
						}
					}
				}
				if route == "" {
					return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Page %q was not found on plugin %q.", pageKey, pluginID)
				}
				resp, err := deps.Manager.Call(ctx, pluginID, plugins.Request{
					PluginID: pluginID,
					Method:   "GET",
					Path:     route,
				})
				if err != nil {
					return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Could not load page %q from plugin %q.", pageKey, pluginID)
				}
				body := unwrapResponseBody(resp.Body)
				var pageEnvelope struct {
					Spec json.RawMessage `json:"spec"`
					Data map[string]any  `json:"data"`
				}
				if json.Unmarshal(body, &pageEnvelope) == nil && len(pageEnvelope.Spec) > 0 {
					specBytes = pageEnvelope.Spec
					if dataObj == nil {
						dataObj = pageEnvelope.Data
					}
				} else {
					specBytes = body
				}
			}

			if dataObj == nil {
				dataObj = map[string]any{}
			}

			valRes := viewspec.ValidatePlugin(specBytes)
			if !valRes.OK {
				return tools.Result{
					Data: map[string]any{
						"ok":     false,
						"errors": valRes.Errors,
					},
				}, nil
			}

			var specObj map[string]any
			_ = json.Unmarshal(specBytes, &specObj)

			consoleURL := "/settings/plugins/studio/preview"
			if pluginID != "" && pageKey != "" {
				consoleURL = fmt.Sprintf("/plugins/%s/pages/%s", pluginID, pageKey)
			}

			return tools.Result{
				Data: map[string]any{
					"ok":         true,
					"spec":       specObj,
					"data":       dataObj,
					"consoleUrl": consoleURL,
				},
				Links: []tools.Link{
					{Label: "Open preview in console", Route: consoleURL},
				},
			}, nil
		},
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#ScaffoldRequest.fields.md

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#Scaffold

``````
// Scaffold builds a valid manifest and TypeScript entry file for the requested
// plugin kind and capabilities.
func Scaffold(req ScaffoldRequest) (ScaffoldResult, error) {
	id := strings.TrimSpace(req.ID)
	name := strings.TrimSpace(req.Name)
	if id == "" || len(id) > 120 {
		return ScaffoldResult{}, tools.Userf("Provide a reverse-DNS plugin id of at most 120 characters.")
	}
	if name == "" || len(name) > 80 {
		return ScaffoldResult{}, tools.Userf("Provide a plugin name of at most 80 characters.")
	}
	summary := strings.TrimSpace(req.Summary)
	if summary == "" {
		summary = "Custom plugin for Ether."
	}
	if len(summary) > 140 {
		return ScaffoldResult{}, tools.Userf("Summary must be at most 140 characters.")
	}

	kind := plugins.Kind(strings.TrimSpace(req.Kind))
	if kind == "" {
		kind = plugins.KindExtension
	}
	var caps []plugins.Capability
	for _, c := range req.Capabilities {
		c = strings.TrimSpace(c)
		if c != "" {
			caps = append(caps, plugins.Capability(c))
		}
	}
	if len(caps) == 0 {
		switch kind {
		case plugins.KindSource:
			caps = []plugins.Capability{plugins.CapStreamSource}
		case plugins.KindNotificationChannel:
			caps = []plugins.Capability{plugins.CapNotify}
		case plugins.KindLiveTVSource:
			caps = []plugins.Capability{plugins.CapLiveTV}
		default:
			caps = []plugins.Capability{plugins.CapRankingStep}
		}
	}

	m := plugins.Manifest{
		ID:          id,
		Version:     "0.1.0",
		Name:        name,
		Description: summary,
		Types:       []string{"movie", "series"},
		Ether: &plugins.EtherBlock{
			Protocol:     plugins.Protocol,
			Kind:         kind,
			Capabilities: caps,
			Summary:      summary,
			Runtime: plugins.RuntimeDecl{
				Kind:  "hosted",
				Entry: "plugin.ts",
			},
		},
	}

	if kind == plugins.KindIntegration {
		m.Ether.Contributes.Integration = &plugins.IntegrationMeta{
			Category: "automation",
			Adds:     []string{"Syncs watch activity."},
			Connect:  "none",
		}
	}

	var codeLines []string
	codeLines = append(codeLines, `type Request = { method: string; path: string; query?: Record<string, string[]>; body?: unknown };`)
	codeLines = append(codeLines, `type Response = { status: number; headers?: Record<string, string>; body?: unknown };`)

	needHandle := false
	for _, cap := range caps {
		switch cap {
		case plugins.CapStreamSource:
			needHandle = true
			m.Ether.Contributes.Source = &plugins.SourceMeta{Class: "direct"}
		case plugins.CapListSource:
			needHandle = true
			m.Catalogs = []plugins.StremioCat{{Type: "movie", ID: "picks", Name: "Picked movies"}}
			m.Ether.Contributes.ListSources = []plugins.ListSourceMeta{
				{Key: "picks", Label: "Picked movies", Catalog: "picks", MaxItems: 100, Refresh: "1h"},
			}
		case plugins.CapLiveTV:
			needHandle = true
			m.Ether.Contributes.Channels = &plugins.ChannelsMeta{Refresh: "1h", Test: true}
		case plugins.CapSubtitles:
			needHandle = true
			m.Ether.Contributes.Subtitles = &plugins.SubtitlesMeta{
				Languages: json.RawMessage(`"any"`),
				Formats:   []string{"srt", "vtt"},
			}
		case plugins.CapMarkers:
			needHandle = true
			m.Ether.Contributes.Markers = &plugins.MarkersMeta{Kinds: []string{"intro", "credits"}}
		case plugins.CapNotify:
			needHandle = true
			m.Ether.Contributes.Notification = &plugins.NotificationMeta{
				SendTest:  true,
				Formats:   []string{"plain"},
				MaxLength: 2000,
			}
		case plugins.CapEvents:
			needHandle = true
			m.Ether.Contributes.Events = &plugins.EventsMeta{
				Subscribe: []string{plugins.EventPlaybackCompleted},
			}
		case plugins.CapFlowActions:
			needHandle = true
			m.Ether.Contributes.FlowActions = []plugins.FlowActionMeta{
				{
					Key:        "run_action",
					Label:      "Run custom action",
					Route:      "/ether/v1/flow-actions/run_action",
					Idempotent: true,
					Timeout:    "15s",
				},
			}
		case plugins.CapRankingStep:
			m.Ether.Contributes.RankingSteps = []plugins.RankingStepMeta{
				{Key: "prefer_custom", Label: "Prefer matching releases"},
			}
		case plugins.CapRuleCondition:
			m.Ether.Contributes.RuleConditions = []plugins.RuleConditionMeta{
				{Key: "custom_match", Label: "Custom release match", Operators: []string{"equals", "contains"}},
			}
		case plugins.CapTools:
			needHandle = true
			m.Ether.Contributes.Tools = []plugins.ToolMeta{
				{
					Name:        "status_summary",
					Title:       "Status summary",
					Description: "Return a short status summary from the plugin.",
					InputSchema: json.RawMessage(`{"type":"object","properties":{}}`),
					ReadOnly:    true,
				},
			}
		case plugins.CapUI:
			needHandle = true
			m.Ether.Contributes.Pages = []plugins.PageMeta{
				{Key: "overview", Label: "Overview", Route: "/ether/view/overview"},
			}
		}
	}

	if needHandle || (!slices.Contains(caps, plugins.CapRankingStep) && !slices.Contains(caps, plugins.CapRuleCondition)) {
		codeLines = append(codeLines, `
function handle(req: Request): Response {
  if (req.path === "/ether/health" || req.path === "/ether/test") {
    return { status: 200, body: { status: "ok" } };
  }
  if (req.path === "/ether/event") {
    return { status: 200, body: { ack: [] } };
  }
  if (req.path === "/ether/channels.json") {
    return { status: 200, body: { channels: [] } };
  }
  return { status: 200, body: { metas: [] } };
}
(globalThis as any).handle = handle;`)
	}
	if slices.Contains(caps, plugins.CapRankingStep) {
		codeLines = append(codeLines, `
function rank_key(candidate: { name: string }, _config: Record<string, unknown>): number {
  return candidate.name ? 0 : 0;
}
(globalThis as any).rank_key = rank_key;`)
	}
	if slices.Contains(caps, plugins.CapRuleCondition) {
		codeLines = append(codeLines, `
function cond_match(candidate: { name: string }, operator: string, value: unknown): boolean {
  const target = typeof value === "string" ? value : "";
  if (operator === "contains" && target !== "") {
    return candidate.name.includes(target);
  }
  return candidate.name === target;
}
(globalThis as any).cond_match = cond_match;`)
	}

	if err := m.Validate(); err != nil {
		return ScaffoldResult{}, tools.Userf("Generated manifest is not valid: %s", err.Error())
	}

	return ScaffoldResult{
		Manifest: m,
		Files: map[string]string{
			"plugin.ts": strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(codeLines, "\n")) + "\n",
		},
	}, nil
}
``````

func pluginScaffoldTool(_ ToolDeps) tools.Tool {
	schema := json.RawMessage(`{
		"type": "object",
		"required": ["id", "name"],
		"properties": {
			"id": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Reverse-DNS plugin ID (for example org.example.dub-ranker)."
			},
			"name": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Human-readable plugin name."
			},
			"kind": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Plugin kind: source, integration, notification_channel, livetv_source, or extension."
			},
			"capabilities": {
				"type": "array",
				"items": { "type": "string" },
				"description": "Capabilities the plugin contributes."
			},
			"summary": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Short one-sentence summary in sentence case."
			}
		},
		"additionalProperties": false
	}`)

	return tools.Tool{
		Name:        "plugin_scaffold",
		Title:       "Scaffold plugin",
		Description: "Generate a valid manifest and TypeScript entry file for a new Ether plugin.",
		InputSchema: schema,
		ReadOnly:    true,
		Audience:    tools.AudienceOwner,
		Owner:       extend.Builtin,
		Execute: func(_ context.Context, _ tools.Principal, input map[string]any) (tools.Result, error) {
			id, err := reqString(input, "id", 120)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			name, err := reqString(input, "name", 80)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			kind, err := optString(input, "kind", 40)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			summary, err := optString(input, "summary", 140)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			caps, err := optStringSlice(input, "capabilities", 12, 40)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}

			res, err := Scaffold(ScaffoldRequest{
				ID:           id,
				Name:         name,
				Kind:         kind,
				Capabilities: caps,
				Summary:      summary,
			})

				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			return tools.Result{
				Data: map[string]any{
					"manifest": res.Manifest,
					"files":    res.Files,
				},
			}, nil
		},
	}
}

	Issues  []plugins.FieldError `json:"issues"`

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#Check

``````
// Check validates a plugin's manifest, copy rules, settings schema, ViewSpec
// files, and hosted TypeScript or JavaScript entry code.
func Check(ctx context.Context, _ *wasm.Engine, req CheckRequest) (ToolCheckReport, error) {
	files := make(map[string][]byte, len(req.Files))
	for name, contents := range req.Files {
		files[name] = []byte(contents)
	}
	rep := kit.Check(ctx, &kit.Package{ManifestRaw: req.Manifest, Files: files})
	out := ToolCheckReport{OK: rep.OK, Issues: []plugins.FieldError{}, Exports: rep.Exports}
	for _, issue := range rep.Errors {
		out.Issues = append(out.Issues, plugins.FieldError{Field: issue.Field, Message: issue.Message})
	}
	return out, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#pluginCheckTool

``````
func pluginCheckTool(deps ToolDeps) tools.Tool {
	schema := json.RawMessage(`{
		"type": "object",
		"properties": {
			"plugin": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Optional installed plugin ID to check."
			},
			"manifest": {
				"description": "Manifest JSON object or JSON string to check."
			},
			"files": {
				"type": "object",
				"description": "Map of file paths to file contents for the plugin."
			}
		},
		"additionalProperties": false
	}`)

	return tools.Tool{
		Name:        "plugin_check",
		Title:       "Check plugin",
		Description: "Validate a plugin manifest, copy rules, settings schema, ViewSpec documents, and TypeScript or JavaScript entry code.",
		InputSchema: schema,
		ReadOnly:    true,
		Audience:    tools.AudienceOwner,
		Owner:       extend.Builtin,
		Execute: func(ctx context.Context, _ tools.Principal, input map[string]any) (tools.Result, error) {
			pluginID, err := optString(input, "plugin", 128)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			var manifestBytes []byte
			files := map[string]string{}

			if pluginID != "" {
				if deps.Manager == nil {
					return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("The plugin manager is not available.")
				}
				rec, err := deps.Manager.Get(ctx, pluginID)
				if err != nil {
					return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Plugin %q is not installed.", pluginID)
				}
				manifestBytes = rec.ManifestRaw
				if len(manifestBytes) == 0 {
					manifestBytes, _ = json.Marshal(rec.Manifest)
				}
				if deps.Runner != nil {
					for k, v := range deps.Runner.loadArtifactFiles(ctx, rec.ID, rec.Version) {
						files[k] = string(v)
					}
				}
			} else {
				rawManifest, ok := input["manifest"]
				if !ok || rawManifest == nil {
					return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Provide either an installed plugin id or a manifest.")
				}
				manifestBytes, err = encodeBoundedJSON(rawManifest, maxManifestBytes, "manifest")
				if err != nil {
					return tools.Result{}, err
				}
				files, err = optFileMap(input, "files")
				if err != nil {
					return tools.Result{}, err
				}
			}

			eng := deps.Engine
			rep, err := Check(ctx, eng, CheckRequest{
				Manifest: manifestBytes,
				Files:    files,
			})
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			return tools.Result{
				Data: map[string]any{
					"ok":      rep.OK,
					"issues":  rep.Issues,
					"exports": rep.Exports,
				},
			}, nil
		},
	}
}
``````

func pluginReplayTool(deps ToolDeps) tools.Tool {
	schema := json.RawMessage(`{
		"type": "object",
		"required": ["kind"],
		"properties": {
			"plugin": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Installed plugin ID to replay."
			},
			"devInstance": {
				"type": "object",
				"description": "Unsaved Studio plugin instance with manifest, entry or files, and settings."
			},
			"kind": {
				"type": "string",
				"enum": ["ranking", "events", "list", "channels"],
				"description": "Replay mode to run: ranking, events, list, or channels."
			},
			"params": {
				"type": "object",
				"description": "Mode-specific replay parameters (stepKey, position, limit, days, sourceKey, probeLimit)."
			}
		},
		"additionalProperties": false
	}`)

	return tools.Tool{
		Name:        "plugin_replay",
		Title:       "Replay plugin",
		Description: "Replay recorded resolution history, events, list pages, or channels against an installed plugin or Studio dev instance.",
		InputSchema: schema,
		ReadOnly:    true,
		OpenWorld:   true,
		Audience:    tools.AudienceOwner,
		Owner:       extend.Builtin,
		Execute: func(ctx context.Context, _ tools.Principal, input map[string]any) (tools.Result, error) {
			if deps.Runner == nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("The Studio replay runner is not available.")
			}
			rawInput, err := encodeBoundedJSON(input, maxRequestBytes, "input")
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			var req ReplayRequest
			if err := json.Unmarshal(rawInput, &req); err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Invalid replay parameters: %s", err.Error())
			}
			report, err := deps.Runner.Replay(ctx, req)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Replay failed: %s", err.Error())
			}
			dataBytes, _ := json.Marshal(report)
			var dataMap map[string]any
			_ = json.Unmarshal(dataBytes, &dataMap)
			return tools.Result{
				Data: dataMap,
			}, nil
		},
	}
}

func pluginShadowReportTool(deps ToolDeps) tools.Tool {
	schema := json.RawMessage(`{
		"type": "object",
		"required": ["plugin"],
		"properties": {
			"plugin": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Installed plugin ID to inspect."
			},
			"limit": {
				"type": "integer",
				"minimum": 1,
				"maximum": 500,
				"description": "Maximum number of shadow journal entries to return (1 to 500)."
			}
		},
		"additionalProperties": false
	}`)

	return tools.Tool{
		Name:        "plugin_shadow_report",
		Title:       "Read plugin shadow report",
		Description: "Read the recorded shadow-mode journal entries for an installed plugin to see what it would have changed.",
		InputSchema: schema,
		ReadOnly:    true,
		Audience:    tools.AudienceOwner,
		Owner:       extend.Builtin,
		Execute: func(ctx context.Context, _ tools.Principal, input map[string]any) (tools.Result, error) {
			if deps.Manager == nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("The plugin manager is not available.")
			}
			pluginID, err := reqString(input, "plugin", 128)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			limit, err := optInt(input, "limit", 100, 1, 500)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			rec, err := deps.Manager.Get(ctx, pluginID)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Plugin %q is not installed.", pluginID)
			}
			entries, err := deps.Manager.Journal(ctx, pluginID, limit, true)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Could not read shadow journal for %q.", pluginID)
			}
			if entries == nil {
				entries = []plugins.JournalEntry{}
			}
			return tools.Result{
				Data: map[string]any{
					"plugin":  pluginID,
					"shadow":  rec.Shadow,
					"count":   len(entries),
					"entries": entries,
				},
				Links: []tools.Link{
					{Label: "Open plugin", Route: "/settings/plugins/" + pluginID},
				},
			}, nil
		},
	}
}

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#pluginInstallTool

``````
func pluginInstallTool(deps ToolDeps) tools.Tool {
	schema := json.RawMessage(`{
		"type": "object",
		"properties": {
			"url": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Manifest or repository URL for remote or GitHub plugins."
			},
			"kind": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Source kind: url, github, or studio."
			},
			"lan": {
				"type": "boolean",
				"description": "Allow private LAN addresses for remote plugins."
			},
			"manifest": {
				"description": "Manifest JSON object or JSON string when installing from Studio."
			},
			"files": {
				"type": "object",
				"description": "Map of file paths to file contents when installing from Studio."
			},
			"settings": {
				"type": "object",
				"description": "Initial plugin settings."
			},
			"shadow": {
				"type": "boolean",
				"description": "Start the plugin in shadow mode so writes are recorded without applying."
			},
			"autoUpdate": {
				"type": "boolean",
				"description": "Enable automatic updates when permissions do not increase."
			}
		},
		"additionalProperties": false
	}`)

	return tools.Tool{
		Name:        "plugin_install",
		Title:       "Install plugin",
		Description: "Preview a plugin and create an owner approval proposal to install it.",
		InputSchema: schema,
		ReadOnly:    false,
		Destructive: true,
		OpenWorld:   true,
		Audience:    tools.AudienceOwner,
		Owner:       extend.Builtin,
		Execute: func(ctx context.Context, _ tools.Principal, input map[string]any) (tools.Result, error) {
			if deps.Manager == nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("The plugin manager is not available.")
			}
			rawURL, err := optString(input, "url", 2048)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			kindStr, err := optString(input, "kind", 32)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			lan, _ := input["lan"].(bool)
			shadow, _ := input["shadow"].(bool)
			autoUpdate, _ := input["autoUpdate"].(bool)
			settings, _ := input["settings"].(map[string]any)

			src := plugins.Source{
				Kind: kindStr,
				URL:  rawURL,
				LAN:  lan,
			}
			if rawManifest, ok := input["manifest"]; ok && rawManifest != nil {
				manifestBytes, err := encodeBoundedJSON(rawManifest, maxManifestBytes, "manifest")
				if err != nil {
					return tools.Result{}, err
				}
				fileMap, err := optFileMap(input, "files")
				if err != nil {
					return tools.Result{}, err
				}
				byteFiles := make(map[string][]byte, len(fileMap))
				for k, v := range fileMap {
					byteFiles[k] = []byte(v)
				}
				src.Kind = "studio"
				src.Manifest = manifestBytes
				src.Files = byteFiles
			} else if rawURL == "" {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Provide either a plugin URL or a Studio manifest.")
			}

			preview, err := deps.Manager.PreviewInstall(ctx, src)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Plugin preview failed: %s", err.Error())
			}

			// Owner-facing copy: what it adds and what it can reach, in plain
			// words. Identifiers and runtimes stay out of the approval card.
			details := []tools.ProposalDetail{{Label: "What it adds", Value: plainContributions(preview.Manifest)}}
			access := "Nothing beyond its own storage"
			if len(preview.PermissionLines) > 0 {
				access = strings.Join(preview.PermissionLines, "; ")
			}
			details = append(details, tools.ProposalDetail{Label: "What it can access", Value: access})
			details = append(details, tools.ProposalDetail{Label: "Version", Value: preview.Manifest.Version})

			opts := plugins.InstallOptions{
				Grants:     plugins.Grants{LAN: lan},
				Settings:   settings,
				AutoUpdate: autoUpdate,
				Shadow:     shadow,
			}

			proposal := &tools.Proposal{
				Category:    "Install plugin",
				Description: fmt.Sprintf("Add %s to Ether.", preview.Manifest.Name),
				Details:     details,
				Input:       input,
				Apply: func(applyCtx context.Context) (tools.Result, error) {
					rec, err := deps.Manager.Install(applyCtx, preview, opts)
					if err != nil {
						return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Could not install plugin: %s", err.Error())
					}
					deps.Studio.NotifyInstalled(applyCtx, rec)
					return tools.Result{
						Data: map[string]any{
							"id":      rec.ID,
							"name":    rec.Name,
							"version": rec.Version,
							"enabled": rec.Enabled,
							"shadow":  rec.Shadow,
						},
						Links: []tools.Link{
							{Label: "Open plugin", Route: "/settings/plugins/" + rec.ID},
						},
					}, nil
				},
			}

			return tools.Result{
				Data: map[string]any{
					"id":          preview.Manifest.ID,
					"name":        preview.Manifest.Name,
					"version":     preview.Manifest.Version,
					"permissions": preview.PermissionLines,
					"verified":    preview.Verified,
				},
				Proposal: proposal,
			}, nil
		},
	}
}
``````

``````
func reqString(input map[string]any, key string, maxLen int) (string, error) {
	v, err := optString(input, key, maxLen)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if v == "" {
		return "", tools.Userf("Field %q is required.", key)
	}
	return v, nil
}

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#optString

``````
func optString(input map[string]any, key string, maxLen int) (string, error) {
	raw, ok := input[key]
	if !ok || raw == nil {
		return "", nil
	}
	s, ok := raw.(string)
	if !ok {
		return "", tools.Userf("Field %q must be a string.", key)
	}
	s = strings.TrimSpace(s)
	if maxLen > 0 && len(s) > maxLen {
		return "", tools.Userf("Field %q must be at most %d characters.", key, maxLen)
	}
	return s, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#optInt

``````
func optInt(input map[string]any, key string, def, minVal, maxVal int) (int, error) {
	raw, ok := input[key]
	if !ok || raw == nil {
		return def, nil
	}
	var n int
	switch v := raw.(type) {
	case float64:
		n = int(v)
	case int:
		n = v
	case int64:
		n = int(v)
	case json.Number:
		i, err := v.Int64()
		if err != nil {
			return 0, tools.Userf("Field %q must be an integer.", key)
		}
		n = int(i)
	default:
		return 0, tools.Userf("Field %q must be an integer.", key)
	}
	if n < minVal || n > maxVal {
		return 0, tools.Userf("Field %q must be between %d and %d.", key, minVal, maxVal)
	}
	return n, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#optStringSlice

``````
func optStringSlice(input map[string]any, key string, maxItems, maxItemLen int) ([]string, error) {
	raw, ok := input[key]
	if !ok || raw == nil {
		return nil, nil
	}
	var out []string
	switch v := raw.(type) {
	case []string:
		out = v
	case []any:
		for _, item := range v {
			s, ok := item.(string)
			if !ok {
				return nil, tools.Userf("Every entry in %q must be a string.", key)
			}
			out = append(out, s)
		}
	default:
		return nil, tools.Userf("Field %q must be an array of strings.", key)
	}
	if len(out) > maxItems {
		return nil, tools.Userf("Field %q allows at most %d items.", key, maxItems)
	}
	for _, s := range out {
		if len(s) > maxItemLen {
			return nil, tools.Userf("Entries in %q must be at most %d characters.", key, maxItemLen)
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#optFileMap

``````
func optFileMap(input map[string]any, key string) (map[string]string, error) {
	raw, ok := input[key]
	if !ok || raw == nil {
		return map[string]string{}, nil
	}
	out := map[string]string{}
	total := 0
	switch m := raw.(type) {
	case map[string]string:
		if len(m) > maxFilesCount {
			return nil, tools.Userf("Field %q allows at most %d files.", key, maxFilesCount)
		}
		for k, v := range m {
			total += len(v)
			if total > maxFileBytes {
				return nil, tools.Userf("Files in %q exceed the size limit.", key)
			}
			out[k] = v
		}
	case map[string]any:
		if len(m) > maxFilesCount {
			return nil, tools.Userf("Field %q allows at most %d files.", key, maxFilesCount)
		}
		for k, v := range m {
			s, ok := v.(string)
			if !ok {
				return nil, tools.Userf("File %q in %q must be a string.", k, key)
			}
			total += len(s)
			if total > maxFileBytes {
				return nil, tools.Userf("Files in %q exceed the size limit.", key)
			}
			out[k] = s
		}
	default:
		return nil, tools.Userf("Field %q must be an object mapping file names to strings.", key)
	}
	return out, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#encodeBoundedJSON

``````
func encodeBoundedJSON(v any, maxBytes int, field string) ([]byte, error) {
	switch val := v.(type) {
	case string:
		if len(val) > maxBytes {
			return nil, tools.Userf("Field %q exceeds the maximum size of %d bytes.", field, maxBytes)
		}
		return []byte(val), nil
	case json.RawMessage:
		if len(val) > maxBytes {
			return nil, tools.Userf("Field %q exceeds the maximum size of %d bytes.", field, maxBytes)
		}
		return val, nil
	case []byte:
		if len(val) > maxBytes {
			return nil, tools.Userf("Field %q exceeds the maximum size of %d bytes.", field, maxBytes)
		}
		return val, nil
	default:
		b, err := json.Marshal(v)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, tools.Userf("Field %q is not valid JSON.", field)
		}
		if len(b) > maxBytes {
			return nil, tools.Userf("Field %q exceeds the maximum size of %d bytes.", field, maxBytes)
		}
		return b, nil
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#plainContributions

``````
// plainContributions says where an installed plugin shows up, for owners.
func plainContributions(m plugins.Manifest) string {
	var parts []string
	e := m.EffectiveEther()
	for _, c := range e.Capabilities {
		switch c {
		case plugins.CapLiveTV:
			parts = append(parts, "live channels in the Live TV guide")
		case plugins.CapStreamSource:
			parts = append(parts, "playable sources on catalogue titles")
		case plugins.CapListSource:
			parts = append(parts, "Home rows and collections")
		case plugins.CapSubtitles:
			parts = append(parts, "subtitles in the player")
		case plugins.CapMetadata:
			parts = append(parts, "title details")
		case plugins.CapRankingStep:
			parts = append(parts, "a step in release ranking")
		case plugins.CapNotify:
			parts = append(parts, "notifications")
		}
	}
	if len(e.Contributes.Pages) > 0 {
		parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%d console page(s)", len(e.Contributes.Pages)))
	}
	if len(parts) == 0 {
		return "Background behaviour only"
	}
	out := strings.Join(parts, ", ")
	return strings.ToUpper(out[:1]) + out[1:]
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/templates.go#LookupTemplate

``````
// LookupTemplate finds a template by ID.
func LookupTemplate(id string) (Template, bool) {
	for _, t := range Templates() {
		if t.ID == id {
			return t, true
		}
	}
	return Template{}, false
}

``````
func prettyJSON(v any) string {
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(v, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		return "{}"
	}
	return string(b) + "\n"
}

// Runs in-process inside the sandboxed WASM runtime with zero network or disk I/O.
export type CandidateFacts = {
  releaseId: string;
  name: string;
  resolution?: string;
  hdr?: string;
  audioCodec?: string;
  languages?: string[];
  cached?: boolean;
  verified?: boolean;
};

export function rank_key(
  candidate: CandidateFacts,
  config?: { language?: string }
): number {
  const target = (config?.language || "fr").toLowerCase();
  const langs = (candidate.languages || []).map((l) => l.toLowerCase());
  let score = 0;
  if (langs.includes(target)) {
    score += 500;
  }
  if (candidate.cached) {
    score += 100;
  }
  return score;
}

(globalThis as any).rank_key = rank_key;
`

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/templates.go#applyProjectOptions

``````
// applyProjectOptions customizes a template's files for the given PluginID, Name, Slot, or StremioURL.
func applyProjectOptions(tpl Template, opts CreateProjectOptions) (pluginID, name string, files map[string]string) {
	files = make(map[string]string, len(tpl.Files))
	for k, v := range tpl.Files {
		files[k] = v
	}
	pluginID = strings.TrimSpace(opts.PluginID)
	if pluginID == "" {
		pluginID = tpl.DefaultPluginID
	}
	name = strings.TrimSpace(opts.Name)
	if name == "" {
		name = tpl.DefaultName
	}

	var man map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(files["manifest.json"]), &man); err != nil {
		return pluginID, name, files
	}
	man["id"] = pluginID
	man["name"] = name

	etherObj, _ := man["ether"].(map[string]any)
	contributes, _ := etherObj["contributes"].(map[string]any)

	if slot := strings.TrimSpace(opts.Slot); slot != "" && etherObj != nil && contributes != nil {
		ensureUICap(etherObj)
		var en map[string]string
		if json.Unmarshal([]byte(files["i18n/en.json"]), &en) == nil && en != nil {
			if en["slot_label"] == "" {
				en["slot_label"] = "Plugin action"
				files["i18n/en.json"] = prettyJSON(en)
			}
		}
		switch slot {
		case "page":
			contributes["pages"] = []map[string]any{
				{
					"key":   "overview",
					"label": "$t:page_label",
					"route": "/ether/view/overview",
				},
			}
		case "command":
			contributes["commands"] = []map[string]any{
				{
					"key":    "run_command",
					"label":  "$t:slot_label",
					"action": "createHighlight",
				},
			}
		default:
			entry := map[string]any{"slot": slot, "key": "custom_slot", "label": "$t:slot_label"}
			if strings.HasPrefix(slot, "actionMenu.") {
				action := "createHighlight"
				switch tpl.ID {
				case "list":
					action = "syncShelf"
				case "local_files":
					action = "matchFolder"
				}
				entry["action"] = action
			} else {
				entry["route"] = "/ether/view/overview"
			}
			contributes["slots"] = []map[string]any{entry}
		}
	}

	// Add-on links often carry a debrid key in the path, so only the host is
	// written into source; the link itself is never stored with the draft.
	if u, err := url.Parse(strings.TrimSpace(opts.StremioURL)); err == nil && u.Host != "" {
		if src, ok := files["src/plugin.ts"]; ok {
			files["src/plugin.ts"] = fmt.Sprintf("// Upstream Stremio add-on host: %s\n", u.Host) + src
		}
	}

	if opts.LiveSearch != nil && contributes != nil {
		if kinds, ok := contributes["mediaKinds"].([]any); ok {
			for _, k := range kinds {
				if kind, ok := k.(map[string]any); ok {
					browse, _ := kind["browse"].(map[string]any)
					if browse == nil {
						browse = map[string]any{}
						kind["browse"] = browse
					}
					browse["liveSearch"] = *opts.LiveSearch
				}
			}
		}
	}

	files["manifest.json"] = prettyJSON(man)
	return pluginID, name, files
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/templates.go#ensureUICap

``````
func ensureUICap(etherObj map[string]any) {
	raw, _ := etherObj["capabilities"].([]any)
	for _, item := range raw {
		if item == "ui" {
			return
		}
	}
	if strs, ok := etherObj["capabilities"].([]string); ok {
		for _, s := range strs {
			if s == "ui" {
				return
			}
		}
		etherObj["capabilities"] = append(strs, "ui")
		return
	}
	etherObj["capabilities"] = append(raw, "ui")
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/background.go#ViewerRequestPath

``````
// ViewerRequestPath identifies calls on a viewer's browse/search/playback path.
// Administrative actions, setup, catalogue sync and background jobs use
// owner-granted limits.
func ViewerRequestPath(path string) bool {
	for _, prefix := range []string{"/stream/", "/catalog/", "/meta/", "/subtitles/", "/ether/open", "/ether/search", "/ether/files/", "/ether/metadata/", "/ether/subtitles/", "/ether/markers", "/ether/debrid/hints"} {
		if strings.HasPrefix(path, prefix) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return (strings.HasPrefix(path, "/ether/v1/kinds/") && !KindSyncPath(path)) ||
		strings.HasPrefix(path, "/ether/v1/live/") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(path, "/ether/v1/screens/")
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/background.go#OptionalCallPath

``````
// OptionalCallPath identifies calls Ether makes only to save work and
// drops at its own deadline (/ether/debrid/hints): a timeout there, on
// Ether's deadline or the route's own budget, says nothing about the
// plugin's health.
func OptionalCallPath(path string) bool {
	p, _, _ := strings.Cut(path, "?")
	return p == "/ether/debrid/hints"
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/background.go#IsSourceSearchPath

``````
// IsSourceSearchPath identifies a stream_source plugin's category search
// (/ether/search) and release file listing (/ether/files/{id}) routes (#792).
func IsSourceSearchPath(path string) bool {
	p, _, _ := strings.Cut(path, "?")
	return p == "/ether/search" || strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/files/")
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/background.go#KindSyncPath

``````
// KindSyncPath identifies a media kind's background catalogue calls (browse,
// changes, and expand). Ether makes them in the background to fill a library,
// never while a viewer waits, so they run on the plugin's granted limits (the
// manifest's request, capped only by the owner's ceilings) instead of the
// viewer budget. A big first sync or facet expansion can then take as long as
// it needs.
func KindSyncPath(path string) bool {
	p, _, _ := strings.Cut(path, "?")
	return strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/v1/kinds/") &&
		(strings.HasSuffix(p, "/browse") || strings.HasSuffix(p, "/changes") || strings.HasSuffix(p, "/expand"))
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/background.go#LiveTVSyncPath

``````
// LiveTVSyncPath identifies a Live TV source plugin's background lineup and
// guide refresh calls (/ether/channels.json and /ether/guide/*). Ether makes
// them in the background to import channels and programmes, never while a
// viewer waits, so they run on the plugin's granted limits.
func LiveTVSyncPath(path string) bool {
	p, _, _ := strings.Cut(path, "?")
	return p == "/ether/channels.json" || strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/guide/")
}

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/background.go#GrantedLimitsPath

``````
// GrantedLimitsPath reports whether path runs on the plugin's owner-granted
// deadline and unit budget rather than a fixed protocol or viewer cap:
// background kind sync (/browse, /changes, /expand), Live TV lineup and guide sync
// (/ether/channels.json, /ether/guide/*), jobs, setup, owner actions,
// agent tools, and event deliveries.
func GrantedLimitsPath(path string) bool {
	p, _, _ := strings.Cut(path, "?")

		LiveTVSyncPath(p) ||

		strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/v1/setup/") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/action/") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/tool/") ||
		p == "/ether/event"
}

// ResolvePoolPath reports whether path is a playback resolution or stream-open

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/background.go#UnitsForDeadline

``````
// UnitsForDeadline converts a call deadline into its matching governance unit
// budget at one unit per WallUnitInterval (100 µs, or 10,000 units per second),
// so a viewer route's unit budget matches the deadline it is advertised.
func UnitsForDeadline(d time.Duration) int64 {
	if d <= 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return int64(d / WallUnitInterval)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/background.go#StremioDeadline

``````
// StremioDeadline is the per-route deadline for a third-party Stremio add-on
// or an add-on-backed plugin (ether.stremio: true). Their stream searches
// routinely take seconds (they search trackers and debrid caches live); the
// caller's own deadline still bounds every call.
func StremioDeadline(path string) time.Duration {
	switch {
	case strings.HasPrefix(path, "/stream/"), strings.HasPrefix(path, "/catalog/"), strings.HasPrefix(path, "/manifest.json"):
		return 20 * time.Second
	case strings.HasPrefix(path, "/meta/"), strings.HasPrefix(path, "/subtitles/"):
		return 10 * time.Second
	default:
		return 30 * time.Second
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/background.go#DeadlineFor

``````
// DeadlineFor returns the baseline per-route deadline from SPEC §5.1.2.
// Routes in GrantedLimitsPath use the plugin's owner-granted deadline instead
// when dispatched through EffectiveDeadline.
func DeadlineFor(path string) time.Duration {
	p, _, _ := strings.Cut(path, "?")
	switch {
	case strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/configure"), strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/health"):
		return 5 * time.Second
	case strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/test"):
		return 15 * time.Second
	case strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/options"), strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/view"):
		return 2 * time.Second
	case p == "/ether/debrid/hints":
		// Asked while a viewer waits on Play. Ether's own 500 ms deadline
		// starts before the call, so it ends first; a timeout here has no
		// health effect (OptionalCallPath).
		return 500 * time.Millisecond
	case strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/open"), strings.HasPrefix(p, "/stream/"):
		return 3 * time.Second
	case IsSourceSearchPath(p):
		// A category search or file listing asks the plugin's own tracker
		// or engine live; the caller's search deadline still bounds it.
		return 10 * time.Second
	case strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/tool"):
		return 15 * time.Second
	case strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/job"):
		return 5 * time.Minute
	case strings.HasPrefix(p, "/meta/"), strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/metadata/"), strings.HasPrefix(p, "/catalog/"), strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/event"), strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/action"), strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/markers"):
		return 10 * time.Second
	case strings.HasPrefix(p, "/subtitles/"), strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/subtitles/"):
		return 5 * time.Second
	case strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/v1/setup/"):
		return 20 * time.Second
	case strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/v1/flow-actions/"):
		return 60 * time.Second
	case strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/v1/kinds/"):
		if strings.HasSuffix(p, "/live/resolve") || strings.HasSuffix(p, "/match") {
			return 5 * time.Second
		}
		if strings.HasSuffix(p, "/resolve") {
			// Leave room for a parallel indexer fan-out and the guest's
			// matching and source checks within a playback slice.
			return 12 * time.Second
		}
		return 10 * time.Second
	case strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/v1/live/"):
		return 15 * time.Second
	case strings.HasPrefix(p, "/ether/v1/screens/"):
		// A screen's data read or action: a viewer is waiting on it.
		if strings.Contains(p, "/actions/") {
			return 8 * time.Second
		}
		return 4 * time.Second
	default:
		return 30 * time.Second
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/background.go#EffectiveDeadline

``````
// EffectiveDeadline returns the enforced deadline for path given the plugin's
// granted deadline ceiling and whether it speaks Stremio add-on routes.
func EffectiveDeadline(path string, granted time.Duration, stremio bool) time.Duration {
	if GrantedLimitsPath(path) {
		if granted > 0 {
			return granted
		}
		return DeadlineFor(path)
	}
	route := DeadlineFor(path)
	if stremio {
		route = StremioDeadline(path)
	}
	if granted > 0 && granted < route {
		return granted
	}
	return route
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/background.go#WaitBackground

``````
// WaitBackground yields before starting work and at each host-service boundary.
func WaitBackground(ctx context.Context, busy func() bool) error {
	for busy != nil && busy() {
		timer := time.NewTimer(time.Second)
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			timer.Stop()
			return ctx.Err()
		case <-timer.C:
		}
	}
	return ctx.Err()
}
``````

func limitsForRequest(l Limits, path string) Limits {
	l.Deadline = EffectiveDeadline(path, l.Deadline, l.Stremio)
	if ViewerRequestPath(path) {
		l.UnitBudget = min(l.UnitBudget, UnitsForDeadline(l.Deadline))
	}
	return l
}

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#decodeFault

``````
func decodeFault(msg string) *Fault {
	at := strings.Index(msg, faultPrefix)
	if at < 0 {
		return nil
	}
	var f Fault
	// The payload may be followed by a JS stack trace; decode one value.
	dec := json.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(msg[at+len(faultPrefix):]))
	if dec.Decode(&f) != nil || f.Code == "" {
		return nil
	}
	return &f
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#ensureQJS

``````
// ensureQJS creates the first QuickJS runtime in the process with
// CloseOnContextDone enabled. fastschema/qjs caches its wazero runtime
// config package-globally from the first New call, and context-driven
// module close is the only reliable way to interrupt a tight JS loop
// (its MaxExecutionTime does not interrupt one), so the first runtime
// must be ours.
func ensureQJS() {
	qjsOnce.Do(func() {
		defer func() { _ = recover() }()
		if rt, err := qjs.New(qjs.Option{Context: context.Background(), CloseOnContextDone: true,
			Stdout: io.Discard, Stderr: io.Discard}); err == nil {
			defer func() { _ = recover() }()
			rt.Close()
		}
	})
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#codecPrelude

``````
// codecPrelude installs __ether_text_decode, __ether_text_encode, TextDecoder,
// and TextEncoder backed by native Go UTF-8 helpers so guest plugins never pay
// per-byte JavaScript loops when decoding or encoding UTF-8 buffers.
const codecPrelude = `
"use strict";
(() => {
  const rawDecode = __ether_raw_text_decode;
  const rawEncode = __ether_raw_text_encode;
  delete globalThis.__ether_raw_text_decode;
  delete globalThis.__ether_raw_text_encode;

  const utf8Labels = new Set([
    "utf-8",
    "utf8",
    "unicode-1-1-utf-8",
    "unicode11utf8",
    "unicode20utf8",
    "x-unicode20utf8",
  ]);

  const toView = (input, fnName) => {
    if (ArrayBuffer.isView(input)) {
      return new Uint8Array(input.buffer, input.byteOffset, input.byteLength);
    }
    if (input instanceof ArrayBuffer) {
      return new Uint8Array(input);
    }
    throw new TypeError(fnName + ": input must be an ArrayBuffer or ArrayBufferView");
  };

  const decodeBuf = (ab, offset, length, fatal) => {
    try {
      return rawDecode(ab, offset, length, fatal);
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = String(e && e.message || e);
      if (fatal && msg.indexOf("not valid for encoding") >= 0) {
        throw new TypeError(msg);
      }
      if (msg.indexOf("detached") >= 0 || msg.indexOf("ArrayBuffer") >= 0) {
        throw new TypeError(msg);
      }
      throw e;
    }
  };

  globalThis.__ether_text_decode = (input) => {
    if (input === undefined) return "";
    if (ArrayBuffer.isView(input)) {
      return decodeBuf(input.buffer, input.byteOffset, input.byteLength, false);
    }
    if (input instanceof ArrayBuffer) {
      return decodeBuf(input, 0, input.byteLength, false);
    }
    throw new TypeError("__ether_text_decode: input must be an ArrayBuffer or ArrayBufferView");
  };

  globalThis.__ether_text_encode = (input) => {
    const s = input === undefined ? "" : String(input);
    return s.indexOf("\x00") < 0 ? rawEncode(s, false) : rawEncode(JSON.stringify(s), true);
  };

  const validSecondByte = (lead, b1) => {
    if (lead === 0xe0) return b1 >= 0xa0 && b1 <= 0xbf;
    if (lead === 0xed) return b1 >= 0x80 && b1 <= 0x9f;
    if (lead === 0xf0) return b1 >= 0x90 && b1 <= 0xbf;
    if (lead === 0xf4) return b1 >= 0x80 && b1 <= 0x8f;
    return b1 >= 0x80 && b1 <= 0xbf;
  };

  const trailingIncomplete = (u8) => {
    const len = u8.byteLength;
    if (len === 0) return 0;
    const b0 = u8[len - 1];
    if (b0 >= 0xc2 && b0 <= 0xf4) return 1;
    if (len >= 2 && b0 >= 0x80 && b0 <= 0xbf) {
      const p1 = u8[len - 2];
      if (p1 >= 0xe0 && p1 <= 0xf4 && validSecondByte(p1, b0)) return 2;
      if (len >= 3) {
        const p2 = u8[len - 3];
        if (p2 >= 0xf0 && p2 <= 0xf4 && validSecondByte(p2, p1)) return 3;
      }
    }
    return 0;
  };

  if (typeof globalThis.TextDecoder !== "function") {
    class TextDecoder {
      constructor(label = "utf-8", options = undefined) {
        const norm = String(label).replace(/^[\t\n\f\r ]+|[\t\n\f\r ]+$/g, "").toLowerCase();
        if (!utf8Labels.has(norm)) {
          throw new RangeError("TextDecoder: unsupported encoding \"" + label + "\"");
        }
        if (options !== undefined && options !== null && typeof options !== "object") {
          throw new TypeError("TextDecoder: options must be an object");
        }
        this._fatal = Boolean(options && options.fatal);
        this._ignoreBOM = Boolean(options && options.ignoreBOM);
        this._pending = null;
        this._bomSeen = false;
      }
      get encoding() { return "utf-8"; }
      get fatal() { return this._fatal; }
      get ignoreBOM() { return this._ignoreBOM; }
      decode(input = undefined, options = undefined) {
        if (options !== undefined && options !== null && typeof options !== "object") {
          throw new TypeError("TextDecoder.decode: options must be an object");
        }
        const stream = Boolean(options && options.stream);
        if (!stream && !this._pending) {
          const hadBomSeen = this._bomSeen;
          this._bomSeen = false;
          if (input === undefined) return "";
          let out;
          if (ArrayBuffer.isView(input)) {
            out = decodeBuf(input.buffer, input.byteOffset, input.byteLength, this._fatal);
          } else if (input instanceof ArrayBuffer) {
            out = decodeBuf(input, 0, input.byteLength, this._fatal);
          } else {
            throw new TypeError("TextDecoder.decode: input must be an ArrayBuffer or ArrayBufferView");
          }
          if (!this._ignoreBOM && !hadBomSeen && out.length > 0 && out.charCodeAt(0) === 0xfeff) {
            return out.slice(1);
          }
          return out;
        }
        const view = input === undefined ? new Uint8Array(0) : toView(input, "TextDecoder.decode");
        if (input !== undefined && view.byteLength === 0) {
          decodeBuf(view.buffer, view.byteOffset, 0, this._fatal);
        }
        let combined = view;
        if (this._pending) {
          combined = new Uint8Array(this._pending.length + view.byteLength);
          combined.set(this._pending, 0);
          combined.set(view, this._pending.length);
          this._pending = null;
        }
        let decodeLen = combined.byteLength;
        if (stream && decodeLen > 0) {
          const keep = trailingIncomplete(combined);
          if (keep > 0) {
            decodeLen -= keep;
            this._pending = combined.slice(decodeLen);
          }
        }
        const rawOut = decodeLen > 0
          ? decodeBuf(combined.buffer, combined.byteOffset, decodeLen, this._fatal)
          : "";
        let res = rawOut;
        if (rawOut.length > 0) {
          if (!this._ignoreBOM && !this._bomSeen && rawOut.charCodeAt(0) === 0xfeff) {
            res = rawOut.slice(1);
          }
          this._bomSeen = true;
        }
        if (!stream) {
          this._bomSeen = false;
        }
        return res;
      }
    }
    globalThis.TextDecoder = TextDecoder;
  }

  if (typeof globalThis.TextEncoder !== "function") {
    class TextEncoder {
      get encoding() { return "utf-8"; }
      encode(input = "") {
        return new Uint8Array(globalThis.__ether_text_encode(input === undefined ? "" : String(input)));
      }
    }
    globalThis.TextEncoder = TextEncoder;
  }
})();
`
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#hotPrelude

``````
// hotPrelude locks a hot-path instance down: no host services except log
// and abort, Date fixed at the epoch, Math.random a seeded generator that
// __ether_rank_batch resets per batch. The monotonic clock is captured in
// a closure for budget checks, then hidden from plugin code.
//
// Budgets are measured with performance.now (WASI's monotonic clock), not
// Date.now: the wall clock counts whole milliseconds, can step, and on
// Windows advances only once per ~15.6 ms timer tick, so a 2 ms budget read
// from it flagged fast candidates that straddled a tick as slow. wazero
// backs the monotonic clock with QueryPerformanceCounter on Windows.
const hotPrelude = `
"use strict";
globalThis.ether = (() => {
  // Capture the monotonic clock for budget checks before it is replaced.
  // It lives only in this closure; plugin code sees the frozen Date and
  // performance below, and a host-function clock would cost a boundary
  // crossing per check.
  const now = performance.now.bind(performance);
  // The calling thread's CPU time in ms, or -1 without a CPU clock. Hidden
  // from plugin code like the monotonic clock.
  const cpu = typeof __ether_cpu_ms === "function" ? __ether_cpu_ms : () => -1;
  delete globalThis.__ether_cpu_ms;
  let state = 0x2545F491;
  const nextRandom = () => { state = (state * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff; return state / 0x80000000; };
  class FixedDate extends Date { constructor(...a) { super(...(a.length ? a : [0])); } static now() { return 0; } }
  globalThis.Date = FixedDate;
  globalThis.performance = Object.freeze({ now: () => 0, timeOrigin: 0 });
  Math.random = nextRandom;
  // A batch arrives in two calls. __ether_load_batch parses the facts and
  // the config or condition value: host work, run with the JSON functions
  // captured here so no plugin code runs in it, under its own deadline.
  // __ether_rank_batch and __ether_cond_batch then run the plugin over it.
  //
  // Budgets bound the plugin's own time (SPEC 5.2): each candidate gets
  // perMs, and the batch stops starting candidates once batchMs is spent;
  // the rest come back null (neutral, slow, not memoized). Wall time on a
  // busy host includes the time the thread sat descheduled, which is not
  // the plugin's. So the cheap monotonic clock is read first, and when it
  // says a budget is spent the thread's CPU clock decides: the batch goes on
  // while the plugin's CPU time is within budget, and a candidate over
  // budget by the wall clock runs once more and is slow only if that run's
  // CPU time is over budget too. Without a CPU clock the wall clock rules.
  const parse = JSON.parse, stringify = JSON.stringify;
  let batch = [], batchArg = null;
  globalThis.__ether_load_batch = (candsJson, argJson) => {
    batch = parse(candsJson);
    batchArg = parse(argJson);
    return batch.length;
  };
  const each = (perMs, batchMs, call, accept) => {
    const cands = batch;
    batch = [];
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < cands.length; i++) out.push(null);
    const wall0 = now(), cpu0 = cpu();
    for (let i = 0; i < cands.length; i++) {
      if (now() - wall0 > batchMs && (cpu0 < 0 || cpu() - cpu0 > batchMs)) break;
      let t0 = now(), v = call(cands[i]);
      if (now() - t0 > perMs) {
        // Over by the wall clock: run it again and judge the plugin's own time.
        const c0 = cpu();
        t0 = now();
        v = call(cands[i]);
        if (c0 < 0 ? now() - t0 > perMs : cpu() - c0 > perMs) continue;
      }
      out[i] = accept(v);
    }
    return stringify(out);
  };
  const score = (v) => (typeof v === "bigint" ? Number(v) : v);
  globalThis.__ether_rank_batch = (perMs, batchMs) => {
    state = 0x2545F491;
    const cfg = batchArg;
    return each(perMs, batchMs, (c) => rank_key(c, cfg), score);
  };
  globalThis.__ether_cond_batch = (op, perMs, batchMs) => {
    state = 0x2545F491;
    const value = batchArg;
    return each(perMs, batchMs, (c) => cond_match(c, op, value), (v) => !!v);
  };
  return {
    log: (...a) => { try { __ether_host("log", JSON.stringify(a.map(String))); } catch (e) {} },
    abort: (msg) => { throw new Error("__ETHER_FAULT__" + JSON.stringify({ code: "aborted", message: String(msg == null ? "aborted" : msg) })); },
  };
})();
globalThis.console = { log: (...a) => ether.log(...a), error: (...a) => ether.log(...a), warn: (...a) => ether.log(...a) };
`
``````

// exportProbe reports entry points and normalizes esbuild's IIFE exports
// (global name __plugin) onto globalThis so both authoring styles work.
const exportProbe = `
(() => {
  const pick = (n) => (typeof globalThis[n] === "function" ? globalThis[n]
    : (globalThis.__plugin && typeof globalThis.__plugin[n] === "function" ? globalThis.__plugin[n] : undefined));
  for (const n of ["handle", "rank_key", "cond_match"]) { const f = pick(n); if (f) globalThis[n] = f; }
  return JSON.stringify({ handle: typeof globalThis.handle === "function",
    rank_key: typeof globalThis.rank_key === "function",
    cond_match: typeof globalThis.cond_match === "function" });
})()
`

// swapCtx is a context whose target can be swapped atomically per call.
// qjs calls wasm functions with its stored Context value; giving it a
// swapCtx lets one pooled instance take per-call deadlines (which close
