## Source: sdk/examples/anime-tosho/plugin.ts

``````
import { plugin, PluginRouteError } from "../../typescript/src/router.ts";
import type { MaybePromise, RawRequest, RawResponse, StreamItem } from "../../typescript/src/types.ts";
import manifest from "./manifest.json";
import schema from "./settings.schema.json";

const API_BASE = "https://feed.animetosho.net";
const USER_AGENT = "Ether/0.3 (+https://github.com/braedonsaunders/ether)";
const DEFAULT_LIMIT = 75;
const MAX_XML_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_PARSED_ITEMS = 200;
const MAX_TRACKERS = 8;

export type ReleaseTypes = "both" | "torrents" | "nzbs";

export interface AnimeToshoSettings {
  releaseTypes: ReleaseTypes;
  category: string;
}

export const DEFAULT_SETTINGS: AnimeToshoSettings = {
  releaseTypes: "both",
  category: "",
};

type AnimeToshoStreamItem = StreamItem & {
  nzbUrl?: string;
  sources?: string[];
};

export interface ParsedMediaID {
  mediaType: "movie" | "series";
  prefix: "tt" | "tmdb" | "tvdb" | "anidb" | "mal" | "kitsu";
  id: string;
  season?: number;
  episode?: number;
  isAnimeEntryId: boolean;
}

export interface SearchPlan {
  kind: "movie" | "episode" | "season_pack";
  endpointPath: "/api" | "/api/torznab" | "/api/newznab";
  url: string;
  season?: number;
  episode?: number;
  isAnimeEntryId: boolean;
  categories: string[];
}

export interface FeedItem {
  title: string;
  infoHash: string;
  nzbUrl: string;
  trackers: string[];
  size: number;
  seeders?: number;
  files?: number;
  season?: number;
  episode?: number;
  categories: string[];
}

export interface ParsedFeed {
  items: FeedItem[];
  apiErrorCode?: string;
  apiErrorDescription?: string;
}

const VALID_RELEASE_TYPES = new Set<string>(["both", "torrents", "nzbs"]);
const CATEGORY_LIST_RE = /^\d+(?:,\d+)*$/;
const HEX40_RE = /^[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/;
const BASE32_32_RE = /^[A-Z2-7]{32}$/i;
const VIDEO_EXT_RE = /\.(mkv|mp4|m4v|avi|webm|ts|mov)$/i;
const BASE32_ALPHABET = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567";

export function normalizeSettings(raw: Partial<AnimeToshoSettings> | Record<string, unknown> | undefined): AnimeToshoSettings {
  const releaseTypesRaw = typeof raw?.releaseTypes === "string" ? raw.releaseTypes.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
  const releaseTypes: ReleaseTypes = VALID_RELEASE_TYPES.has(releaseTypesRaw)
    ? (releaseTypesRaw as ReleaseTypes)
    : DEFAULT_SETTINGS.releaseTypes;
  const categoryRaw = typeof raw?.category === "string" ? raw.category.replace(/\s+/g, "") : "";
  const category = categoryRaw && CATEGORY_LIST_RE.test(categoryRaw) ? categoryRaw : "";
  return { releaseTypes, category };
}

export function validateSettings(raw: Partial<AnimeToshoSettings> | Record<string, unknown> | undefined): Record<string, string> {
  const errors: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (raw && raw.releaseTypes !== undefined && raw.releaseTypes !== "") {
    const val = typeof raw.releaseTypes === "string" ? raw.releaseTypes.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
    if (!VALID_RELEASE_TYPES.has(val)) {
      errors["/releaseTypes"] = "Choose torrents, NZBs, or both.";
    }
  }
  if (raw && raw.category !== undefined && raw.category !== "") {
    const val = typeof raw.category === "string" ? raw.category.replace(/\s+/g, "") : "";
    if (!CATEGORY_LIST_RE.test(val)) {
      errors["/category"] = "Choose a valid Torznab or Newznab category.";
    }
  }
  return errors;
}

function parseNonNegInt(raw: string | undefined): number | undefined {
  if (!raw || !/^\d+$/.test(raw)) return undefined;
  const n = Number(raw);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(n) && n >= 0 ? n : undefined;
}

function parsePosInt(raw: string | undefined): number | undefined {
  const n = parseNonNegInt(raw);
  return n !== undefined && n > 0 ? n : undefined;
}

export function parseMediaID(mediaType: string, rawId: string): ParsedMediaID | null {
  if (mediaType !== "movie" && mediaType !== "series") return null;
  const trimmed = (rawId || "").trim();
  if (!trimmed) return null;

  const parts = trimmed.split(":");
  if (parts[0].startsWith("tt")) {
    if (!/^tt\d+$/.test(parts[0])) return null;
    if (mediaType === "movie") {
      if (parts.length !== 1) return null;
      return { mediaType, prefix: "tt", id: parts[0], isAnimeEntryId: false };
    }
    if (parts.length === 2) {
      const season = parseNonNegInt(parts[1]);
      if (season === undefined) return null;
      return { mediaType, prefix: "tt", id: parts[0], season, isAnimeEntryId: false };
    }
    if (parts.length === 3) {
      const season = parseNonNegInt(parts[1]);
      const episode = parsePosInt(parts[2]);
      if (season === undefined || episode === undefined) return null;
      return { mediaType, prefix: "tt", id: parts[0], season, episode, isAnimeEntryId: false };
    }
    return null;
  }

  const prefix = parts[0].toLowerCase();
  if (prefix === "tmdb" || prefix === "tvdb") {
    const numericId = parts[1];
    if (!numericId || !/^\d+$/.test(numericId) || numericId === "0") return null;
    if (mediaType === "movie") {
      if (prefix !== "tmdb" || parts.length !== 2) return null;
      return { mediaType, prefix, id: numericId, isAnimeEntryId: false };
    }
    if (parts.length === 3) {
      const season = parseNonNegInt(parts[2]);
      if (season === undefined) return null;
      return { mediaType, prefix, id: numericId, season, isAnimeEntryId: false };
    }
    if (parts.length === 4) {
      const season = parseNonNegInt(parts[2]);
      const episode = parsePosInt(parts[3]);
      if (season === undefined || episode === undefined) return null;
      return { mediaType, prefix, id: numericId, season, episode, isAnimeEntryId: false };
    }
    return null;
  }

  if (prefix === "anidb" || prefix === "mal" || prefix === "kitsu") {
    const numericId = parts[1];
    if (!numericId || !/^\d+$/.test(numericId) || numericId === "0") return null;
    if (mediaType === "movie") {
      if (parts.length !== 2) return null;
      return { mediaType, prefix, id: numericId, isAnimeEntryId: true };
    }
    if (parts.length === 2) {
      return { mediaType, prefix, id: numericId, isAnimeEntryId: true };
    }
    if (parts.length === 3) {
      const episode = parsePosInt(parts[2]);
      if (episode === undefined) return null;
      return { mediaType, prefix, id: numericId, episode, isAnimeEntryId: true };
    }
    return null;
  }

  return null;
}

function endpointForSettings(settings: AnimeToshoSettings): "/api" | "/api/torznab" | "/api/newznab" {
  if (settings.releaseTypes === "nzbs") return "/api/newznab";
  if (settings.releaseTypes === "torrents") return "/api/torznab";
  return "/api";
}

function buildQueryString(params: Array<[string, string]>): string {
  return params.map(([k, v]) => `${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(v)}`).join("&");
}

function cleanImdbHint(raw: string | undefined): string {
  const s = (raw || "").trim().toLowerCase();
  return /^tt\d+$/.test(s) ? s : "";
}

function cleanNumericHint(raw: string | undefined): string {
  const s = (raw || "").trim();
  return /^\d+$/.test(s) && s !== "0" ? s : "";
}

export function buildSearchPlan(
  mediaType: string,
  rawId: string,
  query: Record<string, string>,
  settings: AnimeToshoSettings,
): SearchPlan | null {
  const parsed = parseMediaID(mediaType, rawId);
  if (!parsed) return null;

  const endpointPath = endpointForSettings(settings);
  const categories = settings.category ? settings.category.split(",").filter(Boolean) : [];
  const params: Array<[string, string]> = [];

  if (parsed.mediaType === "movie") {
    if (parsed.prefix === "anidb") {
      // Anime Tosho NEW caps list aid on t=search rather than t=movie.
      params.push(["t", "search"], ["aid", parsed.id]);
    } else if (parsed.prefix === "mal") {
      params.push(["t", "movie"], ["malid", parsed.id]);
    } else if (parsed.prefix === "kitsu") {
      params.push(["t", "movie"], ["kitsuid", parsed.id]);
    } else {
      const imdbId = parsed.prefix === "tt" ? parsed.id : cleanImdbHint(query.imdbId);
      const tmdbId = parsed.prefix === "tmdb" ? parsed.id : cleanNumericHint(query.tmdbId);
      if (imdbId) {
        params.push(["t", "movie"], ["imdbid", imdbId]);
      } else if (tmdbId) {
        params.push(["t", "movie"], ["tmdbid", tmdbId]);
      } else {
        return null;
      }
    }
    if (categories.length > 0) params.push(["cat", categories.join(",")]);
    params.push(["limit", String(DEFAULT_LIMIT)]);
    return {
      kind: "movie",
      endpointPath,
      url: `${API_BASE}${endpointPath}?${buildQueryString(params)}`,
      isAnimeEntryId: parsed.isAnimeEntryId,
      categories,
    };
  }

  // Series: episode or season pack.
  params.push(["t", "tvsearch"]);

  if (parsed.prefix === "anidb") {
    params.push(["aid", parsed.id]);
  } else if (parsed.prefix === "mal") {
    params.push(["malid", parsed.id]);
  } else if (parsed.prefix === "kitsu") {
    params.push(["kitsuid", parsed.id]);
  } else {
    // Anime Tosho NEW maps multi-season TV series much more reliably by TMDB
    // than by IMDb, so prefer tmdbid when Ether supplies it in the query hints.
    const tmdbId = parsed.prefix === "tmdb" ? parsed.id : cleanNumericHint(query.tmdbId);
    const tvdbId = parsed.prefix === "tvdb" ? parsed.id : "";
    const imdbId = parsed.prefix === "tt" ? parsed.id : cleanImdbHint(query.imdbId);
    if (tmdbId) {
      params.push(["tmdbid", tmdbId]);
    } else if (tvdbId) {
      params.push(["tvdbid", tvdbId]);
    } else if (imdbId) {
      params.push(["imdbid", imdbId]);
    } else {
      return null;
    }
  }

  const querySeason = parseNonNegInt(query.season);
  const hasQuerySeason = querySeason !== undefined;
  const hasQueryEpisode = parsePosInt(query.episode) !== undefined;
  const explicitPack = query.pack === "1" || query.pack === "true";
  const isSeasonPack = parsed.isAnimeEntryId
    ? parsed.episode === undefined || explicitPack
    : parsed.episode === undefined || explicitPack || (hasQuerySeason && !hasQueryEpisode);

  const season = parsed.isAnimeEntryId ? undefined : (parsed.season ?? querySeason);
  const episode = isSeasonPack ? undefined : parsed.episode;

  if (isSeasonPack) {
    if (!parsed.isAnimeEntryId && season !== undefined && season > 0) {
      params.push(["season", String(season)]);
    }
  } else if (episode !== undefined) {
    if (parsed.isAnimeEntryId) {
      params.push(["ep", String(episode)]);
    } else if (season === 1 && episode > 12) {
      // Absolute episode alias (e.g. One Piece :1:1071 or Attack on Titan :1:52):
      // omit season so Anime Tosho matches absolute numbering across seasons.
      params.push(["ep", String(episode)]);
    } else {
      if (season !== undefined) params.push(["season", String(season)]);
      params.push(["ep", String(episode)]);
    }
  }

  if (categories.length > 0) params.push(["cat", categories.join(",")]);
  params.push(["limit", String(DEFAULT_LIMIT)]);

  return {
    kind: isSeasonPack ? "season_pack" : "episode",
    endpointPath,
    url: `${API_BASE}${endpointPath}?${buildQueryString(params)}`,
    season,
    episode,
    isAnimeEntryId: parsed.isAnimeEntryId,
    categories,
  };
}

export function decodeXmlEntities(input: string): string {
  if (!input || !input.includes("&")) return input;
  return input.replace(/&(#x[0-9a-fA-F]+|#\d+|amp|lt|gt|quot|apos);/g, (full, ent: string) => {
    switch (ent) {
      case "amp":
        return "&";
      case "lt":
        return "<";
      case "gt":
        return ">";
      case "quot":
        return '"';
      case "apos":
        return "'";
      default: {
        const code = ent.startsWith("#x") || ent.startsWith("#X")
          ? parseInt(ent.slice(2), 16)
          : parseInt(ent.slice(1), 10);
        if (!Number.isFinite(code) || code <= 0 || code > 0x10ffff) return full;
        try {
          return String.fromCodePoint(code);
        } catch {
          return full;
        }
      }
    }
  });
}

function unwrapCdata(raw: string): string {
  const trimmed = raw.trim();
  if (trimmed.startsWith("<![CDATA[") && trimmed.endsWith("]]>")) {
    return trimmed.slice(9, -3);
  }
  return decodeXmlEntities(trimmed);
}

function parseTagAttributes(tagText: string): Record<string, string> {
  const attrs: Record<string, string> = {};
  const re = /([a-zA-Z0-9_:-]+)\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|'([^']*)')/g;
  let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((m = re.exec(tagText)) !== null) {
    attrs[m[1].toLowerCase()] = decodeXmlEntities(m[2] ?? m[3] ?? "");
  }
  return attrs;
}

export function base32ToHex(b32: string): string {
  if (!BASE32_32_RE.test(b32)) return "";
  const upper = b32.toUpperCase();
  let bits = 0;
  let value = 0;
  let out = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < upper.length; i++) {
    const idx = BASE32_ALPHABET.indexOf(upper[i]);
    if (idx < 0) return "";
    value = (value << 5) | idx;
    bits += 5;
    if (bits >= 8) {
      bits -= 8;
      const byte = (value >> bits) & 0xff;
      out += byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
    }
  }
  return out.length === 40 ? out : "";
}

function normalizeInfoHash(raw: string): string {
  const trimmed = (raw || "").trim();
  if (HEX40_RE.test(trimmed)) return trimmed.toLowerCase();
  if (BASE32_32_RE.test(trimmed)) return base32ToHex(trimmed);
  return "";
}

function safeDecodeURI(raw: string): string {
  try {
    return decodeURIComponent(raw.replace(/\+/g, " "));
  } catch {
    return raw;
  }
}

export function parseMagnet(magnetUrl: string): { infoHash: string; trackers: string[] } {
  if (!magnetUrl || !magnetUrl.toLowerCase().startsWith("magnet:?")) {
    return { infoHash: "", trackers: [] };
  }
  let infoHash = "";
  const trackers: string[] = [];
  const seenTrackers = new Set<string>();
  const query = magnetUrl.slice(magnetUrl.indexOf("?") + 1);
  for (const part of query.split("&")) {
    if (!part) continue;
    const eq = part.indexOf("=");
    const key = (eq < 0 ? part : part.slice(0, eq)).toLowerCase();
    const val = eq < 0 ? "" : safeDecodeURI(part.slice(eq + 1)).trim();
    if (key === "xt" && !infoHash) {
      const m = /^urn:btih:([a-zA-Z0-9]+)$/i.exec(val);
      if (m) infoHash = normalizeInfoHash(m[1]);
    } else if (key === "tr" && trackers.length < MAX_TRACKERS) {
      if (/^(https?|udp):\/\/\S+$/i.test(val) && !seenTrackers.has(val)) {
        seenTrackers.add(val);
        trackers.push(val);
      }
    }
  }
  return { infoHash, trackers };
}

function isSafeHttpUrl(raw: string): boolean {
  return /^https?:\/\/[^\s"'<>]+$/i.test(raw.trim());
}

function extractTagContent(block: string, tagName: string): string {
  const open = `<${tagName}`;
  const close = `</${tagName}>`;
  let pos = block.indexOf(open);
  while (pos >= 0) {
    const nextChar = block[pos + open.length];
    if (nextChar === ">" || nextChar === " " || nextChar === "\t" || nextChar === "\n" || nextChar === "\r") {
      const gt = block.indexOf(">", pos + open.length);
      if (gt < 0) return "";
      const end = block.indexOf(close, gt + 1);
      if (end < 0) return "";
      return unwrapCdata(block.slice(gt + 1, end));
    }
    pos = block.indexOf(open, pos + open.length);
  }
  return "";
}

export function parseTorznabFeed(xmlInput: string): ParsedFeed {
  if (!xmlInput) return { items: [] };
  const xml = xmlInput.length > MAX_XML_BYTES ? xmlInput.slice(0, MAX_XML_BYTES) : xmlInput;

  // Check top-level Newznab/Torznab XML error element.
  const errMatch = /<error\b([^>]*?)\/?\s*>/i.exec(xml);
  if (errMatch && !xml.includes("<channel")) {
    const attrs = parseTagAttributes(errMatch[1]);
    return {
      items: [],
      apiErrorCode: attrs.code || "error",
      apiErrorDescription: attrs.description || "Upstream feed error.",
    };
  }

  const items: FeedItem[] = [];
  let cursor = 0;
  while (items.length < MAX_PARSED_ITEMS) {
    const start = xml.indexOf("<item", cursor);
    if (start < 0) break;
    const afterName = xml[start + 5];
    if (afterName !== ">" && afterName !== " " && afterName !== "\t" && afterName !== "\n" && afterName !== "\r") {
      cursor = start + 5;
      continue;
    }
    const startGt = xml.indexOf(">", start + 5);
    if (startGt < 0) break;
    const end = xml.indexOf("</item>", startGt + 1);
    if (end < 0) break;
    cursor = end + 7;

    const block = xml.slice(startGt + 1, end);
    const title = extractTagContent(block, "title").trim();
    if (!title) continue;

    let infoHash = "";
    let nzbUrl = "";
    let magnetUrl = "";
    let size = 0;
    let seeders: number | undefined;
    let files: number | undefined;
    let season: number | undefined;
    let episode: number | undefined;
    const catSet = new Set<string>();

    // Inspect <enclosure .../> tags (may have both torrent and nzb enclosures).
    const encRe = /<enclosure\b([^>]*?)\/?\s*>/gi;
    let encMatch: RegExpExecArray | null;
    while ((encMatch = encRe.exec(block)) !== null) {
      const a = parseTagAttributes(encMatch[1]);
      const type = (a.type || "").toLowerCase();
      const url = (a.url || "").trim();
      const len = parseNonNegInt(a.length);
      if (len && len > size) size = len;
      if (type === "application/x-nzb" && isSafeHttpUrl(url) && !nzbUrl) {
        nzbUrl = url;
      }
    }

    // Inspect <torznab:attr .../> and <newznab:attr .../> tags.
    const attrRe = /<(?:torznab|newznab):attr\b([^>]*?)\/?\s*>/gi;
    let attrMatch: RegExpExecArray | null;
    while ((attrMatch = attrRe.exec(block)) !== null) {
      const a = parseTagAttributes(attrMatch[1]);
      const name = (a.name || "").toLowerCase();
      const value = (a.value || "").trim();
      if (!name || !value) continue;
      switch (name) {
        case "infohash": {
          const h = normalizeInfoHash(value);
          if (h) infoHash = h;
          break;
        }
        case "magneturl":
          if (!magnetUrl) magnetUrl = value;
          break;
        case "nzburl":
          if (isSafeHttpUrl(value)) nzbUrl = value;
          break;
        case "size": {
          const n = parseNonNegInt(value);
          if (n !== undefined && n > 0) size = n;
          break;
        }
        case "seeders": {
          const n = parseNonNegInt(value);
          if (n !== undefined) seeders = n;
          break;
        }
        case "files": {
          const n = parsePosInt(value);
          if (n !== undefined) files = n;
          break;
        }
        case "season": {
          const n = parseNonNegInt(value);
          if (n !== undefined) season = n;
          break;
        }
        case "episode": {
          const n = parsePosInt(value);
          if (n !== undefined) episode = n;
          break;
        }
        case "category":
          if (/^\d+$/.test(value)) catSet.add(value);
          break;
      }
    }

    const magnet = parseMagnet(magnetUrl);
    if (!infoHash && magnet.infoHash) infoHash = magnet.infoHash;

    items.push({
      title,
      infoHash,
      nzbUrl,
      trackers: magnet.trackers,
      size,
      seeders,
      files,
      season,
      episode,
      categories: Array.from(catSet),
    });
  }

  return { items };
}

function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes <= 0) return "";
  const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
  let value = bytes;
  let unit = 0;
  while (value >= 1024 && unit < units.length - 1) {
    value /= 1024;
    unit++;
  }
  return unit === 0 ? `${Math.round(value)} B` : `${value.toFixed(1)} ${units[unit]}`;
}

export function itemsToStreams(
  items: FeedItem[],
  plan: SearchPlan,
  settings: AnimeToshoSettings,
): AnimeToshoStreamItem[] {
  const wantedCats = new Set(plan.categories);
  const ranked: Array<{ tier: number; index: number; item: FeedItem }> = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    const item = items[i];
    if (wantedCats.size > 0 && item.categories.length > 0) {
      if (!item.categories.some((c) => wantedCats.has(c))) continue;
    }

    let tier = 1;
    if (plan.kind === "season_pack") {
      // Single-episode items carry an explicit episode attribute; exclude them for pack searches.
      if (item.episode !== undefined) continue;
      if (!plan.isAnimeEntryId && plan.season !== undefined && plan.season > 0) {
        if (item.season !== undefined) {
          if (item.season !== plan.season) continue;
          tier = 0;
        }
      }
    } else if (plan.kind === "episode" && !plan.isAnimeEntryId && plan.season !== undefined) {
      if (item.season !== undefined) {
        if (item.season === plan.season) {
          tier = 0;
        } else if (plan.season === 1 && plan.episode !== undefined && plan.episode > 12) {
          // Absolute-episode alias (e.g. :1:52 matching season 3 ep 52): keep behind exact S1 matches.
          tier = 2;
        } else {
          continue;
        }
      }
    }

    ranked.push({ tier, index: i, item });
  }

  ranked.sort((a, b) => (a.tier !== b.tier ? a.tier - b.tier : a.index - b.index));

  const includeTorrents = settings.releaseTypes !== "nzbs";
  const includeNzbs = settings.releaseTypes !== "torrents";
  const seenHashes = new Set<string>();
  const seenNzbs = new Set<string>();
  const streams: AnimeToshoStreamItem[] = [];

  for (const { item } of ranked) {
    const sizeLabel = formatBytes(item.size);
    const behaviorHints: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    if (item.size > 0) behaviorHints.videoSize = item.size;

    if (includeTorrents && item.infoHash && !seenHashes.has(item.infoHash)) {
      seenHashes.add(item.infoHash);
      const details: string[] = [];
      if (item.seeders !== undefined) details.push(`👤 ${item.seeders}`);
      if (sizeLabel) details.push(`💾 ${sizeLabel}`);
      const torrentHints: Record<string, unknown> = { ...behaviorHints };
      if (plan.kind !== "season_pack" && item.files === 1 && VIDEO_EXT_RE.test(item.title)) {
        torrentHints.filename = item.title;
      }
      const stream: AnimeToshoStreamItem = {
        name: "Anime Tosho",
        title: details.length > 0 ? `${item.title}\n${details.join("  ")}` : item.title,
        infoHash: item.infoHash,
      };
      if (item.trackers.length > 0) {
        stream.sources = item.trackers.map((tr) => `tracker:${tr}`);
      }
      if (Object.keys(torrentHints).length > 0) {
        stream.behaviorHints = torrentHints;
      }
      streams.push(stream);
    }

    if (includeNzbs && item.nzbUrl && !seenNzbs.has(item.nzbUrl)) {
      seenNzbs.add(item.nzbUrl);
      const details: string[] = [];
      if (sizeLabel) details.push(`💾 ${sizeLabel}`);
      details.push("Usenet NZB");
      const stream: AnimeToshoStreamItem = {
        name: "Anime Tosho NZB",
        title: `${item.title}\n${details.join(" · ")}`,
        nzbUrl: item.nzbUrl,
      };
      if (Object.keys(behaviorHints).length > 0) {
        stream.behaviorHints = behaviorHints;
      }
      streams.push(stream);
    }
  }

  return streams;
}

function getHeaderCI(headers: Record<string, string> | undefined, name: string): string {
  if (!headers) return "";
  const target = name.toLowerCase();
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(headers)) {
    if (k.toLowerCase() === target) return String(v || "").trim();
  }
  return "";
}

function parseRetryAfter(headers: Record<string, string> | undefined): string {
  const raw = getHeaderCI(headers, "Retry-After");
  return raw || "60";
}

let pendingRetryAfter = "";

const settingsManifest = {
  ...manifest,
  ether: { ...manifest.ether, settings: schema },
} as any;

export const animeTosho = plugin<AnimeToshoSettings>({
  manifest: settingsManifest,
  defaultSettings: DEFAULT_SETTINGS,
  routes: {
    health() {
      return { status: "ok" };
    },

    configure(settings) {
      const errors = validateSettings(settings as unknown as Record<string, unknown>);
      return { errors };
    },

    test(ctx) {
      const res = ctx.ether.http.fetch({
        url: `${API_BASE}/api?t=caps`,
        headers: {
          "User-Agent": USER_AGENT,
          Accept: "application/xml, text/xml",
        },
      }) as { status: number; headers?: Record<string, string>; body?: string };

      if (res.status === 429) {
        return { ok: false, message: "Anime Tosho NEW rate limit reached. Try again later." };
      }
      if (res.status !== 200 || !res.body || !res.body.includes("<caps")) {
        return { ok: false, message: "Could not read Anime Tosho NEW feed capabilities." };
      }
      const settings = normalizeSettings(ctx.settings);
      const modeLabel =
        settings.releaseTypes === "torrents"
          ? "Torznab torrents"
          : settings.releaseTypes === "nzbs"
            ? "Newznab Usenet NZBs"
            : "Torznab torrents and Newznab Usenet NZBs";
      return {
        ok: true,
        message: `Connected to Anime Tosho NEW (${modeLabel}).`,
      };
    },

    stream(req, ctx) {
      const settings = normalizeSettings(ctx.settings);
      const mergedQuery: Record<string, string> = { ...req.extra, ...ctx.query };
      const plan = buildSearchPlan(req.type, req.id, mergedQuery, settings);
      if (!plan) {
        return { streams: [] };
      }

      const res = ctx.ether.http.fetch({
        url: plan.url,
        headers: {
          "User-Agent": USER_AGENT,
          Accept: "application/xml, text/xml",
        },
      }) as { status: number; headers?: Record<string, string>; body?: string };

      if (res.status === 429 || (res.status === 503 && getHeaderCI(res.headers, "Retry-After"))) {
        pendingRetryAfter = parseRetryAfter(res.headers);
        throw new PluginRouteError(
          429,
          "rate_limited",
          "Anime Tosho NEW rate limit reached. Try again later.",
        );
      }
      if (res.status !== 200) {
        throw new PluginRouteError(
          502,
          "upstream_error",
          `Anime Tosho NEW search failed with HTTP ${res.status}.`,
        );
      }

      const parsed = parseTorznabFeed(res.body || "");
      if (parsed.apiErrorCode) {
        const desc = parsed.apiErrorDescription || "Anime Tosho NEW returned an error.";
        if (parsed.apiErrorCode === "429" || /rate\s*limit|too many requests/i.test(desc)) {
          pendingRetryAfter = parseRetryAfter(res.headers);
          throw new PluginRouteError(429, "rate_limited", desc);
        }
        throw new PluginRouteError(502, "upstream_error", desc);
      }

      return { streams: itemsToStreams(parsed.items, plan, settings) };
    },
  },
});

export function handle(req: RawRequest): MaybePromise<RawResponse> {
  pendingRetryAfter = "";
  const finalize = (res: RawResponse): RawResponse => {
    const retryAfter = pendingRetryAfter;
    pendingRetryAfter = "";
    if (res.status === 429 && retryAfter) {
      return {
        ...res,
        headers: {
          ...(res.headers ?? {}),
          "Retry-After": retryAfter,
        },
      };
    }
    return res;
  };
  const out = animeTosho.handle(req);
  return out instanceof Promise ? out.then(finalize) : finalize(out);
}

if (
  typeof globalThis !== "undefined" &&
  typeof (globalThis as Record<string, unknown>).ether === "object" &&
  (globalThis as Record<string, unknown>).ether !== null
) {
  (globalThis as Record<string, unknown>).handle = handle;
}

``````

# Canada Live

Adds CPAC with English/French audio and five public Global News feeds to Live TV. The broadcasters control availability and URLs. These news and public-affairs feeds do not provide a programme guide through this plugin.

## Use

Created and verified through Studio in the 0.3.3 lab. These examples do not auto-install or change server configuration on upgrade.

From the repository root:

```sh
go run ./cmd/ether plugin check sdk/examples/canada-live
go run ./cmd/ether plugin pack -o /tmp/canada-live.etherpkg sdk/examples/canada-live
```

Install the package in Server → Plugins, or copy these three files into a Studio draft. Review permissions and configure the installed plugin in Setup. The source and English strings are editable in Studio.

## Source: sdk/examples/dub-language/README.md

# Dub language

Adds a release ranking step and a language condition. In Releases, add the step to a profile and enter ISO language codes in preference order. The first matching language wins; MULTi counts for every selected language. Conditions accept an ISO code or list of codes.

Screenshot placeholder: Releases profile drawer showing the ordered audio languages and the step in the ranking ladder.

## Limits

Release names and indexer language tags are imperfect. A language tag does not prove that a track is a dub, and DUB alone does not identify its language. Untagged releases receive no preference. This plugin makes no network calls.


## Source: sdk/examples/dub-language/manifest.json

## Source: sdk/examples/dub-language/plugin.ts

``````
import { plugin, type Manifest, type CandidateFacts } from '../../typescript/src/index.ts';
import manifest from './manifest.json' with { type: 'json' };

type Config = { value?: string[] };
const aliases: Record<string,string> = { english:'en', eng:'en', french:'fr', fre:'fr', fra:'fr', german:'de', ger:'de', deu:'de', spanish:'es', spa:'es', italian:'it', ita:'it', japanese:'ja', jpn:'ja', portuguese:'pt', por:'pt', korean:'ko', kor:'ko', chinese:'zh', chi:'zh', zho:'zh', hindi:'hi', hin:'hi' };
// normalize maps a language name, ISO code or regional variant
// ("spanish-latino", "pt-BR") to its two-letter base.
function normalize(s: string): string {
  let v = s.toLowerCase().trim();
  const dash = v.indexOf('-');
  if (dash > 0) v = v.slice(0, dash);
  return aliases[v] || v;
}
// available reads the audio languages Ether parsed from the release name
// and indexer tags. Ether's parser skips title words ("The French
// Dispatch") that a token scan would count, and re-reading the name here
// cost most of the step's time: ranking runs on the hot path, where a
// 500-release batch shares one 50 ms budget.
function available(c: CandidateFacts): Set<string> {
  const langs = new Set<string>();
  const list = c.languages || [];
  for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) langs.add(normalize(list[i]));
  return langs;
}
function speaks(langs: Set<string>, lang: string): boolean {
  const target = normalize(lang);
  return !!target && (langs.has(target) || langs.has('multi'));
}
export const dubPlugin = plugin<Config>({ manifest: manifest as Manifest, routes: {
  rankKey(c, cfg) {
    const wanted = Array.isArray(cfg?.value) ? cfg.value : [];
    if (wanted.length === 0) return 0;
    const langs = available(c);
    for (let i = 0; i < wanted.length; i++) if (speaks(langs, wanted[i])) return wanted.length - i;
    return 0;
  },
  condMatch(c, op, value) {
    if (op === 'equals') return typeof value === 'string' && speaks(available(c), value);
    if (op === 'in') { const values = Array.isArray(value) ? value : typeof value === 'string' ? value.split(',') : []; const langs = available(c); return values.some(v => typeof v === 'string' && speaks(langs, v)); }
    return false;
  }
}});
export const handle = dubPlugin.handle;
export const rank_key = dubPlugin.rank_key;
export const cond_match = dubPlugin.cond_match;

``````

## Source: sdk/examples/easydebrid/README.md

# EasyDebrid

A native debrid provider using the debrid_provider capability. Add a bearer API token in Setup and run Test. Credentials stay in the secret vault. It checks cached torrents and generates playback links; it does not queue or remove downloads. Paid playback needs an active account and was not tested in the lab.

## Use

Created and verified through Studio in the 0.3.3 lab. These examples do not auto-install or change server configuration on upgrade.

From the repository root:

```sh
go run ./cmd/ether plugin check sdk/examples/easydebrid
go run ./cmd/ether plugin pack -o /tmp/easydebrid.etherpkg sdk/examples/easydebrid
```

Install the package in Server → Plugins, or copy these three files into a Studio draft. Review permissions and configure the installed plugin in Setup. The source and English strings are editable in Studio.

function ok(body:any){return {status:200,body};}
function token(){try{return String(ether.secret.get('apiKey')||'').trim();}catch{return '';}}
function fail(status:number,message:string):never{throw {status,message};}
function api(path:string,body?:any){const key=token();if(!key)fail(401,'Add an EasyDebrid API token in Setup.');const r=ether.http.fetch({url:'https://easydebrid.com/api/v1'+path,method:body?'POST':'GET',headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+key,'Content-Type':'application/json'},...(body?{body:JSON.stringify(body)}:{})});if(r.status<200||r.status>=300)fail(r.status===401||r.status===403?401:r.status===429?429:502,'EasyDebrid request failed (HTTP '+r.status+').');try{return typeof r.body==='string'?JSON.parse(r.body):r.body;}catch{fail(502,'EasyDebrid returned invalid JSON.');}}
function magnet(h:string){if(!/^[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(h))fail(400,'A valid torrent info hash is required.');return 'magnet:?xt=urn:btih:'+h.toLowerCase();}
function files(hash:string){const result=api('/link/generate',{url:magnet(hash)});if(!Array.isArray(result.files))fail(502,'EasyDebrid returned no file list.');return result.files.map((f:any)=>{const path=[...(Array.isArray(f.directory)?f.directory:[]),f.filename].filter(Boolean).join('/');return {id:path,path,size:Number(f.size)||0,link:String(f.url||'')};}).filter((f:any)=>f.path&&f.size>0);}
function account(){const a=api('/user/details');const day=String(a.paid_until||'');const end=/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(day)?day+'T23:59:59Z':day;const ms=Date.parse(end);return {user:String(a.id||''),premium:Number.isFinite(ms)&&ms>Date.now(),...(Number.isFinite(ms)?{expires:new Date(ms).toISOString()}:{})};}
export function handle(req:any){try{
 if(req.path==='/ether/configure')return ok({errors:{}});
 if(req.path==='/ether/health')return ok({status:token()?'ok':'attention',reason:token()?'':'Add an EasyDebrid API token in Setup.'});
 if(req.path==='/ether/test'||req.path==='/ether/action/test'){const a=account();const message=a.premium?'EasyDebrid account connected; premium access is active.':'Account connected, but premium access is expired or unavailable.';return ok(req.path==='/ether/test'?{ok:a.premium,message}:{toast:message,refresh:true});}
 if(req.path==='/ether/view/account')return ok({title:'EasyDebrid',spec:{specVersion:1,layout:'detail',header:[{kind:'page-header',title:{$:'title'},description:{$:'subtitle'}}],body:[{kind:'stat-tile',iconKey:'key',accent:'primary',label:'$t:state',value:{$:'state'}},{kind:'panel',title:'$t:connection',blocks:[{kind:'widget',widget:'ether.actionButton',props:{label:'$t:test',action:'test'}}]},{kind:'panel',title:'$t:capabilities',blocks:[{kind:'text',content:'$t:help'},{kind:'text',content:'$t:docs'}]}]},data:{title:'EasyDebrid',subtitle:'A native plugin source in Sources → Debrid. Configure your account in Plugins → EasyDebrid → Setup, then run the connection test.',state:token()?'Token saved; test account':'Setup required'}});
 if(req.path==='/ether/debrid/account')return ok(account());
 if(req.path==='/ether/debrid/find'||req.path==='/ether/debrid/remove')return {status:501,body:{error:{code:'unsupported',message:'Cached-only provider; no account torrent queue.'}}};
 if(req.path==='/ether/debrid/check'){
  const hashes=Array.isArray(req.body?.hashes)?req.body.hashes:[];if(hashes.length>10000)fail(400,'Too many hashes.');const cached:any={};
  for(let n=0;n<hashes.length;n+=100){const batch=hashes.slice(n,n+100);const r=api('/link/lookup',{urls:batch.map(magnet)});if(!Array.isArray(r.cached)||r.cached.length!==batch.length)fail(502,'EasyDebrid returned an invalid cache check.');batch.forEach((h:string,i:number)=>cached[h]=r.cached[i]===true);}return ok({cached});
 }
 if(req.path==='/ether/debrid/acquire'){const h=String(req.body?.infoHash||'');const r=api('/link/lookup',{urls:[magnet(h)]});if(r.cached?.[0]!==true)return {status:409,body:{error:{code:'not_cached',message:'This torrent is not cached.'}}};return ok({torrentId:h,ready:true,added:false,files:files(h)});}
 if(req.path==='/ether/debrid/link'){const h=String(req.body?.infoHash||req.body?.torrentId||'');const f=files(h).find((f:any)=>f.path===req.body?.path);if(!f)fail(404,'The selected file is no longer available.');return ok({url:f.link,size:f.size});}
 return {status:404,body:{error:{code:'not_found',message:'Route not found.'}}};
 }catch(e){const status=Number(e.status)||502,message=e.status?e.message:'EasyDebrid could not be reached.';if(req.path==='/ether/test')return ok({ok:false,message});return {status,body:{error:{code:'provider_error',message}}};}}
(globalThis as any).handle=handle;

## Source: sdk/examples/english-dubs/README.md

# English dubbed anime

First-party Ether plugin that exposes anime series and films with an English dub as ready-made list sources for Home rows, smart collections, and library rules.

## What it provides

- **Anime with an English dub (`dubbed`)** — TV series and films confirmed to have an English dub in the community MAL-Dubs dataset.
- **Dub in progress (`incomplete`)** — TV series and films whose English dub is still being released.
- **Status page** — Displays cached mapped series, movie, and in-progress counts with a manual cache refresh action.

## How it works

The plugin fetches both upstream datasets at runtime and does not bundle any copy of the data:

1. **Dub status list:** [MAL-Dubs](https://github.com/MAL-Dubs/MAL-Dubs) (`data/dubInfo.json`, ~5,700 MyAnimeList IDs across `dubbed` and `incomplete`).
2. **ID mapping:** [Fribb/anime-lists](https://github.com/Fribb/anime-lists) (`anime-list-mini.json`), used at runtime to map MyAnimeList IDs to TMDB IDs (with IMDb and TVDB fallbacks where a TMDB ID is absent) because Ether's list source resolver matches canonical IMDb, TMDB, and TVDB identities.

Both files are cached in plugin KV storage in compacted form and refreshed daily via a scheduled job (`/ether/job/refresh`) using conditional HTTP requests (`ETag` / `If-None-Match` and `Last-Modified` / `If-Modified-Since`). If an upstream refresh fails transiently after the cache is populated, the plugin serves the previously cached index.

## Settings

| Setting | Type | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Include incomplete dubs (`includeIncomplete`) | Boolean | `false` | Merges entries from the `incomplete` array into the main **Anime with an English dub** list (deduplicated by title). |
| Type filter (`typeFilter`) | Select (`both`, `series`, `movies`) | `both` | Restricts catalog responses to anime series, anime movies, or both. |

## Permissions

- **Network (`raw.githubusercontent.com`)** — Used only to fetch `MAL-Dubs/MAL-Dubs` (`data/dubInfo.json`) and `Fribb/anime-lists` (`anime-list-mini.json`).

## Credits and licenses

- Plugin source code: MIT License.
- Dub list data: [MAL-Dubs](https://github.com/MAL-Dubs/MAL-Dubs), licensed under the [GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0)](https://github.com/MAL-Dubs/MAL-Dubs/blob/main/LICENSE). No copy of the MAL-Dubs data is bundled with this plugin; it is fetched directly at runtime by each server.
- Anime ID mapping: [Fribb/anime-lists](https://github.com/Fribb/anime-lists).

## Limits

- **Community-maintained data:** Dub coverage and completeness depend on volunteer updates to MAL-Dubs; newly announced simuldubs or recent releases may lag behind broadcast dates.
- **MAL-to-TMDB mapping gaps:** Not every MyAnimeList entry (especially OVAs, specials, and newer titles) has a TMDB, TVDB, or IMDb mapping in `Fribb/anime-lists`. Unmapped entries cannot be matched to Ether's canonical catalogue and are omitted.
- **Season collapsing:** MyAnimeList assigns separate IDs per season or cour, while TMDB groups seasons under one show. Duplicate TMDB show IDs are collapsed into a single show entry, so a show appears once if at least one of its seasons is listed as dubbed.
- **Collection item limit:** Ether bounds each collection or Home row list source read to at most 2,000 items per refresh. The confirmed dubbed series list currently exceeds 2,000 TMDB shows, so full mixed or series-only collections receive the first 2,000 mapped items in source order.

## Verification

From the repository root:

```sh
CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o ./ether ./cmd/ether
./ether plugin check sdk/examples/english-dubs
./ether plugin test sdk/examples/english-dubs
./ether plugin pack -o ./english-dubs.etherpkg sdk/examples/english-dubs
./ether plugin check ./english-dubs.etherpkg
node --test sdk/examples/english-dubs/tests/plugin.test.ts
```

## Source: sdk/examples/english-dubs/src/plugin.ts

``````
// English dubbed anime list source plugin for Ether.
//
// Fetches the community MAL-Dubs index (AGPL-3.0) and Fribb/anime-lists
// MyAnimeList-to-TMDB mapping at runtime, caches compacted data in KV with
// ETag / If-Modified-Since revalidation, and exposes Ether list sources for
// confirmed English dubs and in-progress dubs.

export const MAL_DUBS_URL =
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MAL-Dubs/MAL-Dubs/main/data/dubInfo.json";
export const FRIBB_MAP_URL =
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Fribb/anime-lists/master/anime-list-mini.json";

export const CACHE_TTL_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
export const PAGE_SIZE = 200;

const KV_DUBS_META = "dubs:meta";
const KV_DUBS_DATA = "dubs:data";
const KV_MAP_META = "map:meta";
const KV_MAP_DATA = "map:data";
const KV_INDEX_STATS = "index:stats";
const KV_INDEX_DUBBED_SERIES = "index:dubbed:series";
const KV_INDEX_DUBBED_MOVIE = "index:dubbed:movie";
const KV_INDEX_INCOMPLETE_SERIES = "index:incomplete:series";
const KV_INDEX_INCOMPLETE_MOVIE = "index:incomplete:movie";

const KIND_UNKNOWN = 0;
const KIND_TV = 1;
const KIND_MOVIE = 2;
const KIND_OVA = 3;
const KIND_ONA = 4;
const KIND_SPECIAL = 5;

export type TypeFilter = "both" | "series" | "movies";
export type CatalogMediaType = "series" | "movie";
export type CatalogId = "dubbed" | "incomplete";

export interface PluginSettings {
  includeIncomplete: boolean;
  typeFilter: TypeFilter;
}

export interface PluginRequest {
  method?: string;
  path: string;
  query?: Record<string, string | string[]>;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  body?: unknown;
}

export interface PluginResponse {
  status: number;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  body: unknown;
}

interface HttpFetchRequest {
  url: string;
  method?: string;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  body?: string;
  timeoutMs?: number;
}

interface HttpFetchResponse {
  status: number;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  body?: string;
}

export interface HostedEtherGlobal {
  kv: {
    get(key: string): string | null;
    put(key: string, value: string): void;
    delete(key: string): void;
    list(prefix?: string): string[];
  };
  settings: {
    get(): Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined;
  };
  http: {
    fetch(req: HttpFetchRequest): HttpFetchResponse;
  };
  log?(...args: unknown[]): void;
}

interface CacheMeta {
  etag: string;
  lastModified: string;
  fetchedAt: number;
}

export interface DubInfo {
  dubbed: number[];
  incomplete: number[];
}

// Compact tuple persisted in KV: [kindCode, tmdbTv, tmdbMovie, imdb, tvdb]
export type CompactFribbEntry = [
  number,
  number | number[],
  number | number[],
  string,
  number,
];

export type CompactFribbMap = Record<string, CompactFribbEntry>;

// Compact catalog tuple persisted in KV: [id, malId, tmdbId, imdbId, tvdbId]
export type CompactCatalogItem = [string, number, number, string, number];

export interface IndexStats {
  builtAt: number;
  checkedAt: number;
  dubbedRawCount: number;
  incompleteRawCount: number;
  dubbedSeriesCount: number;
  dubbedMovieCount: number;
  incompleteSeriesCount: number;
  incompleteMovieCount: number;
  dubbedUnmapped: number;
  incompleteUnmapped: number;
  lastError?: string;
}

export interface MetaPreview {
  id: string;
  type: CatalogMediaType;
  name: string;
  tmdb_id?: number;
  imdb_id?: string;
  tvdb_id?: number;
}

function getEther(): HostedEtherGlobal {
  const g = (globalThis as unknown as { ether?: HostedEtherGlobal }).ether;
  if (!g) {
    throw new Error("Ether host global is unavailable");
  }
  return g;
}

function ok(body: unknown): PluginResponse {
  return { status: 200, body };
}

function errorResponse(status: number, code: string, message: string): PluginResponse {
  return { status, body: { error: { code, message } } };
}

function logWarn(msg: string): void {
  try {
    getEther().log?.("warn", msg);
  } catch {
    // Logging must never break request handling.
  }
}

function parseBody(raw: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (raw == null) return {};
  if (typeof raw === "string") {
    const trimmed = raw.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return {};
    const parsed = JSON.parse(trimmed);
    return parsed && typeof parsed === "object" && !Array.isArray(parsed)
      ? (parsed as Record<string, unknown>)
      : {};
  }
  if (typeof raw === "object" && !Array.isArray(raw)) {
    return raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  }
  return {};
}

function getHeader(headers: Record<string, string> | undefined, name: string): string {
  if (!headers) return "";
  const want = name.toLowerCase();
  for (const key of Object.keys(headers)) {
    if (key.toLowerCase() === want) {
      return String(headers[key] ?? "").trim();
    }
  }
  return "";
}

function getQueryValue(
  query: Record<string, string | string[]> | undefined,
  key: string,
): string {
  if (!query) return "";
  const val = query[key];
  if (Array.isArray(val)) return String(val[0] ?? "");
  if (typeof val === "string") return val;
  return "";
}

function isFatalHostError(err: unknown): boolean {
  const code = (err as { code?: string } | null)?.code;
  if (
    code === "check_dependency" ||
    code === "forbidden" ||
    code === "governance" ||
    code === "aborted"
  ) {
    return true;
  }
  const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
  return (
    msg.includes("check_dependency") ||
    msg.includes("forbidden") ||
    msg.includes("governance")
  );
}

export function normalizeSettings(raw: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): PluginSettings {
  const obj = raw && typeof raw === "object" ? raw : {};
  const includeIncomplete = Boolean(obj.includeIncomplete);
  const tf = typeof obj.typeFilter === "string" ? obj.typeFilter.trim().toLowerCase() : "both";
  const typeFilter: TypeFilter =
    tf === "series" || tf === "movies" || tf === "both" ? tf : "both";
  return { includeIncomplete, typeFilter };
}

export function validateSettings(raw: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, string> {
  const errors: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (
    raw.includeIncomplete !== undefined &&
    typeof raw.includeIncomplete !== "boolean"
  ) {
    errors.includeIncomplete = "Include incomplete dubs must be true or false.";
  }
  if (raw.typeFilter !== undefined) {
    const tf =
      typeof raw.typeFilter === "string" ? raw.typeFilter.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
    if (tf !== "both" && tf !== "series" && tf !== "movies") {
      errors.typeFilter = "Type filter must be both, series, or movies.";
    }
  }
  return errors;
}

function readKVJson<T>(key: string): T | null {
  const raw = getEther().kv.get(key);
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw) as T;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function writeKVJson(key: string, value: unknown): void {
  getEther().kv.put(key, JSON.stringify(value));
}

function toPositiveInt(v: unknown): number {
  if (typeof v === "number") {
    return Number.isFinite(v) && v > 0 && Math.floor(v) === v ? v : 0;
  }
  if (typeof v === "string") {
    const s = v.trim();
    if (!/^[0-9]+$/.test(s)) return 0;
    const n = Number(s);
    return Number.isSafeInteger(n) && n > 0 ? n : 0;
  }
  return 0;
}

function toPositiveIntList(v: unknown): number[] {
  if (Array.isArray(v)) {
    const out: number[] = [];
    for (const item of v) {
      const n = toPositiveInt(item);
      if (n > 0 && !out.includes(n)) out.push(n);
    }
    return out;
  }
  const single = toPositiveInt(v);
  return single > 0 ? [single] : [];
}

function compactIntOrList(nums: number[]): number | number[] {
  if (nums.length === 0) return 0;
  if (nums.length === 1) return nums[0];
  return nums;
}

function expandIntOrList(v: number | number[]): number[] {
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return v;
  return v > 0 ? [v] : [];
}

function normalizeImdb(v: unknown): string {
  const check = (s: unknown): string => {
    if (typeof s !== "string") return "";
    const norm = s.trim().toLowerCase();
    return /^tt[0-9]+$/.test(norm) ? norm : "";
  };
  if (Array.isArray(v)) {
    for (const item of v) {
      const ok = check(item);
      if (ok) return ok;
    }
    return "";
  }
  return check(v);
}

function encodeKind(raw: unknown): number {
  if (typeof raw !== "string") return KIND_UNKNOWN;
  switch (raw.trim().toUpperCase()) {
    case "TV":
      return KIND_TV;
    case "MOVIE":
      return KIND_MOVIE;
    case "OVA":
      return KIND_OVA;
    case "ONA":
      return KIND_ONA;
    case "SPECIAL":
      return KIND_SPECIAL;
    default:
      return KIND_UNKNOWN;
  }
}

export function parseDubInfoJson(raw: string): DubInfo {
  let doc: unknown;
  try {
    doc = JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch (err) {
    throw new Error(
      `Invalid MAL-Dubs JSON: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`,
    );
  }
  if (!doc || typeof doc !== "object" || Array.isArray(doc)) {
    throw new Error("MAL-Dubs payload must be a JSON object");
  }
  const rec = doc as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (!Array.isArray(rec.dubbed)) {
    throw new Error("MAL-Dubs payload is missing the dubbed array");
  }
  const collect = (arr: unknown): number[] => {
    if (!Array.isArray(arr)) return [];
    const seen = new Set<number>();
    const out: number[] = [];
    for (const item of arr) {
      const n = toPositiveInt(item);
      if (n > 0 && !seen.has(n)) {
        seen.add(n);
        out.push(n);
      }
    }
    return out;
  };
  return {
    dubbed: collect(rec.dubbed),
    incomplete: collect(rec.incomplete),
  };
}

function mergeCompactEntry(
  existing: CompactFribbEntry | undefined,
  incoming: CompactFribbEntry,
): CompactFribbEntry {
  if (!existing) return incoming;
  const kind = existing[0] !== KIND_UNKNOWN ? existing[0] : incoming[0];
  const tv = expandIntOrList(existing[1]);
  for (const id of expandIntOrList(incoming[1])) {
    if (!tv.includes(id)) tv.push(id);
  }
  const mv = expandIntOrList(existing[2]);
  for (const id of expandIntOrList(incoming[2])) {
    if (!mv.includes(id)) mv.push(id);
  }
  const imdb = existing[3] || incoming[3];
  const tvdb = existing[4] || incoming[4];
  return [kind, compactIntOrList(tv), compactIntOrList(mv), imdb, tvdb];
}

// Parse Fribb/anime-lists anime-list-mini.json and compact it to only entries
// with a MyAnimeList ID and at least one TMDB, IMDb, or TVDB identifier.
// Uses native JSON.parse (compiled C in QuickJS) rather than a JS character
// scanner so the ~5.9 MB upstream file parses in milliseconds.
export function parseFribbMiniJson(raw: string): CompactFribbMap {
  let arr: unknown;
  try {
    arr = JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch (err) {
    throw new Error(
      `Invalid Fribb anime-lists JSON: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`,
    );
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(arr)) {
    throw new Error("Fribb anime-lists payload must be a JSON array");
  }

  const out: CompactFribbMap = {};
  for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
    const item = arr[i];
    if (!item || typeof item !== "object" || Array.isArray(item)) continue;
    const entry = item as Record<string, unknown>;

    const malId = toPositiveInt(entry.mal_id);
    if (malId <= 0) continue;

    let tmdbTv: number[] = [];
    let tmdbMovie: number[] = [];
    const rawTmdb = entry.themoviedb_id;
    if (rawTmdb && typeof rawTmdb === "object" && !Array.isArray(rawTmdb)) {
      const t = rawTmdb as Record<string, unknown>;
      tmdbTv = toPositiveIntList(t.tv);
      tmdbMovie = toPositiveIntList(t.movie);
    }

    const imdb = normalizeImdb(entry.imdb_id);
    const tvdbList = toPositiveIntList(entry.tvdb_id);
    const tvdb = tvdbList.length > 0 ? tvdbList[0] : 0;

    if (tmdbTv.length === 0 && tmdbMovie.length === 0 && !imdb && tvdb === 0) {
      continue;
    }

    const key = String(malId);
    const compact: CompactFribbEntry = [
      encodeKind(entry.type),
      compactIntOrList(tmdbTv),
      compactIntOrList(tmdbMovie),
      imdb,
      tvdb,
    ];
    out[key] = mergeCompactEntry(out[key], compact);
  }

  return out;
}

function buildListForMalIds(
  malIds: number[],
  fribbMap: CompactFribbMap,
): { series: CompactCatalogItem[]; movie: CompactCatalogItem[]; unmapped: number } {
  const series: CompactCatalogItem[] = [];
  const movie: CompactCatalogItem[] = [];
  const seenSeriesId = new Set<string>();
  const seenSeriesImdb = new Set<string>();
  const seenSeriesTvdb = new Set<number>();
  const seenMovieId = new Set<string>();
  const seenMovieImdb = new Set<string>();
  let unmapped = 0;

  const pushSeries = (item: CompactCatalogItem, isFallback: boolean): void => {
    const [id, , , imdb, tvdb] = item;
    if (seenSeriesId.has(id)) return;
    if (isFallback) {
      if (tvdb > 0 && seenSeriesTvdb.has(tvdb)) return;
      if (imdb && seenSeriesImdb.has(imdb)) return;
    }
    seenSeriesId.add(id);
    if (imdb) seenSeriesImdb.add(imdb);
    if (tvdb > 0) seenSeriesTvdb.add(tvdb);
    series.push(item);
  };

  const pushMovie = (item: CompactCatalogItem, isFallback: boolean): void => {
    const [id, , , imdb] = item;
    if (seenMovieId.has(id)) return;
    if (isFallback && imdb && seenMovieImdb.has(imdb)) return;
    seenMovieId.add(id);
    if (imdb) seenMovieImdb.add(imdb);
    movie.push(item);
  };

  for (const malId of malIds) {
    const entry = fribbMap[String(malId)];
    if (!entry) {
      unmapped++;
      continue;
    }
    const [kind, rawTv, rawMovie, imdb, tvdb] = entry;
    const tmdbTv = expandIntOrList(rawTv);
    const tmdbMovie = expandIntOrList(rawMovie);

    let mapped = false;
    if (tmdbTv.length > 0) {
      mapped = true;
      for (const tvId of tmdbTv) {
        pushSeries([`tmdb:${tvId}`, malId, tvId, imdb, tvdb], false);
      }
    }
    if (tmdbMovie.length > 0) {
      mapped = true;
      for (const mvId of tmdbMovie) {
        pushMovie([`tmdb:${mvId}`, malId, mvId, imdb, 0], false);
      }
    }

    if (!mapped) {
      if (kind === KIND_MOVIE) {
        if (imdb) {
          mapped = true;
          pushMovie([imdb, malId, 0, imdb, 0], true);
        }
      } else {
        if (tvdb > 0) {
          mapped = true;
          pushSeries([`tvdb:${tvdb}`, malId, 0, imdb, tvdb], true);
        } else if (imdb) {
          mapped = true;
          pushSeries([imdb, malId, 0, imdb, 0], true);
        }
      }
    }

    if (!mapped) {
      unmapped++;
    }
  }

  return { series, movie, unmapped };
}

export function mergeCatalogLists(
  primary: CompactCatalogItem[],
  secondary: CompactCatalogItem[],
): CompactCatalogItem[] {
  if (secondary.length === 0) return primary;
  const out = primary.slice();
  const seenId = new Set<string>();
  const seenImdb = new Set<string>();
  const seenTvdb = new Set<number>();
  for (const item of primary) {
    seenId.add(item[0]);
    if (item[3]) seenImdb.add(item[3]);
    if (item[4] > 0) seenTvdb.add(item[4]);
  }
  for (const item of secondary) {
    const [id, , tmdb, imdb, tvdb] = item;
    if (seenId.has(id)) continue;
    const isFallback = tmdb === 0;
    if (isFallback) {
      if (tvdb > 0 && seenTvdb.has(tvdb)) continue;
      if (imdb && seenImdb.has(imdb)) continue;
    }
    seenId.add(id);
    if (imdb) seenImdb.add(imdb);
    if (tvdb > 0) seenTvdb.add(tvdb);
    out.push(item);
  }
  return out;
}

interface FetchResourceResult<T> {
  changed: boolean;
  data: T;
  meta: CacheMeta;
  staleError?: string;
}

function fetchCachedResource<T>(
  url: string,
  metaKey: string,
  dataKey: string,
  parse: (body: string) => T,
  force: boolean,
  now: number,
): FetchResourceResult<T> {
  const existingMeta = readKVJson<CacheMeta>(metaKey);
  const existingData = readKVJson<T>(dataKey);
  const hasCache = existingData !== null;

  if (
    !force &&
    hasCache &&
    existingMeta &&
    existingMeta.fetchedAt > 0 &&
    now - existingMeta.fetchedAt < CACHE_TTL_MS
  ) {
    return { changed: false, data: existingData, meta: existingMeta };
  }

  const headers: Record<string, string> = { Accept: "application/json" };
  if (hasCache && existingMeta) {
    if (existingMeta.etag) headers["If-None-Match"] = existingMeta.etag;
    if (existingMeta.lastModified) {
      headers["If-Modified-Since"] = existingMeta.lastModified;
    }
  }

  let resp: HttpFetchResponse;
  try {
    resp = getEther().http.fetch({
      url,
      method: "GET",
      headers,
      timeoutMs: 25000,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    if (isFatalHostError(err)) throw err;
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    if (hasCache && existingMeta) {
      logWarn(`Using cached data for ${url} after fetch error: ${msg}`);
      return {
        changed: false,
        data: existingData,
        meta: existingMeta,
        staleError: msg,
      };
    }
    throw new Error(`Failed to fetch ${url}: ${msg}`);
  }

  if (resp.status === 304 && hasCache) {
    const nextMeta: CacheMeta = {
      etag: getHeader(resp.headers, "etag") || existingMeta?.etag || "",
      lastModified:
        getHeader(resp.headers, "last-modified") ||
        existingMeta?.lastModified ||
        "",
      fetchedAt: now,
    };
    writeKVJson(metaKey, nextMeta);
    return { changed: false, data: existingData, meta: nextMeta };
  }

  if (resp.status !== 200) {
    const msg = `HTTP ${resp.status} from ${url}`;
    if (hasCache && existingMeta) {
      logWarn(`Using cached data for ${url} after ${msg}`);
      return {
        changed: false,
        data: existingData,
        meta: existingMeta,
        staleError: msg,
      };
    }
    throw new Error(msg);
  }

  const body =
    typeof resp.body === "string"
      ? resp.body
      : resp.body == null
        ? ""
        : JSON.stringify(resp.body);

  let parsed: T;
  try {
    parsed = parse(body);
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    if (hasCache && existingMeta) {
      logWarn(`Using cached data for ${url} after parse error: ${msg}`);
      return {
        changed: false,
        data: existingData,
        meta: existingMeta,
        staleError: msg,
      };
    }
    throw err;
  }

  const nextMeta: CacheMeta = {
    etag: getHeader(resp.headers, "etag"),
    lastModified: getHeader(resp.headers, "last-modified"),
    fetchedAt: now,
  };
  writeKVJson(dataKey, parsed);
  writeKVJson(metaKey, nextMeta);
  return { changed: true, data: parsed, meta: nextMeta };
}

export function refreshCache(force: boolean): {
  changed: boolean;
  stats: IndexStats;
} {
  const now = Date.now();
  const dubsRes = fetchCachedResource<DubInfo>(
    MAL_DUBS_URL,
    KV_DUBS_META,
    KV_DUBS_DATA,
    parseDubInfoJson,
    force,
    now,
  );
  const mapRes = fetchCachedResource<CompactFribbMap>(
    FRIBB_MAP_URL,
    KV_MAP_META,
    KV_MAP_DATA,
    parseFribbMiniJson,
    force,
    now,
  );

  const existingStats = readKVJson<IndexStats>(KV_INDEX_STATS);
  const hasLists =
    existingStats !== null &&
    getEther().kv.get(KV_INDEX_DUBBED_SERIES) !== null &&
    getEther().kv.get(KV_INDEX_DUBBED_MOVIE) !== null &&
    getEther().kv.get(KV_INDEX_INCOMPLETE_SERIES) !== null &&
    getEther().kv.get(KV_INDEX_INCOMPLETE_MOVIE) !== null;

  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (dubsRes.staleError) errors.push(dubsRes.staleError);
  if (mapRes.staleError) errors.push(mapRes.staleError);
  const lastError = errors.length > 0 ? errors.join("; ") : undefined;

  if (!dubsRes.changed && !mapRes.changed && hasLists && existingStats) {
    const updatedStats: IndexStats = {
      ...existingStats,
      checkedAt: now,
      lastError,
    };
    writeKVJson(KV_INDEX_STATS, updatedStats);
    return { changed: false, stats: updatedStats };
  }

  const dubbedBuilt = buildListForMalIds(dubsRes.data.dubbed, mapRes.data);
  const incompleteBuilt = buildListForMalIds(
    dubsRes.data.incomplete,
    mapRes.data,
  );

  writeKVJson(KV_INDEX_DUBBED_SERIES, dubbedBuilt.series);
  writeKVJson(KV_INDEX_DUBBED_MOVIE, dubbedBuilt.movie);
  writeKVJson(KV_INDEX_INCOMPLETE_SERIES, incompleteBuilt.series);
  writeKVJson(KV_INDEX_INCOMPLETE_MOVIE, incompleteBuilt.movie);

  const stats: IndexStats = {
    builtAt: now,
    checkedAt: now,
    dubbedRawCount: dubsRes.data.dubbed.length,
    incompleteRawCount: dubsRes.data.incomplete.length,
    dubbedSeriesCount: dubbedBuilt.series.length,
    dubbedMovieCount: dubbedBuilt.movie.length,
    incompleteSeriesCount: incompleteBuilt.series.length,
    incompleteMovieCount: incompleteBuilt.movie.length,
    dubbedUnmapped: dubbedBuilt.unmapped,
    incompleteUnmapped: incompleteBuilt.unmapped,
    lastError,
  };
  writeKVJson(KV_INDEX_STATS, stats);
  return { changed: true, stats };
}

function ensureFreshIndex(): IndexStats {
  const now = Date.now();
  const stats = readKVJson<IndexStats>(KV_INDEX_STATS);
  const dubsMeta = readKVJson<CacheMeta>(KV_DUBS_META);
  const mapMeta = readKVJson<CacheMeta>(KV_MAP_META);
  if (
    stats &&
    dubsMeta &&
    mapMeta &&
    dubsMeta.fetchedAt > 0 &&
    mapMeta.fetchedAt > 0 &&
    now - dubsMeta.fetchedAt < CACHE_TTL_MS &&
    now - mapMeta.fetchedAt < CACHE_TTL_MS &&
    getEther().kv.get(KV_INDEX_DUBBED_SERIES) !== null
  ) {
    return stats;
  }
  return refreshCache(false).stats;
}

export function parseCatalogRoute(
  path: string,
  query?: Record<string, string | string[]>,
): { type: CatalogMediaType; id: CatalogId; skip: number } | null {
  const cleanPath = path.split("?")[0];
  if (!cleanPath.startsWith("/catalog/") || !cleanPath.endsWith(".json")) {
    return null;
  }
  const inner = cleanPath.slice("/catalog/".length, -".json".length);
  const parts = inner.split("/");
  if (parts.length < 2 || parts.length > 3) return null;

  let rawType: string;
  let rawId: string;
  try {
    rawType = decodeURIComponent(parts[0]).toLowerCase();
    rawId = decodeURIComponent(parts[1]).toLowerCase();
  } catch {
    return null;
  }

  let type: CatalogMediaType;
  if (rawType === "series" || rawType === "show" || rawType === "tv") {
    type = "series";
  } else if (rawType === "movie") {
    type = "movie";
  } else {
    return null;
  }

  if (rawId !== "dubbed" && rawId !== "incomplete") {
    return null;
  }

  let skip = 0;
  if (parts.length === 3 && parts[2]) {
    for (const pair of parts[2].split("&")) {
      const eq = pair.indexOf("=");
      if (eq <= 0) continue;
      const k = decodeURIComponent(pair.slice(0, eq));
      const v = decodeURIComponent(pair.slice(eq + 1));
      if (k === "skip") {
        const n = Number.parseInt(v, 10);
        if (Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0) skip = n;
      }
    }
  }
  if (skip === 0) {
    const qSkip = getQueryValue(query, "skip");
    if (qSkip) {
      const n = Number.parseInt(qSkip, 10);
      if (Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0) skip = n;
    }
  }

  return { type, id: rawId, skip };
}

function itemToMeta(item: CompactCatalogItem, type: CatalogMediaType): MetaPreview {
  const [id, malId, tmdbId, imdbId, tvdbId] = item;
  const meta: MetaPreview = {
    id,
    type,
    name: `MAL ${malId}`,
  };
  if (tmdbId > 0) meta.tmdb_id = tmdbId;
  if (imdbId) meta.imdb_id = imdbId;
  if (tvdbId > 0) meta.tvdb_id = tvdbId;
  return meta;
}

function handleCatalog(req: PluginRequest): PluginResponse {
  const parsed = parseCatalogRoute(req.path, req.query);
  if (!parsed) {
    return errorResponse(404, "not_found", "Catalog not found.");
  }

  const settings = normalizeSettings(getEther().settings.get());
  if (
    (parsed.type === "movie" && settings.typeFilter === "series") ||
    (parsed.type === "series" && settings.typeFilter === "movies")
  ) {
    return ok({ metas: [], hasMore: false });
  }

  ensureFreshIndex();

  let list: CompactCatalogItem[];
  if (parsed.id === "dubbed") {
    const primaryKey =
      parsed.type === "series" ? KV_INDEX_DUBBED_SERIES : KV_INDEX_DUBBED_MOVIE;
    const primary = readKVJson<CompactCatalogItem[]>(primaryKey) ?? [];
    if (settings.includeIncomplete) {
      const incKey =
        parsed.type === "series"
          ? KV_INDEX_INCOMPLETE_SERIES
          : KV_INDEX_INCOMPLETE_MOVIE;
      const secondary = readKVJson<CompactCatalogItem[]>(incKey) ?? [];
      list = mergeCatalogLists(primary, secondary);
    } else {
      list = primary;
    }
  } else {
    const incKey =
      parsed.type === "series"
        ? KV_INDEX_INCOMPLETE_SERIES
        : KV_INDEX_INCOMPLETE_MOVIE;
    list = readKVJson<CompactCatalogItem[]>(incKey) ?? [];
  }

  if (parsed.skip >= list.length) {
    return ok({ metas: [], hasMore: false });
  }

  const page = list.slice(parsed.skip, parsed.skip + PAGE_SIZE);
  const hasMore = parsed.skip + page.length < list.length;
  return ok({
    metas: page.map((item) => itemToMeta(item, parsed.type)),
    hasMore,
  });
}

function formatTypeFilter(tf: TypeFilter): string {
  if (tf === "series") return "series only";
  if (tf === "movies") return "movies only";
  return "series and movies";
}

function handleStatusView(): PluginResponse {
  const settings = normalizeSettings(getEther().settings.get());
  const stats = readKVJson<IndexStats>(KV_INDEX_STATS);

  const mappedSeries = stats ? String(stats.dubbedSeriesCount) : "0";
  const mappedMovies = stats ? String(stats.dubbedMovieCount) : "0";
  const mappedIncomplete = stats
    ? String(stats.incompleteSeriesCount + stats.incompleteMovieCount)
    : "0";

  const filterSummary = `Active settings: ${formatTypeFilter(settings.typeFilter)}, incomplete dubs ${
    settings.includeIncomplete ? "included in the main list" : "kept separate"
  }.`;

  let cacheStatus: string;
  if (!stats) {
    cacheStatus = `Cache not populated yet. ${filterSummary} Run Refresh cache or wait for the daily schedule.`;
  } else {
    const checkedIso = new Date(stats.checkedAt || stats.builtAt).toISOString();
    const gapNote =
      stats.dubbedUnmapped > 0
        ? ` ${stats.dubbedUnmapped} of ${stats.dubbedRawCount} MAL-Dubs entries had no TMDB, IMDb, or TVDB mapping.`
        : "";
    const errNote = stats.lastError
      ? ` Serving cached data after last refresh error: ${stats.lastError}.`
      : "";
    cacheStatus = `Last checked ${checkedIso}. ${filterSummary}${gapNote}${errNote}`;
  }

  return ok({
    title: "English dubbed anime",
    spec: {
      specVersion: 1,
      layout: "detail",
      header: [
        {
          kind: "page-header",
          title: "$t:page_title",
          description: { $: "subtitle" },
        },
      ],
      body: [
        {
          kind: "stat-tile",
          iconKey: "tv",
          accent: "primary",
          label: "$t:stat_mapped_series",
          value: { $: "mappedSeries" },
        },
        {
          kind: "stat-tile",
          iconKey: "film",
          accent: "primary",
          label: "$t:stat_mapped_movies",
          value: { $: "mappedMovies" },
        },
        {
          kind: "stat-tile",
          iconKey: "clock",
          accent: "primary",
          label: "$t:stat_incomplete",
          value: { $: "mappedIncomplete" },
        },
        {
          kind: "panel",
          title: "$t:panel_cache",
          blocks: [
            { kind: "text", content: { $: "cacheStatus" } },
            {
              kind: "widget",
              widget: "ether.actionButton",
              props: {
                label: "$t:action_refresh",
                action: "refresh",
              },
            },
          ],
        },
        {
          kind: "panel",
          title: "$t:panel_source",
          blocks: [{ kind: "text", content: "$t:source_credit" }],
        },
      ],
    },
    data: {
      subtitle:
        "Provides English-dubbed anime list sources for Home rows, collections, and library rules.",
      mappedSeries,
      mappedMovies,
      mappedIncomplete,
      cacheStatus,
    },
  });
}

function handleTest(): PluginResponse {
  try {
    const res = refreshCache(true);
    const total = res.stats.dubbedSeriesCount + res.stats.dubbedMovieCount;
    return ok({
      ok: total > 0 && !res.stats.lastError,
      message: res.stats.lastError
        ? `Connected with cached fallback: ${res.stats.lastError}`
        : `Mapped ${res.stats.dubbedSeriesCount} series and ${res.stats.dubbedMovieCount} movies from ${res.stats.dubbedRawCount} MAL-Dubs entries.`,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    if (isFatalHostError(err)) throw err;
    return ok({
      ok: false,
      message: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),
    });
  }
}

export function handle(req: PluginRequest): PluginResponse {
  const path = (req.path || "").split("?")[0];

  if (path === "/ether/health") {
    return ok({ status: "ok" });
  }

  if (path === "/ether/configure") {
    return ok({ errors: validateSettings(parseBody(req.body)) });
  }

  if (path === "/ether/test") {
    return handleTest();
  }

  if (path === "/ether/job/refresh") {
    const body = parseBody(req.body);
    const force = body.force === false ? false : true;
    const res = refreshCache(force);
    return ok({
      done: true,
      changed: res.changed,
      stats: res.stats,
    });
  }

  if (path === "/ether/action/refresh") {
    const res = refreshCache(true);
    const total = res.stats.dubbedSeriesCount + res.stats.dubbedMovieCount;
    const toast = res.stats.lastError
      ? `Kept cached ${total} titles after refresh error.`
      : `English dubbed anime cache ready (${res.stats.dubbedSeriesCount} series, ${res.stats.dubbedMovieCount} movies).`;
    return ok({ toast, refresh: true });
  }

  if (path === "/ether/view/status") {
    return handleStatusView();
  }

  if (path.startsWith("/catalog/")) {
    return handleCatalog(req);
  }

  return errorResponse(404, "not_found", "Route not found.");
}

(globalThis as unknown as { handle?: typeof handle }).handle = handle;

``````

## Source: sdk/examples/ether-wrapped/README.md

# Ether Wrapped

Explore a granted viewer's completed titles for the current year, with a monthly chart, top genres and a poster grid. Choose viewers at installation and select one on the page. Add “Your year in titles” in a collection and choose a viewer and optional year.

Screenshot placeholder: Wrapped page with viewer buttons, two stat tiles, posters, genres and a monthly chart in light and dark themes.

## Limits

The page reads the most recent 200 history entries, so older activity can be omitted. The chart counts completed history entries and does not estimate viewing time. Collections include only titles with an IMDb identifier. A viewer grant is required and can be revoked at any time.

## Source: sdk/examples/ether-wrapped/plugin.ts

``````
import { plugin, type Manifest } from '../../typescript/src/index.ts';
import manifest from './manifest.json' with { type: 'json' };
import en from './i18n/en.json' with { type: 'json' };
import fr from './i18n/fr.json' with { type: 'json' };

type History = { titleId: string; type: string; watchedAt: string; completed?: boolean };
type Title = { id: string; title: string; type: string; tmdbId?: number; imdbId?: string; year?: number; genres?: string[]; posterPath?: string; summary?: string };
async function yearData(ctx: any, viewer: number, year: number) {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(viewer) || viewer <= 0 || year < 1900 || year > 9999) return { titles: [], plays: 0, genres: [], months: Array(12).fill(0) };
  const viewers = await ctx.ether.viewers.granted();
  if (!viewers.some((v: any) => v.id === viewer)) return { titles: [], plays: 0, genres: [], months: Array(12).fill(0) };
  const history: History[] = await ctx.ether.viewers.history(viewer, 200, 0);
  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  const months = Array(12).fill(0);
  for (const entry of history) {
    const date = new Date(entry.watchedAt);
    if (!entry.completed || date.getUTCFullYear() !== year) continue;
    let titleId = entry.titleId;
    if (entry.type === 'episode') { const key = Number(titleId); if (Number.isSafeInteger(key) && key >= 4e15 && key < 5e15) titleId = String(2e15 + Math.floor((key - 4e15) / 1e7)); }
    counts.set(titleId, (counts.get(titleId) || 0) + 1);
    months[date.getUTCMonth()]++;
  }
  const titles: Array<Title & {count: number}> = [];
  for (const [id, count] of counts) {
    try {
      const title = await ctx.ether.catalog.get(id) as Title | null;
      if (title) titles.push({ ...title, count });
    } catch { /* A removed title should not hide the rest of the year. */ }
  }
  titles.sort((a,b) => b.count-a.count || a.title.localeCompare(b.title));
  const genreCounts = new Map<string,number>();
  for (const title of titles) for (const genre of title.genres || []) genreCounts.set(genre, (genreCounts.get(genre) || 0) + title.count);
  const genres = [...genreCounts].sort((a,b) => b[1]-a[1] || a[0].localeCompare(b[0])).slice(0,5);
  return { titles, plays: months.reduce((a,b) => a+b,0), genres, months };
}
export const wrappedDefinition = { manifest: manifest as Manifest, strings: { en, fr }, routes: {
  async view(req, ctx) {
    const viewers = await ctx.ether.viewers.granted();
    const viewer = Number(req.query.viewer || viewers[0]?.id || 0);
    const year = Number(req.query.year || new Date().getUTCFullYear());
    const result = await yearData(ctx, viewer, year);
    const data: Record<string,unknown> = { year: String(year), plays: String(result.plays), titleCount: String(result.titles.length), genres: result.genres.map(([g,n]) => `${g} (${n})`).join(', '), titles: result.titles.map(t => ({ ratingKey:t.id, title:t.title, type:t.type, poster:t.posterPath ? `https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/w300${t.posterPath}` : undefined })), series: [{ key:'plays', label:ctx.t('plays'), values:result.months }], times: result.months.map((_,i) => `${year}-${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')}-01T00:00:00Z`) };
    const page = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.ceil(viewers.length / 6) - 1, Number(req.query.viewerPage) || 0));
    const links = viewers.slice(page * 6, page * 6 + 6).map((v,i) => { data[`viewer${i}`] = v.name; data[`active${i}`] = v.id === viewer; return { href:`?viewer=${v.id}&viewerPage=${page}`, label:{$:`viewer${i}`}, activeWhen:{$:`active${i}`} }; });
    data.neverActive = false;
    if (page > 0) links.unshift({href:`?viewerPage=${page-1}`, label:'$t:previous' as any, activeWhen:{$:'neverActive'}});
    if ((page + 1) * 6 < viewers.length) links.push({href:`?viewerPage=${page+1}`, label:'$t:next' as any, activeWhen:{$:'neverActive'}});
    return { spec: { specVersion:1, layout:'list', header:[{kind:'page-header',title:'$t:page',description:'$t:description'}], body:[{kind:'filter-bar',controls:{},leading:{kind:'toggle-links',links}}, {kind:'stat-tile',iconKey:'calendar',accent:'violet',label:'$t:year',value:{$:'year'}},{kind:'stat-tile',iconKey:'play',accent:'teal',label:'$t:plays',value:{$:'plays'}},{kind:'stat-tile',iconKey:'film',accent:'blue',label:'$t:titles',value:{$:'titleCount'}},{kind:'heading',level:2,content:'$t:top_titles'},{kind:'widget',widget:'ether.posterGrid',props:{items:{$:'titles'},empty:'$t:empty'}},{kind:'panel',title:'$t:genres',blocks:[{kind:'text',content:{$:'genres'}}]},{kind:'heading',level:2,content:'$t:activity'},{kind:'widget',widget:'ether.liveChart',props:{series:{$:'series'},times:{$:'times'},label:'$t:plays'}}] }, data };
  },
  async catalog(req,ctx) {
    const viewer = Number(req.extra.viewerId || 0), year = Number(req.extra.year || new Date().getUTCFullYear());
    const data = await yearData(ctx, viewer, year);
    return { metas: data.titles.filter(t => (req.type === 'series' ? t.type === 'show' : t.type === req.type) && t.imdbId).slice(req.skip,req.skip+100).map(t => ({id:t.imdbId!,type:req.type,name:t.title,releaseInfo:String(t.year || ''),description:t.summary})) };
  }
}};
export const wrappedPlugin = plugin(wrappedDefinition);
export const handle = wrappedPlugin.handle;

``````

# Hello plugin (Go)

Run the sidecar from the repository root:

```sh
ETHER_PLUGIN_PORT=8080 go run ./sdk/examples/hello/go/cmd
```

For a tunnel, set `ETHER_TUNNEL_URL` and `ETHER_PLUGIN_CREDENTIAL` instead.
Use a credential obtained by pairing with Ether. The HTTP mode defaults to a
random free port when `ETHER_PLUGIN_PORT` is not set.

Run its tests with `go test ./sdk/examples/hello/go`.

func main() {
	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()
	if err := hello.NewHelloPlugin().Serve(ctx, sdk.ServeOptions{}); err != nil && ctx.Err() == nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
}
