## Source: sdk/examples/smart-lights/src/plugin.ts

``````
// Smart lights example plugin for Ether Flows.
//
// Demonstrates:
//   - Subscribing to canonical Ether events (playback.session.started / stopped)
//   - Publishing schema-validated custom events (scene.changed) via ether.events.publish
//   - Contributing an idempotent Flow action (set_scene) that respects X-Ether-Idempotency-Key and dryRun

interface PluginRequest {
  method?: string;
  path: string;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  body?: unknown;
}

interface PluginResponse {
  status: number;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  body: unknown;
}

interface FlowActionBody {
  flowId?: string;
  runId?: string;
  nodeId?: string;
  idempotencyKey?: string;
  dryRun?: boolean;
  params?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

interface RoomState {
  room: string;
  scene: string;
  brightness: number;
}

interface HostedEther {
  kv: {
    get(key: string): string | null;
    put(key: string, value: string): void;
  };
  settings: {
    get(): Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined;
  };
  events: {
    publish(
      key: string,
      payload?: Record<string, unknown>,
      correlation?: Record<string, unknown>,
    ): void;
  };
}

declare const ether: HostedEther;

const VALID_SCENES: Record<string, boolean> = {
  cinema: true,
  warm: true,
  bright: true,
  off: true,
};

function parseBody(raw: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (!raw) return {};
  if (typeof raw === "string") {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      return parsed && typeof parsed === "object" ? (parsed as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
    } catch {
      return {};
    }
  }
  return typeof raw === "object" ? (raw as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
}

function getHeader(headers: Record<string, string> | undefined, name: string): string {
  if (!headers) return "";
  const target = name.toLowerCase();
  for (const key of Object.keys(headers)) {
    if (key.toLowerCase() === target) {
      return String(headers[key] ?? "");
    }
  }
  return "";
}

function readSettings(): { defaultRoom: string; defaultBrightness: number } {
  const s = ether.settings.get() ?? {};
  const room = typeof s.defaultRoom === "string" && s.defaultRoom.trim() ? s.defaultRoom.trim() : "Living room";
  const rawBrightness = Number(s.defaultBrightness);
  const brightness = Number.isFinite(rawBrightness) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(rawBrightness))) : 25;
  return { defaultRoom: room, defaultBrightness: brightness };
}

function readRoomState(room: string): RoomState {
  const saved = ether.kv.get("room:" + room.toLowerCase());
  if (saved) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(saved) as Partial<RoomState>;
      if (parsed && typeof parsed.scene === "string") {
        return {
          room,
          scene: parsed.scene,
          brightness: typeof parsed.brightness === "number" ? parsed.brightness : 100,
        };
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore corrupt KV value and fall back to default.
    }
  }
  return { room, scene: "bright", brightness: 100 };
}

function applyScene(
  room: string,
  scene: string,
  brightness: number,
  dryRun: boolean,
  emitEvent: boolean,
  correlation?: Record<string, unknown>,
): Record<string, unknown> {
  const prev = readRoomState(room);
  const clamped = scene === "off" ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(brightness)));
  if (!dryRun) {
    ether.kv.put(
      "room:" + room.toLowerCase(),
      JSON.stringify({ room, scene, brightness: clamped }),
    );
    if (emitEvent) {
      ether.events.publish(
        "scene.changed",
        {
          room,
          scene,
          brightness: clamped,
          previousScene: prev.scene,
        },
        correlation,
      );
    }
  }
  return {
    room,
    scene,
    previousScene: prev.scene,
    brightness: clamped,
    applied: !dryRun,
    deduplicated: false,
  };
}

function handleSetScene(req: PluginRequest): PluginResponse {
  const body = parseBody(req.body) as FlowActionBody;
  const params = body.params && typeof body.params === "object" ? body.params : {};
  const defaults = readSettings();

  const room =
    typeof params.room === "string" && params.room.trim()
      ? params.room.trim()
      : defaults.defaultRoom;
  const scene = typeof params.scene === "string" ? params.scene.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
  if (!VALID_SCENES[scene]) {
    return {
      status: 400,
      body: { error: { code: "invalid_scene", message: "Scene must be cinema, warm, bright, or off." } },
    };
  }
  const brightness =
    params.brightness !== undefined && Number.isFinite(Number(params.brightness))
      ? Number(params.brightness)
      : defaults.defaultBrightness;
  const dryRun = Boolean(body.dryRun);
  const idemKey = (getHeader(req.headers, "X-Ether-Idempotency-Key") || String(body.idempotencyKey ?? "")).trim();

  if (!dryRun && idemKey) {
    const cached = ether.kv.get("idem:" + idemKey);
    if (cached) {
      try {
        const prevOutput = JSON.parse(cached) as Record<string, unknown>;
        return {
          status: 200,
          body: { output: { ...prevOutput, deduplicated: true } },
        };
      } catch {
        // Re-execute if cached value cannot be parsed.
      }
    }
  }

  const output = applyScene(room, scene, brightness, dryRun, true, { key: "room:" + room.toLowerCase() });
  if (!dryRun && idemKey) {
    ether.kv.put("idem:" + idemKey, JSON.stringify(output));
  }
  return {
    status: 200,
    body: { output },
  };
}

function handleEventBatch(req: PluginRequest): PluginResponse {
  const body = parseBody(req.body);
  const events = Array.isArray(body.events) ? (body.events as Array<Record<string, unknown>>) : [];
  const defaults = readSettings();
  const ack: string[] = [];

  for (const ev of events) {
    const id = typeof ev.id === "string" ? ev.id : "";
    if (id) ack.push(id);
    const name = typeof ev.name === "string" ? ev.name : "";
    if (name === "playback.session.started") {
      applyScene(defaults.defaultRoom, "cinema", defaults.defaultBrightness, false, true);
    } else if (name === "playback.session.stopped") {
      applyScene(defaults.defaultRoom, "warm", 70, false, true);
    }
  }

  return { status: 200, body: { ack } };
}

function handle(req: PluginRequest): PluginResponse {
  const method = (req.method ?? "GET").toUpperCase();
  if (method === "GET" && req.path === "/ether/health") {
    return { status: 200, body: { status: "ok" } };
  }
  if (method === "POST" && req.path === "/ether/configure") {
    return { status: 200, body: { errors: {} } };
  }
  if (method === "POST" && req.path === "/ether/event") {
    return handleEventBatch(req);
  }
  if (method === "POST" && req.path === "/ether/v1/flow-actions/set_scene") {
    return handleSetScene(req);
  }
  return {
    status: 404,
    body: { error: { code: "not_found", message: "Route not found." } },
  };
}

(globalThis as unknown as { handle: typeof handle }).handle = handle;

``````

## Source: sdk/examples/sports/README.md

# Sports (`org.ether.sports`)

A first-party hosted TypeScript plugin for Ether that brings live scores, standings, schedules, win probability, play-by-play, and team favourites across 17 leagues using ESPN's public JSON endpoints behind a swappable `SportsProvider` interface.

## What it contributes

- **Live feed (`sports`):** `live_events` capability with a 15 s minimum interval and `team` entity kind. The plugin never polls on its own; Ether calls it on demand while a client is subscribed or an alert window is open.
- **Sports screen (`sports`):** `leagues`, `hero`, `Live now`, `Your teams`, `Today`, `Schedule`, `Standings`, and `Teams` sections matching Ether's generic screen contract and binding Vela wire shapes.
- **Live TV matching:** `broadcasts` (normalized TV / stream / radio with region preference) and `matchHints` (team names, short names, nicknames, locations, abbreviations, and expanded broadcast callsigns) for Ether's "Where to watch" and score-bug overlay matcher.
- **Close-game alerts (`status.close`):**
  - Football (NFL, NCAAF): within 8 points in Q4 under 5 min (or OT within 8).
  - Basketball (NBA, WNBA, NCAAM): within 5 points in the last 3 min of regulation (Q4 for 4-quarter leagues, 2nd half for NCAAM) or OT.
  - Hockey (NHL): tied or within 1 goal in the 3rd period (or OT/SO).
  - Soccer (MLS, EPL, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, UCL): level at or after 80' (or level in extra time).
  - Baseball (MLB): within 2 runs in the 9th inning or extra innings.

## Default leagues

Enabled by default and selectable in plugin settings (`leagues`):

NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB, MLS, Premier League (`epl`), La Liga (`laliga`), Bundesliga (`bundesliga`), Serie A (`seriea`), Ligue 1 (`ligue1`), Champions League (`ucl`), NCAAF top 25 (`ncaaf`), NCAAM top 25 (`ncaam`), WNBA, Formula 1 (`f1`), UFC, and PGA Tour (`pga`).

## Settings and permissions

- **Settings (`settings.schema.json`):**
  - `leagues` (`multiSelect`): leagues included on the Sports screen and live score feed.
  - `region` (`select`): preferred broadcast region (`us`, `ca`, `gb`, `eu`, `au`, or `all`). When an event has no broadcasts for the chosen region, all listed broadcasts are returned as fallback so Live TV matching keeps working.
- **Network permissions:** `site.api.espn.com` and `site.web.api.espn.com` for data, and `a.espncdn.com` for team and league logos. Ether fetches logos itself through its signed image proxy and only from hosts listed here, so clients never load ESPN URLs.

## Plugin endpoints

- `GET /ether/v1/live/sports/events?from=&to=&league=&ids=`
- `GET /ether/v1/live/sports/events/{id}`
- `GET /ether/v1/live/sports/entities?kind=team&league=&q=`
- `GET /ether/v1/live/sports/standings?league=`
- `GET /ether/health`
- `POST /ether/configure`
- `POST /ether/test`

## Architecture and caching

- **Provider interface (`src/providers/types.ts`):** `EspnSportsProvider` (`src/providers/espn.ts`) implements `SportsProvider`. Another provider can be passed to `createSportsHandler({ provider })` without changing routing, settings validation, close-game heuristics, or caching helpers.
- **Concurrency & caching:** outbound requests use `ether.http.fetchMany` capped at 6 concurrent requests per host (chunked at 64 per call). KV cache TTLs are 15 s for scoreboards/details with live (`in`/`delayed`) events, 5 min for non-live scoreboards/details, 15 min for standings, and 24 h for teams/entities. Transient upstream errors fall back to stale cached values when available.
- **Self-contained hosted sources:** all imports stay relative inside `sdk/examples/sports/src/` so Ether Studio can import and edit `src/plugin.ts` directly without external package imports. `src/contract.ts` mirrors the v0.3.19 `live_events` and `screens` contract types locally until they are exported from `@ether/plugin-sdk`.

## Build, check, and test

From the repository root:

```sh
# Offline fixture tests (zero network)
node --test sdk/examples/sports/tests/plugin.test.ts

# Real esbuild VFS compile + QuickJS runtime + icon/copy check
go test ./sdk/examples/sports

# Pack and check once live_events & screens manifest validation is merged
go run ./cmd/ether plugin check sdk/examples/sports
go run ./cmd/ether plugin pack -o ~/.scratch/sports.etherpkg sdk/examples/sports
```

## Ether Studio recipe

Follow this recipe to open, inspect, customize, and install `org.ether.sports` inside **Ether Studio** (`Server → Plugins → Develop`):

1. **Import or scaffold the draft:**
   - Pack and install `sdk/examples/sports`, then click **Edit in Studio** on `Sports` (all imports stay inside `src/`, so Studio keeps `src/plugin.ts` and sibling modules editable).
   - Or start a hosted TypeScript draft in Studio and copy `manifest.json`, `settings.schema.json`, `assets/icon.svg`, `i18n/en.json`, `i18n/fr.json`, and `src/**`.
   - Confirm `ether.permissions.network` lists only `["site.api.espn.com", "site.web.api.espn.com", "a.espncdn.com"]`.
2. **Exercise routes in the Inspector** (enable live network in the sandbox permissions drawer to hit ESPN):
   - `GET /ether/health` → `{ status: "ok", provider: "espn", feed: "sports", leagues: [...], region: "us" }`.
   - `POST /ether/test` → probes the first enabled league on ESPN and returns `{ ok: true, message }`.
   - `POST /ether/configure` with `{"leagues":["nfl","nba","epl","f1"],"region":"ca"}` → `200`; `{"leagues":[]}` → `400` with `fields["/leagues"]`.
   - `GET /ether/v1/live/sports/events?league=nfl` → `{ events, nextPollSec }` with normalized RFC3339 timestamps, `broadcasts`, and `matchHints`.
   - `GET /ether/v1/live/sports/events/{id}` (for example `nfl-401873066`) → `LiveEventDetail` with `tables`, `plays`, and `probabilitySeries` (`t` as `0..1` game fraction).
   - `GET /ether/v1/live/sports/entities?kind=team&league=nfl&q=eagles` → `{ entities: [{ id: "nfl-21", kind: "team", ... }] }`.
   - `GET /ether/v1/live/sports/standings?league=nba` → sorted conference tables (`#` ascending from `1`).
3. **Customize in Studio:**
   - **Default leagues:** edit `settings.schema.json` `leagues.default` to pre-select a smaller set (for example `["nfl", "nhl", "epl", "f1"]`).
   - **Close-game thresholds:** edit `src/close.ts` (`isCloseGame`) to tune margins or clock thresholds.
   - **Swap data provider:** implement `SportsProvider` (`src/providers/types.ts`), add its host to `ether.permissions.network`, and pass `{ provider }` into `createSportsHandler` in `src/plugin.ts`.
4. **Install and publish:** click **Install** in Studio, review the two ESPN network grants and 64 MiB hosted memory cap, select leagues and region in the plugin drawer, run **Test connection**, and publish the plugin to Vela so the **Sports** screen appears in navigation.

## Limits and ESPN API notes

- Uses ESPN's public, undocumented JSON endpoints (`site.api.espn.com` and `site.web.api.espn.com`), which may change without notice.
- ESPN's team-sport scoreboard endpoints reject `YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD` date ranges with HTTP 400; multi-day windows fan out bounded single-day requests (up to 7 days) through `http.fetchMany`, while multi-day weekend events (`f1`, `pga`, `ufc`) use range queries.
- ESPN returns HTTP 404 for `/summary` on `f1`, `pga`, and `ufc`; event detail falls back to scoreboard data to build race results/weekend sessions, golf leaderboards, and fight cards.
- NBA and MLB standings returned by ESPN are not pre-sorted by rank; the provider sorts entries by `playoffSeed`/`rank` ascending before rendering tables.
- Test fixtures in `tests/fixtures/` are trimmed recordings of real ESPN responses captured on 2026-11-22.

## Source: sdk/examples/sports/src/cache.ts

``````
/**
 * KV-backed TTL cache for ESPN responses (spec section C):
 * - Scoreboards: 15 s while any event is live (in/delayed), 5 min otherwise
 * - Event details: 15 s while live, 5 min otherwise
 * - Standings: 15 min
 * - Teams/entities: 24 hours
 */

import type { HostedEtherGlobal, LiveEvent } from "./contract.ts";

export const TTL_LIVE_MS = 15_000;
export const TTL_IDLE_MS = 300_000;
export const TTL_STANDINGS_MS = 900_000;
export const TTL_TEAMS_MS = 86_400_000;

interface CacheEnvelope<T> {
  storedAt: number;
  ttlMs: number;
  value: T;
}

export interface CacheRead<T> {
  fresh: boolean;
  value: T;
  storedAt: number;
  ttlMs: number;
}

export class KvCache {
  private readonly kv: HostedEtherGlobal["kv"] | undefined;
  private readonly now: () => number;

  constructor(kv: HostedEtherGlobal["kv"] | undefined, now: () => number) {
    this.kv = kv;
    this.now = now;
  }

  read<T>(key: string): CacheRead<T> | null {
    if (!this.kv) return null;
    try {
      const raw = this.kv.get(key);
      if (!raw) return null;
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<CacheEnvelope<T>>;
      if (
        typeof parsed.storedAt !== "number" ||
        typeof parsed.ttlMs !== "number" ||
        !("value" in parsed)
      ) {
        return null;
      }
      const age = this.now() - parsed.storedAt;
      const fresh = age >= 0 && age < parsed.ttlMs;
      return {
        fresh,
        value: parsed.value as T,
        storedAt: parsed.storedAt,
        ttlMs: parsed.ttlMs,
      };
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  write<T>(key: string, value: T, ttlMs: number): void {
    if (!this.kv || ttlMs <= 0) return;
    try {
      const env: CacheEnvelope<T> = {
        storedAt: this.now(),
        ttlMs,
        value,
      };
      this.kv.put(key, JSON.stringify(env));
    } catch {
      // KV write failure must never fail a read path.
    }
  }
}

export function isLiveState(state: string): boolean {
  return state === "in" || state === "delayed";
}

/**
 * Computes scoreboard cache TTL:
 * - 15 s while any event is live (in/delayed)
 * - 5 min otherwise (capped gently if an upcoming game starts within 5 min
 *   so we don't serve stale pre-game state past kickoff).
 */
export function computeScoreboardTtlMs(
  events: LiveEvent[],
  nowMs: number,
): number {
  let soonestPreDelta = Infinity;
  for (const ev of events) {
    if (isLiveState(ev.status.state)) {
      return TTL_LIVE_MS;
    }
    if (ev.status.state === "pre") {
      const startMs = Date.parse(ev.start);
      if (!Number.isNaN(startMs)) {
        const delta = startMs - nowMs;
        if (delta > 0 && delta < soonestPreDelta) {
          soonestPreDelta = delta;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  if (soonestPreDelta < TTL_IDLE_MS) {
    return Math.max(TTL_LIVE_MS, soonestPreDelta);
  }
  return TTL_IDLE_MS;
}

export function computeNextPollSec(events: LiveEvent[], nowMs: number): number {
  const ttlMs = computeScoreboardTtlMs(events, nowMs);
  return Math.max(15, Math.round(ttlMs / 1000));
}

``````

## Source: sdk/examples/sports/src/close.ts

``````
/**
 * Close-game heuristics (spec section C):
 * - Football (NFL, NCAAF): within 8 points in Q4 under 5 min (or OT within 8)
 * - Basketball (NBA, WNBA, NCAAM): within 5 points in the last 3 min of
 *   regulation (Q4 for 4-quarter leagues, 2nd half for 2-half NCAAM) or OT
 * - Hockey (NHL): tied or within 1 goal in the 3rd period (or OT/SO)
 * - Soccer (MLS, EPL, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, UCL):
 *   level (tied) at or after 80' (or level in extra time)
 * - Baseball (MLB): within 2 runs in the 9th inning or extra innings
 */

import type { Competitor, LiveEventState } from "./contract.ts";
import type { SportCategory } from "./leagues.ts";

export interface CloseGameInput {
  category: SportCategory;
  state: LiveEventState;
  period?: number;
  regulationPeriods: number;
  clock?: string;
  numericClock?: number;
  competitors?: Competitor[];
}

/**
 * Parses a countdown display clock into remaining seconds.
 * Handles "4:59", "0:42.8", and under-1-minute basketball clocks like "42.8".
 * Returns null for non-clock strings such as "HT", "End", or empty.
 */
export function parseRemainingClockSec(
  displayClock?: string,
  numericClock?: number,
): number | null {
  if (displayClock) {
    const trimmed = displayClock.trim();
    const mmss = /^(\d+):(\d{1,2}(?:\.\d+)?)$/.exec(trimmed);
    if (mmss) {
      const mins = Number(mmss[1]);
      const secs = Number(mmss[2]);
      if (Number.isFinite(mins) && Number.isFinite(secs)) {
        return mins * 60 + secs;
      }
    }
    const plainSec = /^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)$/.exec(trimmed);
    if (plainSec) {
      const secs = Number(plainSec[1]);
      if (Number.isFinite(secs)) {
        return secs;
      }
    }
  }
  if (typeof numericClock === "number" && Number.isFinite(numericClock) && numericClock >= 0) {
    return numericClock;
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Parses elapsed soccer minutes from ESPN's clock ("82'", "90'+3'", "105'")
 * or numeric elapsed seconds.
 */
export function parseElapsedSoccerMinutes(
  displayClock?: string,
  numericClock?: number,
): number | null {
  if (displayClock) {
    const trimmed = displayClock.trim();
    const stoppage = /^(\d+)'\s*\+\s*(\d+)'?$/.exec(trimmed);
    if (stoppage) {
      return Number(stoppage[1]) + Number(stoppage[2]);
    }
    const simple = /^(\d+)'$/.exec(trimmed);
    if (simple) {
      return Number(simple[1]);
    }
  }
  if (typeof numericClock === "number" && Number.isFinite(numericClock) && numericClock > 0) {
    return Math.floor(numericClock / 60);
  }
  return null;
}

function twoTeamScoreDiff(competitors?: Competitor[]): number | null {
  if (!competitors || competitors.length !== 2) return null;
  const s0 = Number(competitors[0].score);
  const s1 = Number(competitors[1].score);
  if (!Number.isFinite(s0) || !Number.isFinite(s1)) return null;
  return Math.abs(s0 - s1);
}

export function isCloseGame(input: CloseGameInput): boolean {
  if (input.state !== "in") return false;
  const diff = twoTeamScoreDiff(input.competitors);
  if (diff === null) return false;
  const period = input.period ?? 0;

  switch (input.category) {
    case "football": {
      if (diff > 8) return false;
      if (period > input.regulationPeriods) return true; // OT
      if (period === input.regulationPeriods) {
        const rem = parseRemainingClockSec(input.clock, input.numericClock);
        return rem !== null && rem < 300;
      }
      return false;
    }

    case "basketball": {
      if (diff > 5) return false;
      if (period > input.regulationPeriods) return true; // OT
      if (period === input.regulationPeriods) {
        const rem = parseRemainingClockSec(input.clock, input.numericClock);
        return rem !== null && rem <= 180;
      }
      return false;
    }

    case "hockey": {
      return period >= input.regulationPeriods && diff <= 1;
    }

    case "soccer": {
      if (diff !== 0) return false;
      if (period >= 3) return true; // Extra time / penalties level
      const mins = parseElapsedSoccerMinutes(input.clock, input.numericClock);
      return mins !== null && mins >= 80;
    }

    case "baseball": {
      return period >= input.regulationPeriods && diff <= 2;
    }

    default:
      return false;
  }
}

``````

/**
 * Broadcast normalization (with region preference) and Live TV matchHints
 * derivation (spec sections A2, A5, and C).
 */

import type {
  Broadcast,
  Competitor,
  MatchHints,
  RankingRow,
} from "./contract.ts";

export const VALID_REGIONS = new Set(["us", "ca", "gb", "eu", "au", "all"]);

export function normalizeRegion(raw: unknown): string {
  if (typeof raw !== "string") return "us";
  const r = raw.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (VALID_REGIONS.has(r)) return r;
  return "us";
}

export interface RawEspnGeoBroadcast {
  type?: { shortName?: string; id?: string };
  market?: { type?: string };
  media?: { shortName?: string; name?: string; callLetters?: string };
  region?: string;
}

export interface RawEspnBroadcast {
  market?: string;
  names?: string[];
  type?: { shortName?: string };
  media?: { shortName?: string; name?: string; callLetters?: string };
  region?: string;
}

const STREAM_NAME_RE =
  /espn\+|peacock|paramount\+|prime video|amazon prime|apple tv|dazn|fubo|fandango|netflix|hulu|max\b|nfl\+|nba league pass|mls season pass|mlb\.tv|vict\+|stan sport|discovery\+|viaplay|youtube|streaming/i;

const RADIO_NAME_RE = /radio|sirius|xm\b|westwood one|talksport/i;

function classifyBroadcastKind(
  name: string,
  typeShortName?: string,
): "tv" | "stream" | "radio" {
  const t = (typeShortName || "").toLowerCase();
  if (t.includes("radio") || RADIO_NAME_RE.test(name)) return "radio";
  if (
    t.includes("stream") ||
    t.includes("web") ||
    t.includes("subscription") ||
    t.includes("ott") ||
    t.includes("app") ||
    STREAM_NAME_RE.test(name)
  ) {
    return "stream";
  }
  return "tv";
}

const CALLSIGN_EXPANSIONS: Record<string, string[]> = {
  "usa": ["USA Network", "USA"],
  "usa net": ["USA Network", "USA"],
  "usa network": ["USA Network", "USA"],
  "golf chnl": ["Golf Channel"],
  "golf channel": ["Golf Channel"],
  "tennis chnl": ["Tennis Channel"],
  "tennis channel": ["Tennis Channel"],

const EU_REGIONS = new Set([
  "eu",
  "de",
  "fr",
  "es",
  "it",
  "nl",
  "be",
  "pt",
  "se",
  "no",

  "at",
  "ch",
  "ie",

function matchesRegion(broadcastRegion: string | undefined, target: string): boolean {
  if (target === "all") return true;
  if (!broadcastRegion) return true;
  const br = broadcastRegion.toLowerCase();
  if (br === target) return true;
  if (target === "gb" && (br === "uk" || br === "gb")) return true;
  if (target === "eu" && EU_REGIONS.has(br)) return true;
  return false;
}

export function extractBroadcasts(
  geoBroadcasts: RawEspnGeoBroadcast[] | undefined,
  broadcasts: RawEspnBroadcast[] | undefined,
  regionSetting: string,
): Broadcast[] {
  const all: Broadcast[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();

  const push = (name: string, kind: "tv" | "stream" | "radio", region?: string) => {
    // Show the network's full name ("Golf Channel", not ESPN's "Golf Chnl").
    const clean = (CALLSIGN_EXPANSIONS[name.trim().toLowerCase()]?.[0] || name).trim();
    if (!clean) return;
    const normRegion = region ? region.trim().toLowerCase() : undefined;
    const key = `${clean.toLowerCase()}|${kind}|${normRegion || ""}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) return;
    seen.add(key);
    const b: Broadcast = { name: clean, kind };
    if (normRegion) b.region = normRegion;
    all.push(b);
  };

  if (Array.isArray(geoBroadcasts)) {
    for (const g of geoBroadcasts) {
      const name = g?.media?.shortName || g?.media?.name || "";
      if (!name) continue;
      push(name, classifyBroadcastKind(name, g?.type?.shortName), g?.region);
    }
  }

  if (Array.isArray(broadcasts)) {
    for (const b of broadcasts) {
      if (b?.media?.shortName || b?.media?.name || b?.media?.callLetters) {
        const name = b.media.shortName || b.media.name || b.media.callLetters || "";
        push(name, classifyBroadcastKind(name, b.type?.shortName), b.region);
      }
      if (Array.isArray(b?.names)) {
        for (const rawName of b.names) {
          if (typeof rawName !== "string" || !rawName.trim()) continue;
          // Skip adding a regionless duplicate if geoBroadcasts already covered this network.
          const lower = rawName.trim().toLowerCase();
          if (all.some((existing) => existing.name.toLowerCase() === lower)) {
            continue;
          }
          push(rawName, classifyBroadcastKind(rawName), b.region);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const target = normalizeRegion(regionSetting);
  if (target === "all" || all.length === 0) return all;

  const preferred = all.filter((b) => matchesRegion(b.region, target));
  return preferred.length > 0 ? preferred : all;
}

export interface CompetitorHintInput {
  displayName?: string;
  shortDisplayName?: string;
  name?: string;
  location?: string;
  abbreviation?: string;
}

export function buildMatchHints(
  competitors: Competitor[] | undefined,
  rawTeams: CompetitorHintInput[] | undefined,
  ranking: RankingRow[] | undefined,
  broadcasts: Broadcast[] | undefined,
  extraTerms?: string[],
): MatchHints {
  const terms: string[] = [];
  const termSeen = new Set<string>();
  const addTerm = (value?: string) => {
    if (!value) return;
    let clean = value.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
    if (!clean) return;
    // Collapse accidental doubled phrases like "Real Sociedad Real Sociedad".
    const words = clean.split(" ");
    if (words.length >= 2 && words.length % 2 === 0) {
      const half = words.length / 2;
      const left = words.slice(0, half).join(" ");
      const right = words.slice(half).join(" ");
      if (left.toLowerCase() === right.toLowerCase()) {
        clean = left;
      }
    }
    const key = clean.toLowerCase();
    if (termSeen.has(key)) return;
    termSeen.add(key);
    terms.push(clean);
  };

  if (Array.isArray(rawTeams)) {
    for (const t of rawTeams) {
      addTerm(t.displayName);
      addTerm(t.shortDisplayName);
      addTerm(t.name);
      const loc = t.location?.trim();
      const name = t.name?.trim();
      if (loc && name) {
        const locLow = loc.toLowerCase();
        const nameLow = name.toLowerCase();
        if (
          locLow !== nameLow &&
          !nameLow.includes(locLow) &&
          !locLow.includes(nameLow)
        ) {
          addTerm(`${loc} ${name}`);
        }
      }
      addTerm(loc);
      addTerm(t.abbreviation);
    }
  }

  if (Array.isArray(competitors)) {
    for (const c of competitors) {
      addTerm(c.name);
      addTerm(c.short);
      addTerm(c.abbr);
    }
  }

  if (Array.isArray(ranking)) {
    for (const row of ranking.slice(0, 3)) {
      addTerm(row.name);
      addTerm(row.abbr);
    }
  }

  if (Array.isArray(extraTerms)) {
    for (const extra of extraTerms) {
      addTerm(extra);
    }
  }

  const callsigns: string[] = [];
  const callsignSeen = new Set<string>();
  const addCallsign = (value?: string) => {
    if (!value) return;
    const clean = value.trim();
    if (!clean) return;
    const key = clean.toLowerCase();
    if (callsignSeen.has(key)) return;
    callsignSeen.add(key);
    callsigns.push(clean);
  };

  if (Array.isArray(broadcasts)) {
    for (const b of broadcasts) {
      addCallsign(b.name);
      const expanded = CALLSIGN_EXPANSIONS[b.name.toLowerCase()];
      if (expanded) {
        for (const alias of expanded) {
          addCallsign(alias);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return { terms, callsigns };
}

export const DEFAULT_LEAGUE_IDS: readonly string[] = DEFAULT_LEAGUES.map(
  (l) => l.id,
);

const ALIAS_MAP = new Map<string, LeagueConfig>();
for (const league of DEFAULT_LEAGUES) {
  ALIAS_MAP.set(league.id, league);
  ALIAS_MAP.set(league.abbr.toLowerCase(), league);
  ALIAS_MAP.set(league.espnLeague.toLowerCase(), league);
  for (const alias of league.aliases) {
    ALIAS_MAP.set(alias.toLowerCase(), league);
  }
}

export function resolveLeague(idOrAlias: string): LeagueConfig | undefined {
  const key = idOrAlias.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!key) return undefined;
  return ALIAS_MAP.get(key);
}

export function resolveEnabledLeagues(configured: unknown): LeagueConfig[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(configured)) {
    return [...DEFAULT_LEAGUES];
  }
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const out: LeagueConfig[] = [];
  for (const entry of configured) {
    if (typeof entry !== "string") continue;
    const lg = resolveLeague(entry);
    if (lg && !seen.has(lg.id)) {
      seen.add(lg.id);
      out.push(lg);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

export function formatEventId(leagueId: string, rawEventId: string): string {
  const cleanRaw = rawEventId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "");
  return `${leagueId}-${cleanRaw}`;
}

export function parseEventId(
  eventId: string,
): { league: LeagueConfig; rawEventId: string } | null {
  const trimmed = eventId.trim();
  const dash = trimmed.indexOf("-");
  if (dash <= 0 || dash >= trimmed.length - 1) return null;
  const prefix = trimmed.slice(0, dash);
  const rawEventId = trimmed.slice(dash + 1);
  if (!rawEventId || /[:/]/.test(rawEventId)) return null;
  const league = resolveLeague(prefix);
  if (!league) return null;
  return { league, rawEventId };
}

export function formatEntityId(leagueId: string, rawEntityId: string): string {
  const cleanRaw = rawEntityId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "");
  return `${leagueId}-${cleanRaw}`;
}

``````
/**
 * First-party Ether Sports hosted plugin (org.ether.sports).
 *
 * Implements Ether's v0.3.19 Live Events contract (spec sections A1, A2, A3, C):
 * - GET /ether/v1/live/sports/events?from=&to=&league=&ids=
 * - GET /ether/v1/live/sports/events/{id}
 * - GET /ether/v1/live/sports/entities?kind=team&league=&q=
 * - GET /ether/v1/live/sports/standings?league=
 * - GET /ether/health
 * - POST /ether/configure
 * - POST /ether/test
 *
 * The plugin never polls on its own; Ether calls it on demand.
 */

import { KvCache } from "./cache.ts";
import type {
  EntitiesResponse,
  EventsResponse,
  HostedEtherGlobal,
  HostedRequest,
  HostedResponse,
  StandingsResponse,
} from "./contract.ts";
import { normalizeRegion, VALID_REGIONS } from "./hints.ts";
import {
  DEFAULT_LEAGUE_IDS,
  parseEventId,
  resolveEnabledLeagues,
  resolveLeague,
  type LeagueConfig,
} from "./leagues.ts";
import { EspnSportsProvider } from "./providers/espn.ts";
import {
  throwIfFatalHostError,
  type ProviderRuntime,
  type SportsProvider,
} from "./providers/types.ts";

export interface SportsSettings {
  leagues: string[];
  region: string;
}

export interface SportsHandlerOptions {
  provider?: SportsProvider;
  getEther?: () => HostedEtherGlobal;
  now?: () => number;
}

const FEED_PREFIX = "/ether/v1/live/sports";

function defaultGetEther(): HostedEtherGlobal {
  const g = globalThis as unknown as { ether?: HostedEtherGlobal };
  if (!g.ether) {
    throw new Error("Ether hosted runtime globalThis.ether is not available");
  }
  return g.ether;
}

function queryParam(
  query: Record<string, string | string[]> | undefined,
  key: string,
): string | undefined {
  if (!query) return undefined;
  const val = query[key];
  if (typeof val === "string") return val.trim() || undefined;
  if (Array.isArray(val)) {
    for (const item of val) {
      if (typeof item === "string" && item.trim()) return item.trim();
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

function queryList(
  query: Record<string, string | string[]> | undefined,
  key: string,
): string[] {
  if (!query) return [];
  const val = query[key];
  const rawList = typeof val === "string" ? [val] : Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const raw of rawList) {
    if (typeof raw !== "string") continue;
    for (const part of raw.split(",")) {
      const clean = part.trim();
      if (clean) out.push(clean);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function parseSettings(raw: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): {
  leagues: LeagueConfig[];
  region: string;
} {
  const enabled = resolveEnabledLeagues(raw?.leagues);
  const leagues = enabled.length > 0 ? enabled : resolveEnabledLeagues(DEFAULT_LEAGUE_IDS);
  const region = normalizeRegion(raw?.region);
  return { leagues, region };
}

function validateConfigureBody(body: unknown): {
  settings?: SportsSettings;
  errors?: Record<string, string>;
} {
  if (body !== undefined && body !== null && typeof body !== "object") {
    return { errors: { "/": "must be an object" } };
  }
  const obj = (body || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const errors: Record<string, string> = {};

  let leagueIds: string[] = [...DEFAULT_LEAGUE_IDS];
  if (obj.leagues !== undefined) {
    if (!Array.isArray(obj.leagues)) {
      errors["/leagues"] = "must be a list of league IDs";
    } else if (obj.leagues.length === 0) {
      errors["/leagues"] = "select at least one league";
    } else {
      const resolved: string[] = [];
      const seen = new Set<string>();
      const invalid: string[] = [];
      for (const item of obj.leagues) {
        if (typeof item !== "string") {
          invalid.push(String(item));
          continue;
        }
        const lg = resolveLeague(item);
        if (!lg) {
          invalid.push(item);
        } else if (!seen.has(lg.id)) {
          seen.add(lg.id);
          resolved.push(lg.id);
        }
      }
      if (invalid.length > 0) {
        errors["/leagues"] = `unknown league(s): ${invalid.join(", ")}`;
      } else {
        leagueIds = resolved;
      }
    }
  }

  let region = "us";
  if (obj.region !== undefined && obj.region !== "") {
    if (typeof obj.region !== "string" || !VALID_REGIONS.has(obj.region.trim().toLowerCase())) {
      errors["/region"] = "must be one of us, ca, gb, eu, au, or all";
    } else {
      region = obj.region.trim().toLowerCase();
    }
  }

  if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) {
    return { errors };
  }
  return { settings: { leagues: leagueIds, region } };
}

function resolveRequestedLeagues(
  leagueParam: string[],
  fallbackLeagues: LeagueConfig[],
): { leagues?: LeagueConfig[]; unknown?: string[] } {
  if (leagueParam.length === 0) {
    return { leagues: fallbackLeagues };
  }
  const resolved: LeagueConfig[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const unknown: string[] = [];
  for (const item of leagueParam) {
    const lg = resolveLeague(item);
    if (!lg) {
      unknown.push(item);
    } else if (!seen.has(lg.id)) {
      seen.add(lg.id);
      resolved.push(lg);
    }
  }
  if (unknown.length > 0) {
    return { unknown };
  }
  return { leagues: resolved };
}

function jsonResponse(status: number, body: unknown): HostedResponse {
  return {
    status,
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
    body,
  };
}

function errorResponse(
  status: number,
  code: string,
  message: string,
  extra?: Record<string, unknown>,
): HostedResponse {
  return jsonResponse(status, {
    error: { code, message, ...extra },
  });
}

function parsePathAndQuery(req: HostedRequest): {
  path: string;
  query: Record<string, string | string[]>;
} {
  const merged: Record<string, string | string[]> = {};
  if (req.query) {
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(req.query)) {
      merged[k] = v;
    }
  }
  let cleanPath = req.path || "/";
  const qIdx = cleanPath.indexOf("?");
  if (qIdx >= 0) {
    const qs = cleanPath.slice(qIdx + 1);
    cleanPath = cleanPath.slice(0, qIdx);
    for (const pair of qs.split("&")) {
      if (!pair) continue;
      const eq = pair.indexOf("=");
      const rawK = eq >= 0 ? pair.slice(0, eq) : pair;
      const rawV = eq >= 0 ? pair.slice(eq + 1) : "";
      const k = decodeURIComponent(rawK.replace(/\+/g, " "));
      const v = decodeURIComponent(rawV.replace(/\+/g, " "));
      if (merged[k] === undefined) {
        merged[k] = v;
      }
    }
  }
  if (cleanPath.length > 1 && cleanPath.endsWith("/")) {
    cleanPath = cleanPath.slice(0, -1);
  }
  return { path: cleanPath, query: merged };
}

function decodeSegment(seg: string): string {
  try {
    return decodeURIComponent(seg);
  } catch {
    return seg;
  }
}

export function createSportsHandler(
  options: SportsHandlerOptions = {},
): (req: HostedRequest) => HostedResponse {
  const provider: SportsProvider = options.provider || new EspnSportsProvider();
  const getEther = options.getEther || defaultGetEther;
  const now = options.now || (() => Date.now());

  return function handleRequest(req: HostedRequest): HostedResponse {
    const method = (req.method || "GET").toUpperCase();
    const { path, query } = parsePathAndQuery(req);

    try {
      const host = getEther();
      const rawSettings = host.settings?.get ? host.settings.get() : {};
      const { leagues: enabledLeagues, region } = parseSettings(rawSettings);
      const rt: ProviderRuntime = {
        http: host.http,
        cache: new KvCache(host.kv, now),
        now,
        log: (level, message, fields) => {
          if (typeof host.log === "function") {
            const detail = fields ? `${message} ${JSON.stringify(fields)}` : message;
            host.log(level, detail);
          }
        },
      };

      // Health endpoint
      if (path === "/ether/health" && method === "GET") {
        return jsonResponse(200, {
          status: "ok",
          provider: provider.id,
          feed: "sports",
          leagues: enabledLeagues.map((l) => l.id),
          region,
        });
      }

      // Configure / settings validation endpoint
      if (path === "/ether/configure" && method === "POST") {
        const check = validateConfigureBody(req.body);
        if (check.errors) {
          return errorResponse(400, "invalid_settings", "Invalid plugin settings", {
            fields: check.errors,
          });
        }
        return jsonResponse(200, { ok: true, settings: check.settings });
      }

      // Live connectivity test endpoint
      if (path === "/ether/test" && method === "POST") {
        const probeLeague = enabledLeagues[0];
        const result = provider.healthCheck(probeLeague, rt);
        if (!result.ok) {
          return errorResponse(502, "upstream_error", result.detail);
        }
        return jsonResponse(200, { ok: true, message: result.detail });
      }

      // GET /ether/v1/live/sports/events?from=&to=&league=&ids=
      if (path === `${FEED_PREFIX}/events` && method === "GET") {
        const leagueParams = queryList(query, "league");
        const resolved = resolveRequestedLeagues(leagueParams, enabledLeagues);
        if (resolved.unknown) {
          return errorResponse(
            400,
            "unknown_league",
            `Unknown league: ${resolved.unknown.join(", ")}`,
          );
        }
        const ids = queryList(query, "ids").map((raw) => {
          const colon = raw.lastIndexOf(":");
          return colon >= 0 ? raw.slice(colon + 1) : raw;
        });
        const from = queryParam(query, "from");
        const to = queryParam(query, "to");

        const result: EventsResponse = provider.getEvents(
          {
            leagues: resolved.leagues || enabledLeagues,
            from,
            to,
            ids: ids.length > 0 ? ids : undefined,
            region,
          },
          rt,
        );
        return jsonResponse(200, result);
      }

      // GET /ether/v1/live/sports/events/{id}
      if (path.startsWith(`${FEED_PREFIX}/events/`) && method === "GET") {
        const rawSeg = decodeSegment(path.slice(`${FEED_PREFIX}/events/`.length));
        if (!rawSeg || rawSeg.includes("/")) {
          return errorResponse(404, "not_found", "Event not found");
        }
        const colon = rawSeg.lastIndexOf(":");
        const localId = colon >= 0 ? rawSeg.slice(colon + 1) : rawSeg;
        const parsed = parseEventId(localId);
        if (!parsed) {
          return errorResponse(404, "not_found", "Event not found");
        }
        const detail = provider.getEventDetail(
          parsed.league,
          parsed.rawEventId,
          region,
          rt,
        );
        if (!detail) {
          return errorResponse(404, "not_found", "Event not found");
        }
        return jsonResponse(200, detail);
      }

      // GET /ether/v1/live/sports/entities?kind=team&league=&q=&ids=
      if (path === `${FEED_PREFIX}/entities` && method === "GET") {
        const kind = queryParam(query, "kind") || "team";
        const leagueParams = queryList(query, "league");
        const resolved = resolveRequestedLeagues(leagueParams, enabledLeagues);
        if (resolved.unknown) {
          return errorResponse(
            400,
            "unknown_league",
            `Unknown league: ${resolved.unknown.join(", ")}`,
          );
        }
        const ids = queryList(query, "ids").map((raw) => {
          const colon = raw.lastIndexOf(":");
          return colon >= 0 ? raw.slice(colon + 1) : raw;
        });
        let targetLeagues = resolved.leagues || enabledLeagues;
        if (ids.length > 0 && leagueParams.length === 0) {
          const byId = new Map<string, LeagueConfig>();
          for (const id of ids) {
            const parsed = parseEventId(id);
            if (parsed) byId.set(parsed.league.id, parsed.league);
          }
          if (byId.size > 0) {
            targetLeagues = [...byId.values()];
          }
        }
        const q = queryParam(query, "q");
        const entities = provider.getEntities(
          {
            leagues: targetLeagues,
            kind,
            q,
            ids: ids.length > 0 ? ids : undefined,
          },
          rt,
        );
        const payload: EntitiesResponse = { entities };
        return jsonResponse(200, payload);
      }

      // GET /ether/v1/live/sports/standings?league=
      if (path === `${FEED_PREFIX}/standings` && method === "GET") {
        const leagueParams = queryList(query, "league");
        let targetLeagues: LeagueConfig[];
        if (leagueParams.length > 0) {
          const resolved = resolveRequestedLeagues(leagueParams, enabledLeagues);
          if (resolved.unknown) {
            return errorResponse(
              400,
              "unknown_league",
              `Unknown league: ${resolved.unknown.join(", ")}`,
            );
          }
          targetLeagues = resolved.leagues || [];
        } else {
          const first = enabledLeagues.find((l) => l.supportsStandings);
          targetLeagues = first ? [first] : [];
        }
        const tables = provider.getStandings({ leagues: targetLeagues }, rt);
        const payload: StandingsResponse = { tables };
        return jsonResponse(200, payload);
      }

      return errorResponse(404, "not_found", `Route not found: ${method} ${path}`);
    } catch (err) {
      throwIfFatalHostError(err);
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      return errorResponse(500, "internal_error", message);
    }
  };
}

const defaultHandle = createSportsHandler();

export function handle(req: HostedRequest): HostedResponse {
  return defaultHandle(req);
}

(globalThis as unknown as { handle?: typeof handle }).handle = handle;

``````
