## Source: sdk/examples/subdl/plugin.ts

``````
import { plugin, PluginRouteError } from '../../typescript/src/router.ts';
import { unzipSync, strFromU8 } from './vendor/fflate.js';
import manifest from './manifest.json';
import schema from './settings.schema.json';

const MAX = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
const fail = (message: string): never => { throw new PluginRouteError(502, 'subdl_error', message); };
function readApiKey(ctx: { ether: { secret: { get(name: string): unknown } } }): string {
  try {
    return ((ctx.ether.secret.get('apiKey') as string) || '').trim();
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof Error && /is not saved/i.test(err.message)) return '';
    throw err;
  }
}
function bytes64(s: string): Uint8Array {
  const alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/';
  if (!/^(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{4})*(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{2}==|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{3}=)?$/.test(s) || s.length > 4 * Math.ceil(MAX / 3)) return fail('Invalid subtitle archive.');
  const out: number[] = []; let bits = 0, value = 0;
  for (const c of s.replace(/=+$/, '')) { value = (value << 6) | alphabet.indexOf(c); bits += 6; if (bits >= 8) { bits -= 8; out.push((value >> bits) & 255); } }
  return new Uint8Array(out);
}
function archive(data: string): string {
  const bytes = bytes64(data);
  // Validate the central directory and its declared sizes before inflating.
  let end = -1;
  for (let i = bytes.length - 22; i >= Math.max(0, bytes.length - 65557); i--) if (bytes[i]===80 && bytes[i+1]===75 && bytes[i+2]===5 && bytes[i+3]===6) { end=i; break; }
  if (end < 0) return fail('Invalid subtitle archive.');
  const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer); const count=view.getUint16(end+10,true); let offset=view.getUint32(end+16,true); let total=0;
  if (!count || count > 100 || offset >= end || view.getUint16(end+8,true)!==count || view.getUint16(end+4,true)!==0 || view.getUint16(end+6,true)!==0 || end+22+view.getUint16(end+20,true)!==bytes.length) return fail('Invalid subtitle archive.');
  for (let i=0;i<count;i++) {
    if (offset+46>end || view.getUint32(offset,true)!==0x02014b50) return fail('Invalid subtitle archive.');
    const size=view.getUint32(offset+24,true); total+=size;
    if (total>MAX || (view.getUint16(offset+8,true)&1)) return fail('Subtitle archive is too large or encrypted.');
    offset+=46+view.getUint16(offset+28,true)+view.getUint16(offset+30,true)+view.getUint16(offset+32,true);
  }
  if (offset>end) return fail('Invalid subtitle archive.');
  try {
    const files=unzipSync(bytes); const names=Object.keys(files).filter(n=>/\.srt$/i.test(n) && !n.startsWith('__MACOSX/')).sort();
    if (names.length!==1 || files[names[0]].length>MAX) return fail('The archive must contain one SRT subtitle.');
    return strFromU8(files[names[0]]);
  } catch { return fail('Could not read the subtitle archive.'); }
}
const settingsManifest = {...manifest, ether:{...manifest.ether, settings:schema}} as any;
export const subdl = plugin<{apiKey:string}>({manifest:settingsManifest, routes:{
  subtitles(req, ctx) {
    const id = req.id.split(':');
    const apiKey = readApiKey(ctx);
    if (!/^tt\d+$/.test(id[0]) || !apiKey) return {subtitles:[]};
    let url='https://api.subdl.com/api/v1/subtitles?api_key='+encodeURIComponent(apiKey)+'&imdb_id='+encodeURIComponent(id[0])+'&subs_per_page=30&client=custom_integration';
    if (req.type==='series' && /^\d+$/.test(id[1] || '') && /^\d+$/.test(id[2] || '')) url+='&type=tv&season_number='+id[1]+'&episode_number='+id[2];
    const response=ctx.ether.http.fetch({url}) as any;
    if (response.status!==200) return fail('Subtitle search failed.');
    const body=JSON.parse(response.body); if (!body.status || !Array.isArray(body.subtitles)) return fail('Subtitle search failed.');
    return {subtitles:body.subtitles.slice(0,30).filter((s:any)=>/^\/subtitle\/[0-9]+-[0-9]+\.zip$/.test(s.url || '') && /^[a-z]{2,3}$/i.test(s.language || s.lang || '')).map((s:any)=>({id:s.url,lang:(s.language || s.lang).toLowerCase(),format:'srt',name:String(s.release_name || s.name || 'SubDL').slice(0,200)}))};
  },
  subtitlesDownload(req,ctx) {
    if (!/^\/subtitle\/[0-9]+-[0-9]+\.zip$/.test(req.id) || req.format !== 'srt') return fail('Invalid subtitle selection.');
    const apiKey = readApiKey(ctx);
    if (!apiKey) return fail('Enter an API key.');
    const response=ctx.ether.http.fetch({url:'https://dl.subdl.com'+req.id,headers:{'x-api-key':apiKey}}) as any;
    if (response.status!==200 || !response.bodyBase64) return fail('Subtitle download failed.');
    return {format:'srt',encoding:'utf8',data:archive(response.bodyBase64)};
  },
  test(ctx) { const key = readApiKey(ctx); return {ok:!!key, message:key ? 'API key saved.' : 'Enter an API key.'}; }
}});
export const handle = subdl.handle;

``````

## Source: sdk/examples/travel-mode/README.md

# Travel Mode

A native ranking step with a 1, 2, 4 or 8 GB target. Add it near the top of a quality profile’s ranking order; the default target is 4 GB. Its scorecard uses the same rank_key function with example releases. It favours cached, device-compatible files at 1080p or below, within the selected size target.

## Use

Created and verified through Studio in the 0.3.3 lab. These examples do not auto-install or change server configuration on upgrade.

From the repository root:

```sh
go run ./cmd/ether plugin check sdk/examples/travel-mode
go run ./cmd/ether plugin pack -o /tmp/travel-mode.etherpkg sdk/examples/travel-mode
```

Install the package in Server → Plugins, or copy these three files into a Studio draft. Review permissions and configure the installed plugin in Setup. The source and English strings are editable in Studio.


## Source: sdk/examples/travel-mode/manifest.json

``````
{
  "id": "community.travel.ranking",
  "name": "Travel Mode",
  "version": "1.0.2",
  "description": "A native ranking step for bandwidth-conscious playback, with a live scorecard.",
  "ether": {
    "protocol": 1,
    "kind": "extension",
    "capabilities": [
      "ranking_step",
``````

``````
export function rank_key(c:any,cfg:any={}):number{
 const ceiling=Math.max(480,Math.min(2160,Number(cfg.maxHeight)||1080));
 const budget=Math.max(1,Number(cfg.value??cfg.maxGB)||4)*1073741824;
 const height=parseInt(String(c.resolution||'0').replace(/[^0-9]/g,''),10)||0;
 const clientMax=Number(c.clientCaps?.maxHeight)||ceiling;
 let score=c.cached?300:0;
 if(height>Math.min(ceiling,clientMax))score-=10000;else if(height>0)score+=Math.min(height,1080);
 if(c.size>budget)score-=2000+Math.min(10000,Math.floor((c.size-budget)/1073741824)*100);else if(c.size>0)score+=Math.max(0,500-Math.floor(c.size/1073741824)*100);
 const codec=String(c.videoCodec||'').toLowerCase();const supports=(c.clientCaps?.codecs||[]).map((x:string)=>x.toLowerCase());
 if(codec&&supports.length&&!supports.includes(codec))score-=20000;
 if((c.languages||[]).some((x:string)=>x.toLowerCase()===(cfg.language||'en').toLowerCase()))score+=100;
 return Math.round(score);
}
const SAMPLES=[{name:'1080p cached · 2 GB',resolution:'1080p',size:2*1073741824,cached:true,languages:['en'],videoCodec:'h264'},{name:'720p cached · 1 GB',resolution:'720p',size:1073741824,cached:true,languages:['en'],videoCodec:'h264'},{name:'4K remux · 55 GB',resolution:'2160p',size:55*1073741824,cached:true,languages:['en'],videoCodec:'hevc'}];
export function handle(req:any){
 if(req.path==='/ether/configure')return {status:200,body:{errors:{}}};
 if(req.path==='/ether/health')return {status:200,body:{status:'ok'}};
 if(req.path==='/ether/view/scorecard')return {status:200,body:{title:'Travel Mode',spec:{specVersion:1,layout:'detail',header:[{kind:'page-header',title:{$:'title'},description:{$:'subtitle'}}],body:[{kind:'panel',title:'$t:samples',blocks:[{kind:'text',content:'$t:sample_hint'},{kind:'repeat',items:{$:'scores'},itemKey:{$:'name'},blocks:[{kind:'stat-tile',iconKey:'gauge',accent:'primary',label:{$:'name'},value:{$:'score'}}]}]}]},data:{title:'Travel Mode',subtitle:'Adds a ranking step in Quality with a selectable file-size target. Defaults: 1080p, 4 GB and English audio. This scorecard shows the default settings.',scores:SAMPLES.map(c=>({name:c.name,score:String(rank_key(c))}))}}};
 return {status:404,body:{error:{code:'not_found',message:'Route not found.'}}};
}
``````

# TVmaze Native Catalog

Independent TVmaze show metadata, an acclaimed-series list and a Canadian-airing list. The page publishes a 30-show collection by default. Data is attributed to TVmaze under CC BY-SA; Ether matches external IDs to its canonical catalogue.

## Use

Created and verified through Studio in the 0.3.3 lab. These examples do not auto-install or change server configuration on upgrade.

From the repository root:

```sh
go run ./cmd/ether plugin check sdk/examples/tvmaze
go run ./cmd/ether plugin pack -o /tmp/tvmaze.etherpkg sdk/examples/tvmaze
```

Install the package in Server → Plugins, or copy these three files into a Studio draft. Review permissions and configure the installed plugin in Setup. The source and English strings are editable in Studio.

``````
const API='https://api.tvmaze.com';
function ok(body:any){return {status:200,body};}
function fetchJSON(path:string){const r=ether.http.fetch({url:API+path});if(r.status!==200)throw new Error('TVmaze returned HTTP '+r.status);return typeof r.body==='string'?JSON.parse(r.body):r.body;}
function remember(s:any){ether.kv.put('show:'+s.id,JSON.stringify({at:Date.now(),show:s}));return s;}
function shows(kind:string){let stage='settings';try{
 const max=Math.max(10,Math.min(100,Number(ether.settings.get().maxItems||30)));
 stage='date';const date=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10), key='list:'+kind+':'+(kind==='canada'?date:max);
 stage='cache';const raw=ether.kv.get(key);if(raw){const v=JSON.parse(raw);if(Date.now()-v.at<3600000)return v.shows;}
 stage='fetch';let list:any[];
 if(kind==='canada') {const seen:any={};list=fetchJSON('/schedule?country=CA&date='+date).map((x:any)=>x.show).filter((s:any)=>s&&!seen[s.id]&&(seen[s.id]=true));}
 else {const fetched=fetchJSON('/shows?page=0');if(!Array.isArray(fetched))throw new Error('Expected array: '+JSON.stringify(fetched).slice(0,140));stage='filter';list=fetched.filter((s:any)=>s.externals?.imdb&&(s.rating?.average||0)>=7.5).sort((a:any,b:any)=>(b.rating?.average||0)-(a.rating?.average||0));}
 stage='remember';list=list.slice(0,max).map(remember);ether.kv.put(key,JSON.stringify({at:Date.now(),shows:list}));return list;
}catch(e){throw new Error(stage+': '+e.message);}
}
function resolve(id:string){if(!/^tvmaze:[0-9]+$/.test(id))throw new Error('Expected a TVmaze show identity');const n=id.slice(7),raw=ether.kv.get('show:'+n);if(raw){const c=JSON.parse(raw);if(Date.now()-c.at<86400000)return c.show;}return remember(fetchJSON('/shows/'+n));}
export function handle(req:any){
 if(req.path==='/ether/configure'){const n=Number(req.body?.maxItems??30);return ok({errors:Number.isInteger(n)&&n>=10&&n<=100?{}:{maxItems:'Choose a whole number from 10 to 100.'}});}
 if(req.path==='/ether/health')return ok({status:'ok'});
 if(req.path==='/ether/test'){const s=fetchJSON('/shows/1');return ok({ok:!!s.id,message:'TVmaze public API connected: '+s.name});}
 if(req.path.startsWith('/catalog/')){const list=shows(req.path.includes('/canada')?'canada':'acclaimed');return ok({metas:list.map((s:any)=>({id:'tvmaze:'+s.id,type:'series',name:s.name,poster:s.image?.medium,description:(s.summary||'').replace(/<[^>]*>/g,''),year:Number((s.premiered||'').slice(0,4)),imdb_id:s.externals?.imdb,tvdb_id:s.externals?.thetvdb}))});}
 if(req.path==='/ether/metadata/resolve'){const s=resolve(req.body.id);const title:any={type:'show',title:s.name,ids:{imdb:s.externals?.imdb||'',tvdb:s.externals?.thetvdb||0},summary:(s.summary||'').replace(/<[^>]*>/g,''),year:Number((s.premiered||'').slice(0,4)),genres:s.genres||[],rating:s.rating?.average||0,posterPath:s.image?.original||'',runtime:(s.averageRuntime||s.runtime||0)*60000000000,status:s.status};if(s.premiered)title.released=s.premiered+'T00:00:00Z';return ok({title});}
 if(req.path==='/ether/action/publish'){ether.collections.upsert({id:'tvmaze-acclaimed',name:'TVmaze acclaimed series',description:'A TVmaze-powered shelf. Show data: TVmaze, CC BY-SA. https://www.tvmaze.com',mediaType:'show',sources:[{kind:'plugin:community.tvmaze.catalog/acclaimed',maxItems:Number(ether.settings.get().maxItems||30)}],match:'all',rules:[],exclude:[],sort:'source',limit:100,refresh:'daily',enabled:true,browseInApps:true});return ok({toast:'TVmaze acclaimed series published.',refresh:true});}
 if(req.path==='/ether/view/catalog')return ok({title:'TVmaze Native Catalog',spec:{specVersion:1,layout:'detail',header:[{kind:'page-header',title:{$:'title'},description:{$:'subtitle'}}],body:[{kind:'stat-tile',iconKey:'tv',accent:'primary',label:'$t:count',value:{$:'count'}},{kind:'stat-tile',iconKey:'database',accent:'primary',label:'$t:source',value:'$t:provider'},{kind:'panel',title:'$t:publish',blocks:[{kind:'widget',widget:'ether.actionButton',props:{label:'$t:sync',action:'publish'}}]}]},data:{title:'TVmaze Native Catalog',subtitle:'Show data from TVmaze (CC BY-SA, tvmaze.com). Supplies independent metadata plus acclaimed-series and Canadian-airing lists. Ether matches external IDs to its canonical catalogue.',count:String(shows('acclaimed').length)}});
``````

## Source: sdk/go/README.md

# `etherplugin` (Go SDK)

Go authoring package (`github.com/braedonsaunders/ether/sdk/go`) for Ether Plugin Protocol v1 (EPP/1).

## Execution modes

1. **Native HTTP or WebSocket tunnel sidecar (`ether.runtime.kind: "remote"`)**:
   Compile a standard Go binary and call `p.Serve(ctx, etherplugin.ServeOptions{})` (or mount `p` as an `http.Handler`). Host calls go over HTTP to `/ether/plugin-host/*` authenticated with `X-Ether-Plugin-Credential`.
2. **Hosted WebAssembly guest**: not yet supported. Go 1.27.3 `GOOS=wasip1 GOARCH=wasm` emits `wasi_snapshot_preview1` imports (including `proc_exit`, `clock_time_get`, and `fd_write`), which the runtime forbids. TinyGo is not installed here, so a compatible TinyGo build has not been verified. Use a sidecar until a guest is built and tested against Ether's raw WASM ABI.

## Usage

```go
package main

import (
	"context"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"

	etherplugin "github.com/braedonsaunders/ether/sdk/go"
)

func main() {
	p := etherplugin.New(etherplugin.Definition{
		Manifest: etherplugin.Manifest{
			ID:      "org.ether.examples.hello",
			Name:    "Hello plugin",
			Version: "0.1.0",
			Ether: &etherplugin.EtherManifestBlock{
				Protocol:     1,
				Kind:         etherplugin.KindExtension,
				Capabilities: []etherplugin.Capability{etherplugin.CapListSource, etherplugin.CapUI},
				Summary:      "Minimal greeting plugin for Ether.",
				Runtime:      etherplugin.RuntimeDecl{Kind: "remote"},
			},
		},
		Routes: etherplugin.Routes{
			Catalog: func(ctx *etherplugin.Context, req etherplugin.CatalogRequest) (etherplugin.CatalogResponse, error) {
				return etherplugin.CatalogResponse{
					Metas: []etherplugin.CatalogItem{{
						ID:          "tt0133093",
						Type:        req.Type,
						Name:        "Hello from " + req.ID,
						ReleaseInfo: "1999",
					}},
				}, nil
			},
		},
	})

	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()
	_ = p.Serve(ctx, etherplugin.ServeOptions{})
}
```

## Flows: events and actions

Declare `CapEvents` with `Contributes.Events.Publish` to emit schema-validated custom events to Ether Flows via `ctx.PublishEvent(key, payload, correlation)` (remote `POST /ether/plugin-host/events/publish`, rate-limited to 30/min). Declare `CapFlowActions` with `Contributes.FlowActions` and implement `Routes.FlowAction` to handle `POST /ether/v1/flow-actions/{key}` (or a custom declared `/ether/...` route); `FlowActionRequest.IdempotencyKey` carries `X-Ether-Idempotency-Key` for safe deduplication and `FlowActionRequest.DryRun` indicates a test/dry run.

## Debrid cache hints

Declare `CapDebridCacheHints` and implement `Routes.DebridCacheHints` to answer `POST /ether/debrid/hints` with the listed torrents a debrid service holds (`DebridCacheHintsResponse.Cached`, info hash to provider kinds). Ether calls it only on a viewer's Play, under a 500 ms deadline; see `docs/plugin-debrid.md`.

## WS8b interoperability test

Once `internal/plugins/remote` is present, run
`go test -tags ws8b ./sdk/examples/hello/go -run TestWS8bSDKInterop`.
It starts Ether's tunnel server and exercises the Go, Python, and TypeScript
hello sidecars. It requires Python 3 and a Node version with TypeScript support
and WebSocket. The Go SDK reconnects automatically after a dropped tunnel.

## Tunnel recovery

`Start(ctx, ServeOptions{Mode: "tunnel", ...})` returns after the initial
credential authentication and hello/welcome handshake; initial failures are
returned to the caller. After that, dropped connections retry serially with
jittered exponential backoff (50–100 ms initially, capped at 5–10 seconds).
Every attempt re-authenticates and repeats the handshake, with a 10-second
connection/handshake timeout. A connection stable for a minute resets backoff.

In-flight calls fail on disconnect and are not replayed. Ether runtimes resolve
the current connection for subsequent calls. `handle.Done` stays open during
recovery; cancelling `ctx` or calling `handle.Close()` stops active I/O and any
retry, closes the socket, and closes `Done`. `Close` is safe to call repeatedly.
Request cancellation stops that handler without closing the shared tunnel.

## Sidecars

A sidecar is a remote plugin whose program runs on a machine you choose and
dials out to Ether over the `ether-tunnel-v1` WebSocket. It needs no inbound
port. Use one when the program must reach a local network, a USB device, or an
installed tool that Ether's sandbox cannot.

Set `ETHER_URL` and pair once:

```sh
ETHER_URL=https://ether.example.com \
ETHER_PLUGIN_STATE_DIR=/data \
ETHER_PAIRING_CODE=PAIR-1234 \
./my-sidecar
```

The SDK exchanges the code once, saves the credential, and derives the tunnel
URL from `ETHER_URL`. Create the code in Ether under Plugins › your plugin ›
Connect a sidecar; it is valid for 5 minutes and single use. On later restarts
the saved credential is reused, so no new code is needed.

- `ETHER_URL` — the server's `http(s)` base. The pair URL and the `ws(s)` tunnel
  URL are derived from it.
- `ETHER_PLUGIN_CREDENTIAL` — an explicit credential; always wins.
- `ETHER_PLUGIN_STATE_DIR` — where the credential is saved, else `/data` when it
  exists and is writable (a Docker volume), else the OS user config directory
  `…/ether-plugins/<plugin id>/`.
- `ETHER_PAIRING_CODE` — a one-time code.

The credential is saved at `<state dir>/credential` (mode `0600`, directory
`0700`) as JSON with the Ether URL it belongs to. If the tunnel rejects a saved
credential, the file is deleted and startup fails with one line instead of
reconnecting forever.

A Dockerfile that keeps the credential across restarts:

```dockerfile
FROM golang:1.27 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY . .
RUN go build -o /out/sidecar ./cmd/sidecar

FROM gcr.io/distroless/static
COPY --from=build /out/sidecar /sidecar
VOLUME /data
ENV ETHER_PLUGIN_STATE_DIR=/data
ENTRYPOINT ["/sidecar"]
```

Declare how the console runs it with an `ether.sidecar` manifest block:

```json
"ether": {
  "runtime": { "kind": "remote" },
  "sidecar": {
    "docker": "ghcr.io/you/my-sidecar:1.0.0",
    "docs": "https://example.com/my-sidecar"
  }
}
```

`docker` is an image reference; `download` (an https URL) with `command` (a
single line) is the alternative; `docs` adds a setup link. With a Docker image
the console shows a ready `docker run` command, mounting `-v ether-<id>:/data`
so the saved credential survives a restart.

## Source: sdk/go/data_host.go#*RemoteHostClient.CachePutWithOptions

``````
func (c *RemoteHostClient) CachePutWithOptions(ctx context.Context, libraryKey, name string, data []byte, opts CachePutOptions) (string, error) {
	var payload any
	if opts.FromBlob == "" || data != nil {
		payload = map[string]string{"bodyBase64": base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(data)}
	}
	var out struct {
		Blob string `json:"blob"`
	}
	_, err := c.callJSON(ctx, http.MethodPost, "/ether/plugin-host/data/cache.put", []any{libraryKey, name, payload, opts}, &out, false)
	return out.Blob, err
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/data_host.go#*RemoteHostClient.CacheStat

``````
func (c *RemoteHostClient) CacheStat(ctx context.Context, blob string) (CacheStatResult, error) {
	var out CacheStatResult
	headers := map[string]string{}
	if token, ok := ViewerTokenFromContext(ctx); ok {
		headers[HeaderViewerToken] = token
	}
	_, err := c.callJSONWithHeaders(ctx, http.MethodPost, "/ether/plugin-host/data/cache.stat", headers, []any{blob}, &out, false)
	return out, err
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/data_host.go#FetchCacheRequest

``````
// FetchCacheRequest streams a remote GET response into the plugin's own
// library blob cache. TimeoutMS defaults to 10 minutes (which is also the
// ceiling on viewer and interactive request paths); in a job, schedule, or
// background context TimeoutMS may extend up to the calling job's remaining
// deadline. Setting Resume to true continues an incomplete partial download
// using Range: bytes=<cached>- when the server supports ranges and ETag or
// Last-Modified validators still match, restarting cleanly from byte 0 if they
// do not; the blob becomes readable in cache only once complete. Connections
// defaults to 1. Jobs, schedules, and background calls can request up to 6
// concurrent ranges, sharing the host's limit of 6 per origin. Resume
// preserves each range's progress when parallel ranges are in use.
type FetchCacheRequest struct {
	TimeoutMS             int64             `json:"timeoutMs,omitempty"`
	URL                   string            `json:"url"`
	Headers               map[string]string `json:"headers,omitempty"`
	KeepHeadersOnRedirect []string          `json:"keepHeadersOnRedirect,omitempty"`
	LibraryKey            string            `json:"libraryKey"`
	Name                  string            `json:"name"`
	Resume                bool              `json:"resume,omitempty"`
	Connections           int               `json:"connections,omitempty"`
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/data_host.go#checkDataRange

``````
func checkDataRange(r DataRange) error {
	if r.Offset < 0 || r.Offset > 1<<60 || r.Length <= 0 || r.Length > MaxDataReadBytes {
		return fmt.Errorf("data range needs nonnegative offset and length 1..%d", MaxDataReadBytes)
	}
	return nil
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/data_host.go#*RemoteHostClient.CacheRead

``````
func (c *RemoteHostClient) CacheRead(ctx context.Context, blob string, r DataRange) ([]byte, error) {
	if err := checkDataRange(r); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return c.dataRead(ctx, "cache.read", []any{blob, r})
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/data_host.go#*RemoteHostClient.ArchiveOpen

``````
// ArchiveOpen reads a bounded uncompressed ZIP, 7z or RAR member range.
// Compressed reads restart at the member or solid block beginning per call.
// Prefer large sequential chunks; decoder work and memory obey host grants.
func (c *RemoteHostClient) ArchiveOpen(ctx context.Context, blob string, member int, r DataRange) ([]byte, error) {
	if err := checkDataRange(r); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return c.dataRead(ctx, "archive.open", []any{blob, member, r})
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/data_host.go#*RemoteHostClient.ArchiveRead

``````
// ArchiveRead reads 1..4096 bounded archive member ranges in one host call
// while keeping the sum of requested lengths within the plugin's readBytes grant.
func (c *RemoteHostClient) ArchiveRead(ctx context.Context, blob string, reads []ArchiveReadItem) ([]ArchiveReadResult, error) {
	if len(reads) == 0 || len(reads) > MaxArchiveReadItems {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive.read takes 1..%d reads", MaxArchiveReadItems)
	}
	var total int64
	for _, item := range reads {
		if item.Member < 0 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive.read member index must be nonnegative")
		}
		if err := checkDataRange(DataRange{Offset: item.Offset, Length: item.Length}); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if item.Length > MaxDataReadBytes-total {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive.read requested bytes exceed maximum readBytes ceiling (%d)", MaxDataReadBytes)
		}
		total += item.Length
	}
	var wire []struct {
		Index      int    `json:"index"`
		Member     int    `json:"member"`
		Size       int    `json:"size"`
		BodyBase64 string `json:"bodyBase64"`
	}
	if err := c.dataCall(ctx, "archive.read", []any{blob, reads}, &wire); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out := make([]ArchiveReadResult, len(wire))
	for i, w := range wire {
		body, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(w.BodyBase64)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		out[i] = ArchiveReadResult{Index: w.Index, Member: w.Member, Size: w.Size, Body: body}
	}
	return out, nil
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/data_host.go#*RemoteHostClient.CacheRasterize

``````
// CacheRasterize rasterises an SVG already in the plugin's blob cache into
// a new cached bitmap blob under libraryKey/name, using Ether's bounded SVG
// rasteriser (source and output sizes are host-bounded, unsafe documents
// are refused, and rendered variants are cached host-side).
func (c *RemoteHostClient) CacheRasterize(ctx context.Context, libraryKey, name, blob string, opts RasterizeOptions) (RasterizeResult, error) {
	if opts.Width < 0 || opts.Width > 2048 || opts.Height < 0 || opts.Height > 2048 {
		return RasterizeResult{}, fmt.Errorf("cache.rasterize width and height must be within 0..2048")
	}
	if opts.Format != "" && opts.Format != "png" && opts.Format != "jpeg" {
		return RasterizeResult{}, fmt.Errorf("cache.rasterize format must be png or jpeg")
	}
	args := []any{libraryKey, name, blob}
	if opts != (RasterizeOptions{}) {
		args = append(args, opts)
	}
	var out RasterizeResult
	err := c.dataCall(ctx, "cache.rasterize", args, &out)
	return out, err
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/data_host.go#*RemoteHostClient.ArchiveExtract

``````
// ArchiveExtract streams an uncompressed ZIP, 7z or RAR member straight into
// the plugin's own library blob cache in one pass and returns its blob ref and
// SHA-1/MD5/CRC32 digests without buffering the member in plugin memory.
func (c *RemoteHostClient) ArchiveExtract(ctx context.Context, blob string, member int, opts ...ArchiveExtractOptions) (ArchiveExtractResult, error) {
	args := []any{blob, member}
	if len(opts) > 0 && (opts[0].LibraryKey != "" || opts[0].Name != "") {
		args = append(args, opts[0])
	}
	var out ArchiveExtractResult
	err := c.dataCall(ctx, "archive.extract", args, &out)
	return out, err
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#AICompleteRequest

``````
// AICompleteRequest configures one completion on the owner's configured
// language model (#669).
type AICompleteRequest struct {
	Messages []AIMessage `json:"messages"`
	// Schema is an optional JSON Schema object (raw JSON or map[string]any
	// marshalled to JSON). When set, Ether extracts JSON from the model reply
	// and validates it against Schema before returning. External $ref URLs are
	// rejected.
	Schema json.RawMessage `json:"schema,omitempty"`
	// MaxTokens bounds output tokens (default 1024, max 4096).
	MaxTokens int `json:"maxTokens,omitempty"`
	// Temperature optionally adjusts sampling in [0, 2]; ignored safely by
	// providers/models that disallow explicit temperature.
	Temperature *float64 `json:"temperature,omitempty"`
	// TimeoutMS optionally tightens the call timeout (clamped to 30000 ms on
	// background/action routes, 20000 ms on interactive search routes, and the
	// enclosing call deadline).
	TimeoutMS int64 `json:"timeoutMs,omitempty"`
	// SearchQuery identifies the viewer's search text when calling ai.complete
	// on an interactive search route under permissions.ai: "complete+search".
	// Required on adapter search routes without a URL query param (e.g. GraphQL)
	// and used for normalized per-query caching.
	SearchQuery string `json:"searchQuery,omitempty"`
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#WithViewerToken

``````
// WithViewerToken attaches the host-minted X-Ether-Viewer-Token from an
// incoming frontend adapter request onto ctx so KindVisible and KindBrowse
// authenticate as that request's viewer without passing a viewer ID (#615).
func WithViewerToken(ctx context.Context, token string) context.Context {
	token = strings.TrimSpace(token)
	if token == "" {
		return ctx
	}
	return context.WithValue(ctx, viewerTokenContextKey{}, token)
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#ViewerTokenFromContext

``````
// ViewerTokenFromContext returns the adapter viewer token attached by
// WithViewerToken (or automatically during FrontendAdapter dispatch).
func ViewerTokenFromContext(ctx context.Context) (string, bool) {
	if ctx == nil {
		return "", false
	}
	tok, ok := ctx.Value(viewerTokenContextKey{}).(string)
	return tok, ok && tok != ""
}
``````

``````
// RemoteHostClient implements Host by calling `/ether/plugin-host/*` on the
// Ether server authenticated with `X-Ether-Plugin-Credential`.
type RemoteHostClient struct {

	credential string
	client     *http.Client
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#NewRemoteHostClient

``````
// NewRemoteHostClient creates a RemoteHostClient.
func NewRemoteHostClient(opts RemoteHostOptions) *RemoteHostClient {
	base := opts.BaseURL
	if base == "" {
		base = os.Getenv("ETHER_HOST_URL")
	}
	if base == "" {
		base = "http://127.0.0.1:32450"
	}
	base = strings.TrimRight(base, "/")

	cred := opts.Credential
	if cred == "" {
		cred = os.Getenv("ETHER_PLUGIN_CREDENTIAL")
	}

	hc := opts.HTTPClient
	if hc == nil {
		hc = http.DefaultClient
	}
	return &RemoteHostClient{
		baseURL:    base,
		credential: cred,
		client:     hc,
	}
}
``````

``````
// SettingsGet reads the current non-secret settings from Ether.
func (c *RemoteHostClient) SettingsGet(ctx context.Context) (map[string]any, error) {
	var result struct {
		Settings map[string]any `json:"settings"`
	}
	_, err := c.callJSON(ctx, http.MethodGet, "/ether/plugin-host/settings", nil, &result, false)
	return result.Settings, err
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#*RemoteHostClient.callJSON

``````
func (c *RemoteHostClient) callJSON(
	ctx context.Context,
	method, path string,
	in any,
	out any,
	allow404 bool,
) (bool, error) {
	return c.callJSONWithHeaders(ctx, method, path, nil, in, out, allow404)
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#*RemoteHostClient.callJSONWithHeaders

``````
func (c *RemoteHostClient) callJSONWithHeaders(
	ctx context.Context,
	method, path string,
	extraHeaders map[string]string,
	in any,
	out any,
	allow404 bool,
) (bool, error) {
	var bodyReader io.Reader
	if in != nil {
		b, err := json.Marshal(in)
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		bodyReader = bytes.NewReader(b)
	}
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, c.baseURL+path, bodyReader)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	req.Header.Set("X-Ether-Plugin-Credential", c.credential)
	req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	if in != nil {
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	}
	for k, v := range extraHeaders {
		if v != "" {
			req.Header.Set(k, v)
		}
	}
	resp, err := c.client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close() //nolint:errcheck

	raw, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, (MaxDataReadBytes+2)/3*4+(4<<20)))
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if allow404 && resp.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return false, nil
	}
	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		var errDoc struct {
			Error struct {
				Code          string `json:"code"`
				Message       string `json:"message"`
				RetryAfterSec int64  `json:"retryAfterSec"`
				RetryAt       string `json:"retryAt"`
			} `json:"error"`
		}
		retryAfterSec := int64(0)
		if hdr := strings.TrimSpace(resp.Header.Get("Retry-After")); hdr != "" {
			if n, perr := strconv.ParseInt(hdr, 10, 64); perr == nil && n > 0 {
				retryAfterSec = n
			}
		}
		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &errDoc) == nil && (errDoc.Error.Message != "" || errDoc.Error.Code != "") {
			msg := errDoc.Error.Message
			if msg == "" {
				msg = fmt.Sprintf("host call %s %s failed with status %d", method, path, resp.StatusCode)
			}
			if errDoc.Error.RetryAfterSec > 0 {
				retryAfterSec = errDoc.Error.RetryAfterSec
			}
			return false, &HostError{
				Status:        resp.StatusCode,
				Code:          errDoc.Error.Code,
				Message:       msg,
				RetryAfterSec: retryAfterSec,
				RetryAt:       errDoc.Error.RetryAt,
			}
		}
		return false, &HostError{
			Status:        resp.StatusCode,
			Message:       fmt.Sprintf("host call %s %s failed with status %d", method, path, resp.StatusCode),
			RetryAfterSec: retryAfterSec,
		}
	}
	if out != nil && len(raw) > 0 {
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, out); err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
	}
	return true, nil
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#*RemoteHostClient.KVGet

``````
// KVGet reads a key from the plugin's KV namespace.
func (c *RemoteHostClient) KVGet(ctx context.Context, key string) (string, bool, error) {
	var res struct {
		Key   string `json:"key"`
		Value string `json:"value"`
	}
	found, err := c.callJSON(ctx, http.MethodGet, "/ether/plugin-host/kv/"+url.PathEscape(key), nil, &res, true)
	if err != nil || !found {

	}

}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#*RemoteHostClient.Fetch

``````
// Fetch performs an outbound HTTP request.
func (c *RemoteHostClient) Fetch(ctx context.Context, r HostFetchRequest) (HostFetchResponse, error) {
	if r.TimeoutMS > 0 {
		var cancel context.CancelFunc
		ctx, cancel = context.WithTimeout(ctx, time.Duration(min(r.TimeoutMS, int64(86400000)))*time.Millisecond)
		defer cancel()
	}
	method := r.Method
	if method == "" {
		method = http.MethodGet
	}
	var bodyReader io.Reader
	if r.Body != "" {
		bodyReader = strings.NewReader(r.Body)
	}
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, r.URL, bodyReader)
	if err != nil {
		return HostFetchResponse{}, err
	}
	for k, v := range r.Headers {
		req.Header.Set(k, v)
	}
	resp, err := c.client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return HostFetchResponse{}, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close() //nolint:errcheck
	raw, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 8<<20))
	if err != nil {
		return HostFetchResponse{}, err
	}
	hdrs := map[string]string{}
	for k, vals := range resp.Header {
		if len(vals) > 0 {
			hdrs[strings.ToLower(k)] = vals[0]
		}
	}
	return HostFetchResponse{
		Status:  resp.StatusCode,
		Headers: hdrs,
		Body:    string(raw),
	}, nil
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#*RemoteHostClient.FetchMany

``````
// FetchMany runs up to MaxFetchManyRequests outbound HTTP calls concurrently
// (bounded to MaxFetchManyConcurrency per batch and DefaultMaxFetchPerHost per
// origin), returning ordered results with per-item error isolation.
func (c *RemoteHostClient) FetchMany(ctx context.Context, reqs []HostFetchRequest, opts ...HostFetchManyOptions) ([]HostFetchManyResult, error) {
	var opt HostFetchManyOptions
	if len(opts) > 0 {
		opt = opts[0]
	}
	return runSDKFetchMany(ctx, reqs, opt, c.Fetch)
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#sdkFetchOriginKey

``````
func sdkFetchOriginKey(rawURL string) string {
	u, err := url.Parse(strings.TrimSpace(rawURL))
	if err != nil || u.Host == "" {
		return ""
	}
	scheme := strings.ToLower(u.Scheme)
	if scheme != "http" && scheme != "https" {
		return ""
	}
	host := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.ToLower(u.Hostname()), ".")
	if host == "" {
		return ""
	}
	port := u.Port()
	if port == "" {
		if scheme == "https" {
			port = "443"
		} else {
			port = "80"
		}
	}
	return scheme + "://" + net.JoinHostPort(host, port)
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#runSDKFetchMany

``````
func runSDKFetchMany(
	ctx context.Context,
	reqs []HostFetchRequest,
	opts HostFetchManyOptions,
	doOne func(context.Context, HostFetchRequest) (HostFetchResponse, error),
) ([]HostFetchManyResult, error) {
	if len(reqs) > MaxFetchManyRequests {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("http.fetchMany accepts at most %d requests per call", MaxFetchManyRequests)
	}
	if opts.Concurrency < 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("http.fetchMany concurrency must be a non-negative integer")
	}
	if len(reqs) == 0 {
		return []HostFetchManyResult{}, nil
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	concurrency := opts.Concurrency
	if concurrency <= 0 {
		concurrency = DefaultFetchManyConcurrency
	}
	if concurrency > MaxFetchManyConcurrency {
		concurrency = MaxFetchManyConcurrency
	}
	if concurrency > len(reqs) {
		concurrency = len(reqs)
	}

	var keys []string
	buckets := make(map[string][]int)
	for i, req := range reqs {
		k := sdkFetchOriginKey(req.URL)
		if _, ok := buckets[k]; !ok {
			keys = append(keys, k)
		}
		buckets[k] = append(buckets[k], i)
	}
	jobs := make(chan int, len(reqs))
	emitted := 0
	for emitted < len(reqs) {
		for _, k := range keys {
			q := buckets[k]
			if len(q) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			jobs <- q[0]
			buckets[k] = q[1:]
			emitted++
		}
	}
	close(jobs)

	var gateMu sync.Mutex
	gates := make(map[string]chan struct{})
	acquireOrigin := func(c context.Context, rawURL string) (func(), error) {
		k := sdkFetchOriginKey(rawURL)
		if k == "" {
			return func() {}, nil
		}
		gateMu.Lock()
		sem, ok := gates[k]
		if !ok {
			sem = make(chan struct{}, DefaultMaxFetchPerHost)
			gates[k] = sem
		}
		gateMu.Unlock()
		select {
		case sem <- struct{}{}:
			return func() { <-sem }, nil
		case <-c.Done():
			return nil, c.Err()
		}
	}

	results := make([]HostFetchManyResult, len(reqs))
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	for range concurrency {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			for idx := range jobs {
				if ctx.Err() != nil {
					return
				}
				release, aerr := acquireOrigin(ctx, reqs[idx].URL)
				if aerr != nil {
					return
				}
				resp, err := doOne(ctx, reqs[idx])
				release()
				if err != nil {
					if ctx.Err() != nil {
						return
					}
					code := "host_error"
					if errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
						code = "timeout"
					}
					results[idx] = HostFetchManyResult{Error: &HostFetchError{Code: code, Message: err.Error()}}
					continue
				}
				results[idx] = HostFetchManyResult{
					Status:     resp.Status,
					Headers:    resp.Headers,
					Body:       resp.Body,
					BodyBase64: resp.BodyBase64,
				}
			}
		}()
	}
	wg.Wait()
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return results, nil
}
``````

``````
// KindVisible evaluates the library's Rules and viewer access policy for a
// bounded batch (at most MaxKindVisibleIDs) of external IDs in kindKey (#615).
// ctx must carry the incoming frontend adapter's X-Ether-Viewer-Token (via
// WithViewerToken, attached automatically by FrontendAdapter dispatch).
func (c *RemoteHostClient) KindVisible(ctx context.Context, kindKey string, ids []string) ([]string, error) {
	tok, ok := ViewerTokenFromContext(ctx)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("kinds.visible: no authenticated frontend adapter viewer token on context")
	}
	if len(ids) > MaxKindVisibleIDs {

		map[string]string{HeaderViewerToken: tok},
		map[string]any{"ids": ids},
		&out,
		false,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if out.IDs == nil {
		out.IDs = []string{}
	}
	return out.IDs, nil
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#*RemoteHostClient.CachePut

``````
// CachePut stores one blob in a kind library's cache; the ref is content-addressed.
func (c *RemoteHostClient) CachePut(ctx context.Context, libraryKey, name string, data []byte) (string, error) {
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost,
		c.baseURL+"/ether/plugin-host/cache/"+url.PathEscape(libraryKey)+"?name="+url.QueryEscape(name),
		bytes.NewReader(data))
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if c.credential != "" {
		req.Header.Set("X-Ether-Plugin-Credential", c.credential)
	}
	resp, err := c.client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 1<<20))
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("plugin-host cache put: status %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}
	var out struct {
		Blob string `json:"blob"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &out); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return out.Blob, nil
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#*RemoteHostClient.CacheOpen

``````
// CacheOpen reads one cached blob back.
func (c *RemoteHostClient) CacheOpen(ctx context.Context, blobRef string) ([]byte, error) {
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet,
		c.baseURL+"/ether/plugin-host/cache/"+strings.TrimPrefix(blobRef, "/"), nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if c.credential != "" {
		req.Header.Set("X-Ether-Plugin-Credential", c.credential)
	}
	resp, err := c.client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	if resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugin-host cache open: status %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}
	return io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
}
``````

``````
// CacheDelete removes one cached blob from this plugin's own library cache
// namespaces, freeing its quota immediately. Deleting an absent or already
// evicted ref succeeds.
func (c *RemoteHostClient) CacheDelete(ctx context.Context, blobRef string) error {
	_, err := c.callJSON(ctx, http.MethodDelete, "/ether/plugin-host/cache/"+url.PathEscape(blobRef), nil, nil, false)
	return err
}
``````

``````
// StreamPartURL mints a scoped stream ticket for one zero-based part of a
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#*RemoteHostClient.StreamURLWithOptions

``````
// StreamURLWithOptions mints a scoped stream ticket for one of this plugin's
// own kind items, optionally pinned to a zero-based part and/or resolver
// PlayableSource.ID (#576, #661) and optionally resolved to an absolute URL
// using the active request origin or the adapter's first published address (#772).
func (c *RemoteHostClient) StreamURLWithOptions(ctx context.Context, viewerID int64, itemRef string, opts StreamURLOptions) (string, error) {
	if opts.Wait != nil && opts.Wait.MaxSeconds <= 0 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("stream url: wait.maxSeconds must be a positive integer")
	}
	if opts.PartIndex != nil && *opts.PartIndex < 0 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("stream url: partIndex must be non-negative")
	}
	if opts.Fallback && opts.Source == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("stream url: fallback requires a source")
	}
	if opts.Source != "" && strings.TrimSpace(opts.Source) == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("stream url: source must not be blank")
	}
	payload := map[string]any{"viewerId": viewerID, "itemRef": itemRef}
	if opts.PartIndex != nil {
		payload["partIndex"] = *opts.PartIndex
	}
	if opts.Source != "" {
		payload["source"] = opts.Source
		if opts.Fallback {
			payload["fallback"] = true
		}
	}
	if opts.Absolute {
		payload["absolute"] = true
	}
	if opts.Wait != nil {
		payload["wait"] = opts.Wait
	}
	var headers map[string]string
	if tok, ok := ViewerTokenFromContext(ctx); ok && tok != "" {
		headers = map[string]string{HeaderViewerToken: tok}
	}
	var out struct {
		URL string `json:"url"`
	}
	_, err := c.callJSONWithHeaders(ctx, http.MethodPost, "/ether/plugin-host/frontend/stream-url", headers, payload, &out, false)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return out.URL, nil
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/i18n.go#LintCopy

``````
// LintCopy validates a user-visible string against Ether's copy rules.
// It returns an empty string when valid, or the plain reason when invalid.
func LintCopy(raw string, maxRunes int) string {
	s := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
	if maxRunes > 0 && utf8.RuneCountInString(s) > maxRunes {
		return fmt.Sprintf("is longer than %d characters", maxRunes)
	}
	if strings.ContainsAny(s, "—–") {
		return "must not contain em or en dashes"
	}
	if strings.Contains(s, "!") {
		return "must not contain exclamation marks"
	}
	if bannedCopyRE.MatchString(s) {
		return "must not use the words simply, just or easily"
	}
	for _, r := range s {
		if unicode.IsLetter(r) {
			if unicode.IsLower(r) {
				return "must use sentence case"
			}
			break
		}
	}
	words := strings.Fields(s)
	if len(words) >= 3 {
		caps := 0
		for _, w := range words {
			first, _ := utf8.DecodeRuneInString(w)
			if unicode.IsLetter(first) && unicode.IsUpper(first) {
				caps++
			}
		}
		if caps*3 > len(words)*2 {
			return "must use sentence case"
		}
	}
	return ""
}
``````

``````
// NewI18n creates a localization helper backed by a StringsCatalog.
func NewI18n(catalog StringsCatalog, defaultLocale string) *I18n {
	if defaultLocale == "" {
		defaultLocale = "en"
	}
	if catalog == nil {
		catalog = StringsCatalog{}
	}
	return &I18n{catalog: catalog, defaultLocale: defaultLocale}
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/i18n.go#*I18n.T

``````
// T resolves a key for the given locale and interpolates {param} placeholders.
func (i *I18n) T(rawKey string, params map[string]any, locale string) string {
	key := strings.TrimPrefix(rawKey, "$t:")
	if locale == "" {
		locale = i.defaultLocale
	}
	base := locale
	if idx := strings.IndexByte(locale, '-'); idx > 0 {
		base = locale[:idx]
	}
	var tmpl string
	found := false
	for _, cand := range []string{locale, base, "en"} {
		if cand == "" {
			continue
		}
		if tbl, ok := i.catalog[cand]; ok {
			if v, ok := tbl[key]; ok {
				tmpl = v
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
	}
	if !found {
		tmpl = key
	}
	if len(params) == 0 {
		return tmpl
	}
	return interpRE.ReplaceAllStringFunc(tmpl, func(match string) string {
		name := match[1 : len(match)-1]
		if v, ok := params[name]; ok && v != nil {
			return fmt.Sprint(v)
		}
		return match
	})
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/kinds.go#KindBrowseRequest

``````
// KindBrowseRequest is Ether's browse/search request for one kind level.
type KindBrowseRequest struct {
	Kind     string `json:"-"` // filled from the route, never on the wire
	ParentID string `json:"parentId,omitempty"`
	Level    string `json:"level,omitempty"`
	Cursor   string `json:"cursor,omitempty"`
	Limit    int    `json:"limit,omitempty"`
	Sort     string `json:"sort,omitempty"`
	Desc     bool   `json:"desc,omitempty"`
	// Facets requires any of the listed values per field; AllFacets
	// requires every listed value, ExcludeFacets drops items having any
	// listed value, and AnyGroups adds one OR-group per entry — either a
	// single {field, values} list or {any: [{field, values}, ...]} ORed
	// across fields (#767, #807). All four combine with AND.
	Facets        map[string][]string    `json:"facets,omitempty"`
	AllFacets     map[string][]string    `json:"allFacets,omitempty"`
	ExcludeFacets map[string][]string    `json:"excludeFacets,omitempty"`
	AnyGroups     []KindBrowseFacetGroup `json:"anyGroups,omitempty"`
	// Empty tests field presence or absence per field key (#807): true
	// keeps items with no value in the field, false keeps items with at
	// least one. Counts toward neither value bound; unknown fields are
	// rejected.
	Empty map[string]bool `json:"empty,omitempty"`
	Query string          `json:"query,omitempty"`
	// ExcludeQuery drops items whose indexed text matches, using the same
	// text matching as Query (#807).
	ExcludeQuery string `json:"excludeQuery,omitempty"`
	// Total controls whether kinds.browse computes KindPage.Total:
	// "" or "cheap" (default) returns Total only when O(1), "none" omits it,
	// and "exact" computes an exact Total (cached per library generation).
	Total string `json:"total,omitempty"`
}
``````

``````
// SourceQuery asks Ether to find sources (Host.ResolveSources).
type SourceQuery struct {
	Kind  string `json:"kind"` // indexer_search|indexer_search_results|indexer_search_cancel|indexers|debrid|debrid_check|debrid_acquire|release_files|usenet_check|nzb_request
	Query string `json:"query,omitempty"`
	// Category accepts comma-separated Newznab IDs or standard family names;
	// when set with an empty Query, indexer_search requests recent releases.
	// Source plugins that declared the category answer it too.
	Category string `json:"category,omitempty"`
	// Lookup (indexer_search with Category) adds a typed lookup, such as an
	// album by artist and title, for source plugins that declared its type.
	// Other indexers search Query alone.
	Lookup *SourceLookup `json:"lookup,omitempty"`
	// Profile names the quality profile to score video release names against
	// on indexer_search; empty uses the owner's default profile.
	Profile string `json:"profile,omitempty"`
	// Stream (indexer_search only), when true, starts the fan-out and returns
	// immediately with a SearchID handle to poll via indexer_search_results or
	// stop via indexer_search_cancel (#733).
	Stream bool `json:"stream,omitempty"`
	// SearchID identifies a streaming search started by indexer_search with
	// Stream: true; required on indexer_search_results and indexer_search_cancel.
	SearchID string `json:"searchId,omitempty"`
	// WaitMS (indexer_search_results only) sets how long in milliseconds to
	// wait for at least one new arrival or search completion (capped at
	// 10000 ms; 0 returns immediately).
	WaitMS int `json:"waitMs,omitempty"`
	// FirstResults (indexer_search only), when true, returns as soon as the
	// fastest indexers produce results plus SettleMS (default 250 ms), while
	// slower indexers keep populating Ether's search cache in the background (#733).
	FirstResults bool `json:"firstResults,omitempty"`
	// SettleMS (indexer_search only) sets the post-first-result grace window in
	// milliseconds (nil uses 250 ms when FirstResults is true; 0 returns
	// immediately). Also applies when MinResults is met if explicitly set.
	// Capped at 30000 ms.
	SettleMS *int `json:"settleMs,omitempty"`
	// MinResults (indexer_search only) is the minimum deduplicated candidate
	// count required before returning early.
	MinResults int `json:"minResults,omitempty"`
	// SkipIndexers (indexer_search only) excludes matching indexer IDs or
	// display names (case-insensitive). Precedence over OnlyIndexers.
	SkipIndexers []string `json:"skipIndexers,omitempty"`
	// OnlyIndexers (indexer_search only) restricts the search to matching
	// indexer IDs or display names (case-insensitive).
	OnlyIndexers []string `json:"onlyIndexers,omitempty"`
	// TimeoutMS (indexer_search only) caps how long the call waits in
	// milliseconds, bounded by Ether's 30000 ms ceiling (and any shorter parent
	// request deadline). When shorter than the ceiling, slow indexers still
	// running in the background are reported as pending (and listed in Pending);
	// indexers that hit the ceiling are reported as timed_out.
	TimeoutMS  int      `json:"timeoutMs,omitempty"`
	InfoHashes []string `json:"infoHashes,omitempty"`
	InfoHash   string   `json:"infoHash,omitempty"`
	Magnet     string   `json:"magnet,omitempty"`
	// Deprecated: use TorrentRef for an Ether torrent descriptor reference.
	TorrentURL string `json:"torrentUrl,omitempty"`
	// Deprecated: use NZBRef. NZBURL also accepts legacy download links.
	NZBURL      string       `json:"nzbUrl,omitempty"`
	NZBRef      string       `json:"nzbRef,omitempty"`
	TorrentRef  string       `json:"torrentRef,omitempty"`
	NZBIdentity *NZBIdentity `json:"nzbIdentity,omitempty"`
``````

## Source: sdk/go/kinds.go#IndexerSearchStatus.MarshalJSON

``````
// MarshalJSON preserves ms:0 on search status entries (Status != "") while
// omitting status/results/ms/reason/error on kind:"indexers" entries (Status == "").
func (s IndexerSearchStatus) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	if s.Status == "" {
		type listing struct {
			IndexerID string `json:"indexerId"`
			Indexer   string `json:"indexer"`
			Kind      string `json:"kind,omitempty"`
			MedianMS  *int64 `json:"medianMs,omitempty"`
			LastMS    *int64 `json:"lastMs,omitempty"`
			LastError string `json:"lastError,omitempty"`
		}
		return json.Marshal(listing{
			IndexerID: s.IndexerID,
			Indexer:   s.Indexer,
			Kind:      s.Kind,
			MedianMS:  s.MedianMS,
			LastMS:    s.LastMS,
			LastError: s.LastError,
		})
	}
	type searchStatus struct {
		IndexerID string `json:"indexerId"`
		Indexer   string `json:"indexer"`
		Status    string `json:"status"`
		Results   int    `json:"results,omitempty"`
		MS        int64  `json:"ms"`
		Reason    string `json:"reason,omitempty"`
		Error     string `json:"error,omitempty"`
		Kind      string `json:"kind,omitempty"`
		MedianMS  *int64 `json:"medianMs,omitempty"`
		LastMS    *int64 `json:"lastMs,omitempty"`
		LastError string `json:"lastError,omitempty"`
	}
	return json.Marshal(searchStatus{
		IndexerID: s.IndexerID,
		Indexer:   s.Indexer,
		Status:    s.Status,
		Results:   s.Results,
		MS:        s.MS,
		Reason:    s.Reason,
		Error:     s.Error,
		Kind:      s.Kind,
		MedianMS:  s.MedianMS,
		LastMS:    s.LastMS,
		LastError: s.LastError,
	})
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/kinds.go#SourceResolveResult.MarshalJSON

``````
// MarshalJSON emits the debrid policy or the candidate response envelope.
func (r SourceResolveResult) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	if r.Enabled != nil {
		return json.Marshal(struct {
			Enabled    bool  `json:"enabled"`
			CachedOnly *bool `json:"cachedOnly"`
		}{Enabled: *r.Enabled, CachedOnly: r.CachedOnly})
	}
	cands := r.Candidates
	if cands == nil {
		cands = []SourceCandidate{}
	}
	wire := struct {
		Candidates []SourceCandidate      `json:"candidates"`
		CachedOnly *bool                  `json:"cachedOnly,omitempty"`
		Indexers   *[]IndexerSearchStatus `json:"indexers,omitempty"`
		Pending    *[]IndexerRef          `json:"pending,omitempty"`
		SearchID   string                 `json:"searchId,omitempty"`
		Done       *bool                  `json:"done,omitempty"`
	}{
		Candidates: cands,
		CachedOnly: r.CachedOnly,
		SearchID:   r.SearchID,
		Done:       r.Done,
	}
	if r.Indexers != nil {
		s := r.Indexers
		wire.Indexers = &s
	}
	if r.Pending != nil {
		s := r.Pending
		wire.Pending = &s
	}
	return json.Marshal(wire)
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/kinds.go#SourceCandidate

``````
// SourceCandidate is one Ether-found release for a resolver to rank.
// NZBRef and TorrentRef are opaque references returned by indexer search.
type SourceCandidate struct {
	InfoHash string `json:"infoHash,omitempty"`
	Magnet   string `json:"magnet,omitempty"`
	// Deprecated: TorrentURL carries an opaque ether-torrent: reference. Use TorrentRef.
	TorrentURL string `json:"torrentUrl,omitempty"`
	// Deprecated: NZBURL carries an opaque ether-nzb: reference. Use NZBRef.
	NZBURL     string `json:"nzbUrl,omitempty"`
	NZBRef     string `json:"nzbRef,omitempty"`
	TorrentRef string `json:"torrentRef,omitempty"`
	// FileIndex selects a zero-based entry in the torrent provider file list; nil uses video selection.
	FileIndex *int   `json:"fileIndex,omitempty"`
	Title     string `json:"title,omitempty"`
	Size      int64  `json:"size,omitempty"`
	Seeders   int    `json:"seeders,omitempty"`
	Cached    bool   `json:"cached,omitempty"`
	// CachedBy lists the configured debrid services holding this torrent in
	// acquisition order (or the service that served debrid_acquire); omitted when uncached.
	CachedBy  []DebridServiceRef `json:"cachedBy,omitempty"`
	Indexer   string             `json:"indexer,omitempty"`
	IndexerID string             `json:"indexerId,omitempty"`
	// Score, Resolution, Source and Codec are populated on indexer_search
	// candidates whose release name identifies video; non-video candidates
	// leave them empty.
	Score      *int   `json:"score,omitempty"`
	Resolution int    `json:"resolution,omitempty"`
	Source     string `json:"source,omitempty"`
	Codec      string `json:"codec,omitempty"`
	// Files is populated by release_files or nzb_request.
	Files []ReleaseFile `json:"files,omitempty"`
	// FileCount is the torrent's known file count when reported by an indexer
	// or release_files query.
	FileCount int `json:"fileCount,omitempty"`
	// UsenetCheck is populated only by a usenet_check query.
	UsenetCheck *UsenetCheckResult `json:"usenetCheck,omitempty"`
	// PluginRelease names a release a source plugin answered for a declared
	// category search. It has no infoHash or nzbUrl: hand the candidate back
	// to release_files to list its files and in a release source to open it.
	PluginRelease *PluginReleaseRef `json:"pluginRelease,omitempty"`

	// Ref names this candidate in match scores. Ether derives it from the
	// infohash/NZB when empty; matchers echo it verbatim.
	Ref string `json:"-"`
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/kinds.go#SourceCandidate.CandidateRef

``````
// CandidateRef returns the stable ref matchers report for a candidate.
func (c SourceCandidate) CandidateRef() string {
	switch {
	case c.Ref != "":
		return c.Ref
	case c.InfoHash != "":
		return "infohash:" + strings.ToLower(c.InfoHash)
	case c.Magnet != "":
		return "magnet:" + c.Magnet
	case c.TorrentRef != "":
		return "torrentref:" + c.TorrentRef
	case c.NZBRef != "":
		return "nzbref:" + c.NZBRef
	case c.TorrentURL != "":
		return "torrent:" + c.TorrentURL
	case c.NZBURL != "":
		return "nzb:" + c.NZBURL
	case c.PluginRelease != nil:
		return "plugin:" + c.PluginRelease.Plugin + ":" + c.PluginRelease.ID
	default:
		return c.Title
	}
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/kinds.go#PlayableSource

``````
// PlayableSource is one candidate way to acquire an item's bytes. URL may
// carry {itemIndex}, {pageNumber}, {byteStart}, {byteEnd} and {byteRange}
// placeholders that Ether substitutes.
type PlayableSource struct {
	// Connections requests up to six parallel reads of a range source. Zero uses one.
	Connections int    `json:"connections,omitempty"`
	Path        string `json:"path,omitempty"`
	ID          string `json:"id"`
	Label       string `json:"label,omitempty"`
	Pattern     string `json:"pattern"` // range|download|direct|container|release|file
	MIME        string `json:"mime"`
	// Tier optionally marks interchangeable sources of the same quality tier.
	// Sources sharing a non-nil Tier may be reordered by Ether's source routing
	// (auto/usenet/debrid, measured startup, and stall demotion) and may
	// overtake each other after the ranked open grace period. Distinct tiers
	// keep the plugin's tier order; omitting Tier keeps exact plugin order.
	Tier *int  `json:"tier,omitempty"`
	Size int64 `json:"size,omitempty"`
	// SizeApproximate marks Size as an approximate hint (for example from a
	// Usenet release_files estimate) rather than an exact byte count.
	SizeApproximate bool    `json:"sizeApproximate,omitempty"`
	DurationSec     float64 `json:"durationSec,omitempty"`
	// DurationToleranceSec opts into open-time container duration verification
	// when DurationSec > 0: Ether reads the container duration (reusing the
	// durable release_probes cache) and refuses the source as wrong content
	// when the observed duration differs from DurationSec by more than this
	// tolerance, trying the next candidate and flagging the plugin answer.
	DurationToleranceSec  float64           `json:"durationToleranceSec,omitempty"`
	URL                   string            `json:"url,omitempty"`
	Headers               map[string]string `json:"headers,omitempty"`
	KeepHeadersOnRedirect []string          `json:"keepHeadersOnRedirect,omitempty"`
	BlobRef               string            `json:"blobRef,omitempty"`
	SHA256                string            `json:"sha256,omitempty"`
	// SHA1 and CRC32 are hex digests checked against the served bytes,
	// including a release's selected file or container member; Size too.
	SHA1      string         `json:"sha1,omitempty"`
	CRC32     string         `json:"crc32,omitempty"`
	MaxBytes  int64          `json:"maxBytes,omitempty"`
	ExpiresAt int64          `json:"expiresAt,omitempty"`
	Container *ContainerRef  `json:"container,omitempty"`
	Release   *ReleaseHint   `json:"release,omitempty"`
	Parts     []KindItemPart `json:"parts,omitempty"`
}
``````

``````
	FileHint       string     `json:"fileHint,omitempty"`
	Track          *TrackHint `json:"track,omitempty"`

	// "Cached torrents only" off. Omit or leave false to follow the owner's debrid setting.

	// try a cached-only add instead of trusting a checkcached miss.
``````

## Source: sdk/go/kinds.go#*Context.StreamURL

``````
// StreamURL mints a short-lived, scoped ticket for one of this plugin's own
// kind items and returns the Ether stream URL to embed in a frontend adapter
// response (spec §6.5). The viewer is taken from the request's X-Ether-Viewer
// header, which Ether injects after authenticating; the plugin never sees a
// credential. Bytes are served by Ether from the ticket, never by the plugin.
func (c *Context) StreamURL(itemRef string) (string, error) {
	if c.Ether == nil {
		return "", errors.New("stream url: no host service available")
	}
	viewerID, err := strconv.ParseInt(strings.TrimSpace(c.Headers["X-Ether-Viewer"]), 10, 64)
	if err != nil || viewerID <= 0 {
		return "", errors.New("stream url: no authenticated viewer on this request")
	}
	return c.Ether.StreamURL(c.Context, viewerID, itemRef)
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/kinds.go#*Context.StreamPartURL

``````
// StreamPartURL mints a short-lived, scoped ticket for one zero-based part of
// a multi-file kind item (#576) and returns the Ether stream URL to embed in a
// frontend adapter response.
func (c *Context) StreamPartURL(itemRef string, partIndex int) (string, error) {
	if partIndex < 0 {
		return "", errors.New("stream url: partIndex must be non-negative")
	}
	return c.StreamURLWithOptions(itemRef, StreamURLOptions{PartIndex: &partIndex})
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/kinds.go#*Context.StreamURLWithOptions

``````
// StreamURLWithOptions mints a short-lived, scoped ticket for one of this
// plugin's own kind items, optionally pinned to a zero-based part and/or a
// specific resolver PlayableSource.ID (#576, #661) and optionally resolved to
// an absolute URL (#772).
func (c *Context) StreamURLWithOptions(itemRef string, opts StreamURLOptions) (string, error) {
	if opts.Wait != nil && opts.Wait.MaxSeconds <= 0 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("stream url: wait.maxSeconds must be a positive integer")
	}
	if c.Ether == nil {
		return "", errors.New("stream url: no host service available")
	}
	if opts.PartIndex != nil && *opts.PartIndex < 0 {
		return "", errors.New("stream url: partIndex must be non-negative")
	}
	if opts.Fallback && opts.Source == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("stream url: fallback requires a source")
	}
	if opts.Source != "" && strings.TrimSpace(opts.Source) == "" {
		return "", errors.New("stream url: source must not be blank")
	}
	viewerID, err := strconv.ParseInt(strings.TrimSpace(c.Headers["X-Ether-Viewer"]), 10, 64)
	if err != nil || viewerID <= 0 {
		return "", errors.New("stream url: no authenticated viewer on this request")
	}
	ctx := c.Context
	if tok := c.viewerToken(); tok != "" {
		ctx = WithViewerToken(ctx, tok)
	}
	if oh, ok := c.Ether.(StreamURLOptionsHost); ok {
		return oh.StreamURLWithOptions(ctx, viewerID, itemRef, opts)
	}
	if opts.Source != "" {
		return "", errors.New("stream url: host does not support source-scoped stream tickets")
	}
	if opts.Absolute {
		return "", errors.New("stream url: host does not support absolute stream URLs")
	}
	if opts.Wait != nil {
		return "", errors.New("stream url: host does not support preparation waits")
	}
	if opts.PartIndex != nil {
		if ph, ok := c.Ether.(PartStreamHost); ok {
			return ph.StreamPartURL(ctx, viewerID, itemRef, *opts.PartIndex)
		}
		u, err := c.Ether.StreamURL(ctx, viewerID, itemRef)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		sep := "?"
		if strings.Contains(u, "?") {
			sep = "&"
		}
		return u + sep + "part=" + strconv.Itoa(*opts.PartIndex), nil
	}
	return c.Ether.StreamURL(ctx, viewerID, itemRef)
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/kinds.go#*Context.RequestNZB

``````
// RequestNZB opens an indexer search reference and returns a file list and vault reference.
func (c *Context) RequestNZB(ref string) (SourceCandidate, error) {
	res, err := c.ResolveSourcesWithResult(SourceQuery{Kind: "nzb_request", NZBRef: ref})
	if err != nil {
		return SourceCandidate{}, err
	}
	if len(res.Candidates) != 1 || res.Candidates[0].NZBRef == "" {
		return SourceCandidate{}, errors.New("nzb_request returned no vault reference")
	}
	return res.Candidates[0], nil
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/kinds.go#*Context.ResolveSourcesWithResult

``````
// ResolveSourcesWithResult runs sources.resolve and returns both the candidate
// list and per-indexer search statuses for indexer_search queries (#733).
// Falls back to Host.ResolveSources when the host does not implement
// ResolveSourcesResultHost.
func (c *Context) ResolveSourcesWithResult(q SourceQuery) (SourceResolveResult, error) {
	if c.Ether == nil {
		return SourceResolveResult{}, errors.New("resolve sources: no host service available")
	}
	if rh, ok := c.Ether.(ResolveSourcesResultHost); ok {
		return rh.ResolveSourcesWithResult(c.Context, q)
	}
	cands, err := c.Ether.ResolveSources(c.Context, q)
	if err != nil {
		return SourceResolveResult{}, err
	}
	if cands == nil {
		cands = []SourceCandidate{}
	}
	return SourceResolveResult{Candidates: cands}, nil
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/kinds.go#*Context.viewerToken

``````
func (c *Context) viewerToken() string {
	if tok := strings.TrimSpace(headerValue(c.Headers, HeaderViewerToken)); tok != "" {
		return tok
	}
	if tok, ok := ViewerTokenFromContext(c.Context); ok {
		return tok
	}
	return ""
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/kinds.go#*Context.KindVisible

``````
// KindVisible evaluates the library's Rules and viewer access policy for a
// bounded batch (at most MaxKindVisibleIDs) of external IDs in kindKey (#615).
// Only frontend adapter requests carrying Ether's authenticated viewer token
// may call it.
func (c *Context) KindVisible(kindKey string, ids []string) ([]string, error) {
	if c.Ether == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("kinds.visible: no host service available")
	}
	kh, ok := c.Ether.(KindPolicyHost)
	if !ok {
		return nil, errors.New("kinds.visible: host client does not implement KindPolicyHost")
	}
	tok := c.viewerToken()
	if tok == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("kinds.visible: no authenticated frontend adapter viewer on this request")
	}
	return kh.KindVisible(WithViewerToken(c.Context, tok), kindKey, ids)
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/kinds.go#*Context.KindBrowse

``````
// KindBrowse browses or searches kindKey with the library's Rules and viewer
// access policy applied for the requesting frontend-adapter viewer (#615).
// Only frontend adapter requests carrying Ether's authenticated viewer token
// may call it.
func (c *Context) KindBrowse(kindKey string, query KindBrowseQuery) (KindPage, error) {
	if c.Ether == nil {
		return KindPage{}, errors.New("kinds.browse: no host service available")
	}
	kh, ok := c.Ether.(KindPolicyHost)
	if !ok {
		return KindPage{}, errors.New("kinds.browse: host client does not implement KindPolicyHost")
	}
	tok := c.viewerToken()
	if tok == "" {
		return KindPage{}, errors.New("kinds.browse: no authenticated frontend adapter viewer on this request")
	}
	return kh.KindBrowse(WithViewerToken(c.Context, tok), kindKey, query)
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/kinds.go#*Plugin.dispatchKinds

``````
// dispatchKinds handles the /ether/v1/kinds, /ether/v1/setup and
// /ether/v1/frontend route families. It reports false when the path is
// none of them so Dispatch can fall through to its 404.
func (p *Plugin) dispatchKinds(pctx *Context, method, path string, req RawRequest) (RawResponse, bool) {
	if !strings.HasPrefix(path, "/ether/v1/") {
		return RawResponse{}, false
	}
	rest := strings.TrimPrefix(path, "/ether/v1/")
	parts := strings.Split(rest, "/")
	// Frontend adapters are protocol surfaces (WebDAV, Subsonic, OPDS, …) and
	// see every method token. The kind and setup routes stay JSON GET/POST.
	if parts[0] == "frontend" {
		if len(parts) >= 2 {
			key, _ := url.PathUnescape(parts[1])
			return p.dispatchFrontend(pctx, method, key, "/"+strings.Join(parts[2:], "/"), req), true
		}
		return RawResponse{}, false
	}
	if method != http.MethodPost && method != http.MethodGet {
		return errorJSON(http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "method_not_allowed", "Kind routes use GET or POST."), true
	}
	switch {
	case len(parts) >= 2 && parts[0] == "kinds":
		kind, _ := url.PathUnescape(parts[1])
		return p.dispatchKind(pctx, kind, parts[2:], req), true
	case len(parts) >= 3 && parts[0] == "live":
		feed, _ := url.PathUnescape(parts[1])
		return p.dispatchLiveFeed(pctx, method, feed, parts[2:]), true
	case len(parts) == 4 && (parts[0] == "screens" || parts[0] == "surfaces") && (parts[2] == "sources" || parts[2] == "actions"):
		screen, _ := url.PathUnescape(parts[1])
		name, _ := url.PathUnescape(parts[3])
		return p.dispatchScreen(pctx, method, screen, parts[2], name, req), true
	case len(parts) == 3 && parts[0] == "setup" && parts[2] == "test":
		if p.kindHandlers == nil || p.kindHandlers.setup == nil {
			return errorJSON(http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "Setup test handler is not registered."), true
		}
		var in SetupTestRequest
		if len(req.Body) > 0 {
			if err := json.Unmarshal(req.Body, &in); err != nil {
				return errorJSON(http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_json", "Request body must be valid JSON."), true
			}
		}
		if in.Step == "" {
			in.Step, _ = url.PathUnescape(parts[1])
		}
		res, err := p.kindHandlers.setup.TestSetup(pctx, in)
		if err != nil {
			return toRouteErrorResponse(err), true
		}
		return okJSON(res, http.StatusOK), true
	}
	return RawResponse{}, false
}
``````

``````
func (p *Plugin) dispatchKind(pctx *Context, kind string, tail []string, req RawRequest) RawResponse {
	h := p.kindHandlers
	decode := func(v any) (RawResponse, bool) {
		if len(req.Body) == 0 {
			return RawResponse{}, true
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(req.Body, v); err != nil {
			return errorJSON(http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_json", "Request body must be valid JSON."), false
		}
		return RawResponse{}, true
	}
	switch {
	case len(tail) == 1 && (tail[0] == "browse" || tail[0] == "search"):
		prov := lookup(h, func(k *kindHandlers) CatalogProvider { return k.catalog[kind] })
		if prov == nil {
			return errorJSON(http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", fmt.Sprintf("No catalogue provider is registered for kind %q.", kind))
		}
		var in KindBrowseRequest
		if resp, ok := decode(&in); !ok {
			return resp
		}
		in.Kind = kind
		if in.Limit <= 0 {
			in.Limit = 200
		}
		if tail[0] == "search" {
			sp, isSearch := prov.(SearchProvider)
			if !isSearch {
				return errorJSON(http.StatusNotImplemented, "not_implemented", "This provider does not search.")
			}
			page, err := sp.Search(pctx, in)
			return kindPageResponse(page, err, in.Limit)
		}
		page, err := prov.Browse(pctx, in)
		return kindPageResponse(page, err, in.Limit)
	case len(tail) == 1 && tail[0] == "expand":
		prov := lookup(h, func(k *kindHandlers) CatalogProvider { return k.catalog[kind] })
		ep, isExpand := prov.(ExpandProvider)
		if prov == nil || !isExpand {
			return errorJSON(http.StatusNotImplemented, "not_implemented", "This provider does not expand facets.")
		}
		var in KindExpandRequest
		if resp, ok := decode(&in); !ok {
			return resp
		}
		in.Kind = kind
		res, err := ep.Expand(pctx, in)
		if err != nil {
			return toRouteErrorResponse(err)
		}
		if res.Job == "" && res.Items == nil {
			res.Items = []KindItem{}
		}
		return okJSON(res, http.StatusOK)
	case len(tail) == 1 && tail[0] == "related":
		prov := lookup(h, func(k *kindHandlers) CatalogProvider { return k.catalog[kind] })
		rp, isRelated := prov.(RelatedProvider)
		if prov == nil || !isRelated {
			return errorJSON(http.StatusNotImplemented, "not_implemented", "This provider has no related items.")
		}
		var in KindRelatedRequest
		if resp, ok := decode(&in); !ok {
			return resp
		}
		in.Kind = kind
		res, err := rp.Related(pctx, in)
		if err != nil {
			return toRouteErrorResponse(err)
		}
		if res.Items == nil {
			res.Items = []KindItem{}
		}
		return okJSON(res, http.StatusOK)
	case len(tail) == 1 && tail[0] == "lyrics":
		prov := lookup(h, func(k *kindHandlers) CatalogProvider { return k.catalog[kind] })
		lp, isLyrics := prov.(LyricsProvider)
		if prov == nil || !isLyrics {
			return errorJSON(http.StatusNotImplemented, "not_implemented", "This provider has no lyrics.")
		}
		var in KindLyricsRequest
		if resp, ok := decode(&in); !ok {
			return resp
		}
		in.Kind = kind
		res, found, err := lp.Lyrics(pctx, in)
		if err != nil {
			return toRouteErrorResponse(err)
		}
		if !found {
			return errorJSON(http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "No lyrics for this item.")
		}
		return okJSON(res, http.StatusOK)
	case len(tail) == 2 && tail[0] == "items":
		prov := lookup(h, func(k *kindHandlers) CatalogProvider { return k.catalog[kind] })
		if prov == nil {
			return errorJSON(http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", fmt.Sprintf("No catalogue provider is registered for kind %q.", kind))
		}
		id, _ := url.PathUnescape(tail[1])
		item, err := prov.Detail(pctx, kind, id)
		if err != nil {
			return toRouteErrorResponse(err)
		}
		return okJSON(item, http.StatusOK)
	case len(tail) == 1 && tail[0] == "changes":
		prov := lookup(h, func(k *kindHandlers) CatalogProvider { return k.catalog[kind] })
		cp, isChanges := prov.(ChangesProvider)
		if prov == nil || !isChanges {
			// 404/501 tells Ether to fall back to a re-walk diff.
			return errorJSON(http.StatusNotImplemented, "not_implemented", "This provider has no changes feed.")
		}
		var in KindChangesRequest
		if resp, ok := decode(&in); !ok {
			return resp
		}
		in.Kind = kind
		page, err := cp.Changes(pctx, in)
		if err != nil {
			return toRouteErrorResponse(err)
		}
		if page.Upserts == nil {
			page.Upserts = []KindItem{}
		}
		return okJSON(page, http.StatusOK)
	case len(tail) == 1 && tail[0] == "resolve":
		var r KindResolver
		if h != nil {
			r = h.resolve[kind]
		}
		if r == nil {
			return errorJSON(http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", fmt.Sprintf("No resolver is registered for kind %q.", kind))
		}
		var in KindResolveRequest
		if resp, ok := decode(&in); !ok {
			return resp
		}
		in.Kind = kind
		res, err := r.Resolve(pctx, in)
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, ErrKindNotAvailable) {
				return okJSON(KindResolveResponse{Sources: []PlayableSource{}}, http.StatusOK)
			}
			return toRouteErrorResponse(err)
		}
		if res.Sources == nil {
			res.Sources = []PlayableSource{}
		}
		return okJSON(res, http.StatusOK)
	case len(tail) == 1 && tail[0] == "live":
		var lp KindLiveProvider
		if h != nil {
			lp = h.live[kind]
		}
		if lp == nil {
			return errorJSON(http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", fmt.Sprintf("No live provider is registered for kind %q.", kind))
		}
		var in KindLiveRequest
		if resp, ok := decode(&in); !ok {
			return resp
		}
		in.Kind = kind
		if in.Limit <= 0 {
			in.Limit = 50
		}
		page, err := lp.Live(pctx, in)
		if err != nil {
			return toRouteErrorResponse(err)
		}
		if page.Items == nil {
			page.Items = []KindLiveItem{}
		}
		if in.Limit > 0 && len(page.Items) > in.Limit {
			page.Items = page.Items[:in.Limit]
		}
		return okJSON(page, http.StatusOK)
	case len(tail) == 2 && tail[0] == "live" && tail[1] == "resolve":
		var lp KindLiveProvider
		if h != nil {
			lp = h.live[kind]
		}
		if lp == nil {
			return errorJSON(http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", fmt.Sprintf("No live provider is registered for kind %q.", kind))
		}
		var in KindLiveResolveRequest
		if resp, ok := decode(&in); !ok {
			return resp
		}
		in.Kind = kind
		res, err := lp.ResolveLive(pctx, in)
		if err != nil {
			return toRouteErrorResponse(err)
		}
		return okJSON(res, http.StatusOK)
	case len(tail) == 1 && tail[0] == "match":
		var m KindMatcher
		if h != nil {
			m = h.match[kind]
		}
		if m == nil {
			return errorJSON(http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", fmt.Sprintf("No matcher is registered for kind %q.", kind))
		}
		var in KindMatchRequest
		if resp, ok := decode(&in); !ok {
			return resp
		}
		in.Kind = kind
		res, err := m.Match(pctx, in)
		if err != nil {
			return toRouteErrorResponse(err)
		}
		if res.Matches == nil {
			res.Matches = []KindMatchScore{}
		}
		return okJSON(res, http.StatusOK)
	}
	return errorJSON(http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "No kind route matched.")
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/kinds.go#kindPageResponse

``````
// kindPageResponse enforces the page contract: never more than limit
// items (Ether treats an oversized page as a contract error).
func kindPageResponse(page KindPage, err error, limit int) RawResponse {
	if err != nil {
		return toRouteErrorResponse(err)
	}
	if limit > 0 && len(page.Items) > limit {
		page.Items = page.Items[:limit]
	}
	if page.Items == nil {
		page.Items = []KindItem{}
	}
	return okJSON(page, http.StatusOK)
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/kinds.go#*Plugin.dispatchFrontend

``````
func (p *Plugin) dispatchFrontend(pctx *Context, method, key, subPath string, req RawRequest) RawResponse {
	var a FrontendAdapter
	if p.kindHandlers != nil {
		a = p.kindHandlers.frontend[key]
	}
	if a == nil || a.Handler() == nil {
		return errorJSON(http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", fmt.Sprintf("No frontend adapter is registered for %q.", key))
	}
	if subPath == "/" || subPath == "" {
		subPath = "/"
	}
	// Protocol adapters (Subsonic, OPDS, WebDAV) carry their arguments in the
	// query string; the server relays them, so rebuild the request URL with
	// the original query. The server flattens repeated keys to the first
	// value, so a query map holds one value per key.
	_, query := parsePathAndQuery(req.Path, req.Query)
	target := "http://ether.invalid" + subPath
	if len(query) > 0 {
		target += "?" + encodeQuery(query)
	}
	reqCtx := pctx.Context
	if tok := headerValue(req.Headers, HeaderViewerToken); tok != "" {
		reqCtx = WithViewerToken(reqCtx, tok)
		pctx.Context = reqCtx
	}
	reqCtx = context.WithValue(reqCtx, frontendContextKey{}, pctx)
	upload := req.Upload
	if headerValue(req.Headers, frontendUploadHeader) == "1" {
		upload = new(FrontendUpload)
		if err := json.Unmarshal(req.Body, upload); err != nil {
			return errorJSON(http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_upload", "Invalid frontend upload metadata.")
		}
	}
	bodyBytes := req.Body
	if upload != nil {
		reqCtx = context.WithValue(reqCtx, frontendUploadKey{}, upload)
		bodyBytes = nil
	}
	httpReq := httptest.NewRequestWithContext(reqCtx, method, target, bytes.NewReader(bodyBytes))
	for k, v := range req.Headers {
		httpReq.Header.Set(k, v)
	}
	if upload != nil {
		httpReq.Header.Del(frontendUploadHeader)
		httpReq.Header.Del("Content-Type")
		if upload.ContentType != "" {
			httpReq.Header.Set("Content-Type", upload.ContentType)
		}
	}
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	a.Handler().ServeHTTP(rec, httpReq)
	res := rec.Result()
	defer res.Body.Close()
	body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(res.Body, maxFrontendBody+1))
	if err != nil {
		return errorJSON(http.StatusBadGateway, "adapter_error", err.Error())
	}
	if len(body) > maxFrontendBody {
		return errorJSON(http.StatusBadGateway, "adapter_error", "Frontend adapter response is larger than 10 MiB; serve media through Ether stream URLs.")
	}
	hdrs := map[string]string{}
	for k := range res.Header {
		hdrs[k] = res.Header.Get(k)
	}
	// A HEAD reply carries headers only, exactly as a real server would.
	if method == http.MethodHead {
		body = nil
	}
	return RawResponse{Status: res.StatusCode, Headers: hdrs, BinaryBody: body}
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/kinds.go#encodeQuery

``````
// encodeQuery renders a query map back into a raw query string, preserving
// key order is unnecessary; values are escaped so adapters see what the
// viewer sent.
func encodeQuery(query map[string]string) string {
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(query))
	for k := range query {
		keys = append(keys, k)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)
	parts := make([]string, 0, len(keys))
	for _, k := range keys {
		parts = append(parts, url.QueryEscape(k)+"="+url.QueryEscape(query[k]))
	}
	return strings.Join(parts, "&")
}
``````
